paragraph1: SUMMARYIndian startups managed to raise a mere $146.7 Mn between November 23 and November 27, down 49.3% from $291.3 Mn raised in the previous week AI topped the sectoral funding charts, with five startups cumulatively raising over $64 Mn this week Fintech was the second-most funded sector this week as two startups raised $53.8 Mn. Finnable’s $43.8 Mn round accounted for nearly 81% of the sector’s total haul The Indian startup funding market ended November on a softer note. business as usual as AI led the funding charts.
paragraph3: Five AI startups cumulatively raised over $64 Mn this week, buoyed primarily by enterprise AI startup Aiden AI’s $32 Mn funding round. Fintech emerged as the second most funded sector, with two startups raising a combined $53.8 Mn. A closer look, however, shows that Finnable’s $43.8 Mn round accounted for nearly 81% of the sector’s total funding this week. Advanced hardware and technology and ecommerce sectors minted three deals each, but raised $16.67 Mn and $12.1 Mn, respectively. Meanwhile, edtech recorded a single round worth over $1 Mn. Pre-seed and seed-stage startups raised $820K across two deals.
paragraph4: A third pre-seed venture did not disclose the size of its fundraise. Startup Fund Updates This Week PE firm GEF Capital Partners marked the first close of its fourth India-focused climate fund at $615 Mn. Impact investor Lok Capital also announced the first close of its fifth fund at $130 Mn. The fund, which will focus on financial inclusion, climate and sustainability, has a target corpus of $200-250 Mn. US-based VC firm VU Venture Partners, an early backer of OpenAI, SpaceX and Uber, entered the Indian market. It plans to back seed and Series A startups across nine sectors, with cheque sizes ranging between $100K to $1 Mn. Bengaluru-based VC firm Aeravti Ventures announced the launch of its second fund, with a target corpus of ₹300 Cr. It claims to have already secured commitments worth over ₹150 Cr, and expects to mark the final close within six months. CortexSpark Ventures, founded by former Infosys executives Vinay Peshwa and Sanjay Khanduri, launched its debut fund with a target corpus of ₹1,000 Cr. The fund, which also has an additional greenshoe option of ₹400 Cr, will back deeptech and AI startups.
paragraph5: Startup M&As This Week CredAble acquired a 70% stake in AI-native regulatory intelligence startup Reql to expand its banking technology portfolio. Shadowfax is acquiring the Indian entity of intra-city delivery platform Borzo (formerly WeFast) for ₹23.3 Cr. Other Developments Of The Week Cold-chain logistics startup Celcius Logistics is in advanced talks to raise ₹100 Cr in a Pre-Series C funding round from existing backers IvyCap Ventures, Omnivore and Eurazeo. New investor Centricity could potentially also join the fundraise. Electronics design and manufacturing startup Elecbits is in talks to raise $12-15 Mn in a fresh funding round, which will likely be led by PE firm Xponentia Capital.

title: The M5 MacBook Air just got its biggest discount since Apple raised the price
title_bn: The M5 MacBook Air just got its biggest discount since Apple raised the price
author: TechPulse
excerpt: If you’ve been holding off on buying a new MacBook Air since Apple raised prices by $200 in June, you’re in luck. The 13-inch M5 MacBook Air is on sale at Amazon and Best Buy with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage starting at $999 ($300 off) for Black
paragraph1: Skip to main contentThe new promo drops Apple’s 13-incher to within $100 of its all-time low, easing the sting of recent price hikes.The new promo drops Apple’s 13-incher to within $100 of its all-time low, easing the sting of recent price hikes.by Sheena VasaniNov 28, 2026, 3:30 AM UTCSheena Vasani writes about tech news, reviews gadgets, and helps readers save money by highlighting deals and product recommendations for The Verge.If you’ve been holding off on buying a new MacBook Air since Apple raised prices by $200 in June, you’re in luck.
paragraph2: The 13-inch M5 MacBook Air is on sale at Amazon and Best Buy with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage starting at $999 ($300 off) for Black Friday, which is the lowest price we’ve seen since the hike. If you want a larger display, Amazon and Best Buy are also taking $300 off the otherwise identical 15-inch model with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage, dropping it to $1,199.$999$1199The M5-equipped MacBook Air is a good middle ground if you need more power than the MacBook Neo — which, thanks to a $100 discount, is $599 — but don’t want to splurge on a MacBook Pro. Its faster chip, 16GB of RAM, and 512GB of storage make it better suited for multitasking and creative work in apps like Photoshop and Premiere.
paragraph3: You also get a higher-resolution display, better speakers, a backlit keyboard that makes typing in the dark easier, and faster ports. Plus, its sharper webcam supports Apple’s Center Stage feature, which automatically adjusts the framing to keep you in view during video calls.Of course, the Air can’t match the performance or higher-end displays you can get with a MacBook Pro, whether you opt for an M5 model, the newer M5 Pro model with a PROLED XDR Display, or one of the M6-powered machines. A Pro may be worth the extra money if you regularly edit video or work on more demanding creative projects.
paragraph4: But if you mostly need a laptop for work, browsing, and occasional photo or video editing, the M5 Air is more than capable.Verge ShoppingSign up to get the best deals on products we’ve found and tested sent to your inbox.Email (required)Follow topics and authors from this story to see more like this in your personalized homepage feed and to receive email updates.Sheena VasaniVerge ShoppingSign up to get the best deals on products we’ve found and tested sent to your inbox.

paragraph4: They still offer great ANC, a timeless foldable design, and delivering performance nearly on par with Sony’s newer flagships at a fraction of the cost.$54Govee’s Table Lamp 2 is way more fun than your average table lamp. It also has USB ports so you can charge your phone, ensuring you always have a backup plan.$299The Ring 5 is a fantastic entry point for new users. While short on improvements over its thicker predecessor, it’s hard not to appreciate that it manages to deliver similar battery life despite being thinner. It delivers up to 24 hours of battery life, with a built-in loop for easy carrying. You can also use it as a power bank and pair it with other Sonos speakers over Bluetooth when Wi-Fi isn’t available.

The batteries themselves are long-lasting, too.$35007 First Light, a third-person stealth action game from the studio behind Hitman, is one of the best action games we’ve played this year. title: The best Black Friday deals you can still get on AirPods, Macs, and other Apple gear
title_bn: The best Black Friday deals you can still get on AirPods, Macs, and other Apple gear
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Black Friday is entering the evening, which means one of the best times of the year to save some cash on a new pair of AirPods or the latest Apple Watch is coming to a close. After all, the holiday savings can help offset the unfortunate price hikes
paragraph1: Skip to main contentWe dug up the biggest price drops on Apple hardware and accessories before Black Friday officially ends.We dug up the biggest price drops on Apple hardware and accessories before Black Friday officially ends.by Brad Bourque and Sheena VasaniUpdated Nov 27, 2026, 11:53 PM UTCBlack Friday is entering the evening, which means one of the best times of the year to save some cash on a new pair of AirPods or the latest Apple Watch is coming to a close. After all, the holiday savings can help offset the unfortunate price hikes from earlier this year, when Apple raised the cost of some of its most popular gear. Some discounts still apply to recent releases like the Apple Watch Series 12 and touchscreen MacBook Pro, too, which are available at their lowest prices to date.In addition to a variety of discounts across retailers, Apple is offering up to $300 in gift cards with select purchases between November 27th and November 30th. How much you get back is determined by how much you spend, with up to $100 available for some iPhone and Apple Watch purchases, and up to $300 for the 16-inch MacBook Pro. That said, in some cases you may be able to save more by buying from other retailers.Earbud and headphone deals$149The latest AirPods Pro offer improved noise cancellation and richer bass, along with built-in heart sensors that work with Apple’s Fitness app to monitor calories burned across more than 50 workouts. Read our review.$180Beats’ fitness-focused earbuds feature ear hooks designed to stay put during even the most intense workouts as well as built-in heart rate monitoring. They also deliver relatively bass-rich sound for their design, along with solid noise cancellation, wireless charging, and AirPods features like adaptive audio thanks to Apple’s H2 chip. Read our review.You can buy the AirPods 4 on sale at Walmart for around $89 ($40 off), which is $20 shy of their best price. Apple’s last-gen earbuds lack active noise cancellation, but they still deliver good, relatively bass-rich sound, even if they don’t quite match the newer AirPods 5. They also offer voice call quality on par with the latest AirPods Pro.
paragraph2: Read our review.The second-gen AirPods Max are down to $419 ($130 off) at Amazon and Best Buy, which is $19 shy of their best price to date (Target also has them for about $10 more). Like the original, Apple’s latest over-ear headphones feature a luxurious build consisting of aluminum, steel, and a mesh fabric, but they offer better sound and noise cancellation. The new H2 chip also enables features like adaptive audio and live translation. Read our review.$99The latest Beats Studio Pro feature improved noise cancellation, sound quality, and comfort. They also support lossless audio over USB-C and offer native support for a range of iOS and Android features like other Beats headphones. Read our review.$249The Beats 360 are ANC headphones for people who prefer headphones over earbuds at the gym. They’re Beats’ first IP-rated cans, with ear cushions that you can easily remove for cleaning (or style points). They also stay in place during most exercises, while still delivering solid bass. Read our review.If you want over-ears and are comfortable going without active noise cancellation, the Beats Solo 4 are on sale starting at $79.99 ($120 off) at Amazon and Target — a new low price. The headphones are a noticeable improvement over their predecessor, delivering more detailed sound and support for lossless audio. They also last up to 50 hours on a single charge, while their memory foam ear cushions make them comfortable enough for long listening sessions.
paragraph3: Read our review.The Beats Studio Buds Plus are down to around $89.95 ($80 off) at Amazon, Best Buy, and Target, nearly matching their lowest price to date. The wireless earbuds feature a slick, eye-catching transparent option and solid noise cancellation, especially at this price. They’re also exceptionally comfortable, with four ear tip sizes to help you find a secure fit. Sure, you don’t get wireless charging, but they offer IPX4 water resistance and up to nine hours of battery life on a single charge. Read our review.MacBook deals$599Apple’s most affordable laptop uses the same A18 Pro chip found in the iPhone 16 Pro. It features a vibrant 13-inch display, surprisingly good speakers, and 8GB of RAM, making it a solid option for students and anyone who needs a laptop for everyday tasks. Read our review.$999Apple’s latest MacBook Air features an M5 chip and starts with 512GB of storage, with significantly faster performance than prior generations. It’s still an excellent machine despite the higher base price, especially given the battery life and speakers. Read our review.The recently released 16.3-inch MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display, 24GB of RAM, and 1TB of storage is on sale starting at $3,099 ($300 off) — a new low price — at Amazon. The redesigned laptop is Apple’s first with an OLED touchscreen, which allows for rich colors and deep blacks.
paragraph4: It’s also noticeably thinner and lighter than the non-touchscreen 16-inch MacBook Pro, and features a new Dynamic Island that replaces the notch and provides quick access to controls and notifications. Read our review.The 14-inch M6-powered MacBook Pro is on sale starting at $1,749 ($250 off) at Amazon and Best Buy, which is a new low price. The Pro builds on its predecessor with a faster chip and support for Wi-Fi 7. In our testing, it handled multitasking, photo editing, and occasional video editing with ease while still delivering exceptional battery life. It lacks the newer MacBook Pro’s gorgeous OLED display, but its Mini LED screen still looks great, especially given its smooth 120Hz refresh rate. It also offers excellent speakers and a good selection of ports, including three Thunderbolt 4 ports, HDMI, and an SD card slot. Read our review.Apple Watch deals$299The Apple Watch Series 12 introduces AI-powered Audio Intelligence features, including sound recognition alerts, Live Rewind, and Siri Recap. It can also track your heart rate every five seconds, even when you’re not exercising, and offers faster charging than prior models. Read our review.The Apple Watch SE 3 is on sale in the 40mm / GPS configuration starting at $179 ($50 off) at Amazon and Walmart, matching its best price to date, while Best Buy is currently $20 higher. Apple’s newest entry-level smartwatch remains our top recommendation for anyone who wants a basic fitness tracker, as it offers all the essentials alongside an always-on display and Apple’s S10 chip, which enables on-device Siri requests. Read our review.AirTags, chargers, and other deals$18Apple’s latest AirTags feature an upgraded ultra-wideband chip for more precise location tracking, a noticeably louder speaker, and an expanded Bluetooth range. Read our review.
paragraph5: $52The Baseus PicoGo AM52 is a 10,000mAh magnetic power bank that supports fast 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging and up to 45W wired charging via its built-in USB-C cable. It was one of the fastest wireless chargers we tested, bringing an iPhone 17 Pro Max to 65 percent in an hour. Read our guide to the best Qi2 batteries.$379Apple’s 11th-gen iPad offers 128GB of storage — twice that of its predecessor — and runs on a faster A16 chip. It also comes in four colors: blue, pink, yellow, and silver.You can buy the last-gen iPad Mini with 128GB of storage and Wi-Fi on Amazon in select colors for $484 ($115 off), which is the best price we’ve seen since Apple’s recent price hikes. It has a smaller screen and a slower chip than the newer model, and it lacks an OLED screen, the Acoustic Display, and water resistance. Still, it’s a great option for reading and everyday use that’s currently more affordable than its $599 successor, with support for Apple Intelligence and the Apple Pencil Pro. Read our review.Apple’s latest Magic Mouse is matching its all-time low of $59.99 ($20 off) at Amazon.

title: The best robot vacuums we’ve tested are up to 60 percent off for Black Friday
title_bn: The best robot vacuums we’ve tested are up to 60 percent off for Black Friday
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Black Friday is here, and if you want a little help keeping your floors clean this holiday season, now is a great time to pick up a robot vacuum. Some of the best models we’ve tested over the last year or two are on sale for up to 60 percent off, whe
paragraph1: Sheena Vasani writes about tech news, reviews gadgets, and helps readers save money by highlighting deals and product recommendations for The Verge.Black Friday is here, and if you want a little help keeping your floors clean this holiday season, now is a great time to pick up a robot vacuum. Some of the best models we’ve tested over the last year or two are on sale for up to 60 percent off, whether you’re after a basic robovac for quick cleanups or a more advanced model that vacuums, mops, and practically takes care of itself.This year’s sale has made some pricier robot vacuums a lot more affordable. The Eufy Omni C28, for example, now costs about what you’d expect to pay for a budget bot, while the Matic — which impressed us with its almost humanlike navigation — is getting a rare discount in the form of a bundle. If none of those are quite what you’re looking for, we’ve also found good deals on models from Roborock, Dreame, and more, with picks below for a variety of budgets and cleaning needs.$550Roborock’s first roller-mop robot vacuum, the Curv 2 Flow, features flagship specs at a midrange price, including excellent mopping, a retractable mop cover, 20,000Pa suction, AI-powered obstacle avoidance, and a compact design. Read our review.
paragraph2: $230Despite lacking a multifunction dock, the budget-friendly robot vacuum and mop offers an impressive set of features for the price, including AI-powered obstacle avoidance, sonic mopping, automatic mop lifting, and a self-emptying dock.$1395The Matic robot vacuum and mop is ideal for cluttered homes with pets, multiple floors, and a mixture of carpets and hardwood. It offers almost humanlike navigation, tackling high-pile rugs and mopping up wet spills. The quiet bot also requires less maintenance than many rivals thanks to its onboard water tank and dust bag. Read our review.$380The Eufy Omni C28 combines excellent mopping performance with a small self-cleaning dock that’s well suited for apartments and other smaller spaces. It navigates around furniture and into tight areas with ease, while its roller mop does a great job cleaning hard floors.$1000The Dreame X60 Ultra is a powerful robot vacuum and mop that does a great job of cleaning carpets thanks to its dual roller brushes and 35,000Pa of suction.
paragraph3: It can climb over tall thresholds, squeeze under low furniture, and automatically detach its mop pads when vacuuming carpets.$900The Narwal Flow 2 is an excellent robot vacuum for hardwood floors. A superb mop with a wide flat roller pad and a good vacuum, the Flow 2 also has top-notch navigation and obstacle detection. Its sleek base station is also less of an eyesore than most models. Read our review.$990Roborock’s Saros 20 stands out for its ability to climb tall thresholds, avoid obstacles with impressive accuracy, and clean under low furniture thanks to its slim design. It also combines powerful 36,000Pa suction with great spinning mop pads, which is why we recommend it for homes with multiple floor types and tricky transitions between rooms.$749Ecovacs’ robot vacuum and mop can pretreat stains, keep carpets dry with a smart mop cover, and deliver powerful 22,000Pa suction.
paragraph4: It also includes an all-in-one dock that automatically empties the dustbin, refills the water tanks, and washes the mop with heated, pressurized water.$160The Matter-compatible SwitchBot K11 Plus is ideal for small apartments, bedrooms, and home offices. It can easily navigate around chair and desk legs and into tight spaces that most other bots miss. It also features a commendable 6,000Pa of suction power — which is great for this price point — and works well on both hardwood and carpet.$800With high suction power, an improved brush system, and the ability to scale thresholds up to 6cm, the X50 Ultra stands out as a great robot vacuum-mop hybrid. While its 20,000Pa suction isn’t quite as powerful as the X60 Ultra’s and it can’t tackle especially high thresholds as well, it’s still an excellent option. Its edge cleaning also isn’t quite as effective as the X60 Ultra’s, but you’re otherwise getting many of the same features for a lot less.$475The Dreame L40 Ultra Gen 2 delivers powerful 25,000Pa suction, AI-powered obstacle avoidance, and a self-cleaning dock that empties the dustbin, washes the mop, and refills its water tanks.
paragraph5: Unlike the X50 Ultra, however, it lacks the ability to climb high thresholds or stairs.$400The Freo X Ultra features spinning triangular mop pads and can swing slightly to reach baseboards. Its large charging dock holds two big water tanks, while Narwal’s disposable onboard bin compresses the dust. It’s also relatively quiet when it returns to the dock, and its anti-tangle brush and 8,200Pa of suction perform well on most carpets.Verge ShoppingSign up to get the best deals on products we’ve found and tested sent to your inbox.Email (required)Follow topics and authors from this story to see more like this in your personalized homepage feed and to receive email updates.

title: Yooka-Laylee’s free upgrade is skipping Xbox
title_bn: Yooka-Laylee’s free upgrade is skipping Xbox
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Playtronic Games is getting ready to launch Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition as a free update on PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and PC on December 15th. Unfortunately for Xbox owners, the developer says it "can't commit to any addit
paragraph1: Terrence O'Brien is the Verge’s weekend editor. He’s covered the tech industry for over 18 years and knows a thing or two about synths.
paragraph2: Playtronic Games is getting ready to launch Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition as a free update on PlayStation 5, Switch 2, and PC on December 15th. Unfortunately for Xbox owners, the developer says it “can’t commit to any additional platforms for the foreseeable future.
paragraph3: ” In a statement posted on X, Playtronic said that it understands the frustration some players may feel, but that bringing the Definitive Edition to Xbox just isn’t viable “given the technological challenges and costs,” and reminded people that they’re a small team.Some, like The Game Business editor-in-chief Christopher Dring, have speculated that Xbox’s smaller install base has made it harder for some indie devs to “financially justify” launching on Xbox.
paragraph4: Others, like John Linneman of Digital Foundry, have countered that Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition is ultimately a minor update and pointed out that the Xbox Series X version was already available in native 4K, unlike the PS4 and Switch versions.Follow topics and authors from this story to see more like this in your personalized homepage feed and to receive email updates.

excerpt: We were big fans of Apple’s new iPad Mini when we reviewed it in early November, but its steep starting price of $699 was hard to swallow. Thankfully, the small tablet is already getting a sizable discount for Black Friday. Right now, Amazon and Walm
paragraph1: Skip to main contentApple’s most portable tablet offers a larger OLED screen and water resistance.Apple’s most portable tablet offers a larger OLED screen and water resistance.by Sheena VasaniNov 27, 2026, 10:30 PM UTCSheena Vasani writes about tech news, reviews gadgets, and helps readers save money by highlighting deals and product recommendations for The Verge.We were big fans of Apple’s new iPad Mini when we reviewed it in early November, but its steep starting price of $699 was hard to swallow.
paragraph2: Thankfully, the small tablet is already getting a sizable discount for Black Friday. Right now, Amazon and Walmart are both selling the 2026 iPad Mini with Wi-Fi and 128GB of storage starting at $599 ($100 off), its lowest price to date.$599The new Mini is a notable upgrade over its predecessor, with a larger 8.5-inch OLED display that delivers deeper blacks and better contrast than the previous model’s 8.
paragraph3: 3-inch LCD. Despite the bigger screen, the tablet itself is smaller and lighter, making it easier to carry. Apple also added IP67 dust and water resistance, so you have less reason to worry about where you use it. As my colleague David Pierce noted in his review, that made a big difference in his day-to-day use; he felt more comfortable handing the Mini to his spill-prone toddler or keeping it nearby in the kitchen to follow recipes.
paragraph4: He even took it into the shower to keep watching a football game.The upgraded A20 Pro chip also made apps load faster and demanding games run better in Pierce’s testing, while battery life held steady at around nine hours of screentime. At $599, though, the new Mini is still relatively expensive if you mainly want a tablet for browsing the web or streaming shows. The last-gen iPad Mini, which runs on Apple’s A17 Pro chip, is available for under $500 if you’d rather save another $100 and can live without the OLED screen and water resistance.
paragraph5: But if you’ve been waiting for a more worthwhile upgrade to Apple’s smallest tablet, the current Black Friday discount makes the new model easier to justify.$484Verge ShoppingSign up to get the best deals on products we’ve found and tested sent to your inbox.Email (required)Follow topics and authors from this story to see more like this in your personalized homepage feed and to receive email updates.Sheena VasaniVerge ShoppingSign up to get the best deals on products we’ve found and tested sent to your inbox.

title: AYANEO’s latest KONKR Pocket Advance color nails that classic translucent GBA look
title_bn: AYANEO এর সর্বশেষ KONKR পকেট অ্যাডভান্স রঙের নখ যে ক্লাসিক ট্রান্সলিউসেন্ট GBA চেহারা
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The Ice Blue KONKR Pocket Advance is the spitting image of Nintendo's GBA in Glacier.
paragraph1: AYANEOAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR AYANEO has a new special-edition KONKR Pocket Advance, with an Ice Blue color. Compared to the initial colors launched this past summer, Ice Blue is available with as much as 6GB of RAM, up from 4GB. Sales begin at $109, and AYANEO says that shipments will get started this month.
paragraph2: We are pretty shamelessly in love with retro-focused gaming handhelds around here, and earlier this year AYANEO launched its love letter to the Game Boy Advance, the KONKR Pocket Advance — now it’s rounding November out with the introduction of a new color option that’s just a perfect throwback to the original hardware.Sales of the Pocket Advance got started this past August, with Navy, Coral, and Grey available as the initial color options. We’ve seen a few more special editions arrive since then, but today’s addition is seriously putting out those classic GBA vibes with its new Ice Blue colorway.
paragraph3: AYANEOIt is just impossible for us to look at this and not flash back to the original GBA’s “Glacier” translucent model — which, if you were a good early aughts kid, was obviously the best choice.Sadly, the initial $89 pricing is long gone, but at least you can pick up the new Ice Blue model for the same $109 the other colors are going for in their 32GB storage, 3GB RAM configuration, or upgrade to 64GB storage and 6GB RAM for just $139 (discounted from $129 and $159, respectively). That latter option offers an extra 2GB of RAM on top of the 4GB you’d get with the original 64GB edition.
paragraph4: Of course, today’s games are a little more demanding than the GBA titles of yesteryear, so AYANEO has hooked the Pocket Advance up with the hardware you’ll need to tackle them, like that extra pair of face buttons up front.Just like AYANEO’s Pocket Air Mini, there’s a MediaTek Helio G90T running the show here, and the 3.5-inch 960×640 display offers a sharp enough picture to push beyond mobile titles and even experiment with stuff like PlayStation emulation.
paragraph5: According to the manufacturer, shipments will start going out later this month, so this might make for a great stocking-stuffer for the classic gamer on your shopping list this holiday season.
bangla_paragraph1: আইএএনইও গুগলে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ যুক্ত করুনঃ টিএল;ডিআর আইএনইওর একটি নতুন বিশেষ সংস্করণ কনক পকেট অ্যাডভান্স রয়েছে, যা আইস ব্লু রঙের। গত গ্রীষ্মে চালু হওয়া প্রাথমিক রঙগুলির তুলনায়, আইস নীল 4 জিবি থেকে 6 জিবি পর্যন্ত র্যাম সহ উপলব্ধ। বিক্রয় 109 ডলার থেকে শুরু হয় এবং আইএনিও বলেছে যে শিপমেন্টগুলি এই মাসে শুরু হবে।
bangla_paragraph2: আমরা এখানে রেট্রো-ফোকাসযুক্ত গেমিং হ্যান্ডহেল্ডগুলির প্রতি বেশ নির্লজ্জভাবে ভালবাসি, এবং এই বছরের শুরুতে AYANEO গেম বয় অ্যাডভান্স, কনক্র পকেট অ্যাডভেঞ্চের জন্য তার প্রেমের চিঠি চালু করেছে  এখন এটি একটি নতুন রঙের বিকল্পের সাথে নভেম্বরকে ঘূর্ণায়মান করছে যা মূল হার্ডওয়্যারের সাথে নিখুঁতভাবে ফিরে আসে। পকেট এডভান্সেসের বিক্রয় গত আগস্ট থেকে শুরু হয়েছিল, প্রাথমিক রঙ বিকল্প হিসাবে নৌকা, কোরাল এবং গ্রে উপলব্ধ। আমরা  এর আগমনের পর থেকে আরও কয়েকটি বিশেষ সংস্করণ দেখেছি।
bangla_paragraph3: AYANEOএটি আমাদের জন্য এটি দেখতে অসম্ভব এবং মূল জিবিএএ এর  গ্ল্যাসিয়ার  স্বচ্ছ মডেল  যা আপনি যদি একটি ভাল প্রাথমিক aughts বাচ্চা হন তবে অবশ্যই সেরা পছন্দ ছিল।দুর্ভাগ্যক্রমে, প্রাথমিক $ 89 মূল্য দীর্ঘ চলে গেছে, তবে কমপক্ষে আপনি একই $ 109 এর জন্য নতুন আইস ব্লু মডেলটি তুলতে পারেন অন্যান্য রঙগুলি তাদের 32GB স্টোরেজে যাচ্ছে, 3GB র্যাম কনফিগারেশন, বা মাত্র $ 139 এর জন্য 64GB স্টেমিং এবং 6GB রাম আপগ্রেড করুন (যথাক্রমে $ 129 এবং $ 159 থেকে ছাড় দেওয়া হয়েছে) ।
bangla_paragraph4: অবশ্যই, আজকের গেমগুলি অতীতের জিবিএ শিরোনামগুলির চেয়ে কিছুটা বেশি চাহিদাপূর্ণ, তাই আইএএনইও পকেট অ্যাডভান্সকে হার্ডওয়্যার দিয়ে সংযুক্ত করেছে যা আপনাকে তাদের মোকাবেলা করতে হবে, যেমন সামনের দিকে অতিরিক্ত জোড়া মুখের বোতাম। আইএএএনআইওর পকেট এয়ার মিনির মতোই, এখানে একটি মিডিয়াটেক হেলিও জি 90 টি শো চালাচ্ছে, এবং 3.5-ইঞ্চি 960 × 640 ডিসপ্লে মোবাইল শিরোপা ছাড়িয়ে যাওয়ার জন্য এবং এমনকি প্লেস্টেশন এমুলেশন মত জিনিসগুলির সাথে পরীক্ষা করার জন্য যথেষ্ট ধারালো চিত্র সরবরাহ করে।
bangla_paragraph5: নির্মাতার মতে, এই মাসের শেষের দিকে পণ্যগুলি বিক্রি শুরু হবে, তাই এই ছুটির মরসুমে আপনার শপিং লিস্টে ক্লাসিক গেমারের জন্য এটি একটি দুর্দান্ত স্টকের স্টাফিং হতে পারে।

title: RBI Clubs 25 Card Payment Circulars Into A Single Framework
title_bn: একক কাঠামোর মধ্যে ২৫টি কার্ড পেমেন্ট সার্কুলার যুক্ত করল আরবিআই ক্লাব
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has clubbed 25 existing circulars, governing debit, credit and prepaid card transactions, under a…
paragraph1: SUMMARYThe framework also notes that token service providers must arrange annual security through empanelled auditors and file monthly reports The new norms look to streamline compliance and security rules for card-based digital payments The framework also directed credit card issuers to avoid restrictive network agreements and offer network choice at issuance or renewal The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has clubbed 25 existing circulars, governing debit, credit and prepaid card transactions, under a single regulatory framework. Called the Reserve Bank of India (Digital Payments – Card-based transaction) Directions, 2026, the new norms look to streamline compliance and security rules for card-based digital payments. The new rules also replace the need for referring multiple instructions issued over the years. The new framework, which comes into force with immediate effect, primarily pertains to banks, non-bank payment system providers, and ecosystem participants under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act. For end users, the notification does not add any new compliance, but instead brings all existing rules under one document. The new guidelines consolidate all existing circulars related to card security, authentication, tokenisation, storage of card details and merchant discount rates (MDR).
paragraph2: The new framework retains the EMV chip standard for all cards. It also noted that all point-of-sale (PoS) terminals and ATMs will continue to be EMV-compliant. The new norms also incorporate the existing exemption (from additional authentication) for eligible contactless transactions of up to ₹5,000. Domestic card transactions must settle in Indian currency via an Indian bank, reiterated the new guidelines. The RBI’s new framework also directed credit card issuers to avoid restrictive network agreements and offer network choice at issuance or renewal. However, issuers, which have disbursed 10 Lakh active cards or fewer, will be exempt from offering this choice.
paragraph3: Further, the rules also envisage new security and customer control mandates. The central bank’s new rules also put the onus on regulated entities to ensure that card users have 24/7 controls to modify their transaction limits or to turn off their transactions altogether. The framework also covers device, merchant-interface, and card-on-file (CoF) tokenisation. Token service providers (TSPs) must gather explicit authenticated consent and not charge fees to cardholders, added the new norms. The framework also notes that TSPs must also arrange system and security audits at least annually through CERT-In-empanelled auditors and file monthly reports. Further, entities, other than card issuers and networks, are barred from storing actual card data for card-not-present payments.
paragraph4: The new rules also incorporate existing MDR ceilings for debit card transactions. For small merchants with annual turnover of up to ₹20 Lakh, MDR remains capped at 0.4% for physical PoS payments, including online card transactions. The rate for QR-based payment infrastructure has been set at 0.3% for small merchants. For merchants with turnover above ₹20 Lakh, the MDR ceilings for PoS transactions and QR-based payments have been set at 0.
paragraph5: 9% and 0.8%, respectively. The new rules also lay out customer protection mandates and grievance redressal mechanisms for the general public.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসারএই কাঠামোটি আরও উল্লেখ করে যে টোকেন পরিষেবা সরবরাহকারীদের অবশ্যই বার্ষিক সুরক্ষার ব্যবস্থা করতে হবে এবং প্যানেলযুক্ত অডিটরদের মাধ্যমে মাসিক প্রতিবেদন জমা দিতে হবে। নতুন নিয়মগুলি কার্ড ভিত্তিক ডিজিটাল অর্থ প্রদানের জন্য সম্মতি এবং সুরক্ষা নিয়মগুলিকে সহজতর করার লক্ষ্যে।
bangla_paragraph2: নতুন কাঠামোটি সমস্ত কার্ডের জন্য ইএমভি চিপ স্ট্যান্ডার্ড বজায় রেখেছে। এটি আরও উল্লেখ করেছে যে সমস্ত পয়েন্ট-অফ-সেল (পিওএস) টার্মিনাল এবং এটিএমগুলি ইএমভির সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ থাকবে। নতুন মানগুলিতে 5000 টাকার যোগ্য যোগাযোগহীন লেনদেনের জন্য বিদ্যমান ছাড় (অতিরিক্ত প্রমাণীকরণ থেকে) অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে। দেশীয় কার্ড লেনদেনে অবশ্যই ভারতীয় ব্যাংকের মাধ্যমে ভারতীয় মুদ্রায় নিষ্পত্তি করতে হবে, নতুন নির্দেশিকা পুনর্ব্যক্ত করা হয়েছে। নতুন কাঠিপথে ক্রেডিট কার্ড প্রদানকারীদেরও বিধিনিষেধমূলক নেটওয়ার্ক এজেন্সি এড়াতে নির্দেশ দেওয়া হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: এছাড়াও, নিয়মগুলি নতুন সুরক্ষা এবং গ্রাহক নিয়ন্ত্রণের আদেশও বিবেচনা করে। কেন্দ্রীয় ব্যাংকের নতুন নিয়মগুলি নিয়ন্ত্রিত সংস্থাগুলির উপরও চাপ দেয় যাতে নিশ্চিত হয় যে কার্ড ব্যবহারকারীদের তাদের লেনদেনের সীমা পরিবর্তন করতে বা তাদের ণ সম্পূর্ণরূপে বন্ধ করতে 24/7 নিয়ন্ত্রণ রয়েছে। কাঠামোটি ডিভাইস, মার্চেন্ট-ইন্টারফেস এবং কার্ড-অন-ফাইল (সিওএফ) টোকেনাইজেশনকেও কভার করে। টোকেনের পরিষেবা সরবরাহকারী (টিএসপি) অবশ্যই স্পষ্টভাবে প্রমাণিত সম্মতি সংগ্রহ করতে হবে এবং কার্ডেধারীদের কাছ থেকে ফি চার্জ করবে না, নতুন মানগুলি যুক্ত করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: নতুন নিয়মগুলি ডেবিট কার্ড লেনদেনের জন্য বিদ্যমান এমডিআর সিলিংগুলিও অন্তর্ভুক্ত করে। ₹ 20 লক্ষের বার্ষিক টার্নওভার সহ ছোট ব্যবসায়ীদের জন্য, অনলাইন কার্ডের লেনদেন সহ শারীরিক পিওএস পেমেন্টের জন্য এমডিআরের সীমা 0.4% রয়েছে। ক্ষুদ্র ব্যবসায়ীর জন্য কিউআর-ভিত্তিক পেমেন্ট অবকাঠামোর হার 0.3% নির্ধারণ করা হয়েছে।  20 লক্ষ টাকার বেশি টারনওভারযুক্ত ব্যবসায়দের জন্য, পিওএসের লেনদা এবং কিউআর-ভুক্ত পেমেন্টগুলির জন্য এমডির সিলিন্ড 0.4% নির্ধারণ করেছে।
bangla_paragraph5: নতুন নিয়মগুলোতে গ্রাহক সুরক্ষা ও সাধারণ মানুষের জন্য অভিযোগ নিষ্পত্তি ব্যবস্থাও রয়েছে।

bangla_paragraph1: (চিত্র ক্রেডিটঃ সাইবার পাওয়ার) সালাম, বর্তমান এবং সম্ভাব্য প্রযুক্তি মালিকদের। আপনারা অনেকেই ইতিমধ্যে বিবেচনা করেছেন যে বর্তমানে আপনার ইলেকট্রনিক্স প্রতিস্থাপন করার জন্য এটি সত্যিই খারাপ সময়, কারণ দাম প্রায় গোল্ড কন্টিনেন্টালস দিয়ে প্রদানের বিন্দুতে রয়েছে। এটি যুক্তিযুক্ত, তাহলে আপনি এই গিয়ারটি সুরক্ষিত চান, এবং এটি করার প্রয়োজনীয় ফর্মটি একটি ইউপিএস, যেমন সাইবারপাওয়ার এসটি 900 ইউ, বর্তমানে মাত্র 99 ডলারে অ্যামাজনে বিক্রয় হচ্ছে।

title: Get the cheapest RTX 5070 around this Black Friday with Gigabyte's $839 Gaming OC card

title: LineageOS 24 PC port brings Android 17 to your spare laptop
title_bn: LineageOS 24 পিসি পোর্ট আপনার রিজার্ভ ল্যাপটপে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড 17 নিয়ে আসে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: This project might just be the cure for Googlebook envy.
paragraph1: Add Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Developer Mateus Seiboth has put together a port of LineageOS 24 for x86 PCs. The release can run of a USB stick, and supports systems with as little as 4GB of RAM. GPU support is a little more hit-and-miss, with AMD cards currently favored.
paragraph2: Android fans have a new device category to put on their holiday shopping lists this year, with Googlebook deals already arriving for Black Friday, but if you can’t afford to pick up some new hardware right now, we just found what might be the next best thing, courtesy of a project to bring LineageOS 24 to your existing PC.CapivaOS, or LineageOS 24.0 for x86_64 PCs, as it exists on GitHub, is still very much a work in progress, and Seiboth warns that there are plenty of issues and limitations, both known and unknown, but if you’ve been frustrated by the lack of good, modern Android ports for PC hardware, this could be right up your alley.
paragraph3: Specifically, it sounds like GPU support is still a little bit iffy, with newer Intel and AMD solutions supported, but NVIDIA cards or older Intel graphics potentially causing problems. The good news there is that you can easily try it out without making any permanent modifications to your system, and an ISO image available on SourceForge supports running live off removable media.On the plus side, CPU support looks quite more robust, and the release even should run on systems with as little as 4GB of RAM — although 8GB is recommended.
paragraph4: Obviously, there’s a lot less polish here than you’ll see on a Googlebook, and you won’t find Google apps and services baked in across the platform by default. But if you’re just interested in “Android on a laptop” and aren’t looking to pick up new hardware dedicated to that experience, this sounds like it could at least be worth checking out.In addition to porting the OS itself, Seiboth has also crafted a collection of basic apps that should make the platform feel a little more like a proper computer, including a text editor, file manager, and system resource viewer.
paragraph5: Regular ARM apps are run through Google’s libndk_translation layer for x86 compatibility — there’s also Linux app support present, and that’s an active area for ongoing development.If you’re curious enough to give it a try, let us know how the experience went for you (and share your hardware details) down in the comments.
bangla_paragraph1: গুগলে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ যুক্ত করুনঃ TL; DR বিকাশকারী ম্যাটিউস সিবথ x86 পিসির জন্য লাইনএজওএস 24 এর একটি পোর্ট একসাথে রেখেছেন। রিলিজটি একটি ইউএসবি স্টিক চালাতে পারে এবং 4 গিগাবাইট র্যাম সহ সিস্টেমগুলিকে সমর্থন করে। জিপিইউ সমর্থন কিছুটা বেশি হিট-এন্ড-মিস, বর্তমানে এএমডি কার্ডগুলির সাথে পছন্দ করা হয়।
bangla_paragraph2: অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ভক্তদের এই বছর তাদের ছুটির শপিং লিস্টে রাখার জন্য একটি নতুন ডিভাইস বিভাগ রয়েছে, ব্ল্যাক ফ্রাইডে এর জন্য গুগলবুক ডিল ইতিমধ্যে আসছে, কিন্তু আপনি যদি এখনই কিছু নতুন হার্ডওয়্যার কিনতে না পারেন, আমরা কেবলমাত্র পরবর্তী সেরা জিনিসটি খুঁজে পেয়েছি, আপনার বিদ্যমান পিসিতে লাইনএজওএস 24 আনতে একটি প্রকল্পের সৌজন্যে।
bangla_paragraph3: বিশেষত, এটি জিপিইউ সমর্থন এখনও কিছুটা অনিশ্চিত বলে মনে হচ্ছে, নতুন ইন্টেল এবং এএমডি সমাধানগুলি সমর্থিত, তবে এনভিআইডিআইএ কার্ড বা পুরানো ইন্টেল গ্রাফিক্স সম্ভাব্য সমস্যার কারণ হতে পারে। ভাল খবরটি হ'ল আপনি আপনার সিস্টেমে কোনও স্থায়ী পরিবর্তন না করেই সহজেই এটি চেষ্টা করতে পারেন এবং সোর্সফোর্জে উপলব্ধ একটি আইএসও চিত্র অপসারণযোগ্য মিডিয়া থেকে লাইভ চালানো সমর্থন করে।
bangla_paragraph4: অবশ্যই, গুগলবুকের তুলনায় এখানে অনেক কম পোলিশ রয়েছে, এবং আপনি ডিফল্টরূপে প্ল্যাটফর্ম জুড়ে গুগলের অ্যাপ্লিকেশন এবং পরিষেবাগুলি বেকড পাবেন না। তবে আপনি যদি কেবল ল্যাপটপে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড নিয়ে আগ্রহী হন এবং সেই অভিজ্ঞতার জন্য নিবেদিত নতুন হার্ডওয়্যারটি তুলতে চান না, তবে এটি কমপক্ষে পরীক্ষা করার মতো মনে হতে পারে।ওএসটি নিজেই পোর্টিং করার পাশাপাশি, সিবথ বেসিক অ্যাপ্লিকেশানগুলির একটি সংগ্রহও তৈরি করেছে যা প্ল্যাটਫর্মটিকে আরও কিছুটা উপযুক্ত কোডের মতো বোধ করবে।
bangla_paragraph5: নিয়মিত এআরএম অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলি x86 সামঞ্জস্যের জন্য গুগলের libndk_translation স্তর দিয়ে চালিত হয়  লিনাক্স অ্যাপ্লিকেশান সমর্থনও রয়েছে, এবং এটি চলমান উন্নয়নের জন্য একটি সক্রিয় ক্ষেত্র।

title: YouTube’s latest mobile redesign lets you like videos without opening them
title_bn: ইউটিউবের সর্বশেষ মোবাইল পুনরায় নকশা আপনাকে ভিডিওগুলি খুলতে না চাইলেও লাইক করতে দেয়
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Just because you can doesn’t mean you should.
paragraph1: Karandeep Singh Oberoi / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR YouTube’s latest mobile redesign introduces more frequent Shorts sections, edge-to-edge thumbnails, and redesigned video cards on the Home feed. Users are criticizing the cluttered layout, which makes it harder to distinguish between Shorts, long-form videos, and community posts. The redesign also introduces dedicated Like, Comment, and Save buttons on the Home feed, and we’ve spotted it on both Android and iOS. YouTube is not done tinkering with its mobile app, and the streaming giant’s latest redesign is making the platform’s Home feed a lot more chaotic.It’s been less than a month since YouTube began moving the Subscription tab away from the bottom navigation bar, and users, very clearly, weren’t happy with the change. The app’s latest round of changes is getting a similarly negative reception. I have the redesigned UI on both Android and iOS, and I can see why users are feeling frustrated.For starters, the redesign makes the Home feed way busier than before. Users on Reddit have observed dedicated Shorts sections appearing more frequently in the Home feed. My colleagues and I have experienced the same.I’m seeing a dedicated Shorts section after roughly every three to four long-form videos.
paragraph2: The section’s UI itself appears to have changed, too. Previously, Shorts surfaced with margins on each side. Now, thumbnails for Shorts stretch edge to edge, as seen in the screenshot below.There’s a silver lining here. Previously, each Shorts section within the Home feed housed six individual videos. With the new UI, the grid seems to have been limited to four. The first screenshot below highlights the old UI, while the second one showcases the new one.Only the bottom corners of the entire Shorts grid are rounded, while all other corners are sharp. There’s no reason for a company as big as Google to be shipping such an unpolished UI.That’s not all, though. With the change, more Playables, ads, playlists, photos, and community posts are making their way to the Home feed, contributing to it looking like a cluttered mess.
paragraph3: I often find myself having to double-check what I’m looking at before tapping on it, and others feel the same way. Reddit user GlacityTime wrote: Image posts, long-form videos, and shorts all blend together now so, at a glance, you no longer know what you’re looking at. You’re more likely to click on a short, thinking it’s long-form, and end up scrolling for hours. This seems intentional. User HotLaw7730 added: I get why they would experiment with new UI layouts to see what works and what doesn’t. I think that’s a neat idea. But I’m sorry but this new layout sucks. It is so utterly confusing to navigate. Why are community posts and Youtube videos framed with the same size and dimensions? It doesn’t make sense. User CostinTea wrote: Image posts and video thumbnails in the feed look exactly the same and I hate getting tricked.
paragraph4: YouTube might be a little too eager for engagement Long-form videos are receiving a big UI change too. Video thumbnails now sit within dedicated cards on the Home feed, as seen in the screenshots above, and they feature a big change that’s a mixed bag. Each card now features dedicated buttons to like, comment on, and save videos directly from the Home feed without having to open them. I’m sure you can see where this is going.A shortcut to save videos from the Home feed is great — you see something that you like but don’t have the time to watch it, you hit Save from the Home feed, and you’re good to go. Comments make somewhat sense too. Reading them can give you a brief idea of what to expect from a video and what others think about it. But what makes absolutely no sense is the addition of a dedicated Like button on the Home feed.There’s no reason to be hitting Like on a video without watching it, unless you’re giving the thumbs up to a video that you’ve already watched, in which case it won’t appear on the feed in the first place. There’s also the possibility of hitting the Like button while scrolling, which could then inadvertently feed YouTube’s recommendation algorithm the wrong signals.The UI update seems to be connected to a new app build.
paragraph5: An old Samsung phone of mine was still on the old UI, but updating the YouTube app to version 21.47.483 brought up the redesigned interface. The same happened on my Pixel 8. On iOS, the redesigned interface seems connected to YouTube version 21.47.6.Have you received the redesigned YouTube Home feed on your phone yet? Let us know how you feel about it in the comments below!
bangla_paragraph1: করণদীপ সিং ওবেরোই / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ গুগলে অ্যান্ড্রেড কর্তৃত্ব যুক্ত করুনঃ TL; DR ইউটিউবের সর্বশেষ মোবাইল পুনরায় নকশা হোম ফিডে আরও ঘন ঘন শর্টস বিভাগ, প্রান্ত থেকে প্রান্তের থাম্বনেইল এবং পুনরুত্পাদিত ভিডিও কার্ডগুলি প্রবর্তন করে। ব্যবহারকারীরা বিশৃঙ্খলার বিন্যাসকে সমালোচনা করছেন, যা শর্টের মধ্যে পার্থক্য করা কঠিন করে তোলে, দীর্ঘ-ফর্ম ভিডিও এবং সম্প্রদায় পোস্ট। পুনরাত্পর্ণটি হোম ফীডে ডেডিকেটেড লাইক, মন্তব্য এবং সংরক্ষণ বোতামগুলিও প্রবর্তিত করে এবং আমরা এটি অ্যান্ড্রিড এবং আইওএস উভয় ক্ষেত্রেই দেখেছি। আপনি
bangla_paragraph2: এই বিভাগে, শর্টস ইউআই নিজেই পরিবর্তিত হয়েছে বলে মনে হচ্ছে। পূর্বে, শার্টস প্রতিটি পক্ষের মার্জিন সহ উপরিভাগে এসেছিল। এখন, শার্টের জন্য থাম্বনেইলগুলি নীচের স্ক্রিনশটে দেখা গেছে, প্রান্ত থেকে প্রান্তে প্রসারিত হয়। এখানে একটি রৌপ্য আস্তরণ রয়েছে। পূর্বে হোম ফিডের মধ্যে প্রতিটি শর্টের বিভাগে ছয়টি পৃথক ভিডিও ছিল। নতুন ইউআইয়ের সাথে, গ্রিডটি চারটিতে সীমাবদ্ধ বলে মনে হয়। নীচের প্রথম স্ক্রীনশটে পুরানো ইউআই হাইলাইট করা হয়েছে, যখন দ্বিতীয়টি নতুনটি প্রদর্শন করে। পুরো শর্টে কেবল নীচের কোণগুলি।
bangla_paragraph3: আমি প্রায়ই নিজেকে খুঁজে পাই যে আমি এটিতে আলতো চাপার আগে আমি যা দেখছি তা ডাবল চেক করতে হয়, এবং অন্যরা একই ভাবে অনুভব করে। রেডডিট ব্যবহারকারী গ্ল্যাসিটিটাইম লিখেছেনঃ চিত্র পোস্ট, দীর্ঘ-ফর্ম ভিডিও এবং শর্টস এখন একসাথে মিশে যায় তাই এক নজরে, আপনি আর জানেন না যে আপনি কী দেখছেন। আপনি এটি দীর্ঘ-বিন্যাস বলে মনে করে একটি সংক্ষিপ্ততে ক্লিক করার সম্ভাবনা বেশি এবং ঘন্টার পর ঘন্টা স্ক্রোলিং শেষ করেন। এটি ইচ্ছাকৃত বলে মনে হয়। ব্যবহারকারী হটলও 7730 যোগ করেছেনঃ আমি বুঝতে পারি কেন তারা কী কাজ করে এবং কী না তা দেখার জন্য নতুন ইউআই লেআউটগুলির সাথে পরীক্ষা করবে
bangla_paragraph4: ইউটিউব হয়তো ব্যস্ততার জন্য একটু বেশি আগ্রহী হতে পারে লং ফর্ম ভিডিওগুলিও একটি বড় ইউআই পরিবর্তন পাচ্ছে। ভিডিও থাম্বনেইলগুলি এখন হোম ফিডে ডেডিকেটেড কার্ডের মধ্যে বসে আছে, যেমনটি উপরের স্ক্রিনশটগুলিতে দেখা যায়, এবং তাদের একটি বড় পরিবর্তন রয়েছে যা একটি মিশ্র ব্যাগ। প্রতিটি কার্ডে এখন হোল্ডিং ফিড থেকে সরাসরি ভিডিওগুলি পছন্দ, মন্তব্য এবং সংরক্ষণের জন্য ডেডিকেট বোতাম রয়েছে। আমি নিশ্চিত যে আপনি দেখতে পাচ্ছেন যে এটি কোথায় যাচ্ছে। হোম ফীড থেকে ভিডিওগুলি সংরক্ষিত করার জন্য একটি শর্টকাট দুর্দান্ত  আপনি কিছু দেখেন
bangla_paragraph5: আমার একটি পুরানো স্যামসাং ফোন এখনও পুরানো ইউআইতে ছিল, কিন্তু ইউটিউব অ্যাপ্লিকেশনটি 21.47.483 সংস্করণে আপডেট করার ফলে পুনরায় ডিজাইন করা ইন্টারফেসটি উপস্থিত হয়েছিল। আমার পিক্সেল 8 এও একই ঘটনা ঘটেছে। আইওএসে, পুনরুত্পাদিত ইন্টারফেশনটি ইউটিওব সংস্করণ 21.46.6. এর সাথে সংযুক্ত বলে মনে হচ্ছে। আপনি কি আপনার ফোনে পুনরূদ্ধার করা ইউটিইউব হোম ফিডটি পেয়েছেন? নীচের মন্তব্যে আপনি এটি সম্পর্কে কী মনে করেন তা আমাদের জানান!

The ‌iPhone Air‌ 2 is shaping up to receive the most substantial changes. A 48-megapixel Ultra Wide camera is expected to join the existing Fusion camera, with leaked dummy models showing the two lenses arranged horizontally across the camera plateau. The addition would address one of the original ‌iPhone Air‌'s most visible drawbacks: having fewer rear cameras than the cheaper standard iPhone. Other rumored upgrades include a 3,500mAh battery, making it approximately 11% larger than the original model's, the A20 Pro chip, and vapor chamber cooling. Analyst Jeff Pu expects the device to retain its 6.5-inch display, 12GB of memory, and 18-megapixel Center Stage front camera, while gaining Apple's C2 modem and N2 wireless chip. Earlier reports suggested a thinner, brighter display could help accommodate a larger battery, but more recent reporting points to unchanged display specifications so Apple can use existing OLED panel inventory.
paragraph2: The changes follow reports of weak demand for the original ‌iPhone Air‌. Apple has reportedly considered a lower price for its successor, which could help distinguish it from the Pro models while making its thin design more accessible. The standard ‌iPhone 18‌ is expected to retain a broadly similar design to the iPhone 17, with a 6.3-inch display and two rear cameras. Its main upgrades are likely to include an A20 chip, Apple's C2 modem, and more memory. Both the A20 and A20 Pro are expected to use a 2nm manufacturing process for improved performance and efficiency. Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo predicts 9GB of RAM for the ‌iPhone 18‌, while Pu expects 12GB and a smaller Dynamic Island. A 9GB configuration would reportedly remain below the memory requirement for enhanced on-device dictation and controls for Siri's vocal expressiveness and pace. A purported internal diagram points to a 4,430mAh battery shared by the ‌iPhone 18‌ and iPhone 18e, with changes to the standard model's speaker and haptic engine creating additional space. A separate report suggests the device could also gain higher display brightness.
paragraph3: The iPhone 18e is also expected to receive the A20 chip and 9GB of RAM, while retaining a 60Hz display and single 48-megapixel rear camera. A front-camera upgrade has also been rumored. Its appearance could change with a new iPad Pro-style housing that groups the lens, microphone, and flash. Reports disagree on whether its display will remain approximately 6.1 inches or grow to 6.3 inches. Recent CAD leaks also suggest thicker camera housings on the ‌iPhone 18‌ and ‌iPhone Air‌ 2. bangla_paragraph1: ম্যাকরুমার্স শো-এর এই সপ্তাহের পর্বটিতে, আমরা অ্যাপলের আসন্ন আইফোন 18, আইফোন 18 ই এবং আইফোন এয়ার 2 এর দিকে নজর রাখি, যা 2027 সালের প্রথম দিকে চালু হওয়ার আশা করা হচ্ছে। অ্যাপল ফেব্রুয়ারি বা মার্চ মাসে আইফোন ১৮ এবং আইফোনে 18 ই চালু করবে বলে আশা করা হয়, আইফোন অ্যার 2 এর সাথে কিছুটা পরে অনুসরণ করা যেতে পারে। রিলিজগুলি অ্যাপলের বিভক্ত লঞ্চ চক্রটি সম্পূর্ণ করবে, এই শরত্কালে আইফোন 18-প্রো, আইফোন 18-প্রোম্যাক্স এবং আইপডুও অনুসরণ করবে। আইফোন 2 সর্বাধিক সাবস্ক্রিপশন পেতে আকার ধারণ করছে।
bangla_paragraph2: আইফোনের দামের তুলনায় আইফোন এয়ারের দাম অনেক কম। মূল আইফোন এর চাহিদা দুর্বল হওয়ার পরে এই পরিবর্তনগুলি ঘটেছে। অ্যাপল তার উত্তরসূরির জন্য কম দাম বিবেচনা করেছে, যা এটিকে প্রো মডেলের থেকে আলাদা করতে সহায়তা করতে পারে এবং তার পাতলা নকশাটিকে আরও অ্যাক্সেসযোগ্য করে তুলতে পারে। স্ট্যান্ডার্ড আইফোন 18 একটি 6.3-ইঞ্চি ডিসপ্লে এবং দুটি পিছনের ক্যামেরা সহ আইফোন 17 এর সাথে ব্যাপকভাবে অনুরূপ নকশা বজায় রাখার আশা করা হচ্ছে। এর প্রধান আপগ্রেডগুলির মধ্যে একটি এ 20 চিপ, অ্যাপলের সি 2 মডেম এবং আরও মেমরি অন্তর্ভুক্ত হওয়ার সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে। এ 20 এবং এ 20 প্রো উভয়ই প্রত্যাশিত হবে
bangla_paragraph3: আইফোন 18 ই এছাড়াও একটি 60Hz ডিসপ্লে এবং একক 48 মেগাপিক্সেলের পিছনের ক্যামেরা বজায় রেখে A20 চিপ এবং 9GB র্যাম পাবেন বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। একটি সামনের ক্যামেরার আপগ্রেডও গুজব রয়েছে। এর চেহারা একটি নতুন আইপ্যাড প্রো-স্টাইলের হাউজিংয়ের সাথে পরিবর্তন হতে পারে যা লেন্স, মাইক্রোফোন এবং ফ্ল্যাশকে একত্রিত করে। এর ডিসਪ্লেটি প্রায় 6.1 ইঞ্চি থাকবে কিনা বা 6.3 ইঞ্চিতে বাড়বে কিনা তা নিয়ে প্রতিবেদনগুলি একমত নয়। সাম্প্রতিক সিএডি ফুটোগুলি আইফোন 18-এ এবং আইফোন এয়ার 2-এ আরও পুরু ক্যামেরা হাউসিংয়ের পরামর্শ দেয়।
bangla_paragraph4: ম্যাকরুমার্স শো এর নিজস্ব ইউটিউব চ্যানেল রয়েছে, তাই নতুন পর্ব এবং ক্লিপগুলি ধরে রাখতে আপনি সাবস্ক্রাইব করেছেন তা নিশ্চিত করুন। আপনি অ্যাপল পডকাস্ট, স্পটিফাই, ওভারক্লাউড বা অন্যান্য পডক্যাস্ট অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলিতে ম্যাকারুমার্স শোকেও শুনতে পারেন। আপনি আমাদের আরএসএস ফিডটি সরাসরি আপনার প্লেয়ারে অনুলিপি করতে পারেন। যদি আপনি ইতিমধ্যে ম্যাকেরুমার্স অনুষ্ঠানের পূর্ববর্তী পর্বটি না শুনে থাকেন তবে আইফোন ডুওর নতুন ফেস আনলক বৈশিষ্ট্য এবং অ্যাপলের পরবর্তী প্রজন্মের সম্পর্কিত সমস্ত সর্বশেষ গুজব সম্পর্কে আমাদের আলোচনা শুনতে catch up করুন
bangla_paragraph5: আজ তার পাওয়ার অন নিউজলেটারটিতে, গুরম্যান বলেন যে অ্যাপলের ২০২৭ সালের প্রথমার্ধে আইফোন এয়ার ২ এবং নতুন আইপ্যাড এয়ার এবং আইপ্যাক প্রো মডেল সহ কিছু অতিরিক্ত পণ্য পরিকল্পনা রয়েছে,...'আইফোন ২০ প্রো' গুজব অনুযায়ী আইফোন এর উপর ভিত্তি করে তৈরি হবেপরবর্তী বছরের "আইফোন২০ প্রো" মডেলগুলি আইফোন অ্যারের মতো একই গ্লাস ডিজাইন ব্যবহার করবে, তবে চারপাশে আরও স্পষ্টভাবে বাঁকা হবে, "ফিক্সড ফোকাস ডিজিটাল" নামে পরিচিত ফাঁসকারী অনুসারে।

paragraph2: Ecovacs calls the Deebot X12 the first robot vacuum with FocusJet technology. bangla_paragraph4: পাওয়ারবুস্ট চার্জিং এটি দীর্ঘ সময় ধরে রিচার্জ না করে বড় বাড়িতে চলতে দেয়। এটি ভয়েস কন্ট্রোলের জন্য আলেক্সা, গুগল হোম এবং অ্যাপল হومের সাথে কাজ করে। ক্রেতারা আমাজনে পাঁচটি তারার মধ্যে ডিওবট এক্স 12 কে 4.6 রেট দেয় এবং চুক্তিটি আমাজন দ্বারা বিক্রি এবং শিপিং করা হয়।

title: Samsung is holding back these 30+ Galaxy AI features for the Galaxy S27
title_bn: স্যামসাং গ্যালাক্সি এস২৭-এর জন্য এই ৩০+ গ্যাল্যাক্সি এআই বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলিকে ফিরিয়ে রাখছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: One UI 9.5 beta code ties about three dozen features to a Galaxy AI version the Galaxy S26 doesn't have.
paragraph1: Pankil Shah / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Code in One UI 9.5 Beta 1 ties a long list of new Galaxy AI features to “Galaxy AI version 20271,” which Samsung’s own code labels as the S27’s AI version. Gated Galaxy S27 features span Gallery’s Recompose, new Camera ProScan and Log LUT tools, full-table AI select, expanded Scam Detection languages, and an Audio eraser for your calls. Several 20271 features, including Gen Video credits, Samsung Browser’s Ask anything, and Now Brief’s Bixby action card, appear tied to a paid Galaxy AI Premium tier. Samsung brought several S26 features to older phones this year, so not all of these may stay Galaxy S27-exclusive forever. Over the past week, we’ve found dozens of new Galaxy AI features in One UI 9.5 Beta 1 for the Galaxy S26 Ultra, but many refuse to run on the device. When we dug into Samsung’s Scam Detection features for third-party calling apps, we noticed they check for something called “Galaxy AI version 20271,” a level our S26 Ultra doesn’t meet. Now, we’ve found code that spells out what that number means: It’s the Galaxy S27’s AI version. We’ve gone through code across numerous apps in the One UI 9.5 Beta 1 firmware on our Galaxy S26 Ultra, and here’s every Galaxy AI feature we’ve found so far that appears to be reserved for the Galaxy S27.
paragraph2: APK teardownThis reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship.Samsung’s code calls it the “S27” AI version Every Galaxy phone with Galaxy AI carries an AI version number in its firmware, and Samsung’s apps check that number before switching features on. In One UI 9.5, two apps name the levels outright.Voice Recorder labels 20261 as the S26’s version and 20271 as the S27’s:Aamir Siddiqui / Android AuthoritySamsung’s One UI Home launcher does the same:Aamir Siddiqui / Android AuthorityOur Galaxy S26 Ultra reports 20263, both on One UI 9 stable and on the One UI 9.5 beta. This is higher than the 20261 Samsung’s code assigns to the S26, suggesting the phone’s AI version may have already been raised once, likely with the One UI 9 update. Voice Recorder ties 20263 to “Q8_B8,” which, as we know from model number leaks, refers to the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Z Flip 8 that launched with One UI 9.Every Galaxy AI feature we found tied to the S27 So what exactly is Samsung holding back for the S27? Here’s everything we found.
paragraph3: Gallery and Photo Editor Several of the S27’s Gallery features have already surfaced. Recompose changes a photo’s camera angle with AI, and Shorts turns your photos into short videos. Both check for version 20271.The same check also unlocks a few things we haven’t seen reported yet: Photo Assist prompt suggestions: The editor could suggest creative edits for the photo you have open. Code<string name="suggest_prompt_guided_tour_title">Get ready to be inspired</string> <string name="suggest_prompt_guided_tour_body">AI will analyze your photo to suggest creative ways to transform it.</string> A new Restyle style pack: A download of new styles that only 20271 phones can get. A different Restyle image model: On 20271 phones, Photo Editor appears to switch Restyle’s image backend to one labeled “GPT,” instead of the “GEMPIX” backend used otherwise. The code doesn’t say which company’s model that is. Gallery’s Gen Video feature, whose presets SammyGuru detailed through files shared by the Cipher Project, is switched off on every phone in this build. The code behind it in Photo Editor reveals more than the presets, though: A free-prompt mode, with “AI-generated ideas” if you’re stuck Videos of 3 to 10 seconds, in 9:16 or 16:9, at 360p, 720p (default), 1080p, or 4K Multiple photos as input, plus a sound toggle A watermark and content credentials on saved videos, and a cost of one credit per video Code<string name="gen_video_setting_detail">Transform still photos into dynamic videos with creative presets or AI-generated ideas.</string> <string name="gen_video_max_images">You can add up to %1$d images.
paragraph4: </string> <string name="gen_video_credit_unit">1 credit</string> <string name="gen_video_watermark_notice">When you save an image or video edited with AI, a watermark and content credentials are added to show that it contains AI-generated content.</string>The same 20271 check also unlocks a Generate stickers button above cutouts in Gallery and other apps that let you lift subjects out of images, which sends your cutout to Samsung’s AI sticker tools. Samsung’s video editor gets a Creative studio tab for AI stickers behind the same check.CameraStephen Radochia / Android AuthorityWe already covered two of the biggest camera features, Vision mode and Auto portrait, and both sit behind the 20271 check.The Camera app gates a few more behind 20271: ProScan, which the Cipher Project spotted as an S27 feature, with code pointing to page flattening, two-page book scanning, and new PDF options Monitor view in Pro mode Dynamic frame in Shot suggestions, which suggests a better framing for your shot and guides you to it Code<string name="dynamic_frame_composition_tips">Tap the thumbnail to switch to the suggested framing and take a photo.</string> <string name="dynamic_frame_target_reach_guide">Move the camera until the dot is inside the circle.</string>AI select and text extraction Samsung Capture, which powers AI select, has a single 20271 switch that unlocks four features: Full table detection Two-finger scrolling while AI select is open An Add to Memory button, spotted by the Cipher Project, that saves your selection to Samsung’s upcoming Memory app Event extraction through Samsung’s private AI cloud, which we demoed earlier today We managed to force the 20271 behavior on our S26 Ultra. With it on, AI select recognized an entire 83-row table on a webpage and offered a Copy table chip. With the phone’s default behavior, a similar selection on the same table produced only a “Translate” chip and a misread link chip (“Egy.pt”). Separately, the “Extract text” tool in Camera, Gallery, and other Samsung apps gets Multi-select for picking several blocks of text at once, and a table view for tables it finds, again only on 20271 phones.
paragraph5: Now Brief Now Brief, part of Samsung’s Smart suggestions app, holds back several new cards for 20271 phones: A Taboola-powered Top news card A Spotify card A birthday card A Galaxy Premium card It could also use your YouTube interests and Bixby as new sources of personalization. The Premium card’s “Bixby action” pitch lines up with the paid features we’ve seen elsewhere. Internally, Samsung calls that card “premium_claw,” which suggests it could be how Galaxy Claw shows up in Now Brief for paying users. Code<string name="brief_settings_contents_news_top_news">Top news</string> <string name="brief_settings_content_detail_music_and_podcasts">Spotify playlist recommendations for exercise, travel, and other activities</string> <string name="brief_settings_contents_birthday_reminder">Birthday reminder</string> <string name="custom_card_premium_claw">Bixby action</string> <string name="custom_card_premium_claw_description">Automate tasks across your apps.</string>Calls Several call features we’ve already reported check for 20271: Fake call detection Recording calls in third-party apps Scam Detection for those apps The same check also gates three things we haven’t seen reported yet: Google’s Scam Detection for calls, which launched on the Galaxy S26 only in US English, appears set to support five more languages on 20271 phones: English (UK and Australia), German, Spanish (Mexico), and French (France). Google already offers Scam Detection in those countries on Pixel 9 and newer phones. Your mic gets an Audio eraser option during calls. Call assist is turned on by default for VoIP apps. Keyboard, Voice Recorder, and translation Samsung Keyboard: Refine voice input, which cleans up filler words in dictation, needs 20271.

title: GTA VI Now (Barely) Running on Apple Silicon Macs
title_bn: জিটিএ ৬ এখন (কঠিন) অ্যাপল সিলিকন ম্যাক চালাচ্ছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: "Grand Theft Auto VI" can theoretically now run on Apple silicon Macs via unofficial community projects, despite Rockstar Games offering no official Mac version. Developers have adapted the Xbox Series version of the game to work on macOS unofficiall
paragraph1: "Grand Theft Auto VI" can theoretically now run on Apple silicon Macs via unofficial community projects, despite Rockstar Games offering no official Mac version. Developers have adapted the Xbox Series version of the game to work on macOS unofficially, with some reporting that they can explore scenes and control the camera. Unfortunately, the projects remain experimental and performance is too slow for normal play. Mac owners can already play GTA VI through Remote Play from a compatible console. These unofficial projects instead run the game locally on the Mac itself. One project, "Halfwave," reports around 3 frames per second in a prison scene and almost 5 frames per second during a boat sequence on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB of memory.
paragraph2: A separate test with 1080p output reached 6 frames per second in the boat scene. The developer also says saved games and free roam work, although lighting errors, flickering objects, and slow-loading scenery remain. Halfwave builds on "VIctory-macOS," another community effort to run the game on Apple's chips. A tester using an M2 Pro Mac reported reaching the opening movement tutorial and controlling the camera, but at approximately one frame every two seconds. The projects use several translation tools as a workaround to make the Xbox game work on a Mac. Rosetta 2 handles processor instructions, CrossOver Wine provides Windows compatibility, and Apple's D3DMetal translates graphics into a format the Mac can display.
paragraph3: AI tools are also helping with the projects. Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar's parent company, is already targeting efforts to bring the game to other platforms unofficially. A copyright complaint published by GitHub alleged that a similar project called "Leonida" infringed Take-Two's rights. GTA VI launched on November 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and Series S. Rockstar has not yet announced plans to bring it to the Mac. bangla_paragraph1: "গ্র্যান্ড চুরি অটো VI" তত্ত্বগতভাবে এখন অ-অফিসিয়াল কমিউনিটি প্রকল্পের মাধ্যমে অ্যাপল সিলিকন ম্যাকগুলিতে চালানো যেতে পারে, যদিও রকস্টার গেমস কোনও অফিসিয়াল ম্যাক সংস্করণ সরবরাহ করে না। বিকাশকারীরা ম্যাকোজে অ-আফিসিয়ালভাবে কাজ করার জন্য গেমের এক্সবক্স সিরিজ সংস্করণটি অভিযোজিত করেছে, কিছু রিপোর্ট সহ তারা দৃশ্যগুলি অন্বেষণ করতে এবং ক্যামেরা নিয়ন্ত্রণ করতে পারে। দুর্ভাগ্যক্রমে, প্রকল্পগুলি পরীক্ষামূলক এবং পারফরম্যান্স স্বাভাবিক খেলার জন্য খুব ধীর। ম্যাকের মালিকরা ইতিমধ্যে একটি সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ কনসোল থেকে রিমোট প্লেয়ের মাধ্যমে জিটিএ VI খেলতে পারেন।

title: iPhone 18 Production Delay Leaves Apple Little Time Before Launch
title_bn: আইফোন ১৮ উৎপাদন বিলম্বিত হওয়ার কারণে অ্যাপল লঞ্চের আগে খুব কম সময়ই আছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e models are reportedly suffering from another production delay. In a new post on Weibo, the leaker known as "Fixed Focus Digital" claimed that neither model has entered mass production, with the start pushed b
paragraph1: Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e models are reportedly suffering from another production delay. In a new post on Weibo, the leaker known as "Fixed Focus Digital" claimed that neither model has entered mass production, with the start pushed back from late October to around New Year's Day in 2027. In October, the same source pointed to late November as the production target for the standard ‌iPhone 18‌ and suggested Apple was preparing to build a large inventory. The latest claim cites a different earlier deadline, but January would be later than either of the previously reported targets.
paragraph2: Fixed Focus Digital previously suggested that Apple will use some of the same manufacturing processes and components for the two phones. The leaker recently shared a diagram purporting to show identical batteries and 6.3-inch displays for both, although reports disagree about whether the iPhone 18e's screen will increase in size. Expected upgrades include an A20 chip in both models, while other rumors point to 9GB of RAM, up from 8GB, and Apple's C2 modem.
paragraph3: Larger batteries have also been rumored, with a potential front-facing camera upgrade for the iPhone 18e. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman recently identified February or March as the expected introduction window for both devices. If that schedule holds, a January production start would give Apple less time than usual to accumulate stock before launch. title: Samay Raina Becomes First YouTube Creator Globally To Cross 10 Lakh Paid Channel Members
title_bn: সমাই রায়না বিশ্বব্যাপী প্রথম ইউটিউব ক্রিয়েটর হিসেবে ১০ লক্ষের বেশি পেড চ্যানেলের সদস্য হয়েছেন।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Stand-up comedian Samay Raina has become the first YouTube creator, globally, to cross 10 Lakh paid channel memberships, the YouTube…
paragraph1: SUMMARYSamay Raina has become the first YouTube creator, globally, to cross 10 Lakh paid channel memberships The milestone signals Indian audiences’ increasing willingness to pay creators directly, which could help creators earn more sustainable and predictable income Raina’s channel has a base of 1.24 Cr subscribers implying a conversion rate of around 8.1% Stand-up comedian Samay Raina has become the first YouTube creator, globally, to cross 10 Lakh paid channel memberships, the YouTube team said in a post on Google India’s blog. Raina’s channel, which commands a base of 1.
paragraph2: 24 Cr subscribers, offers three monthly subscription tiers costing ₹59, ₹599, and ₹1,999 to unlock additional content, community-based features, and more. This implies a conversion rate of around 8.1% from subscriber to paying member. “It’s an extraordinary milestone for Samay and a proud moment for India’s entire creator ecosystem,” YouTube said.
paragraph3: It further noted that over 12 Lakh viewers in India purchased at least one channel membership for Raina in June 2026 alone. This resulted in Indian creators’ membership revenue surging over 25% YoY in the same month. The commercial milestone signals a turnaround for Raina after a controversial spell for the creator. In February 2025, his show India’s Got Latent triggered a controversy after offensive remarks made during the show sparked outrage.
paragraph4: The backlash resulted in complaints and FIRs filed against Raina, Allahbadia, and others involved in the show, leading the comedian to publicly apologise. He temporarily took down the show’s entire catalogue from YouTube for a period as well. However, 2026 has been a different story as Raina returned with his stand-up special ‘Still Alive’, as well as a new season of Latent launched on both YouTube and Netflix. Featuring celebrity guests like Alia Bhatt, Varun Dhawan, Tanmay Bhat, and Ayushmann Khurrana, the second season amassed around 3.
paragraph5: 9 Cr viewers across both platforms. Raina’s latest achievement further signals a new trend among Indian audiences – willingness to pay creators directly. Historically, creators have been more dependent on ad- or sponsor-linked revenue models. However, a shift to recurring revenue models built on direct support from a loyal community of followers could generate more sustainable and predictable income.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার সমাই রায়না বিশ্বব্যাপী প্রথম ইউটিউব স্রষ্টা হিসেবে ১০ লক্ষের বেশি পেড চ্যানেলের সদস্যপদ অর্জন করেছেন। এই মাইলফলকটি ভারতীয় দর্শকদের সরাসরি স্রষ্টার কাছে অর্থ প্রদানের ইচ্ছা বাড়ানোর ইঙ্গিত দেয়। যা স্রস্টারদের আরও টেকসই এবং পূর্বাভাসযোগ্য আয় করতে সাহায্য করতে পারে। রায়নার চ্যানেলিটির গ্রাহক সংখ্যা ১.২৪ কোটি। যার ফলে রূপান্তর হার প্রায় ৮.১ শতাংশ। স্ট্যান্ডআপ কমেডিয়ান সমাই রায়েনা বিশ্বজুড়ে প্রথম ইউ টিউব নির্মাতা হিসেবে ১০ লাখের বেশি পেইড চ্যানেলে সদস্যপদের সংখ্যা অর্জন করেছেন, ইউটিইউব টিম এর কর্মীরা।
bangla_paragraph2: ইউটিউব জানিয়েছে, 'এই অ্যাপটি স্যামাইয়ের জন্য একটি অসাধারণ মাইলফলক এবং ভারতের সমগ্র স্রষ্টা বাস্তুতন্ত্রের জন্য একটি গর্বের মুহূর্ত।'
bangla_paragraph3: এটি আরও উল্লেখ করেছে যে ভারতে 12 লক্ষেরও বেশি দর্শক এককভাবে জুন 2026 সালে রায়নার জন্য কমপক্ষে একটি চ্যানেলের সদস্যতা কিনেছিলেন। এর ফলে একই মাসে ভারতীয় স্রষ্টাদের সদস্যপদ রাজস্ব 25% এরও বেশি বেড়েছে। বাণিজ্যিক মাইলফলকটি স্রষ্টার জন্য বিতর্কিত স্পেলের পরে রায়নাকে একটি পালা দেওয়ার লক্ষণ। ফেব্রুয়ারী 2025, তার শো ইন্ডিয়া গট ল্যাটেনট শো চলাকালীন আপত্তিজনক মন্তব্যের পরে বিতর্ক সৃষ্টি করেছিল।
bangla_paragraph4: এই প্রতিক্রিয়ার ফলে রায়না, আল্লাবাদিয়া এবং শোতে জড়িত অন্যদের বিরুদ্ধে অভিযোগ এবং এফআইআর দায়ের করা হয়েছিল, যা কমেডিয়ানকে প্রকাশ্যে ক্ষমা চাইতে বাধ্য করেছিল। তিনি সাময়িকভাবে ইউটিউব থেকে শোটির পুরো ক্যাটালগটিও সাময়िकভাবে সরিয়ে নিয়েছিলেন। তবে, ২০২৬ সালটি আলাদা গল্প ছিল কারণ রায়ণা তার স্ট্যান্ড-আপ বিশেষ স্টিল অ্যালাইভ, পাশাপাশি ইউটিওব এবং নেটফ্লিক্স উভয় ক্ষেত্রেই ল্যাটিনের একটি নতুন মরসুম চালু করেছিলেন। আলিয়া ভাট, বরুণ ধাওয়ান, তনমাই ভাট এবং আয়ুষ্মানের মতো সেলিব্রিটি অতিথিদের বৈশিষ্ট্যযুক্ত।
bangla_paragraph5: রায়নার সর্বশেষ অর্জনটি ভারতীয় দর্শকদের মধ্যে একটি নতুন প্রবণতার সংকেত দেয়  স্রষ্টাদের সরাসরি অর্থ প্রদানের ইচ্ছাকে। ঐতিহাসিকভাবে, স্রষ্টারা বিজ্ঞাপন বা স্পনসর-সংযুক্ত রাজস্ব মডেলের উপর বেশি নির্ভরশীল ছিলেন। তবে অনুগামীদের অনুগত সম্প্রদায়ের প্রত্যক্ষ সহায়তায় নির্মিত পুনরাবৃত্তির রাজস্ব মোডে স্থানান্তর আরও টেকসই এবং পূর্বাভাসযোগ্য আয় তৈরি করতে পারে।

title: TSMC gives a sneap peak at AI Design Kit: Agentic AI with foundry expertise
title_bn: TSMC gives a sneap peak at AI Design Kit: Agentic AI with foundry expertise
author: TechPulse
excerpt: TSMC brings agentic AI to chip design as A14 design rule count hits 3.6X that of N5 while customers demand 33% shorter development cycle.
paragraph1: The semiconductor industry is in a paradoxical situation these days.
paragraph2: On the one hand, AI drives demand for the leading-edge nodes from both established players and new entrants, with everyone trying to accelerate the development cycle.
paragraph3: On the other hand, leading-edge nodes become more complex, which increases entry barriers and stretches design cycles.
paragraph4: While the challenge seems to be insoluble, it looks like TSMC has found a solution.

title: Sony’s BRAVIA Theater Bar 5 hits a record-low $248
title_bn: Sony’s BRAVIA Theater Bar 5 hits a record-low $248
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Sony's 3.1-channel Dolby Atmos soundbar with a wireless subwoofer is 29% off, now at its lowest price ever.
paragraph1: Add Android Authority on Google: Sony’s newest midrange soundbar just hit a new low. The Sony BRAVIA Theater Bar 5 with its wireless subwoofer is down to $248 on Amazon, which is $102 off its $349.99 list price and $30 below its previous best price of $278.
paragraph2: The BRAVIA Theater Bar 5 is a 3.1-channel system, and that dedicated center channel is the key detail. It focuses on voices, so dialogue stays clear even during loud action scenes, which is one of the most common complaints about TV speakers.
paragraph3: It supports both Dolby Atmos and DTS:X, and Sony’s Vertical Surround Engine creates a sense of height and immersion without extra speakers on the ceiling. The included wireless subwoofer adds deep bass for movies, sports, and games, and you can place it wherever it fits in the room.Bluetooth support means you can also stream music from your phone, so the Bar 5 doubles as a living room speaker when the TV is off.
paragraph4: It’s sold and shipped by Amazon, and the deal applies to the full bar and subwoofer bundle.At $248, the Theater Bar 5 is a sizable upgrade over built-in TV audio for not much money, and this is the cheapest it has been.
