title: Samsung is building a Siri-style Vision mode for its Camera app, along with Auto portrait
title_bn: স্যামসাং তার ক্যামেরা অ্যাপ্লিকেশনের জন্য একটি সিরি-স্টাইল ভিজন মোড তৈরি করছে, অটো প্রতিকৃতি সহ
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Both features are likely bound for the Galaxy S27 series.
paragraph1: Zac Kew-Denniss / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Code in One UI 9.5 Beta 1 points to a new “Vision mode” in Samsung’s Camera app. It will seemingly describe what you point at and hand off follow-up questions to Gemini. The same build also points to a new “Auto portrait” feature, which could add background blur in Photo mode whenever it spots a face or a pet. Neither feature works on the Galaxy S26 Ultra, and the code suggests both need new hardware, so they will likely debut on the Galaxy S27 series. Pointing your camera at something and asking your phone about it isn’t really a new feature these days. Samsung shipped Bixby Vision with the Galaxy S8 back in 2017. Google has Lens and Circle to Search, and Gemini Live’s camera sharing has been on Android phones since last year. Apple was late to the party with Visual Intelligence. Then, with iOS 27, Apple moved Visual Intelligence to the Camera app, where a new Siri mode lives alongside Photo, Video, and other camera modes. Despite beating Apple to the punch, Samsung appears to be preparing its own refreshed version of this feature, seemingly borrowing from Apple’s UX. We dug through the Galaxy S26 Ultra’s One UI 9.5 Beta 1 firmware and found a new Vision mode in the Camera app, plus an Auto portrait feature for Photo mode.
paragraph2: Apple's Siri mode in the iOS 27 Camera app, shown at WWDC 2026APK teardownThis reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship.Vision mode could turn the Samsung Camera app into a point-and-ask tool The Samsung Camera app has code for a new mode simply called Vision, which sits among the regular camera modes. When the feature launches, you could switch to it like any other mode in the Camera app. Code<string name="SM_VISION_AI">Vision</string> <string name="vision_ai_generated_by_ai">This content was generated by AI</string>When users switch to it, the shutter icon could animate into a new design, and the camera could start streaming the live preview to a new Samsung app called Visual Agent Service. Based on the code, it seems the mode will show a scene card with an AI-written summary of what’s in front of you, along with a row of tappable keywords, and a footer noting that the content was generated by AI. Below the card, Vision mode appears to show suggested actions (“nudges”), a text extraction button, and a flashlight toggle.Vision mode will likely also have two buttons next to the shutter: Ask and Translate. If that layout sounds familiar, it’s because Apple’s Siri mode uses a similar setup: a description card at the top of the viewfinder and two buttons flanking the shutter.Tapping Ask, or one of the keywords, appears to send the camera frame to the Gemini app, along with the keyword’s question if you tapped one. Code shows that this will also copy that question to your clipboard. Translate will likely hand the camera viewfinder frame to Samsung’s AI Vision app instead (a separate app from the Camera app’s Vision mode).Notably, pressing the shutter in Vision mode doesn’t appear to save a photo.
paragraph3: It will likely only freeze the viewfinder preview, so you can ask questions about it.You can already do much of this on your Galaxy phone today: simply open Gemini Live and share your camera.Rita El Khoury / Android AuthorityWhat would set Vision mode apart, if Samsung ships it as the code describes, is that it would be built into the Camera app and would give you Samsung’s own scene summary before you reach Gemini. We couldn’t tell whether that summary is generated on your phone or in the cloud, as that work happens inside Visual Agent Service, which currently isn’t available on the S26 Ultra.Vision mode leans on what’s left of Bixby Vision for translation The AI Vision app looks to be what’s left of Bixby Vision. It keeps the same package name, and some of its strings still say “Welcome to Bixby Vision.”On the S26 Ultra, the AI Vision app no longer has an app drawer icon. Instead, it opens only from the camera, where it appears to power the Real-time translation feature that debuted with the Galaxy S26 series. The old Bixby Vision button in the camera’s More menu was already hidden in One UI 9, so Vision mode in the Camera app isn’t replacing it so much as bringing point-and-ask back to the camera in a new form.When we pointed the camera at Hindi text on the S26 Ultra, the AI Vision app overlaid an English translation within a few seconds. Samsung’s own translation engine handled it on the phone, though this could change on newer phones, as the AI Vision app has picked up a new setting in One UI 9.5 for processing data on-device:Code<string name="setting_process_data_only_on_device">Process data only on device</string> <string name="setting_process_data_only_on_device_summary">For added privacy, process AI Vision data on your device instead of online.</string> <string name="cloud_translation_on_device_only_guide">To translate without signing in to your Samsung account, turn on Process data only on device in Settings.
paragraph4: </string>The app also has new strings for network errors, a consent screen for translation, and a content filter. There’s even a fallback message saying it will use on-device translation if the phone can’t connect. Together, they point to cloud translation for users signed in to a Samsung account.Code<string name="live_trans_network_unavailable_use_on_device_toast">Couldn't connect to the network. On-device translation will be used instead.</string> <string name="live_trans_network_unavailable_try_again_toast">Couldn't connect to the network. Check your connection and try again.</string> <string name="translation_onboarding_consent_body">To continue, agree to the %1$sTerms and Conditions%2$s, the %3$sPrivacy Notice%4$s, and then agree to the additional required agreements. The Privacy Notice lets you know how we handle your personal information.</string> <string name="safety_filter_error">Can't translate text because it might contain inappropriate content.</string> <string name="text_translator_safety_filter_error">This content can't be translated.</string> <string name="safety_filter_sa_token_error">Check Samsung account error.</string>The on-device setting appears only on phones with a newer Galaxy AI version than the S26 Ultra’s, outside China, and it appears to be off by default.
paragraph5: On older phones like the S26 Ultra, the app always translates on the phone, which is why the setting doesn’t show up.Camera app’s Auto portrait could add blur without switching to Portrait mode The Samsung Camera app has another new feature in the works, called Portrait effect in Photo, which the code refers to as Auto portrait. It appears to apply background blur automatically in Photo mode when it detects a face or a pet. You could also turn it on manually from the viewfinder, with a slider to adjust blur strength. Code<string name="Title_Portrait_effect_in_photo">Portrait effect in Photo</string> <string name="bokeh_effect_blur">Blur</string>If this sounds familiar, Apple added something similar with the iPhone 15. When newer iPhones detect a person, cat, or dog in the shot, the camera automatically captures depth data without using Portrait mode, so you can turn the photo into a portrait later in the Photos app.Based on the code, Samsung’s take appears to work differently: when the effect kicks in, the camera appears to switch to a dedicated Auto portrait capture mode, so the blur is applied as you shoot rather than saved for later.Neither Vision mode nor Auto portrait currently works on the Galaxy S26 Ultra, and the code suggests both need hardware the phone doesn’t have, making the Galaxy S27 series the obvious candidate. The S27 series is rumored to launch in January, so we may not have long to wait to see whether Samsung’s Vision mode can stand next to Apple’s Siri mode within their respective camera apps.Samsung has not officially announced either feature. We’ll keep you updated when we learn more.

It appears to apply background blur automatically in Photo mode when it detects a face or a pet. You could also turn it on manually from the viewfinder, with a slider to adjust blur strength. Code<string name="Title_Portrait_effect_in_photo">Portrait effect in Photo</string> <string name="bokeh_effect_blur">Blur</string>If this sounds familiar, Apple added something similar with the iPhone 15. When newer iPhones detect a person, cat, or dog in the shot, the camera automatically captures depth data without using Portrait mode, so you can turn the photo into a portrait later in the Photos app.Based on the code, Samsung’s take appears to work differently: when the effect kicks in, the camera appears to switch to a dedicated Auto portrait capture mode, so the blur is applied as you shoot rather than saved for later.Neither Vision mode nor Auto portrait currently works on the Galaxy S26 Ultra, and the code suggests both need hardware the phone doesn’t have, making the Galaxy S27 series the obvious candidate. The S27 series is rumored to launch in January, so we may not have long to wait to see whether Samsung’s Vision mode can stand next to Apple’s Siri mode within their respective camera apps.Samsung has not officially announced either feature. We’ll keep you updated when we learn more.

title: GTA 6 drives nearly 290% surge in franchise’s mobile game downloads, hits 2.3 million in first week

author: TechPulse
excerpt: Amid the GTA 6 craze, several reportedly turned to the other video games in the GTA franchise, boosting overall app downloads and player activity. It has also seemingly impacted other gaming applications, including PlayStation which saw 1.3 million d
paragraph1: Amid the GTA 6 craze, several reportedly turned to the other video games in the GTA franchise, boosting overall app downloads and player activity. It has also seemingly impacted other gaming applications, including PlayStation which saw 1.3 million downloads between November 16 to 22.Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) was released on November 19. It has been more than a week since Grand Theft Auto 6 marked its much-awaited debut after a long wait of 13 years. The hype around the game continues across social media with YouTube videos, memes, viral posts and more on characters, popular catchphrases and more. Even those who have never played video games before have to be living under a rock not to know about GTA 6.Fans turn to GTA franchise with 2.
paragraph2: 3 million downloadsAmid this, a sharp rise in downloads and player activity across the GTA franchise has been reported. It is said that its older mobile games have recorded an almost fourfold surge in downloads during the first week of its release.According to data from AppMagic, cited by PocketGamer, downloads of the GTA franchise's mobile games have climbed from 590,000 to 2.3 million between November 16 and November 22. GTA: Vice City – Definitive Edition is reported to be leading the trend, with more than 1.1 million downloads in this period.The impact extended to PC gaming as well. AppMagic data showed that daily active users of GTA 5 – Enhanced Edition on Steam rose from 407,000 to 718,000 between November 16 and 21.
paragraph3: GTA 4: The Complete Edition also recorded a significant increase, with daily active users climbing from 68,000 to 115,000.GTA 6's impact on other gaming appsMeanwhile, other gaming apps have also seemingly benefited from the launch of GTA 6.According to the market intelligence firm, PlayStation App downloads have hit 1.3 million, which is more than twice the previous week's figure. On the other hand, Twitch downloads have also reportedly doubled to 1.3 million.The launch has set records for PlayStation, as over 39 million unique players and 683 million hours of gameplay have been reported. The average playtime per player was 17.
paragraph4: 4 hours, as per the same report.All about Grand Theft Auto 6GTA 6, set in Vice City, a fictional city inspired by Miami and South Florida, focuses on a couple who try to succeed at crime. The video game this time introduced these two main characters, Lucia and Jason in the open-world game.The initial reviews of GTA VI lauded the makers for their attention to detail, increased choices for players and some resolved interactions in the game. While critics were mostly impressed by GTA 6, a section of people on the internet preferred the previous GTA game.The game was developed and published by Rockstar Games.About the AuthorSneha BiswasSneha Biswas specialises in covering entertainment and pop culture, with a specialisation on Bollywood, Hollywood, OTT platforms, K-pop, K-dramas, and major developments in the US entertainment industry. She believes in telling stories that balance speed with substance, and in making entertainment journalism contextual, culturally aware, and reader-first rather than purely reactive.
paragraph5:
With over six years of experience in digital media, Sneha currently serves as a Deputy Chief Content Producer at Live Mint. She has spent more than three and a half years with the HT Group and returned to the organisation in February 2025, joining Live Mint to uplift the entertainment section. Over the past year, she has been closely involved in entertainment coverage including breaking news, explainers, trend reporting, box office reports and analysis for the audience.

Sneha is Google News certified, having completed training focused on newsroom best practices, digital reporting, and SEO-driven content strategies. Her work reflects a strong understanding of audience behaviour, search trends, and the evolving consumption patterns of entertainment news across formats.

Prior to her current role, Sneha has worked across multiple content and editorial functions within digital newsrooms, building expertise in content planning, editing, and real-time coverage. Her professional interests lie at the intersection of entertainment, internet culture, and global pop trends.

Working for the National city team, Biswas closely follows global entertainment movements while maintaining a strong pulse on what is happening in India.
bangla_paragraph1: জিটিএ 6 এর উন্মত্ততার মধ্যে, বেশ কয়েকটি জিটিএর ফ্র্যাঞ্চাইজিতে অন্যান্য ভিডিও গেমগুলিতে ফিরে এসেছিল, সামগ্রিক অ্যাপ্লিকেশন ডাউনলোড এবং প্লেয়ারের ক্রিয়াকলাপকে বাড়িয়ে তুলেছিল। এটি প্লেস্টেশন সহ অন্যান্য গেমিং অ্যাপ্লিকেশানগুলিতেও প্রভাব ফেলেছে যা 16 থেকে 22 নভেম্বরের মধ্যে 1.3 মিলিয়ন ডাউনলোড দেখেছিল। গ্র্যান্ড চুরি অটো VI (জিটিএ 6) 19 নভেম্বর প্রকাশিত হয়েছিল। গ্রান্ড চুরি স্বয়ংক্রিয় 6 দীর্ঘ 13 বছরের অপেক্ষার পরে তার বহু প্রতীক্ষিত আত্মপ্রকাশের এক সপ্তাহেরও বেশি সময় ধরে। গেমটির চারপাশে হাইপটি সারা বছর ধরে অব্যাহত রয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: ৩ মিলিয়ন ডাউনলোডএর মধ্যে, জিটিএ ফ্র্যাঞ্চাইজি জুড়ে ডাউনলোড এবং প্লেয়ারের ক্রিয়াকলাপের তীব্র বৃদ্ধি পাওয়া গেছে। বলা হয় যে এর পুরানো মোবাইল গেমগুলি মুক্তির প্রথম সপ্তাহে ডাউনলোডের প্রায় চারগুণ বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে। পকেটগেমারের উদ্ধৃত অ্যাপম্যাগিকের তথ্য অনুসারে, জিটির ফ্র্যাଞ୍ଚাইজির মোবাইল গেমগুলির ডাউনলোডগুলি ৫৯০,০০০ থেকে ২.3 মিলিয়ন নভেম্বরের মধ্যে বেড়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: জিটিএ ৪: সম্পূর্ণ সংস্করণও উল্লেখযোগ্য বৃদ্ধি রেকর্ড করেছে, দৈনিক সক্রিয় ব্যবহারকারীরা ৬৮,০০০ থেকে ১১৫,০০০ এ উঠেছে। জিটিএর প্রভাব অন্যান্য গেমিং অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলিতেও রয়েছে। এদিকে, অন্যান্য গেমिंग অ্যাপ্লিকেশানগুলিও জিটিএই ৬ এর প্রবর্তনের থেকে লাভবান হয়েছে বলে মনে হচ্ছে। বাজার গোয়েন্দা সংস্থার মতে, প্লেস্টেশন অ্যাপ্লিকেেশন ডাউনলোডগুলি ১.৩ মিলিয়ন পৌঁছেছে, যা আগের সপ্তাহের সংখ্যার দ্বিগুণেরও বেশি। অন্যদিকে, টুইচ ডাউনলোডও দ্বিগুণ হয়ে ১.৫ মিলিয়ন হয়েছে বলে জানা গেছে। লঞ্চটি প্লেয়ের জন্য রেকর্ড স্থাপন করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: গ্র্যান্ড চুরি অটো 6 জিটিএ 6 সম্পর্কে সমস্ত কিছু, মায়ামি এবং দক্ষিণ ফ্লোরিডা দ্বারা অনুপ্রাণিত একটি কাল্পনিক শহর ভাইস সিটিতে সেট করা, একটি দম্পতিকে অপরাধে সফল হওয়ার চেষ্টা করে। ভিডিও গেমটি এই সময় এই দুটি প্রধান চরিত্র, লুসিয়া এবং জেসনকে ওপেন-ওয়ার্ল্ড গেমটিতে প্রবর্তন করেছিল। জিটিএর প্রাথমিক পর্যালোচনাগুলি বিশদগুলিতে তাদের মনোযোগ, খেলোয়াড়দের জন্য বর্ধিত পছন্দ এবং গেমটিতে কিছু সমাধানের জন্য নির্মাতাদের প্রশংসা করেছিল। সমালোচকরা বেশিরভাগ জিটিএই 6 দ্বারা মুগ্ধ হয়েছিল, তবে একটি বিভাগ যা
bangla_paragraph5:
ডিজিটাল মিডিয়াতে ছয় বছরেরও বেশি অভিজ্ঞতার সাথে, স্নেহা বর্তমানে লাইভ মিন্টের ডেপুটি চিফ কনটেন্ট প্রযোজক হিসাবে কাজ করছেন। তিনি এইচটি গ্রুপের সাথে সাড়ে তিন বছরেরও বেশী সময় কাটিয়ে ফেব্রুয়ারী ২০২৫ সালে সংস্থায় ফিরে এসেছিলেন, বিনোদন বিভাগকে উন্নত করতে লাইভ মিন্টে যোগদান করেছিলেন। গত এক বছরে তিনি ব্রেকিং নিউজ, ব্যাখ্যাকারী, ট্রেন্ড রিপোর্টিং, বক্স অফিস রিপোর্ট এবং দর্শকদের জন্য বিশ্লেষণ সহ বিনোদের কভারেজে নিবিড়ভাবে জড়িত ছিলেন।

title: AI reshaping role mix, not triggering hiring freeze: Experts
title_bn: এআই-র ভূমিকা সংশোধন, নিয়োগ বন্ধের কারণ নয়ঃ বিশেষজ্ঞরা
author: TechPulse
excerpt: AI reshaping role mix, not triggering hiring freeze: Experts
paragraph1: AI reshaping role mix, not triggering hiring freeze: ExpertsAI reshaping role mix, not triggering hiring freeze: ExpertsNew Delhi, Nov 27 (PTI) Artificial Intelligence is reshaping the mix of roles in an organisation rather than triggering an across-the-board hiring freeze, as companies face increasing competition for AI and cloud talent while entry-level hiring has softened, experts said.With rapid AI adoption, hiring is slowing as productivity expectations rise, and rather than laying off large numbers of mid-level workers, companies are using AI to squeeze more output from existing teams."AI is part of the story, but it is not the whole story," said Achal Khanna, CEO, SHRM – APAC & MENA, and noted that workforce optimisation and softer entry-level hiring have coincided with a 7 per cent year-on-year dip in tech roles, even while competition remains stiff for AI and cloud specialists.
paragraph2: Asked if AI is being used to empower or control people, Alexander Alonso, Chief Knowledge Officer, SHRM, said governance, not AI itself, determines whether technology ends up empowering or constraining people."In my view, managers need three safeguards: transparency about what is being measured and why; a named human being accountable for decisions on pay, promotion and exit; and clarity that data is being used to develop people, not simply rank them. Without these safeguards, AI adoption can become a trust problem before it delivers productivity gains," Alonso said.
paragraph3: By 2031, AI may help draft job descriptions, screen applicants, conduct first-round interviews and flag retention risks. But it cannot carry the consequences of a decision about someone's career."As AI tools improve, human judgement becomes even more important.
paragraph4: SHRM's research on AI use in the workplace found that around one-third of US workers use AI tools their employers have prohibited, underlining the need for people to recognise risks and question unreliable outputs," Alonso said.Going ahead, Khanna said for employees it is no longer a trade-off between stability, fair pay, career growth, flexibility and purpose; employees want the whole bundle."Employees want predictable pay, opportunities to grow, flexibility and alignment with their employer's values.
paragraph5: Organisations that treat these as alternatives may find it harder to attract and retain talent," she said.
bangla_paragraph1: এআই-র ভূমিকা সংশোধন, নিয়োগ বন্ধ নয়: বিশেষজ্ঞরাএআই-এর ভূমিকা সংশোধনের কাজ, নিয়োদন বন্ধ নয়ঃ বিশেষজ্ঞরানয়াদিল্লি, ২৭ নভেম্বর (পিটিআই) কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তা একটি সংস্থার ভূমিকা সংশ্লেষণকে সংশোধন করছে, কারণ সংস্থাগুলি এআই এবং ক্লাউড প্রতিভা জন্য ক্রমবর্ধমান প্রতিযোগিতার মুখোমুখি হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: "আমার মতে, ম্যানেজারদের তিনটি সুরক্ষা প্রয়োজনঃ কী পরিমাপ করা হচ্ছে এবং কেন তা সম্পর্কে স্বচ্ছতা; বেতন, পদোন্নতি এবং প্রস্থান সম্পর্কিত সিদ্ধান্তের জন্য একটি নামযুক্ত মানব দায়বদ্ধ; এবং স্পষ্টতা যে ডেটা কেবল তাদের র্যাঙ্কিং নয়, মানুষকে বিকাশের জন্য ব্যবহৃত হচ্ছে। এই সুরক্ষা ছাড়াই এআই গ্রহণ করা সম্ভব।
bangla_paragraph3: ২০৩১ সালের মধ্যে, এআই চাকরির বর্ণনা, আবেদনকারীদের স্ক্রিন, প্রথম রাউন্ডের সাক্ষাত্কার এবং পতাকা ধরে রাখার ঝুঁকিগুলি তৈরি করতে সহায়তা করতে পারে। তবে এটি কারও কর্মজীবন সম্পর্কে সিদ্ধান্তের পরিণতি বহন করতে পারে না। "যেহেতু এআই সরঞ্জামগুলি উন্নত হয়, মানুষের বিচার আরও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হয়ে ওঠে।
bangla_paragraph4: কর্মক্ষেত্রে এআই ব্যবহারের বিষয়ে এসএইচআরএম-এর গবেষণায় দেখা গেছে যে মার্কিন কর্মীদের প্রায় এক-তৃতীয়াংশ এআই সরঞ্জাম ব্যবহার করে যা তাদের নিয়োগকর্তারা নিষিদ্ধ করেছেন, যা মানুষের ঝুঁকিগুলি স্বীকৃতি দেওয়ার এবং অবিশ্বস্ত আউটপুটগুলি নিয়ে প্রশ্ন করার প্রয়োজনীয়তার উপর জোর দেয়", অ্যালনসো বলেছিলেন।
bangla_paragraph5: যারা এগুলিকে বিকল্প হিসেবে বিবেচনা করে, তাদের প্রতিভা আকর্ষণ এবং ধরে রাখা কঠিন হয়ে উঠতে পারে", বলেন তিনি।

title: Kabeer Biswas’ M Raises $9 Mn Led By RTP Global
title_bn: কাবের বিশ্বাস এম-এর নেতৃত্বে ৯ মিলিয়ন ডলার সংগ্রহ
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas’ AI startup M has raised $9 Mn (₹82 Cr) in a fresh funding round led by…
paragraph1: Dunzo cofounder Kabeer Biswas’ AI startup M has raised $9 Mn (₹82 Cr) in a fresh funding round led by VC firm RTP Global, sources familiar with the development told Inc42. Existing investors of the startup, including Peak XV Partners and Blume Ventures, also doubled down on their erstwhile bets. With this fundraise, M’s total capital raised has reached around $20 Mn. Queries sent to M, RTP Global, and Blume Ventures didn’t receive any response till the time of publication.
paragraph2: The story would be updated based on receiving their responses. The latest round comes around seven months after M raised $11 Mn (around ₹102 Cr) in a seed funding round led by Peak XV, with participation from Blume Ventures and fintech major CRED. Founded in December 2025 by Biswas and former Swish executive Kartik Mishra, M currently offers access through a waitlist. Details of its services remain scant, but the startup had earlier said it planned to weave AI “into the most human part of a home — the kitchen” to help people manage their homes by automating routine decisions, coordination, and everyday services.
paragraph3: “We will make modern living feel frictionless and fundamentally transformed,” M’s description of itself reads. In June, M was reported to be serving around 150 households in Bengaluru as part of its early rollout. The startup was also exploring a subscription-led model, with its target audience comprising affluent urban households. Biswas, who cofounded hyperlocal delivery startup Dunzo in 2014, launched M after a brief stint with Flipkart Minutes.
paragraph4: Dunzo, which had raised capital from Reliance Retail, shut its operations in 2025. The Bengaluru-based startup struggled with mounting cash burn, operational challenges and competition in the quick commerce market. Biswas subsequently joined Flipkart in 2025 to lead its quick commerce business, Minutes, but exited the company in October that year. With M, Biswas is attempting to build a new consumer tech category around AI-powered household management, moving beyond the delivery-led convenience model that defined his earlier venture.

bangla_paragraph3: আমরা আধুনিক জীবনকে ঘর্ষণহীন এবং মৌলিকভাবে রূপান্তরিত করব, এম এর বর্ণনাটি নিজেই বলেছে। জুন মাসে, এম তার প্রাথমিক প্রবর্তনের অংশ হিসাবে বেঙ্গালুরুতে প্রায় ১৫০ টি পরিবারের সেবা দিচ্ছে বলে জানা গেছে। স্টার্টআপটি একটি সাবস্ক্রিপশন-নেতৃত্বাধীন মডেলও অন্বেষণ করছিল, যার লক্ষ্য শ্রোতাদের মধ্যে ধনী শহুরে পরিবার রয়েছে। ২০১৪ সালে হাইপারলোকাল ডেলিভারি স্টার্ট আপ ডানজো সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা বিশ্বাস ফ্লিপকার্ট মিনিটসের সাথে একটি সংক্ষিপ্ত কাজের পরে এম চালু করেছিলেন।
bangla_paragraph4: ডানজো, যা রিলায়েন্স খুচরা থেকে মূলধন সংগ্রহ করেছিল, ২০২৫ সালে তার কার্যক্রম বন্ধ করে দেয়। বেঙ্গালুরু ভিত্তিক স্টার্টআপটি ক্রমবর্ধমান নগদ পোড়া, অপারেশনাল চ্যালেঞ্জ এবং দ্রুত বাণিজ্য বাজারে প্রতিযোগিতার সাথে লড়াই করেছিল। এরপরে বিশ্বাস তার দ্রুত বাণিজ্য ব্যবসা, মিনিটস পরিচালনা করতে ২০২২ সালে ফ্লিপকার্টে যোগদান করেছিলেন, তবে সেই বছরের অক্টোবরে সংস্থাটি ছেড়েছিলেন। এম এর সাথে, বিশ্বাসের একটি নতুন ভোক্তা প্রযুক্তি বিভাগ তৈরি করার চেষ্টা করছে এআই-চালিত পরিবারের পরিচালনার চারপাশে, ডেলিভারি-নেতৃত সুবিধা ছাড়িয়ে

title: indē wild Slips Into Red In FY26 Despite 2.4X YoY Surge In Operating Revenue
title_bn: ২৬ অর্থবছরে অপারেটিং আয়ের ২.৪ গুণ বৃদ্ধি সত্ত্বেও ভারতে প্রবৃদ্ধি কমেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Nikhil Kamath-backed beauty and personal care (BPC) startup indē wild slipped back into the red in the financial year ended…
paragraph1: SUMMARYindē wild swung to a ₹95 Lakh net loss in FY26, reversing a ₹38.5 Lakh profit in the previous fiscal The 139% revenue growth to ₹59.8 Cr was offset by expenses rising over 2.5X YoY, highlighting mounting expansion costs The BPC startup is expanding its retail footprint across India, the US and UK, with products now stocked in 197 Sephora stores overseas Nikhil Kamath-backed beauty and personal care (BPC) startup indē wild slipped back into the red in the financial year ended March 31, 2026 (FY26), posting a net loss of ₹95 Lakh against a net profit of ₹38.5 Lakh in FY25. This is despite the startup’s operating revenue zooming 139% year-on-year (YoY) to ₹59.8 Cr as against ₹25 Cr reported in FY25.
paragraph2: indē wild’s widening expenses, which zoomed over 2.5X YoY, weighed heavily on its margins as the startup expanded its operations during the fiscal year. Including other income of ₹2.3 Cr (up 10X YoY), total income during the year stood at ₹62.1 Cr. Founded in 2021 by influencer Diipa Büller-Khosla and her husband, Oleg Büller-Khosla, the BPC brand retails haircare, skincare and lipcare products in the affordable-premium range. It has positioned itself as combining traditional Ayurvedic ingredients and rituals with modern skincare and haircare science.
paragraph3: Its products are sold through its own online channels and retail partners, including Nykaa, Tira and Sephora. It has now expanded to international markets in the US and UK through its partnership with Sephora, which has placed the brand’s products across 197 stores in both countries. Earlier this week, the startup raised an undisclosed amount from Zeordha founder Nikhil Kamath’s WTFund. Kamath will also be making his modeling debut through the brand, endorsing its haircare line, Moonlight Growth. Besides Kamath, the startup also counts Unilever Ventures and SoGal Ventures as its investors. It has raised $8 Mn till date. Much of indē wild’s social media virality is driven largely through an influencer-marketing engine online and online community building.
paragraph4: It competes in a highly competitive BPC market, with competitors including Kama Ayurveda, Forest Essentials and RAS Luxury Oils, along with more affordable clean beauty brands like Juicy Chemistry, Nat Habit, and Biotique. Expenses Weigh Down Bottom Line The startup slipped back into a net loss in FY26 as its expenses jumped over 156% YoY in FY26 to ₹63 Cr compared to ₹24.6 Cr earlier. Purchase of Stock-In-Trade: As indē wild’s revenue base grew, its inventory expenditure jumped 167% YoY to ₹22 Cr from ₹8.4 Cr in the year-ago period. At the close of FY26, it had inventory worth ₹10.5 Cr on its books.
paragraph5: Employee Benefit Expenses: indē wild spent around ₹9 Cr on payroll during the fiscal year under review, a 172.7% increase from ₹3.3 Cr in year-ago period. Marketing & Advertising: Expenses under this head more than tripled YoY to ₹19.7 Cr from ₹6 Cr spent in FY25.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার বি.পি.সি. স্টার্টআপ ভারত, মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্র এবং যুক্তরাজ্য জুড়ে খুচরা বিক্রির সুযোগ বাড়িয়ে দিচ্ছে। বর্তমানে বিদেশে 197টি সেফোরা স্টোরে পণ্য রয়েছে। নিখিল কামাতের সমর্থিত বিউটি অ্যান্ড পার্সোনাল কেয়ার (বিপিসি) স্টার্ট আপ ইন্ডি ওয়াইল্ড ৩১ মার্চ, ২০২২ সালে শেষ হওয়া অর্থবছরে আবারো নেমে এসেছে।
bangla_paragraph2: indē wild’s widening expenses, which zoomed over 2.5X YoY, weighed heavily on its margins as the startup expanded its operations during the fiscal year. Including other income of ₹2.3 Cr (up 10X YoY), total income during the year stood at ₹62.1 Cr. Founded in 2021 by influencer Diipa Büller-Khosla and her husband, Oleg Büller-Khosla, the BPC brand retails haircare, skincare and lipcare products in the affordable-premium range. It has positioned itself as combining traditional Ayurvedic ingredients and rituals with modern skincare and haircare science.
bangla_paragraph3: Its products are sold through its own online channels and retail partners, including Nykaa, Tira and Sephora. It has now expanded to international markets in the US and UK through its partnership with Sephora, which has placed the brand’s products across 197 stores in both countries. Earlier this week, the startup raised an undisclosed amount from Zeordha founder Nikhil Kamath’s WTFund. Kamath will also be making his modeling debut through the brand, endorsing its haircare line, Moonlight Growth. Besides Kamath, the startup also counts Unilever Ventures and SoGal Ventures as its investors. It has raised $8 Mn till date. Much of indē wild’s social media virality is driven largely through an influencer-marketing engine online and online community building.

title: Paying high roaming charges abroad? WhatsApp's upcoming eSIM feature could offer an alternative
title_bn: বিদেশে উচ্চ রোমিং চার্জ পরিশোধ করা? হোয়াটসঅ্যাপের আসন্ন ই-সিম বৈশিষ্ট্য একটি বিকল্প প্রস্তাব করতে পারে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: WhatsApp is developing an in-app travel eSIM service with partners including Jio, Verizon and others, allowing users to purchase and install international data plans without changing their existing WhatsApp number.
paragraph1: WhatsApp is developing an in-app travel eSIM service with partners including Jio, Verizon and others, allowing users to purchase and install international data plans without changing their existing WhatsApp number.WhatsApp plans in-app travel eSIM service.(AI generated image for representational purposes only)WhatApp is working on a new feature that will enable users to buy and install foreign travel eSIMs directly from the messaging app. The feature, expected to roll out in select countries soon, is being developed in partnership with telecom operators and eSIM providers, including Reliance Jio in India and Verizon in the US. It's designed to allow international tourists to connect to mobile data as soon as they arrive in their destination country without having to purchase a physical SIM card or pay high roaming rates.The upcoming service will allow eligible users to browse and purchase travel data plans through WhatsApp in just a few steps. It has yet to reveal the launch date, supported destinations or the prices of plans or data limits. The functionality will make the international connectivity more convenient for the users without forcing them to change their WhatsApp account or phone number.
paragraph2: WhatsApp partners with Jio and Verizon for travel eSIM serviceIn an official blog post titled Stay connected on WhatsApp when you travel, published on WhatsApp's website, the company confirmed that it is working with multiple eSIM providers and telecom operators to bring the service to users. The confirmed partners include Jio, Smart Axiata, Smart Communications and Verizon.The feature will be rolled out in “quasi-experimental” countries soon, says WhatsApp. It has not just announced which markets will be the first to get the service or if Indian users will be included in the initial rollout.The campaign seeks to assist travellers in connecting with people and places once they have arrived in a different country, the company said. While travelling, users often rely on airport Wi-Fi or buy area SIM cards to avail of mobile internet connectivity. An upcoming service might provide an alternative to allow them to plan the connectivity pre- or during the trip.Users can retain their existing WhatsApp numberWhatsApp also noted that users will not have to change the phone number associated with the WhatsApp account when they install a travel eSIM.
paragraph3: This allows travellers to use mobile data from the travel eSIM while still being able to send, receive messages and make calls with their existing account.Kunal Shah, Head of WhatsApp, also discussed the company's plans in a post on X, inviting eSIM partners to participate in the initiative. He emphasised the mission of maintaining users' engagement with WhatsApp during their journeys.WhatsApp Android app hints at travel eSIM featuresThe announcement follows an earlier report that identified references to a Travel eSIM feature in WhatsApp for Android version 2.26.47.10. The report says that the app's code indicated that users were able to search for plans according to their travel destinations.
paragraph4: The offers that were reported were regional and global packages, fixed data allowances, and unlimited data plans. There could be instructions for the user on how to install the app and an alert for them as to whether the eSIM was installed or not.However, these details are based on references found in the Android app's code and have not been confirmed as final features by WhatsApp. More information about availability, pricing and supported plans is expected closer to the rollout.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content.
paragraph5: Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.
bangla_paragraph1: হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ জিও, ভেরিজন এবং অন্যান্য সহযোগীদের সাথে একটি ইন-অ্যাপ ভ্রমণ ই-সিম পরিষেবা বিকাশ করছে, যা ব্যবহারকারীদের তাদের বিদ্যমান হোয়াটের নম্বর পরিবর্তন না করে আন্তর্জাতিক ডেটা প্ল্যান কিনতে এবং ইনস্টল করতে দেয়। হোয়াটেসঅপ ইন-এপ ভ্রমণ এসআইএম পরিষেবা পরিকল্পনা করে।
bangla_paragraph2: হোয়াটসঅ্যাপের ওয়েবসাইটের মাধ্যমে প্রকাশিত হোয়াটের অফিসিয়াল ব্লগে 'আপনি যখন ভ্রমণ করেন তখন হোয়াটেসে সংযুক্ত থাকুন' শিরোনামে একটি পোস্ট প্রকাশিত হয়েছে। হোয়াટসঅাপ নিশ্চিত করেছে যে এটি একাধিক ই-সিম সরবরাহকারী এবং টেলিকম অপারেটরদের সাথে কাজ করছে। নিশ্চিত অংশীদারদের মধ্যে জিও, স্মার্ট অ্যাক্সিয়াটা, স্মার্ট কমিউনিকেশনস এবং ভেরিজোন রয়েছে। এই বৈশিষ্ট্যটি শীঘ্রই অক্সি-পরীক্ষামূলক দেশে চালু করা হবে, হোয়া্টসঅপ বলেছে। এটি কেবলমাত্র কোন ব্র্যান্ডের ঘোষণা করেনি।
bangla_paragraph3: এটি ভ্রমণকারীদের তাদের বিদ্যমান অ্যাকাউন্ট দিয়ে বার্তা প্রেরণ, গ্রহণ এবং কল করতে সক্ষম থাকাকালীন ভ্রমণকারীকে ভ্রমণ ই-সিমের মোবাইল ডেটা ব্যবহার করতে দেয়। হোয়াটসঅ্যাপের প্রধান কুনাল শাহও এক্স-এ একটি পোস্টে কোম্পানির পরিকল্পনা নিয়ে আলোচনা করেছেন, ই-এসআইএম অংশীদারদের এই উদ্যোগে অংশ নিতে আমন্ত্রণ জানিয়েছেন। তিনি তাদের ভ্রমণের সময় হোয়াટসঅপ-এর সাথে ব্যবহারকারীদের ব্যস্ততা বজায় রাখার মিশনে জোর দিয়েছেন। হোয়ারসঅ্যাক অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অ্যাপ্লিকেশন ভ্রমণ এসআইএম বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি সম্পর্কে পরামর্শ দেয়। এই ঘোষণাটি একটি পূর্ববর্তী প্রতিবেদনের পরে আসে যা রেফারেন্স চিহ্নিত করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: রিপোর্ট করা অফারগুলি ছিল আঞ্চলিক এবং বিশ্বব্যাপী প্যাকেজ, স্থির ডেটা ভাতা এবং সীমাহীন ডেটা পরিকল্পনা। অ্যাপটি কীভাবে ইনস্টল করবেন সে সম্পর্কে ব্যবহারকারীর জন্য নির্দেশাবলী এবং তাদের জন্য ই-সিম ইনস্টলেশন হয়েছে কিনা তা সম্পর্কে একটি সতর্কতা থাকতে পারে। যাইহোক, এই বিবরণগুলি অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অ্যাপ্লিকেশনটির কোডে পাওয়া রেফারেন্সের উপর ভিত্তি করে এবং হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ দ্বারা চূড়ান্ত বৈশিষ্ট্য হিসাবে নিশ্চিত করা হয়নি। প্রাপ্যতা, মূল্য এবং সমর্থিত পরিকল্পনা সম্পর্কে আরও তথ্য রোলআউট কাছাকাছি প্রত্যাশিত। লেখক সম্পর্কে
bangla_paragraph5: প্রজ্ঞার অভিজ্ঞতা ব্রেকিং নিউজ, ব্যাখ্যাকারী, এসইও-চালিত গল্প, পণ্য কভারেজ, সাক্ষাত্কার, আনবক্সিং ভিডিও এবং লাইভ ইভেন্ট রিপোর্টিং অন্তর্ভুক্ত। তিনি নিউজরুম এবং মাঠের রিপোর্টার উভয় ক্ষেত্রেই তার অভিজ্ঞতা প্রদান করে প্রধান প্রযুক্তি এবং এআই ইভেন্টেও কভার করেছেন। সাংবাদিকতার বাইরে, প্রজ্ঞা একজন আগ্রহী গেমার এবং কাল্পনিকের উত্সাহী পাঠক। তিনি গেম এবং বইয়ের মাধ্যমে নিমজ্জনমূলক জগতগুলি অন্বেষণ করতে পছন্দ করেন, বিশেষত নতুন দৃষ্টিকোণ, ধারণা এবং অভিজ্ঞতা সরবরাহকারী গল্পগুলিতে বিশেষ আগ্রহ রয়েছে।

title: Chinas humanoid robot investment set to accelerate, selective commercial use expected in 2027: Morgan Stanley
title_bn: চীনের মানবিক রোবট বিনিয়োগ দ্রুততর হবে, ২০২৭ সালে বেছে নেওয়া বাণিজ্যিক ব্যবহারের আশা করা হচ্ছে: মর্গান স্ট্যানলি
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Investment in humanoid robots is expected to accelerate in China, with improving artificial intelligence capabilities likely to support initial commercial deployments in selected tasks in 2027, even as widespread adoption remains some distance away,
paragraph1: Investment in humanoid robots is expected to accelerate in China, with improving artificial intelligence capabilities likely to support initial commercial deployments in selected tasks in 2027, even as widespread adoption remains some distance away, according to a Morgan Stanley report.Chinas humanoid robot investment set to accelerate, selective commercial use expected in 2027: Morgan StanleyNew Delhi [India], : Investment in humanoid robots is expected to accelerate in China, with improving artificial intelligence capabilities likely to support initial commercial deployments in selected tasks in 2027, even as widespread adoption remains some distance away, according to a Morgan Stanley report.The report said spending on data collection, robot training and early customer deployments is likely to increase, creating opportunities for companies supplying cameras, sensors, robotic hands, motors and other components."Development spending can drive hardware orders before widespread commercial adoption," the report said, highlighting how suppliers could benefit from rising investment even before humanoid robots become widely used in commercial operations.
paragraph2: Morgan Stanley said recent advances in AI models have improved robots' ability to understand instructions and perform physical tasks. In one robotics benchmark, the success rate of a newer model more than doubled to 41.2 per cent from 19.6 per cent, while its average response time declined by 33 per cent.
paragraph3: The report expects these improvements to create a cycle in which better robot performance encourages investment in data and training, while feedback from wider operations helps developers improve models and skills.The report expects small-scale commercial use in selected applications in 2027. It said repeat purchases, productive working hours and the ability of robots to perform tasks efficiently compared with human labour would be important indicators of progress.Companies are also setting delivery and capacity targets.
paragraph4: UBTECH is targeting around 4,000 industrial and commercial humanoid deliveries in 2026, along with 1,500-2,000 household units. Geekplus expects to ship its first batch of around 300 humanoids by the end of 2026 or early 2027.Morgan Stanley said manufacturers are expanding production capacity in anticipation of demand, although precision machining, equipment availability, skilled labour and production yields remain challenges.The report said the gap between technological advances and commercial viability is likely to narrow gradually, with the sector's near-term progress depending on policy support, further improvements in AI capabilities and product launches.

bangla_paragraph2: মর্গান স্ট্যানলি বলেন, এআই মডেলের সাম্প্রতিক অগ্রগতি রোবটগুলির নির্দেশাবলী বুঝতে এবং শারীরিক কাজ সম্পাদন করার ক্ষমতা উন্নত করেছে। একটি রোবোটিক্স বেঞ্চমার্কে, একটি নতুন মডেলটির সাফল্যের হার দ্বিগুণেরও বেশি বেড়ে হয়েছে 41.2 শতাংশ থেকে 19.6 শতাংশে, যখন এর গড় প্রতিক্রিয়া সময় 33 শতাংশ হ্রাস পেয়েছে।

bangla_paragraph5: এটি যোগ করেছে যে টেকসই বৃদ্ধির জন্য উৎপাদনশীলতা বৃদ্ধি, বাণিজ্যিকভাবে কার্যকর ব্যয় এবং গ্রাহকদের পুনরাবৃত্তি আদেশের আরও স্পষ্ট প্রমাণ প্রয়োজন।

title: NUUK Expands Its Home Appliances Portfolio To Drive ₹150 Cr Revenue In FY27
title_bn: এনইউইউকে ২৭ অর্থবছরে ১৫০ কোটি টাকার রাজস্ব অর্জনের লক্ষ্যে গৃহ সরঞ্জামগুলির পোর্টফোলিও সম্প্রসারণ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Indian consumers are more discerning than ever, particularly when setting up their dream homes. After spending months obsessing over every…
paragraph1: Indian consumers are more discerning than ever, particularly when setting up their dream homes. After spending months obsessing over every little detail of their humble abode, from furniture and wall colours to lighting and décor, the last thing they want is an appliance that sticks out like a sore thumb. Imagine walking into a beautifully designed home. The walls are painted in soothing colours, the furniture has been carefully chosen, the lighting is just right, and every little detail reflects the homeowner’s personal taste. Everything looks picture-perfect, except for a bulky, old-fashioned table fan and that clunky room heater sitting awkwardly in a corner. Indian consumers often face this eyesore and must choose between aesthetics and performance, with few options that bring the best of both worlds together. Gazal Kalra and Shalabh Gupta experienced this gap firsthand when they struggled to find aesthetically pleasing home appliances without compromising functionality. Inspired by their experience, they launched NUUK, a design-led home appliances brand, in 2023 to bring aesthetics and functionality together in everyday appliances. Today, Nuuk boasts a portfolio of 20 products and variants across five categories — cooling, floor care, food preparation, heating, and garment and fabric care. Since its launch, NUUK has sold more than 6 Lakh units across categories via its website, ecommerce marketplaces, quick commerce platforms and other sales channels. The brand has also won Red Dot Design Awards, an international honour for design excellence, thrice and earned recognition at Kyoorius Design Awards, a national award that celebrates creative and design excellence. In FY26, the company reported net revenue of approximately ₹70 Cr, with revenue in April and May 2026 growing 2x YoY.
paragraph2: To support its next phase of growth, NUUK has raised over $10 Mn from Vertex Ventures SE Asia & India SEA and Good Capital. Everyday Appliances, Reimagined The architects behind NUUK’s concept and its subsequent growth, Kalra and Gupta, bring complementary expertise, making them a natural fit for the venture. While Kalra brings expertise in human-centred design from her time at Stanford Design School and experience building and scaling businesses as cofounder of Rivigo, Gupta brings a strong understanding of strategy, consumer behaviour, and digital-first brand building from his stints at McKinsey, Twitter (now X), and Noise. For the NUUK founders, building a design-led home appliances brand meant improving how everyday appliances look, work and fit into consumers’ daily lives. “Every design decision must serve a purpose. It should make the product more intuitive, convenient and effective without compromising performance,” Kalra said, citing the example of NUUK’s flagship air circulator, HĀLO, which addresses two common problems with conventional fans — noise and limited airflow direction. The product also includes a mood lighting feature, adding another design element to a product usually treated as purely functional. The same approach extends to the kitchen. While developing BRĪSK, NUUK’s toxin-free ceramic air fryer, the founders said that they identified concerns around cooking surfaces used in conventional air fryers. “We spent over 24 months researching and testing alternative materials before developing the air fryer with a Swiss-engineered ILAG CeramicTech surface that is free from lead, cadmium, PFOA, PFAS and PTFE,” Kalra assured. BRĪSK, Kalra added, also features a 360-degree Rapid Air Circulation system to cook food evenly and up to 30% faster, plus an ILAG ceramic surface for a non-stick effect, durability, and easy cleaning. For its floor care segment, the founders turned their attention to addressing all the challenges of cleaning Indian homes.
paragraph3: The result is REN PRO, a cordless vacuum cleaner with 34 kPa suction and a FlexiStick bending rod. The product’s adaptive suction technology automatically adjusts power based on detected dust levels, helping optimise battery life. RECOMMENDED FOR yOU “We want every feature to solve a problem and not add complexity,” she said. To stay ahead of the innovation curve, the founders started paying attention to the post-sales journey of their products. Gupta shared the case study of KRÜSH, a blender that customers used for smoothies and shakes rather than chutneys or dry masalas. “As customers began raising concerns about discolouration, dampness and lingering odours, we introduced a separate stainless steel jar with KRÜSH PRO, making it suitable for a wider range of kitchen tasks,” he said. NUUK’s LĪT fan went through a similar evolution. Customers wanted a taller model with stronger oscillation, prompting NUUK to introduce LĪT PRO with a ProLift stem and a more powerful sweep. Reflecting on these changes, Gupta said, “In both cases, the new version answers something people told us rather than something we guessed. That’s how we approach every product: listen for the friction, then design it away.” Building The Manufacturing Backbone As NUUK expands across categories, it faces the challenge of scaling production while maintaining consistent quality across very different appliances. Addressing this requires close control over product specifications, engineering and quality standards.
paragraph4: NUUK follows a partnership-led manufacturing model. While the company owns product conception, engineering and design, its manufacturing partners operate the production lines. Its in-house new product development team handles everything from consumer insights and industrial design to product architecture, feature definition and technical specifications. To execute this model, NUUK works with a network of Indian and global appliance manufacturers, including Zetwerk and Epack Durable. Its manufacturing partners operate facilities across Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Haryana. Localising the component base is another part of this strategy. NUUK works with both Indian and global suppliers, selecting components based on quality and performance. According to Gupta, locally sourced components account for 30% to 100% of a product’s material value, depending on the product. NUUK is gradually increasing the use of Indian components across its portfolio. Maintaining quality across this network also requires checks at multiple stages. The brand’s components are inspected upon receipt against specifications defined by its team, while finished products undergo in-process inspections. Every production lot also goes through a pre-dispatch inspection against agreed acceptance standards before it is released.
paragraph5: The company is now working towards making 100% of its products in India from 2027. This would build on its existing manufacturing partnerships and localisation efforts, as it looks to develop production capabilities that meet global standards. NUUK’s Next Phase Of Growth NUUK’s next phase of growth will depend on how effectively it can build on its existing categories while expanding into new areas. The company currently operates across five categories, with fans accounting for around 51% of its revenue, followed by vacuum cleaners at 18%, and food preparation appliances and room heaters at approximately 12% each. Deepening its presence across these categories while introducing products for more specialised consumer needs will be central to this effort. NUUK is also strengthening its brand and consumer outreach, having brought in filmmaker and actor Karan Johar as its brand ambassador. NUUK has continued to expand its portfolio with products such as SĒRV MAX, a multi-cook electric kettle, and is also exploring further opportunities in its heating range. One of its new category bets is indoor air quality. NUUK has recently launched STĀCK, an air purifier that features four-stage HEPA-14 filtration and sensors that track PM2.5, PM10, temperature and humidity.
bangla_paragraph1: ভারতীয় গ্রাহকরা আগের চেয়ে বেশি বিচক্ষণ, বিশেষ করে তাদের স্বপ্নের বাড়ি স্থাপন করার সময়। আসবাবপত্র এবং দেয়ালের রঙ থেকে আলো এবং সজ্জা পর্যন্ত তাদের বিনয়ী বাসস্থানের প্রতিটি ছোট্ট বিবরণ নিয়ে মাসগুলি ব্যয় করার পরে, তারা যে শেষ জিনিসটি চায় তা হ'ল একটি যন্ত্র যা একটি ব্যথা আঙ্গুলের মতো দাঁড়িয়ে আছে। একটি সুন্দরভাবে ডিজাইন করা বাড়িতে হাঁটার কথা কল্পনা করুন। দেয়ালগুলি শান্ত রঙে আঁকা হয়েছে, আসবাবগুলি সাবধানে নির্বাচিত হয়েছে, আলো ঠিক আছে এবং প্রতিটি ছোট ছোট বিবরণ প্রতিফলিত হয়।
bangla_paragraph2: এনইউইউকে তার পরবর্তী বৃদ্ধির পর্যায়ে সমর্থন করার জন্য ভার্টেক্স ভেঞ্চার্স এসই এশিয়া ও ইন্ডিয়া সিএ এবং গুড ক্যাপিটাল থেকে ১০ মিলিয়ন ডলারেরও বেশি সংগ্রহ করেছে। প্রতিদিনের অ্যাপ্লায়েন্স, পুনরায় কল্পনা করা এনইইউকিউকে ধারণার পিছনে স্থপতি এবং এর পরবর্তী বৃদ্ধিকারী ক্যালরা এবং গুপ্তা পরিপূরক দক্ষতা নিয়ে আসেন, তাদের উদ্যোগের জন্য একটি প্রাকৃতিক ফিট করে তোলে। যদিও ক্যালর স্ট্যানফোর্ড ডিজাইন স্কুলে তার সময় থেকে মানবকেন্দ্রিক নকশায় দক্ষতা এবং রিভিগোর সহ-প্রতিষ্ঠাতা হিসাবে ব্যবসা নির্মাণ এবং স্কেলিংয়ের অভিজ্ঞতা নিয়ে আসে, গুপ্ত একটি শক্তিশালী ওভারভিউ নিয়ে আসে।
bangla_paragraph3: এর ফলে ৩৪ কেপিএ চুষন এবং ফ্লেক্সিস্টিক বাঁকানো রড সহ একটি কর্ডলেস ভ্যাকুয়াম ক্লিনার রেন প্রো তৈরি হয়েছে। পণ্যটির অভিযোজিত চুষার প্রযুক্তি সনাক্ত ধুলোর মাত্রার উপর ভিত্তি করে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে শক্তি সামঞ্জস্য করে, ব্যাটারির আয়ু অনুকূল করতে সহায়তা করে। আপনার জন্য প্রস্তাবিত আমরা প্রতিটি বৈশিষ্ট্য একটি সমস্যা সমাধান করতে চাই এবং জটিলতা যুক্ত করি না, তিনি বলেছিলেন। উদ্ভাবনের বক্ররেখার আগে থাকার জন্য, প্রতিষ্ঠাতারা তাদের পণ্যগুলির বিক্রয়োত্তর যাত্রায় মনোযোগ দিতে শুরু করেছিলেন। গুপ্ত KRÜSH এর কেস স্টাডি ভাগ করেছেন, একটি ব্লেন্ডার th
bangla_paragraph4: এনইউইউকে একটি অংশীদারিত্ব-নেতৃত্বাধীন উত্পাদন মডেল অনুসরণ করে। যদিও সংস্থাটি পণ্য ধারণা, প্রকৌশল এবং নকশার মালিক, তবে এর উত্পন্ন অংশীদারা উত্পাহনের লাইনগুলি পরিচালনা করে। এর অভ্যন্তরীণ নতুন পণ্য বিকাশ দল গ্রাহক অন্তর্দৃষ্টি এবং শিল্প নকশা থেকে পণ্য স্থাপত্য, বৈশিষ্ট্য সংজ্ঞা এবং প্রযুক্তিগত স্পেসিফিকেশন পর্যন্ত সবকিছু পরিচালনা করবে। এই মডেলটি কার্যকর করতে, এনইইউকিউ জেটওয়ার্ক এবং ইপ্যাক টেকসই সহ ভারতীয় এবং বিশ্বব্যাপী অ্যাপ্লায়েন্স প্রস্তুতকারকদের একটি নেটওয়ার্কের সাথে কাজ করে।
bangla_paragraph5: ন্যুউক ২০২৭ সাল থেকে ভারতে তার পণ্যের ১০০% তৈরির দিকে কাজ করছে। এটি তার বিদ্যমান উত্পাদন অংশীদারিত্ব এবং স্থানীয়করণের প্রচেষ্টাকে গড়ে তুলবে, কারণ এটি বিশ্বমানের মান পূরণ করে এমন উত্পন্ন ক্ষমতা বিকাশের লক্ষ্য রাখে। ন্যুকে এর পরবর্তী পর্যায়ের বৃদ্ধি ন্যুকের পরবর্তী পর্য্যায়ের বৃদ্ধি নির্ভর করবে যে এটি নতুন অঞ্চলে প্রসারিত হওয়ার সময় এটি তার বর্তমান বিভাগগুলিতে কতটা কার্যকরভাবে তৈরি করতে পারে। সংস্থাটি বর্তমানে পাঁচটি বিভাগে পরিচালনা করে, যার মধ্যে ভক্তরা এর প্রায় ৫১% এর জন্য দায়ী।

title: 'Still trying to process this': 17-year-old ‘AI Kid of India’ Raul John Aju clicks selfie with Russian President Vladimir Putin
title_bn: 'এখনও এই বিষয়টা নিয়ে ভাবছি': ১৭ বছর বয়সী এআই কিড অফ ইন্ডিয়া রাউল জন আজু রাশিয়ার প্রেসিডেন্ট ভ্লাদিমির পুতিনের সঙ্গে সেলফি তুললেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: At nine, he was making videos in a bathroom, driven by nothing more than curiosity and a love for creating. At 17, Kerala's Raul John Aju, popularly known as India's 'AI Kid', found himself taking a selfie with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the
paragraph1: Moscow [Russia], November 27 (ANI): At nine, he was making videos in a bathroom, driven by nothing more than curiosity and a love for creating. At 17, Kerala's Raul John Aju, popularly known as India's 'AI Kid', found himself taking a selfie with Russian President Vladimir Putin at the AI Journey 2026 conference in Moscow. It is a journey that even he admits he could never have imagined.From experimenting with AI to developing AI-powered tools, training thousands of people and building his own technology venture, Aju has been steadily turning his childhood curiosity into an entrepreneurial journey. Sharing the photograph with Putin on Instagram, the teenager reflected on how far he had come, while acknowledging that there was still much more to learn and achieve.“From making my first video in a bathroom at 9 to taking a selfie with President Putin, never in my wildest dreams did I think life would take me here,” Aju wrote on Instagram.Beyond milestones and appearances, he focused on how the experience has shaped him personally.
paragraph2: “More than anything I’ve achieved, I’m grateful for the person this journey has helped me become.”The teenager said interacting with leading experts and experienced minds gave him a fresh perspective on his own journey. He added that the experience made him realise how much more he needed to learn and explore in the field of artificial intelligence.“Meeting some incredible people at AI Journey (way smarter than me) made me realise how much more I have to learn,” he added.Aju also acknowledged the support of those who had been part of his journey, expressing gratitude to the AI Journey team, his parents and friends for standing by him and encouraging him along the way.“Thank you AIJ, everyone at AIJ, and especially my parents for always believing in me. Also @jaybhadwal and @the_harryeffect @josh.
paragraph3: joji luv u :)..And to everyone who’s been part of this journey, thank you for making a little kid’s dreams come true.”“Still a curious kid, just with a few more stories to tell.” He concluded the post with a picture of himself with Vladimir Putin.In another Instagram post accompanying a video of his meeting with Putin, the young innovator expressed amazement at how far he had come.“Still trying to process this. From being a little kid making videos for fun to meeting President Putin at 17, life has given me opportunities I never even knew to dream of,” he wrote.
paragraph4: “So much more to learn, so much more to do. Grateful for every single person who’s been part of this journey,” he added.Known as the ‘AI Kid of India’, the Kerala teenager has attracted attention for developing artificial intelligence tools, conducting AI training programmes and turning his interest in the technology into a startup.One of the notable aspects of his entrepreneurial journey is that his father works with him and reportedly receives a monthly salary of ₹2 lakh, according to Gulf News.Aju studied as a Plus Two Commerce student at North Edappally GHSS while pursuing his interest in artificial intelligence. His LinkedIn profile identifies him as the founder and Chief Technology Officer of AIRealm Technologies, where he works on developing AI products, conducting experiments and creating practical technology solutions.Through AIRealm Technologies Pvt Ltd, Aju has developed several AI-based projects and tools.
paragraph5: Profiles of the young innovator have reported that he has created around 15 AI tools and trained nearly five lakh people in artificial intelligence.Among his projects is JustEase, an AI-based initiative developed in collaboration with the Kerala government to help people access information and make decisions during emergencies.He has also worked on Rescue AI, a project aimed at providing emergency guidance, information about laws and access to legal assistance.His work has also taken him to prominent technology platforms. In 2026, Aju attended the India AI Impact Summit in Delhi, where he interacted with United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres and discussed the role of young people in the artificial intelligence era, as per the outlet.From creating his first video at the age of nine to building AI-based solutions and attending international technology conferences, Aju's journey has attracted attention for his early interest in technology and entrepreneurship.His latest meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin has added another significant milestone to his journey, which he describes as one driven by curiosity, learning and gratitude.

bangla_paragraph2: আমি যে কোনও কিছুর চেয়ে বেশি অর্জন করেছি, আমি এই যাত্রা আমাকে যে ব্যক্তি হতে সাহায্য করেছে তার জন্য কৃতজ্ঞ।  কিশোরীটি বলেছে যে শীর্ষস্থানীয় বিশেষজ্ঞ এবং অভিজ্ঞ মনের সাথে যোগাযোগ তাকে তার নিজের যাত্রার উপর একটি নতুন দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি দিয়েছে। তিনি যোগ করেছেন যে এই অভিজ্ঞতা তাকে বুঝতে সাহায্য করেছে যে কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তার ক্ষেত্রে তাকে আরও কত কিছু শিখতে এবং অন্বেষণ করতে হবে। ️এআই যাত্রায় কিছু অবিশ্বাস্য ব্যক্তির সাথে দেখা (আমার চেয়ে অনেক বেশি স্মার্ট) আমাকে বুঝতে সাহায্য করেছিল যে আমার আরও কত শিখতে হবে,  তিনি যোগ করেছিলেন।
bangla_paragraph3: একটি ছোট্ট শিশুর স্বপ্নকে বাস্তবে পরিণত করার জন্য ধন্যবাদ।এখনও একটি কৌতূহলী শিশু, শুধু আরও কিছু গল্প বলার জন্য। তিনি ভ্লাদিমির পুতিনের সাথে নিজের ছবি দিয়ে পোস্টটি শেষ করেছেন।
bangla_paragraph4: তিনি আরও বলেন, এই যাত্রার অংশীদার প্রত্যেকের প্রতি কৃতজ্ঞ। ভারতের এআই কিড নামে পরিচিত এই কেরালার কিশোর কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তার সরঞ্জাম তৈরি, এআই প্রশিক্ষণ কর্মসূচি পরিচালনা এবং প্রযুক্তিতে তার আগ্রহকে স্টার্টআপে পরিণত করার জন্য দৃষ্টি আকর্ষণ করেছে। তার উদ্যোক্তা যাত্রায় অন্যতম উল্লেখযোগ্য দিক হল তার বাবা তার সাথে কাজ করেন এবং প্রতি মাসে ২ লক্ষ টাকা বেতন পান বলে গালফ নিউজের তথ্য অনুযায়ী।
bangla_paragraph5: এই তরুণ উদ্ভাবকের প্রোফাইল থেকে জানা যায় যে তিনি প্রায় ১৫ টি এআই সরঞ্জাম তৈরি করেছেন এবং কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তার ক্ষেত্রে প্রায় পাঁচ লক্ষ মানুষকে প্রশিক্ষণ দিয়েছেন। তাঁর প্রকল্পগুলির মধ্যে রয়েছে জাস্টইজ, যা জরুরি অবস্থার সময় তথ্য অ্যাক্সেস এবং সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে মানুষকে সহায়তা করার জন্য কেরালা সরকারের সহযোগিতায় তৈরি একটি এআই ভিত্তিক উদ্যোগ। তিনি রেসকিউ এআই-তেও কাজ করেছেন, যা একটি প্রকল্প যা জরুরী দিকনির্দেশনা, আইন সম্পর্কিত তথ্য এবং আইনী সহায়তার অ্যাক্সসেস প্রদানের লক্ষ্যে।

paragraph1: Croma Black Friday Sale 2026 is live till Nov 30 with up to 50% off. iPhone 16 from ₹45,490, MacBook Neo at ₹42,714; laptop, TV and appliance deals.A person holds Apple’s new iPhone 17 series at an Apple Store.(REUTERS)Croma has announced its Black Friday Sale 2026 in India, with discounts of up to 50% on smartphones, laptops, televisions, home appliances and personal care products. The five-day sale runs from November 26 to November 30, 2026, in Croma stores and online. Eligible purchases also get bank cashback, exchange bonuses and EMI benefits.The sale includes deals on Apple, Samsung, Oppo, Lenovo, HP, Acer, Sony and LG products.
paragraph2: Croma said on November 26 that the iPhone 16 starts at ₹45,490 after offers, while the iPhone 17 Pro Max starts at ₹96,290. Actual prices depend on bank offers, exchange value and device condition. Croma Black Friday Sale 2026: iPhone and MacBook deals Apple products are among the sale's main highlights. Buyers of select iPhones and MacBooks can combine bank cashback with exchange benefits and extra exchange bonuses.The iPhone 16 (128GB) is listed at ₹45,490. That price includes up to ₹2,000 in bank cashback, up to ₹24,000 for exchanging an iPhone 14 (128GB), and an additional exchange bonus of up to ₹8,000.The iPhone 17 Pro Max (256GB, Orange) starts at ₹96,290 with similar offers, including up to ₹4,000 in bank cashback.
paragraph3: The MacBook Neo (8GB RAM, 256GB storage) is priced at ₹42,714, with exchange benefits of up to ₹12,000 and bank cashback of up to ₹7,000.Samsung, Oppo and Redmi smartphones offerCroma is also offering discounts on Android phones:Oppo F35 Pro 5G (6GB + 128GB) starting at ₹11,761Redmi 17C 5G (4GB + 128GB) starting at ₹11,999Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra (12GB + 256GB) starting at ₹85,999Laptop deals during the Croma Black Friday SaleThose who wish to purchase laptops can avail an exchange bonus of up to 20% on their purchase, cashback on select models and an EMI facility on select models.The Lenovo Yoga S7 14-inch laptop is listed at an effective price of ₹102,392. The HP OmniBook 5 AI Laptop (16GB RAM, 512GB storage) starts at ₹69,810, while Acer Aspire Lite laptops start at ₹43,609.Sony, LG, and home appliance offersTelevisions and soundbars are also being sold. The LG 55-inch AI Nano TV is priced at ₹44,990, and the Sony 65-inch Bravia 3II is priced at ₹116,990. The LG 75-inch 4K AI Nano TV is listed at ₹89,990.
paragraph4: Croma is also providing up to ₹26,000 cashback and EMI discounts on some TVs. Additionally, customers can receive up to 12% off select soundbars when buying them with a TV.The Philips Digital Air Fryer (4.2-litre) is priced at ₹7,299 when used for smaller appliances. Select Philips personal care products are offered at up to 30% off, and select Havells grooming and personal care products at up to 50% off.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life.
paragraph5: She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.
bangla_paragraph1: ক্রোমা ব্ল্যাক ফ্রাইডে বিক্রয় ২০২৬ ৩০ নভেম্বর পর্যন্ত ৫০% পর্যন্ত ছাড় সহ লাইভ। আইফোন ১৬ ₹৪৫,৪৯০ থেকে, ম্যাকবুক নিও ৪২,৭১৪ থেকে; ল্যাপটপ, টিভি এবং অ্যাপ্লায়েন্স ডিল। একজন ব্যক্তি অ্যাপল স্টোরে অ্যাপলের নতুন আইফোন ১৭ সিরিজ ধরে রেখেছেন। ক্রোমার ভারতে ব্ল্যাক ফ্রেডেই বিক্রয় २०২৬ ঘোষণা করেছে, স্মার্টফোন, ল্যাপ্টপ, টেলিভিশন, গৃহ সরঞ্জাম এবং ব্যক্তিগত যত্ন পণ্যগুলিতে ৫০% ছাড় সহ। পাঁচ দিনের বিক্রয় ২৬ নভেম্বরের থেকে ৩০ নবেম্বর, ২০২6, ক্রোমের স্টোর এবং অনলাইন উভয় ক্ষেত্রেই চলছে। যোগ্য ক্রয়গুলিও
bangla_paragraph2: ক্রোমা ২৬ নভেম্বর বলেছেন যে আইফোন ১৬ অফারগুলির পরে ₹৪৫,৪৯০ থেকে শুরু হয়, যখন আইফোন ১৭ প্রো ম্যাক্স ₹৯৬,২৯০-এ শুরু হয়। প্রকৃত দামগুলি ব্যাংক অফার, বিনিময় মূল্য এবং ডিভাইসের অবস্থার উপর নির্ভর করে। ক্রোমার ব্ল্যাক ফ্রাইডে বিক্রয় ২০২৬: আইফোন এবং ম্যাকবুক ডিল অ্যাপল পণ্যগুলি বিক্রয়ের প্রধান হাইলাইটগুলির মধ্যে রয়েছে। নির্বাচিত আইফোন ও ম্যাকবুকের ক্রেতারা বিনিময় সুবিধা এবং অতিরিক্ত বিনিময় বোনাসের সাথে ব্যাংক ক্যাশব্যাক একত্রিত করতে পারে। আইফোন ১ 16 (128 জিবি) ₹45,490 এ তালিকাভুক্ত। সেই মূল্যে ₹2,000 পর্যন্ত অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: ম্যাকবুক নিও (8 জিবি র্যাম, 256 জিবি স্টোরেজ) এর দাম 42,714 টাকা, এর বিনিময় সুবিধা 12,000 টাকা এবং ব্যাংক ক্যাশব্যাক 7,000 টাকা পর্যন্ত। স্যামসাং, ওপ্পো এবং রেডমি স্মার্টফোন অফার ক্রোমার অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ফোনগুলিতেও ছাড় দেওয়া হচ্ছেঃ ওপ্পোর এফ 35 প্রো 5 জি (6 জিবি + 128 জিবি) থেকে শুরু করে 11,761 রেডমী 17 সি 5 জি (4 জিবি 128 + জিবি), 11,999 থেকে শুরু হচ্ছেস্যামসাঙ গ্যালাক্সি এস 26 আল্ট্রা (12 জিবি+ 256 জিবি) থেকে 85,999 টাকায় শুরু করেক্রোমার ব্ল্যাক ফ্রাইডে বিক্রির সময় ল্যাপটপ ডিলগুলি।যারা ল্যাপ্টপ কিনতে চান তারা টাকার বোনাস বিনিময় করতে পারেন।

title: As Google threatens to cut schools search access, Los Angeles blocks AI features
title_bn: গুগল স্কুলের সার্চ অ্যাক্সেস বন্ধ করার হুমকি দিচ্ছে, লস অ্যাঞ্জেলেস এআই বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি ব্লক করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: As Google threatens to cut schools' search access, Los Angeles blocks AI features
paragraph1: School districts are taking steps to block Google's artificial intelligence features and are considering dropping Google products entirely unless the company gives them a permanent AI workaround, pitting them against the tech giant whose Chromebook computers and learning tools are deeply embedded in America's classrooms.In a major step, Los Angeles school officials have quietly disabled AI-generated summaries, known as AI Overview, in Google searches on school-issued devices. The move makes Los Angeles Unified the largest district to sideline the company, which has said it will not separate its search product from AI tools for education.The LA district, which enrolls half a million students, has made no formal announcement, and the move caught parents and students by surprise, said Bridie Lee, a leader of Schools Beyond Screens LA, which has pushed for screen-time limits and tech oversight in the district.The group had several members who weighed in at a meeting of the Los Angeles school board’s A.I. committee on Friday, Nov. 13. By that Monday, AI Overview was gone.“It was the talk of the playground,” Lee said.Google is the dominant provider of education technology for America’s classrooms. Beyond its low-cost Chromebooks, the most widely used student laptops, Google’s suite of education apps like Google Docs and Classroom has become integral to classwork, homework and communication among students and teachers.But concerns about AI's impact on learning have ignited a battle between schools and Google. In September, the country’s two largest school districts — New York and LA — announced one-year moratoriums on student use of generative AI, and Google has said it's not possible to take AI out of its search products.
paragraph2: Schools are considering other internet search providers.LAUSD said in a statement it temporarily suspended AI Overview to ensure student experiences are “age-appropriate and safe.” It also said it continually evaluates its digital safeguards, including third-party tools. It was likely using such a tool that it was able to disable AI Overview.Schools Beyond Screens LA asked parents to send videos of what laptop screens looked like and received clips showing that AI Overview was no longer an option in Google search on district devices. Then activists reached out to the district, which confirmed AI Overview was disabled. Lee said they had no other details on how it was done or how long it is intended to stay disabled.“We’re thrilled LAUSD did this,” said Lee. “AI is seeping into everything. It’s dangerous. It’s hurting learning. And it’s a corporate overreach into public schools. It’s Big Tech attempting to strongarm tech policy without anyone’s consent.”Other districts, such as Fairfax County Public Schools in Virginia, have developed plug-ins to remove AI summaries for students searching on Google, according to multiple published reports.
paragraph3: Schools are seeing growing backlash against technology, starting with cellphones and screentime and now focusing on AI, amid concerns that students are using AI to think for them.The Mountain View, California-based company in August found itself at the center of controversy. That's when it said it had turned on its Gemini chatbot for many K-12 students using Google Classroom, its learning management system. Weeks later, New York City and LA schools banned generative AI. In New York, the ban applies to all elementary and middle school students, and in Los Angeles all students K-12 are banned from using AI on school devices. Both districts said the ban would allow officials to develop AI policies this academic year.Then, in early November, Google backtracked. It published a blog post saying it would instead turn off Gemini and all search tools by default for K-12 schools in the coming months. Administrators would have to turn on each tool if they wanted students to access them.Google said this was to give schools more choice. But the choice to turn off AI altogether is not there.While the blog post does not explicitly say search can’t be used without AI, Chris Phillips, vice president for education at Google, told The New York Times: “Search and AI are deeply integrated.” If schools ban AI, students “will not have access to search, and they’ll see a message from their school that indicates it’s not available.”The integration of AI in search isn't new.
paragraph4: Google introduced AI Overview in 2025, and anyone who uses Google search will get AI answers to many search results. Google insists AI Overview is an integral part of its search product now and cannot be separated.Earlier this month, hundreds of Google employees signed a petition asking the company's leadership to allow schools to turn off AI features “without disrupting their ability to use search as a whole.”“The way the decision has been reported in the press is poor, and makes Google, and our Education and Search products as a result, look like we’re punishing schools for not using AI,” the petition said. “Many students, educators and parents have concerns about AI in the classroom, as is shown by many school districts who have placed moratoriums or bans on such technology. It is our job as Googlers to respect the user, and listen to them when they have concerns about our products.”Google says it hears parents' and teachers' concerns about students using AI to “shortcut learning” and that it shares the same goal: helping students learn. But what many parents and teachers want — the ability to bypass AI entirely and allow students to use Google search like it was in, say, 2024 — is not something Google offers. This has forced districts across the U.S. to choose between restricting students’ access to AI and maintaining access to the popular search engine.Instead of offering an AI-free search product for schools, Google announced a pilot “guided learning” tool that walks students “step-by-step through a range of complex problems, instead of just giving quick answers.”“We are actively building these experiences in partnership with educators, listening closely to ensure our products support students and teachers,” the company said in a statement.Currently, Google search offers AI Overview, which contains summarized answers resulting from general searches, and AI Mode, which is a chatbot interaction.
paragraph5: Guided learning, which is not yet available, will walk users through steps intended to support critical thinking to get to the answer.LA schools had already disabled Google’s AI Mode at the beginning of the school year on school-issued student devices, said Jack Kelanic, the district’s chief information officer, during a school board committee meeting on artificial intelligence last week. Educators and staff still have access.“We understand this as a deeper embedding of AI into the education suite,” Kelanic said. He added, to applause, that the district is not bound to Google’s products if officials determine the changes are not in line with the district’s priorities.“We have choices,” Kelanic said. “We can change the default search engine literally overnight.”___The Associated Press’ education coverage receives financial support from multiple private foundations. title: It took X 20 years to add parental controls. Can new feature make platform safer for kids?
title_bn: পিতা-মাতার নিয়ন্ত্রণ যোগ করতে ২০ বছর লেগেছে। নতুন বৈশিষ্ট্য কি শিশুদের জন্য প্ল্যাটফর্মকে নিরাপদ করে তুলতে পারে?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: X introduced parental controls for teenagers, allowing parents to set screen time limits, approve followers, restrict access to sensitive content, and manage direct message settings. However, parents cannot read private messages or access their child
paragraph1: X introduced parental controls for teenagers, allowing parents to set screen time limits, approve followers, restrict access to sensitive content, and manage direct message settings. However, parents cannot read private messages or access their children's search and viewing history.A 3D-printed miniature model of Elon Musk and the X logo are seen in this illustration.(Reuters)X, formerly known as Twitter, has introduced parental controls for teenagers, nearly 20 years after the platform's launch. The new features will be available from today, 27 November and will enable parents and guardians to manage their children's activity and control their children's content and interactions on the platform. The transfer is designed to empower families to have greater control over their teens' internet experience while also allowing teens to own their accounts, according to an X post.Under the new system, accounts belonging to users aged 13 to 17 will automatically be placed in a protected mode.
paragraph2: This will stop them from seeing sensitive material and from being shown targeted advertisements. However, teenagers will be able to view the restrictions applied to their accounts. Additionally, X has made it clear that parents are not able to view private messages, search or viewing history, and can't post on behalf of their children.X parental controls: What can parents manage?The new parental control features give parents the right to supervise and control their teens' activities. Parents will be able to see how much time their children spend on X each week and limit their daily use.They may also accept new followers, limit feed suggestions and videos to accounts their teenagers follow, and block certain words.
paragraph3: Other options include disabling sensitive media, deciding who can send direct messages and viewing which accounts their teenagers are messaging.However, X has maintained certain boundaries of privacy. Parents will be unable to view what children are actually viewing in private conversations or their browsing and search history.X faces criticism over child safety concernsParent controls are part of a series of measures aimed at keeping kids safer online. Grok was criticised in January 2026 for creating sexually explicit images of women and children without consent using its AI chatbot.Child sexual abuse material, misinformation and AI-generated content have also been a problem on the platform. X formally updated its policies in June 2024 to permit certain forms of adult content, subject to restrictions.
paragraph4: Teenagers will retain visibility into account restrictionsDespite introducing parental supervision, X says teenagers will remain aware of changes made to their accounts. The company aims to maintain a healthy balance between parental control and young users' independence and privacy."Parents want practical tools, and teens deserve room to grow," Michael O'Herlihy, head of safety at X, said in the company's announcement. Central to the feature's design was giving families a way to set safeguards and ensuring that teenagers are aware of changes to their accounts, he added. While X has a minimum age of 13, teens have been using the platform.The new parental controls mark a significant addition to X's safety features, particularly as concerns over teenagers' exposure to harmful online content continue to grow.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing.
paragraph5: She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. title: AI may put 24 million knowledge-worker jobs at risk globally over five years: JP Morgan

paragraph1: Artificial intelligence (AI) could displace around 24 million knowledge-worker jobs worldwide over the next five years under an illustrative scenario, as businesses increasingly use the technology to replace tasks currently performed by employees, according to a JP Morgan Wealth Management report.AI may put 24 million knowledge-worker jobs at risk globally over five years: JP MorganNew Delhi [India], November 27 (ANI): Artificial intelligence (AI) could displace around 24 million knowledge-worker jobs worldwide over the next five years under an illustrative scenario, as businesses increasingly use the technology to replace tasks currently performed by employees, according to a JP Morgan Wealth Management report.The report estimates that such displacement could affect about 1.3 per cent of the global knowledge workforce annually over five years, based on a scenario in which half of potential enterprise AI spending goes towards replacing jobs that would otherwise have been filled, with AI costing about half as much as the workers it replaces.
paragraph2: The report said, "Much of the AI adjustment could come through roles left unfilled rather than layoffs." It added that the bigger risk could arise if job displacement is concentrated in particular occupations or regions, potentially creating greater economic and political pressure.The scale of the possible impact is also significant for the United States. If two-thirds of the displaced roles were located there, the country could see around 16 million workers affected over five years, or roughly 3 million annually.
paragraph3: According to the report, this would amount to about 2 per cent of payrolls each year, more than four times the pace of manufacturing job losses in the 2000s. The impact would approach the rate of job losses during the Great Recession, but would continue over five years instead of two.However, JP Morgan said the more likely outcome was disruption within jobs rather than the complete elimination of roles."Every job is ultimately a collection of tasks, and to date, AI can automate or augment only a portion of them," the report said.
paragraph4: It added that the adoption of AI across the economy would take time and remain uneven and gradual, which could help limit the risk of widespread job displacement.The report also noted that AI adoption remains at an early stage. Only 6 per cent of work hours in the United States are currently AI-assisted, even though two-thirds of tasks may be theoretically exposed to the technology.It said wider adoption beyond the technology sector would be necessary for AI investments to deliver the expected returns, with businesses needing to move beyond pilot programmes and use the technology more extensively to improve productivity.
