bangla_paragraph4: এটি যোগ করেছে যে অর্থনীতি জুড়ে এআই গ্রহণের জন্য সময় লাগবে এবং এটি অসম এবং ধীরে ধীরে থাকবে, যা ব্যাপক কর্মসংস্থান অপসারণের ঝুঁকি সীমাবদ্ধ করতে সহায়তা করতে পারে। প্রতিবেদনে আরও উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে যে এআই গৃহীত হওয়া এখনও একটি প্রাথমিক পর্যায়ে রয়েছে। মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে বর্তমানে মাত্র 6 শতাংশ কাজের সময় এআই-সহায়তাপ্রাপ্ত, যদিও তত্ত্বগতভাবে দুই-তৃতীয়াংশ কাজ প্রযুক্তির সংস্পর্শে আসতে পারে। এটি বলেছে যে প্রত্যাশিত ফলাফল প্রদানের জন্য প্রযুক্তি খাতের বাইরে আরও বিস্তৃত গ্রহণ প্রয়োজন হবে।

title: OnePlus reveals ColorOS 17 plans for native apps, paid AI features, and more
title_bn: ওয়ানপ্লাস নেটিভ অ্যাপ, বেতনভুক্ত এআই বৈশিষ্ট্য এবং আরও অনেক কিছুর জন্য ColorOS 17 পরিকল্পনা প্রকাশ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: More native apps are coming, but some AI features will cost you.
paragraph1: Dhruv Bhutani / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR OnePlus is exploring wider availability of its native Phone app and plans to bring OPPO’s Calendar app to its devices. ColorOS 17 users can pay for additional AI usage or wait for their free allowance to reset. OnePlus plans to add AI Photo Agent in a future update but has confirmed the removal of its iconic Calculator Easter egg. The transition from OxygenOS to ColorOS has brought plenty of changes to OnePlus phones. And while many of our readers have warmed up to the new software, not everything has been well received by fans. From missing features to the future of native OnePlus apps, the company has now addressed some of the biggest questions surrounding ColorOS 17, revealing what users can expect from future updates and what’s already gone for good.
paragraph2: In a recent AMA on the OnePlus Community forum, OnePlus revealed that it’s exploring plans to bring its native dialer to more markets. Many OnePlus phones ship with Google Phone, while users in markets like India have access to the company’s own calling app, complete with features such as call recording without an audible announcement, AI-powered call summaries, and real-time translations. More users could eventually ditch Google’s dialer, although availability, including call recording support, will depend on the device and region.Joe Maring / Android AuthorityThe company is also considering bringing OPPO’s Calendar app to OnePlus phones, giving users another alternative to Google’s stock apps. Neither app has a confirmed timeline for wider availability.OnePlus also shed some light on the cost of using its AI features, something we touched on in our recent ColorOS 17 hands-on with the OnePlus 15.
paragraph3: While some features will remain free, others will have free usage limits. Once you exhaust your allowance, you’ll have two options: pay for additional usage or wait for your allowance to reset. The company hasn’t specified how much additional usage will cost or how frequently these allowances will reset.As for the AI features themselves, OnePlus plans to introduce AI Photo Agent in a future update. The feature lets you edit photos using natural language commands, much like Google Photos’ Help Me Edit. Meanwhile, AI Mind Pilot availability will vary by device, software version, and region.
paragraph4: The company is also evaluating whether it can bring 3D and AI Motion Wallpapers to more phones.OPPOMusic lovers wondering why lyrics aren’t showing up on their lock screens may have their streaming apps to blame. ColorOS 17 already supports the functionality, but music apps need to share lyrics with the system. OnePlus is working with app developers to expand compatibility.Meanwhile, those experiencing increased battery drain or overheating after updating are advised to give their phones time to complete background optimizations. OnePlus hasn’t promised better battery life across all devices, but it says ColorOS 17 includes improvements to reduce micro-stutters during scrolling, app switching, and other everyday tasks.
paragraph5: Unfortunately, one familiar OnePlus feature isn’t making the transition to ColorOS. Typing “1+” followed by the equals button in the Calculator app will no longer bring up the iconic Never Settle Easter egg. It was among the little touches we highlighted when previewing what OnePlus users stood to lose with the switch to ColorOS, and OnePlus has now officially confirmed it’s gone.

bangla_paragraph2: ওয়ানপ্লাস কমিউনিটি ফোরামে সাম্প্রতিক একটি এএমএ-তে, ওয়ান প্লাস প্রকাশ করেছে যে এটি আরও বেশি বাজারে তার নেটিভ ডায়ালার আনতে পরিকল্পনা করছে। অনেক ওয়ান প্লাস ফোন গুগল ফোনের সাথে শিপ করে, যখন ভারতের মতো বাজারের ব্যবহারকারীরা কোম্পানির নিজস্ব কলিং অ্যাপ্লিকেশন অ্যাক্সেস করে, একটি শোনা অ্যানুয়ালিটি ছাড়াই কল রেকর্ডিং, এআই-চালিত কল সংক্ষিপ্তসার এবং রিয়েল-টাইম অনুবাদগুলির মতো বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলির সাথে সম্পূর্ণ। আরও বেশি ব্যবহারকারী শেষ পর্যন্ত গুগলের ডায়লারটি বাদ দিতে পারে, যদিও কল রেকোর্ডিং সমর্থন সহ উপলভ্যতা,
bangla_paragraph3: যদিও কিছু বৈশিষ্ট্য বিনামূল্যে থাকবে, অন্যদের বিনামূল্যে ব্যবহারের সীমা থাকবে। একবার আপনি আপনার ভাতা শেষ হয়ে গেলে, আপনার দুটি বিকল্প থাকবেঃ অতিরিক্ত ব্যবহারের জন্য অর্থ প্রদান করুন বা আপনার ভাতার পুনরায় সেট হওয়ার জন্য অপেক্ষা করুন। সংস্থাটি কত অতিরিক্ত ব্যবহার ব্যয় করবে বা এই ভাতাগুলি কত ঘন ঘন পুনরাই সেট হবে তা নির্দিষ্ট করেনি। এআই বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলির জন্য, ওয়ানপ্লাস ভবিষ্যতের আপডেটে এআই ফটো এজেন্ট চালু করার পরিকল্পনা করেছে। বৈশিষ্ট্যটি আপনাকে গুগল ফটো হেল্প মি এর মতো প্রাকৃতিক ভাষার কমান্ডগুলি ব্যবহার করে ফটো সম্পাদনা করতে দেয়।
bangla_paragraph4: কোম্পানিটি আরও বেশি সংখ্যক ফোনে 3 ডি এবং এআই মোশন ওয়ালপেপার আনতে পারে কিনা তাও মূল্যায়ন করছে। OPPOMusic প্রেমীরা কেন তাদের লক স্ক্রিনে গীতিকার প্রদর্শিত হচ্ছে না তা ভাবছেন তাদের স্ট্রিমিং অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলি দোষারোপ করতে পারে। ColorOS 17 ইতিমধ্যে কার্যকারিতা সমর্থন করে, তবে সঙ্গীত অ্যাপ্লিকেশানগুলি সিস্টেমের সাথে গীতিকার ভাগ করতে হবে। অ্যাপ্লিকেসন বিকাশকারীদের সাথে সামঞ্জস্যতা প্রসারিত করার জন্য ওয়ানপ্লাস কাজ করছে। এদিকে, আপডেটের পরে ব্যাটারি ড্রেন বা অতিরিক্ত উত্তাপের অভিজ্ঞতা যারা তাদের ফোনগুলিকে সময় দেওয়ার পরামর্শ দেওয়া হয়।
bangla_paragraph5: দুর্ভাগ্যবশত, ওয়ানপ্লাসের একটি পরিচিত বৈশিষ্ট্য ColorOS এ রূপান্তর করছে না। ক্যালকুলেটর অ্যাপে 1+ টাইপ করার পরে সমান বোতামটি আর আইকনিক নেভার সেটল ইস্টার ডিমটি আনবে না। এটি এমন একটি ছোট স্পর্শ ছিল যা আমরা ওয়ান প্লাস ব্যবহারকারীদের ColorOS তে স্যুইচ করার সাথে কী হারাতে পারে তার পূর্বরূপ দেওয়ার সময় তুলে ধরেছিলাম এবং ওয়ান প্লাস এখন আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে নিশ্চিত করেছে যে এটি চলে গেছে।

title: Apple To Open Seventh India Store In Hyderabad’s Kukatpally
title_bn: হায়দরাবাদের কুকাতপল্লীতে অ্যাপলের সপ্তম ইন্ডিয়া স্টোর খুলছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple continues to expand its retail footprint in India. The iPhone maker is all set to launch its seventh official…
paragraph1: SUMMARYThe new store, which will open at Lake Shore Mall in Hyderabad’s Kukatpally, will offer the complete lineup of Apple products and services With the latest store, Apple will be looking to further deepen its presence in India, drive sales and streamline user experience Buoyed by strong demand, Apple India’s net profit zoomed 66% YoY to ₹5,311 Cr in FY26, while operating revenue grew 31.4% YoY to ₹1.04 Lakh Cr Apple continues to expand its retail footprint in India. The iPhone maker is all set to launch its seventh official store in the country in Hyderabad on December 10. As per its website, the new store will open at Lake Shore Mall in Hyderabad’s Kukatpally. The new outlet will offer the complete lineup of Apple products and services, including the latest iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo, MacBook Pro, Apple Watches, AirPods and HomePods. According to Deccan Herald, the company has also revealed the barricade for the Kukatpally store, which features a pearl-inspired Apple logo set against iridescent tones.
paragraph2: It takes inspiration from the city’s historical title as the City of Pearls. The new outlet will join the company’s six other flagship stores in the country. The Cupertino-based big tech giant already operates retail outlets in Mumbai’s BKC and Borivali, Saket and Noida in Delhi NCR, Hebbal in Bengaluru and Koregaon Park in Pune. Notably, Apple already has a healthy presence in the city. Hyderabad is home to the company’s retail customer team and the R&D division for maps. The move comes as Apple continues to deepen its presence in India by launching retail outlets, leasing spaces for corporate offices and scaling local manufacturing. In January this year, the iPhone maker leased an additional 57,000 sq ft of office space at WaveRock IT Park in Hyderabad for five years at a monthly rent of ₹71.
paragraph3: 6 Lakh. With this, the total footprint of its campus in the city now stands at nearly 6.34 Lakh sq ft. A week ago, Apple also reportedly opened its second office in Bengaluru. Located at Embassy Zenith in the startup hub’s Vasanth Nagar, the 14-story building stands directly opposite the 150-year-old Bangalore Golf Club. Not just this, the company is also aggressively doubling down on manufacturing in India. The country has become one of its largest production bases outside China, with iPhone exports crossing ₹2 Lakh Cr in FY26.
paragraph4: At the same time, it is also expanding its services ecosystem in India. The OEM has launched new offerings such as Apple Pay and Fitness+ in the past few months, which are expected to create new revenue streams for the iPhone maker going forward. All these bets appear to be paying off. Buoyed by strong demand across iPhones, Macs, iPads and other products, Apple India’s net profit zoomed 66% YoY to ₹5,311 Cr in FY26 as operating revenue grew 31.4% YoY to ₹1.04 Lakh Cr. The original equipment manufacturer (OEM) also reported record India revenues in Q4 FY26, with its iPhone vertical setting a revenue record and Mac and services revenue reaching new highs.
paragraph5: However, near-term momentum faces pressure due to chip and memory shortages. The company recently said that it expects supply chain constraints to impact iPhones, Macs and iPads globally, potentially influencing product availability in India. In another headwind, the iPhone maker Apple also suffered a major outage earlier this month, which brought many of its services to a standstill for thousands of users globally.

title: WhatsApp To Partner Jio To Launch Int’l Data eSIM Feature In India
title_bn: ভারতে ইন্টারনেট ডেটা ই-সিম চালু করতে জিওর সঙ্গে অংশীদার হলেন হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Messaging platform WhatsApp plans to roll out a new feature that lets users buy and install international data eSIMs directly…
paragraph1: SUMMARYWhatsApp said that the service will initially be available in select countries, adding that it is also “working” with Reliance Jio for the launch The launch comes as WhatsApp looks to expand its utility beyond messaging under Kunal Shah, who took over as the platform’s global head earlier this year The feature will also allow users to view their purchased and expired eSIMs and check their remaining data balance Messaging platform WhatsApp plans to roll out a new feature that lets users buy and install international data eSIMs directly within the app. In a blog post, WhatsApp said that the offering will initially be available in select countries. The messaging giant said that it is also “working” with Indian telecom giant Reliance Jio for the launch. “To make it even easier to connect when traveling, today we’re announcing a new way to buy and install a data eSIM when traveling internationally in just a few taps without leaving the app. It’ll be as effortless as sending a message,” read the blog post.
paragraph2: According to news portal Android Authority, the code of WhatsApp’s app version 2.26.47.10 also contains references to a new feature that could help users buy eSIMs. As per the report, the messaging platform will search for compatible eSIM options once users enter their destination.
paragraph3: The tool will reportedly also allow users to view their purchased and expired eSIMs and check their remaining data balance. The aforementioned version of WhatsApp also reportedly appears capable of warning users when they are running low on data and when their plan is about to expire. Besides Jio, WhatsApp also said that it is also working with multiple eSIM providers and telecom operators, including Smart Axiata, Smart Communications and Verizon for the new offering. “You’ll see it right in the app when it’s available for you,” added WhatsApp. “What if WhatsApp could work anywhere you go in the world without any struggle.
paragraph4: Starting our early explorations around eSIMs so that you can continue sending those stickers without any interruptions… Inviting partners everywhere to join us in this important mission,” said WhatsApp CEO Kunal Shah in a post on X. The latest launch comes as WhatsApp looks to expand beyond messaging under newly-appointed CEO Kunal Shah, who took over as the platform’s global head earlier this year after stepping away from day-to-day operations at CRED. Just a day ago, the Meta-owned platform also introduced scheduled messages feature, which allows users to schedule texts, photos and videos in advance (between 10 minutes and 14 days) across individual and group chats. Earlier this month, Shah outlined three broad priorities for WhatsApp — making communication more expressive, simplifying everyday services and integrating AI into the platform. As part of this, the messaging giant is also streamlining offerings such as bill payments and financial transactions within WhatsApp.
paragraph5: It is also said to be piloting new features such as view-once text messages in the app on select Android devices. Overall, India is the biggest market for WhatsApp in terms of customers, with the country accounting for more than 500 Mn of its global user base.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ জানিয়েছে যে এই পরিষেবাটি প্রাথমিকভাবে নির্বাচিত দেশগুলিতে উপলব্ধ হবে। তারা আরও যোগ করেছে যে এটি চালু করার জন্য রিলায়েন্স জিওর সাথেও কাজ করছে। এই লঞ্চটি এমন একটি সময়ে আসে যখন হোয়াটের মাধ্যমে মেসেজিংয়ের বাইরেও তার ইউটিলিটি প্রসারিত করার চেষ্টা করা হচ্ছে।

bangla_paragraph4: ই-সিম সম্পর্কে আমাদের প্রাথমিক অনুসন্ধান শুরু করা যাতে আপনি কোনও বাধা ছাড়াই স্টিকারগুলি প্রেরণ চালিয়ে যেতে পারেন... এই গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মিশনে আমাদের সাথে যোগ দিতে সর্বত্র অংশীদারদের আমন্ত্রণ জানানো, "হোয়াটসঅ্যাপের প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা কুনেল শাহ এক্স-এ একটি পোস্টে বলেছেন। সর্বশেষ লঞ্চটি ঘটেছে যখন হোয়াটসআপ নতুন নিয়োগপ্রাপ্ত প্রধান নির্চালক কুনেল শা'র অধীনে মেসেজিংয়ের বাইরেও প্রসারিত হতে চায়, যিনি এই বছরের শুরুতে প্ল্যাটফর্মের বিশ্ব প্রধান হিসাবে দায়িত্ব গ্রহণ করেছিলেন।

title: Samsung is bringing Galaxy Watch 9 health features to older Galaxy Watches
title_bn: স্যামসাং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ ৯ এর স্বাস্থ্য বৈশিষ্ট্য পুরোনো গ্যাল্যাক্সি ঘড়িতে নিয়ে আসছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Even Galaxy Watch 4 owners aren't being left behind.
paragraph1: Adamya Sharma / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Samsung is bringing six Galaxy Watch 9 health and fitness features to the Galaxy Watch 8 series. The upgrades include Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load, Fitness Index, improved Sleep Coaching, and enhanced sleep apnea detection. Select features also support older models, with improved Sleep Coaching extending back to the Galaxy Watch 4. Samsung could break its tradition of launching a new Galaxy Watch every year as early as 2027, reportedly shifting its focus to software updates and new health features for existing smartwatches.
paragraph2: We’re already seeing what that approach could mean for Galaxy Watch owners, as Samsung has confirmed that several health and fitness features from the Galaxy Watch 9 are making their way to last year’s models.The company began rolling out stable One UI 9 Watch to the Galaxy Watch 8 series in mid-November, with US users receiving the update shortly after. In a new announcement, Samsung has detailed six health and fitness upgrades originally introduced with the Galaxy Watch 9 and Watch Ultra 2 that are coming to the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic.Vitals tracks five overnight health metrics, including heart rate, skin temperature, and blood oxygen, to flag unusual changes in your readings.
paragraph3: Heart Health Score, meanwhile, helps you understand how everyday habits like sleeping and exercising affect your heart. For fitness enthusiasts, Daily Cardio Load helps balance training and recovery, while Fitness Index assesses your overall fitness and suggests exercises based on your goals.Brady Snyder / Android AuthoritySamsung is also improving Sleep Coaching, which now requires just three nights of data within two weeks to offer personalized guidance. The advice adapts weekly as your sleeping habits change.
paragraph4: Earlier this month, Samsung began rolling out enhanced sleep apnea detection to its latest wearables, promising support for older Galaxy Watches. That upgrade is now reaching the Watch 8 series, offering three categories of breathing disruption frequency. Other additions include the Portrait Watch Face and an improved Compass that lets you save important locations and retrace your steps.Perhaps even better, Samsung confirms that Daily Cardio Load and Fitness Index support the Galaxy Watch 7 running One UI 9 Watch, while the improved Sleep Coaching experience goes back as far as the Galaxy Watch 4.
paragraph5: Some features require separate updates to Samsung Health or Samsung Health Monitor, and availability may vary by region.Whether or not Samsung skips next year’s smartwatch launch, bringing these features to hardware that can already support them gives existing Galaxy Watch owners fewer reasons to spend money on a new model.

title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?
title_bn: এলিস হুয়াং গুপ্তচর নাকি না?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.
paragraph1: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, a former executive at the data-center company Megaspeed, is a Chinese spy. She had an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who abruptly resigned on Nov. 12 after acknowledging it and was just as abruptly reinstated on Monday of this week. What’s publicly known is murkier than the headlines suggest. U.S. intelligence has reportedly tracked Alice Huang’s contact with an officer of China’s spy agency, but officials haven’t offered public evidence that she was commissioned to target Nvidia’s chief. In the past week, after President Trump successfully pushed to bring Jensen Huang back, the administration has played down the allegations it once circulated internally. Whether that reflects new intelligence or political pressure is the big question. Undisputed reporting shows the claim emerged from the White House itself. It first appeared in a highly classified memo written in March under the oversight of Secretary of State Marco Rubio and circulated to White House officials ahead of Trump’s trip to China in May. The memo formed the partial basis for the New York Times’ initial reporting on the scandal, published Oct.
paragraph2: 29 and its existence was first reported on Nov. 8. The memo did not definitively say, according to the Wall Street Journal, that Alice Huang was a Chinese spy. CNN, by contrast, has reported that the memo concluded she was a Chinese intelligence asset. What’s better established is that Alice Huang was in touch with Chinese intelligence. The Ministry of State Security (MSS) is Beijing’s civilian spy agency, responsible for both foreign intelligence and domestic counterintelligence. Last weekend, the Times, citing people with knowledge of U.S. intelligence reports, reported that Huang was in contact with an MSS officer from the spring of 2025 until this fall, a period that overlaps her relationship with Jensen Huang. (The Chinese government has called the spy claims a “smear,” and Megaspeed says Huang left the company in August 2025 and that its business is legitimate.) Attorney General Todd Blanche, who was Trump’s personal defense lawyer before taking over the Justice Department, told journalists on Tuesday: “I have no reason to stand up here and say Nvidia is anything but a good corporate citizen.” On the same day, Trump said a pardon was an option for Jensen Huang but that he did not think one would be needed.
paragraph3: Senior intelligence officials reportedly told Congress that the government apparently has no actual evidence that the MSS directed Alice Huang to pursue an affair with Jensen Huang. None of those statements necessarily exonerates Alice Huang as an intelligence agent. Instead, they support the alternate theory that the Chinese government didn’t tell her to begin the affair and that Jensen Huang broke no law by having it. From a certain angle, the circumstantial evidence surrounding Alice Huang looks quite suspicious. She was a top executive at a company investigated for illicitly channeling Nvidia chips to China, and her husband, Kang Wei, is said to have even closer ties to the MSS, with some sources saying he worked for the agency. The timing of the government’s reversal is at the heart of the matter. Trump has said he lobbied the board “directly and indirectly” to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, so it wouldn’t be surprising if officials who serve at his pleasure were recasting the case in terms that satisfy his agenda. That wouldn’t necessarily make their assessments wrong. But unless new intelligence has actually resolved the question, and none has been publicly identified as yet, that backdrop is critical to keep in mind. CBS has also reported that Rubio has privately voiced concerns about aspects of Jensen Huang’s return. Earlier this month, CNN reported that the intelligence community was still working to understand Alice Huang’s relationship with Jensen Huang and that the intelligence collected on her to date does not prove she was acting as a spy for Beijing. After a briefing by top intelligence officials earlier this month, Rep.
paragraph4: Jim Himes (D-Conn.), the incoming chair of the House Intelligence Committee, said he was unsure whether she was a spy or a “useful idiot.” And this week, the Wall Street Journal pointed out that under Chinese leader Xi Jinping, top corporate executives routinely maintain ties to the country’s intelligence service without being formally deputized as assets. The crush of conflicting claims, most from anonymous government sources, obviously leaves large questions unanswered as to what actually transpired. Some of those questions that naturally spring to mind: Alice Huang is said to have been under U.S. surveillance for over a year. If the government suspected her of espionage, why wasn’t Jensen Huang warned earlier (and privately, so as not to cause the stock-market-destabilizing maelstrom that followed the more recent disclosure)? One explanation that has been given is that alerting the Nvidia chief might have tipped off Huang that her cover had been blown. If Alice Huang was a spy, what information did she pass to the Chinese government, and what influence did she actually have? Most critically, how did the allegation reach the public at all? The likeliest answer is a leak.
paragraph5: A source told CNN that Rubio briefed Trump on the intelligence in May, yet Trump has since said he only recently learned of the concerns, and in October he presented Jensen Huang with the National Medal of Science. Officials who felt they could not get through to the president may have turned to reporters instead, which would explain how the contents of a memo whose existence has never been disputed found their way into print. What remains unclear is who leaked it, and whether they anticipated the fallout. There are answers to all of these questions, of course, but when the public will get them is anybody’s guess. Jensen Huang is due to appear before the Senate Banking Committee next week, and by the look from the statements of some of its members, he’s likely in for a rough ride. Unfortunately, congressional hearings, particularly public ones, rarely unearth secrets that haven’t already been disclosed. title: XGIMI Vibe One battery-powered projector hits a record low under $200
title_bn: এক্সজিআইএমআই ভিবে ওয়ান ব্যাটারি চালিত প্রজেক্টর রেকর্ড কমিয়ে ২০০ ডলারের নিচে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: XGIMI's portable Vibe One projector is 24% off on Amazon, with Google TV, official Netflix, and a built-in battery.
paragraph1: Rita El Khoury / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: XGIMI’s fun, battery-powered projector just dropped to its lowest price. The XGIMI Vibe One is down to $189 on Amazon, which is $60 off its $249 list price and a new record low. The Vibe One is designed for grab-and-go entertainment.
paragraph2: It has a built-in battery, so you can carry it to the bedroom, a friend’s place, or the backyard without hunting for an outlet, and its stand doubles as a handle. XGIMI rates the battery at up to 1.2 hours of video, which covers a short movie or a few episodes.
paragraph3: It projects a 1080p image and runs Google TV with official Netflix, so you can jump straight into streaming apps without a separate device. Auto focus and auto keystone correction keep setup quick, and the stand lets you tilt the projector to aim the picture where you want it.The XGIMI Vibe One also works as a Bluetooth speaker when you’re not watching anything, and XGIMI includes stickers in the box so you can customize its look.
paragraph4: It’s rated at 250 lumens, so it’s best suited to darker rooms and evening viewing. The deal is from a third-party seller, but the order ships from Amazon.At $189, it’s a playful, affordable projector that makes a great gift for teens, college students, or anyone who wants a simple movie night setup.
bangla_paragraph1: রিতা এল খুরি / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ গুগলে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড প্রশাসক যোগ করুনঃ এক্সজিআইএমআই এর মজাদার, ব্যাটারি চালিত প্রজেক্টরটি সবেমাত্র তার সর্বনিম্ন মূল্যে নেমে এসেছে। এক্সজিএমআই ভিবে ওয়ান অ্যামাজনে 189 ডলারে নেমে গেছে, যা 249 ডলারের তালিকা মূল্য থেকে 60 ডলার হ্রাস পেয়েছে এবং একটি নতুন রেকর্ড কম। ভিবে একটি গ্র্যাপ-এন্ড-গো বিনোদনের জন্য ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এটিতে একটি অন্তর্নির্মিত ব্যাটারি রয়েছে, যাতে আপনি এটিকে শয়নকক্ষ, কোনও বন্ধুর বাড়িতে বা পিছনের উঠোনে কোনও আউটলেট না খুঁজেই বহন করতে পারেন এবং এর স্ট্যান্ডটি একটি হ্যান্ডেল হিসাবে দ্বিগুণ হয়। এক্সজিআইএমআই ব্যাটারির হার ১.২ ঘন্টা পর্যন্ত ভিডিওতে, যা একটি স্বল্পদৈর্ঘ্য চলচ্চিত্র বা কয়েকটি পর্বকে কভার করে।
bangla_paragraph3: এটি একটি 1080p চিত্র প্রজেক্ট করে এবং অফিসিয়াল নেটফ্লিক্সের সাথে গুগল টিভি চালায়, যাতে আপনি পৃথক ডিভাইস ছাড়াই সরাসরি স্ট্রিমিং অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলিতে ঝাঁপিয়ে পড়তে পারেন। অটো ফোকাস এবং অটো কীস্টোন সংশোধন সেটআপটি দ্রুত রাখে এবং স্ট্যান্ডটি আপনাকে প্রজেকটরটি আপনার পছন্দ মতো ছবিটি লক্ষ্য করতে পারে। আপনি যখন কিছু দেখছেন না তখন এক্সজিআইএমআই ভিবে ওয়ান ব্লুটুথ স্পিকার হিসাবেও কাজ করে এবং এক্সজিএমআই বক্সে স্টিকার অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে যাতে আপনি এর চেহারাটি কাস্টমাইজ করতে পারেন।
bangla_paragraph4: এটি ২৫০ লুমেন রেটযুক্ত, তাই এটি অন্ধকার ঘর এবং সন্ধ্যায় দেখার জন্য সবচেয়ে উপযুক্ত। চুক্তিটি একটি তৃতীয় পক্ষের বিক্রেতা থেকে, তবে অর্ডারটি অ্যামাজন থেকে জাহাজে আসে। ১৮৯ ডলারে, এটি একটি কৌতুকপূর্ণ, সাশ্রয়ী মূল্যের প্রজেক্টর যা কিশোর, কলেজ ছাত্র বা যে কেউ একটি সহজ সিনেমা রাতের সেটআপ চান তাদের জন্য দুর্দান্ত উপহার দেয়।

title: Pixel users report broken always-on display in Android Auto after November update
title_bn: পিক্সেল ব্যবহারকারীরা নভেম্বর আপডেটের পর অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অটোতে সর্বদা চালু প্রদর্শন ভাঙা হয়েছে বলে রিপোর্ট করেছেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Even the newest Pixel phones aren't spared.
paragraph1: Sanuj Bhatia / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Pixel users report that the November update breaks the always-on display when connected to Android Auto. The issue affects multiple generations, including the Pixel 9, Pixel 10, and Pixel 11 series. We’ve reached out to Google to see whether it’s aware of the bug and working on a fix. Pixel owners across Reddit and the Android Auto Help community report that their phones’ always-on displays stop working when connected to Android Auto.
paragraph2: Instead of showing the time, notifications, and other glanceable information, the screen remains completely black until they disconnect from their cars.The issue isn’t limited to older Pixels either. While the initial complaint came from a Pixel 9 Pro owner using wireless Android Auto, the Pixel 10 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL are also affected.Rita El Khoury / Android AuthoritySome peculiar things are happening behind the scenes.
paragraph3: One Pixel 11 Pro owner noticed that their phone’s display settings blamed Bedtime Mode for disabling AOD, even though neither Bedtime Mode nor Driving Mode was active.Disabling Driving Mode hasn’t helped, and neither have recent Google Play system updates. A Pixel 11 Pro XL owner briefly regained normal AOD functionality, but the problem returned the following morning. Tapping the screen still wakes the phone, but that defeats the convenience of having an always-on display.
paragraph4: Similar complaints have surfaced outside Google’s English-speaking communities, with a Pixel 9 Pro owner on Taiwanese forum Mobile01 also experiencing broken AOD and having trouble getting Android Auto to launch automatically following the November update.The good news is that an Android Auto community specialist has already requested diagnostic information from an affected user to help with the investigation. The specialist subsequently confirmed that the team had contacted the user via email for further assistance.We’ve asked Google if it’s aware of the bug, and we’ll update this article when we hear back.

title: Kazakhstan boosts AI cooperation with Russia, which is hungry for advanced US chips
title_bn: কাজাখস্তান রাশিয়ার সাথে কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তার সহযোগিতা বাড়াচ্ছে, যা উন্নত মার্কিন চিপসের জন্য ক্ষুধার্ত
author: TechPulse
excerpt: RUSSIA-KAZAKHSTAN/AI (PIX, TV):Kazakhstan boosts AI cooperation with Russia, which is hungry for advanced US chips
paragraph1: * Russia struggles to develop AI due to sanctions* Kazakh President met Nvidia's Huang in October* Kazakh bank orders Nvidia advanced chips* Tokayev tells Putin Russian AI firms are welcomeBy Gleb BryanskiMOSCOW, - Kazakhstan's President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev advanced his country's AI ambitions at Russia's main AI conference on Thursday, telling President Vladimir Putin that Russian companies Sberbank and Yandex were welcome in Kazakhstan's market.Tokayev's visit to Moscow comes a month after he held a meeting with Nvidia Chief Executive Jensen Huang in the Kazakh capital Astana, during which Freedom Holding, a big Kazakhstan bank, said it was placing a large order for Nvidia's B300 chips.Russia's supercomputers are built on older versions of Nvidia chips. It is struggling to develop its AI industry and catch up with leaders United States and China, as US sanctions over its war in Ukraine have halted its imports of the US-made chips needed to train AI models.Many Russian companies operate in Central Asian nations without restrictions, taking advantage of these countries' continued relations with the West, as well as their proximity and business ties to China.
paragraph2: Closer Russia-Kazakhstan cooperation on AI and a growing Russian corporate footprint in the ex-Soviet state could boost this trend."We are pleased to see Russian companies' progress in our market, and they can rely on our comprehensive assistance," Tokayev told Putin ahead of Sberbank's AI Journey conference in Moscow.BOTTLENECKS IN TECHNOLOGY RACETokayev said that Russia-based technology group Yandex was the biggest employer in Kazakhstan, and a large delegation of his country's AI entrepreneurs and officials responsible for AI joined the president on his visit to Moscow.Sberbank unveiled new versions of its GigaChat AI model and its video-generating Kandinsky model on Thursday, and presented Tokayev and Putin with a new generation of its Grin AI-powered humanoid robots.Russia does not produce its own advanced chips, and its supercomputers used to train AI models were built before the war in Ukraine began and the West imposed sanctions.
paragraph3: The."A shortage of electricity, power grids, and complex component base are becoming bottlenecks in the technological race. Overcoming these barriers requires new, massive investments," Putin told the conference.CHINA-MADE CHIPSA new Russian decree allows Russian companies to use data centres located abroad with the permission of security services. Putin signed it after Ukrainian drones targeted Russian data centres and supercomputers earlier this year.
paragraph4: Sberbank and Yandex did not publicly say whether they would respond by moving some of their services to data centres in other countries, as information about data centres at Russian companies is confidential.Sberbank Chief Executive German Gref visited China in May to discuss access to the most advanced China-made chips, but a person with knowledge of those discussions told Reuters the talks were inconclusive.The Russian daily Kommersant reported on Thursday, citing sources, that Gref, who was born in Soviet Kazakhstan, was also in regular discussions about AI development with Tokayev and was a frequent visitor to the Kazakh capital.Sberbank did not comment on the report.During Huang's October visit to Kazakhstan, Freedom Holding, led by Russian-born entrepreneur Timur Turlov – who renounced his Russian citizenship in 2022 and also severed business links to Russia – announced plans to build a $2 billion Sovereign AI Hub in Kazakhstan."
paragraph5: We are already placing an order for our first computing cluster powered by Nvidia's latest B300 chips, with up to 300 servers and a total investment of hundreds of millions of dollars," Turlov said at the time.Huang, who this month resigned and was then reinstated to his role as CEO, also confirmed during the October visit that Nvidia had invested in Kazakhstan's AI video generation startup Higgsfield as part of the statup's $400-million funding round.This article was generated from an automated news agency feed without modifications to text.

bangla_paragraph2: এআই-র ক্ষেত্রে রাশিয়া-কাজাকস্তানের মধ্যে ঘনিষ্ঠ সহযোগিতা এবং প্রাক্তন সোভিয়েত রাষ্ট্রের মধ্যে রাশিয়ার কর্পোরেট পদচিহ্ন এই প্রবণতাকে বাড়িয়ে তুলতে পারে। "আমরা রাশিয়ান কোম্পানিগুলির আমাদের বাজারে অগ্রগতি দেখে আনন্দিত, এবং তারা আমাদের ব্যাপক সহায়তার উপর নির্ভর করতে পারে", টোকায়ভ মস্কোতে সেরব্যাঙ্কের এআই যাত্রা সম্মেলনের আগে পুতিনকে বলেছিলেন।

bangla_paragraph5: আমরা ইতিমধ্যে এনভিডিয়ার সর্বশেষ বি৩০০ চিপস দ্বারা চালিত আমাদের প্রথম কম্পিউটিং ক্লাস্টারের জন্য অর্ডার দিচ্ছি, যার মধ্যে ৩০০ টি পর্যন্ত সার্ভার রয়েছে এবং মোট শত শত মিলিয়ন ডলারের বিনিয়োগ রয়েছে", তুরলোভ তখন বলেছিলেন। এই মাসে পদত্যাগ করে এবং তারপরে সিইও হিসাবে তার ভূমিকায় পুনরায় নিয়োগ দেওয়া হুং অক্টোবরের সফরেও নিশ্চিত করেছিলেন যে এনভিডিয়া কাশ্মীরের এআই ভিডিও জেনারেশন স্টার্টআপ হিগসফিল্ডে বিনিয়োগ করেছে।

title: Ford unveils the GT41 as it hopes to win Le Mans again
title_bn: ফোর্ড আবারো লে ম্যান জিতেছে বলে আশা করে GT41 উন্মোচন করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Ford enters the World Endurance Championship in 2027 with the new prototype.
paragraph1: The hybrid system and transmission are also standard parts. But Ford supplies the engine—a 5.4 L V8 based on the Mustang’s Coyote engine—as well as software to control the hybrid powertrain.
paragraph2: A non-hybridized version of the Coyote has already been racing effectively under the hood of the Ford Mustang GT3. The technical regulations also allow for more styling freedom than we often see in racing. The absolute amount of aerodynamic downforce is capped, as is the minimum drag, so OEMs are encouraged to use road car styling details to create a closer link between prototype and road car.
paragraph3: I’ll probably need to spend more time looking at it to spot those road car cues, but I do see quite a few superficial similarities with the Genesis LMDh car, as well as the Ferrari Hypercar. Despite being an American car brand, Ford doesn’t have plans as yet to enter IMSA’s WeatherTech championship, so don’t expect to see the GT41 next January racing at Daytona. Instead, it will take its first green flag in Qatar in March, the first of WEC’s nine races next season.
paragraph4: Ford should find it an extremely competitive championship. Although Peugeot and Alpine will not race next year, McLaren is also entering, alongside returning teams from Aston Martin, BMW, Cadillac, Genesis, Ferrari, and Toyota, which this year won Le Mans and the overall title, following three years of Ferrari domination.
bangla_paragraph1: হাইব্রিড সিস্টেম এবং ট্রান্সমিশনও স্ট্যান্ডার্ড অংশ। তবে ফোর্ড Mustang এর Coyote ইঞ্জিনের উপর ভিত্তি করে একটি 5.4 লিটার V8 ইঞ্জিন সরবরাহ করে। পাশাপাশি হাইব্রীড পাওয়ার ট্রেন নিয়ন্ত্রণের জন্য সফ্টওয়্যার।
bangla_paragraph2: ফোর্ড মুস্তাং জিটি 3 এর হুডের অধীনে ইতিমধ্যে কোয়োটের একটি নন-হাইব্রিডাইজড সংস্করণ কার্যকরভাবে দৌড়াদৌড়ি করছে। প্রযুক্তিগত বিধিগুলিও আমরা প্রায়শই দৌড়ের চেয়ে স্টাইলিংয়ের আরও স্বাধীনতা দেয়। বায়ুসংক্রান্ত ডাউনফোর্সের পরম পরিমাণ সীমিত, যেমন ন্যূনতম ড্রাগ, তাই OEMs কে প্রোটোটাইপ এবং রাস্তার গাড়ির মধ্যে আরও ঘনিষ্ঠ সংযোগ তৈরি করতে রাস্তা গাড়ির স্টাইলের বিবরণ ব্যবহার করতে উত্সাহিত করা হয়।

title: Unihertz shows off Titan 2 Elite in new white color, and you can pre-order now
title_bn: ইউনিহার্জ নতুন সাদা রঙে টাইটান ২ এলিট প্রদর্শন করছে, আর আপনি এখনই প্রি-অর্ডার করতে পারেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: You’ll just have to wait a couple months to get it.
paragraph1: Add Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Last week, Unihertz posted a teaser for an upcoming new Titan 2 Elite color option. Today the company reveals the Titan 2 Elite in white. Unihertz is accepting pre-orders now, but the white model won’t ship for another couple months.
paragraph2: Hardware keyboards are one of those holdovers from the early days of smartphones that just keep popping back up, and if you’re tempted to go a little retro for your next purchase, you’ve now got a new option available to you, as Unihertz reveals its latest color for the Titan 2 Elite.Last week, we saw Unihertz start teasing a new color option for the Titan 2 Elite. The teaser itself didn’t seem to contain much in the way of hints, leaving us to just speculate as we waited for the announcement.
paragraph3: At the very least, we wouldn’t have long to wait, with the manufacturer implying we’d get our answer sometime this month. December still doesn’t arrive for a few more days, but this mystery is already wrapping up, with Unihertz sharing a new white colorway for the Titan 2 Elite, joining the previously available black and orange.As you can see above, this keyboard is for more than just typing, and like BlackBerry models of yesteryear, you can use the touch-sensitive surface for scrolling through your favorite apps, or even pull up a cursor for finer control.
paragraph4: If all those keys aren’t enough to satisfy your crave for input buttons, Unihertz even gives the Titan 2 Elite a programmable side button that you can set up as a shortcut to whatever you want.At just about $490, the white Titan 2 Elite costs the same as the orange and black models, but there is another consideration that might impact your purchasing decision — while the other ones ship straight away, the new white edition is currently just in pre-order, and won’t ship for another two months, well into the new year.That said, Unihertz is prioritizing shipments based on the order in which they’re received, so the longer you hem and haw about it, the further out your ship date is likely to slide.
paragraph5: Was this the new color you were hoping for? Will you be picking up a white Titan 2 Elite, or are you maybe still holding out hope we could get a fourth color option somewhere further down the line? Let us know down in the comments.

title: Amazfit Bip Max smartwatch drops to a record low of $89.99
title_bn: অ্যামাজিফট বিপ ম্যাক্স স্মার্টওয়াচ রেকর্ড সর্বনিম্ন ৮৯.৯৯ ডলারে নেমে এসেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Save $10 on Amazfit's big-screen GPS smartwatch with a 2.07-inch AMOLED display and up to 20 days of battery life.
paragraph1: AmazfitAdd Android Authority on Google: Amazfit’s newest budget smartwatch just hit its lowest price yet. The Amazfit Bip Max is $89.99 on Amazon right now, down from its $99.
paragraph2: 99 list price. That’s $10 off, a 10% discount, and the lowest price it has sold for since it launched earlier this year. The Bip Max is all about getting a lot of watch for not much money.
paragraph3: Its 2.07-inch AMOLED display reaches up to 3,000 nits, so it’s easy to read outdoors, and it’s protected by tempered glass with an anti-fingerprint coating.Battery life is the big selling point.
paragraph4: Amazfit rates it at up to 20 days with typical use, up to 10 days with heavy use, and up to 40 hours of continuous GPS tracking. Built-in GPS means you can leave your phone at home on runs and rides.There’s 4GB of storage for offline maps and podcasts, Bluetooth calling through a built-in speaker and microphone, and more than 150 sports modes.
paragraph5: It also tracks heart rate, blood oxygen, stress, and sleep, and it’s water resistant to 50 meters.The Amazfit Bip Max works with both Android phones and iPhones, and with a 4.5-star rating on Amazon, it’s an easy recommendation for anyone who wants a capable fitness watch for under $90.
bangla_paragraph1: অ্যামাজিফট গুগলে অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ যুক্ত করুন: অ্যামাজফিট এর সর্বশেষ বাজেট স্মার্টওয়াচটি এখন পর্যন্ত সর্বনিম্ন দাম পেয়েছে। অ্যাম্যাজিফ্ট বিপ ম্যাক্সের দাম বর্তমানে অ্যামাগনে $৮৯.৯৯, যা $৯৯ থেকে কম।
bangla_paragraph2: 99 তালিকা মূল্য. যে $ 10 ছাড়, 10% ছাড়, এবং সর্বনিম্ন দাম এটি এই বছরের শুরুতে চালু করা হয়েছে. বিপ ম্যাক্স অনেক টাকা জন্য অনেক ঘড়ি পেতে সব সম্পর্কে।
bangla_paragraph3: এর ২.০৭ ইঞ্চি AMOLED ডিসপ্লে 3,000 নিট পর্যন্ত পৌঁছায়, তাই এটি বাইরের জায়গায় পড়তে সহজ, এবং এটি একটি অ্যান্টি-ফিংগারপ্রিন্ট লেপ সহ টেম্পারেড গ্লাস দ্বারা সুরক্ষিত। ব্যাটারি জীবন বড় বিক্রয় পয়েন্ট।
bangla_paragraph4: অ্যামাজিফট এটিকে সাধারণ ব্যবহারের সাথে ২০ দিন পর্যন্ত, ভারী ব্যবহারের সঙ্গে ১০ দিন পর্যন্ত এবং ৪০ ঘন্টা পর্যন্ত অবিচ্ছিন্ন জিপিএস ট্র্যাকিংয়ের হার দেয়। অন্তর্নির্মিত জিপিএসের অর্থ আপনি দৌড়াতে এবং যাত্রায় আপনার ফোনটি বাড়িতে রেখে যেতে পারেন। অফলাইন মানচিত্র এবং পডকাস্টের জন্য 4 গিগাবাইট স্টোরেজ রয়েছে, একটি অন্তর্নমিত স্পিকার এবং মাইক্রোফোনের মাধ্যমে ব্লুটুথ কল এবং 150 টিরও বেশি স্পোর্টস মোড রয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph5: এটি হার্ট রেট, রক্তে অক্সিজেন, চাপ এবং ঘুমের গতিও ট্র্যাক করে, এবং এটি 50 মিটার পর্যন্ত জল প্রতিরোধী। অ্যামাজনফিট বিপ ম্যাক্স অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ফোন এবং আইফোন উভয়ই কাজ করে, অ্যামাজনে 4.5 তারকা রেটিং সহ, এটি 90 ডলারের নিচে একটি সক্ষম ফিটনেস ঘড়ি চান এমন কারও জন্য এটি একটি সহজ প্রস্তাব।

title: A month with the iPhone Duo has changed how I use my phone
title_bn: আইফোন ডুও নিয়ে এক মাস আমার ফোন ব্যবহারের পদ্ধতি বদলে দিয়েছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: From reading more books to breaking mindless scrolling habits, Apple's foldable has changed my daily routines in ways I didn't anticipate.
paragraph1: For years, the definition of a premium smartphone depended on its cameras, processors, and how light it felt when you stowed it in your pocket. The iPhone Duo challenges that concept by asking consumers to pay more for a fundamentally different smartphone experience, even if it means sacrificing what they’ve long thought of as high-end features. In a little under a month of using the Duo, I’ve found that the trade-offs I was initially concerned about matter far less to me than I had expected. What’s been more interesting is how the Duo’s foldable form factor has changed my everyday habits, including how I interact with apps, which apps I use, and how I organize and personalize the phone itself. I also easily forgot a number of my initial concerns about switching to the Duo. The apps, for the most part, are now optimized for the Duo; I’ve reacquainted myself with Touch ID; and I don’t miss the Pro Max camera on most days. That’s not to say the Duo doesn’t have its shortcomings. I still miss that telephoto lens sometimes, and I’m still longing for Face ID — though not as much since Apple shipped a face unlock feature in the latest update. But after a month of using the Duo, I’ve found these compromises have had less of an impact on my day-to-day experience compared with the benefits that the new form factor brings. Multitasking feels more natural I was surprised by how much I’ve grown to appreciate the Duo’s multitasking capabilities. Initially, I didn’t think I’d regularly use it to view two apps side by side, given the still fairly limited screen space even while the phone is unfolded, especially compared with an iPad.
paragraph2: But I’ve found myself snapping apps to both halves of the screen more often than I had imagined. For starters, Apple has made this side-by-side mode incredibly intuitive and easy to use — you simply drag the app over to the left or right side of the screen and drop it into the target box that appears. I have regularly taken advantage of this feature to do all sorts of things. Image Credits:Apple I really enjoy keeping X open as I read through the news, which allows me to switch back and forth between the article I’m reading and real-time reactions to it. Sometimes I’ll keep email or Slack open on the side while I’m working on something else so I don’t miss an important message or notification. And much like the overstimulated members of Gen Z (which I am not), I sometimes like scrolling social media while engaging with some other media off to the side. Case in point: I passively watched Netflix’s “Love is Blind” reunion while reading the gossipy tweets and Reddit posts about the main characters on the other side of the screen. This sort of TV watching behavior used to be called second-screen viewing, but now it’s morphing into something new. Everything is happening on one screen, so should we call it “Duo screen viewing,” perhaps? It makes me long for even more interactive TV experiences where commentary and content are combined. It really is like having two phones I’ve noticed another shift in my behavior since adopting the Duo as my main device.
paragraph3: When I’m out and about, the Duo feels more like an (arguably heavier) iPhone mini. For those who still miss smaller iPhones, the Duo is the next best thing. Despite its weight, the phone feels small. You can cover it with one hand; you can type with a thumb; you can reach the top and bottom easily; and you can even fit it into your front and back pockets. The Pro Max now feels unbelievably strange in my hand — how was I ever comfortable wrangling this giant rectangle? The Duo’s small screen works well when you’re on the go, especially for short interactions like responding to a quick text or pulling up directions to a destination. It’s not as great for mindless scrolling, which I appreciate, as it forces me to engage with the real world instead of killing every moment of boredom or unease by opening up apps. An illustration of the Apple iPhone Duo is displayed at a store in Krakow, Poland, on October 27, 2026. (Photo by Karolina Janik/JPix/NurPhoto via Getty Images)Image Credits:NurPhoto / Contributor (opens in a new window) / Getty Images But when you’re home or somewhere with time to kill, you can unfold the screen and enjoy your apps super-sized. It’s the best of both worlds. I find that I instinctively unfold the phone when I’m preparing to watch videos, because the larger screen is best for that.
paragraph4: It’s also unfolded if I’m shopping, as it’s more convenient for looking at products, zooming in to examine the details, or complete checkout forms. Generally, I also unfold the Duo when I’m actively using apps. This setup has also allowed me to rethink my Home Screen layout: With the Duo closed, I prefer to see just widgets on the small screen with key information like weather, time, battery life, and so on. Meanwhile, the only app icons on the Home Screen are those in the dock. The Duo apps are ready now In the weeks since its launch, most of the apps that weren’t yet optimized for the Duo have been upgraded to support its foldable form factor. In mid-November, Apple said there were over 200,000 Duo-ready apps, and in my experience, that certainly feels true. A majority of my so-called “daily drivers” — with the glaring exception of key Google apps like Gmail and Drive — have dropped the black band on the side of the screen that was frustrating early testers of the phone. Most apps now take advantage of the available space, whether that’s on the Duo’s small front screen or the wider, unfolded one. I’ve also found it interesting to see the different interpretations developers have had for how to best optimize their app for Duo. Some have used the form factor as a way to bring in some sort of novelty: there’s a note-taking app that opens and closes like a notebook, with pages you can write on with the Apple Pencil; a retro Walkman-like music player; a tiny typewriter; a gaming handheld; a game where you close the phone to make grilled cheese. Image Credits:Tiny Computers As much as I love the whimsy of this group of apps, I appreciate how my everyday apps feel better to use on the unfolded screen.
paragraph5: Spotify, at last, feels less cluttered when it has more screen real estate. A number of note-taking, list-making, and calendar apps also feel somehow more usable when spread out. The Netflix app is actually fantastic with its support for multiple viewing modes, which include playing video on the closed outer display, the “laptop” orientation with its big player controls, and the “tent” mode. Image Credits:Apple Other developers have similarly reimagined how their app would work if it had originally been designed for the Duo’s small and larger screens. One good example of this is Sofa, a handy utility for organizing the books, movies, TV shows, podcasts, albums, and games you want to check out. When the Duo is closed, its navigation is tucked off to the right side in a vertical bar, while the main screen focuses on the items you’ve saved. But when the Duo is unfolded, the number of items displayed on the screen also expands into a two-column layout, with more of your items featured on the screen and your lists on the left side. It doesn’t feel like two different apps, but like you’ve opened up the app itself and given it more space to spread out. Image Credits:Sofa (screenshot from their Threads post) (opens in a new window) In terms of your daily social media scroll, apps like TikTok and Instagram have been updated to be perfectly usable on the Duo, whether the phone is open or closed. When closed, TikTok now stretches the video to cover the screen, instead of showing the ugly black bar. Scrolling short-form videos on the Duo, while unfolded like a slightly smaller iPad mini, has become my preferred way to watch.
bangla_paragraph1: বছরের পর বছর ধরে, একটি প্রিমিয়াম স্মার্টফোনের সংজ্ঞা তার ক্যামেরা, প্রসেসর এবং যখন আপনি এটি আপনার পকেটে রেখেছিলেন তখন এটি কতটা হালকা ছিল তার উপর নির্ভর করেছিল। আইফোন ডুও গ্রাহকদের মৌলিকভাবে ভিন্ন স্মার্ট ফোন অভিজ্ঞতার জন্য আরও বেশি অর্থ প্রদানের জন্য জিজ্ঞাসা করে এই ধারণাকে চ্যালেঞ্জ জানায়, এমনকি যদি এর অর্থ তারা দীর্ঘকাল ধরে উচ্চ-শেষ বৈশিষ্ট্য হিসাবে যা ভেবেছিল তা ত্যাগ করে। ডুয়ো ব্যবহারের এক মাসেরও কম সময়ে, আমি দেখেছি যে আমি প্রাথমিকভাবে উদ্বিগ্ন ছিলাম trade-offs আমার প্রত্যাশার চেয়ে অনেক কম গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
bangla_paragraph2: কিন্তু আমি নিজেকে স্ক্রিনের উভয় অর্ধেকের অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলি কল্পনা করার চেয়ে বেশি সময় ধরে স্ন্যাপ করতে দেখেছি। শুরু করার জন্য, অ্যাপল এই পাশের মোডটিকে অবিশ্বাস্যভাবে স্বজ্ঞাত এবং ব্যবহার করা সহজ করে তুলেছে  আপনি কেবল অ্যাপ্লিকেশানটিকে স্ক্রিনে বাম বা ডানদিকে টেনে আনুন এবং প্রদর্শিত লক্ষ্য বাক্সে ফেলে দিন। আমি নিয়মিত এই বৈশিষ্ট্যটি বিভিন্ন ধরণের কাজ করার জন্য ব্যবহার করেছি। চিত্র ক্রেডিটঃঅ্যাপল আমি সত্যিই এক্স খোলা রাখতে পছন্দ করি যখন আমি সংবাদটি পড়ি, যা আমাকে পিছনে এবং এগিয়ে যেতে দেয়
bangla_paragraph3: আমি যখন বাইরে থাকি, ডুওটি আইফোন মিনি (সম্ভবত আরও ভারী) এর মতো মনে হয়। যারা এখনও ছোট আইফোনগুলি মিস করেন তাদের জন্য ডুয়ো পরবর্তী সেরা জিনিস। এর ওজন সত্ত্বেও, ফোনটি ছোট মনে হয় । আপনি এটি এক হাতে coverেকে রাখতে পারেন; আপনি একটি আঙ্গুল দিয়ে টাইপ করতে পারেন; আপনার উপরের এবং নীচের অংশে সহজেই পৌঁছতে পারেন; এবং আপনি এমনকি আপনার সামনের এবং পিছনের পকেটেও ফিট করতে পারেন। প্রো ম্যাক্স এখন আমার হাতে অবিশ্বাস্যভাবে অদ্ভুত বোধ করে  আমি কীভাবে এই বিশাল আয়তক্ষেত্রের সাথে ঝগড়া করতে পেরেছি? ডুউয়ের ছোট স্ক্রিন কাজ করে
bangla_paragraph4: এটি যদি আমি কেনাকাটা করছি তবে এটিও প্রকাশিত হয়, কারণ এটি পণ্যগুলি দেখার জন্য, বিশদটি পরীক্ষা করতে জুম ইন করতে বা চেকআউট ফর্মগুলি সম্পূর্ণ করার জন্য আরও সুবিধাজনক। সাধারণত, আমি যখন অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলি সক্রিয়ভাবে ব্যবহার করছি তখন আমি ডুওটিও প্রকাশ করি। এই সেটআপটি আমাকে আমার হোম স্ক্রিনের বিন্যাসটি পুনর্বিবেচনা করতেও অনুমতি দিয়েছেঃ ডুয়ো বন্ধ থাকলে, আমি আবহাওয়া, সময়, ব্যাটারির আয়ু ইত্যাদির মতো মূল তথ্য সহ ছোট স্ক্রিনে উইজেটগুলি দেখতে পছন্দ করি। এদিকে হোম স্ক্রীনে একমাত্র অ্যাপ আইকনগুলি ডকের মধ্যে রয়েছে। ডুঅ অ্যাপ্লিকেশানগুলি হ'ল
bangla_paragraph5: স্পটিফাই, অবশেষে, যখন এটির আরও স্ক্রিন রিয়েল এস্টেট থাকে তখন কম বিশৃঙ্খল বোধ করে। নোট গ্রহণ, তালিকা তৈরি এবং ক্যালেন্ডার অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলির একটি সংখ্যাও ছড়িয়ে পড়লে কিছুটা বেশি ব্যবহারযোগ্য বলে মনে হয়। নেটফ্লিক্স অ্যাপ্লিকেশানটি আসলে একাধিক দেখার মোডের সমর্থনের সাথে দুর্দান্ত, যার মধ্যে রয়েছে বন্ধ বাইরের ডিসপ্লেতে ভিডিও প্লে করা, ল্যাপটপ  ওরিয়েন্টেশন এর বড় প্লেয়ার নিয়ন্ত্রণ এবং টেন্ট  মোড। চিত্র ক্রেডিটঃ অ্যাপল অন্যান্য বিকাশকারীরা একইভাবে পুনরায় কল্পনা করেছেন যে তাদের অ্যাপটি কীভাবে কাজ করবে যদি এটির মূল ছিল

title_bn: সাউন্ডকোর লিবার্টি ৫ ইয়ারফোন ৪২% ছাড়ে রেকর্ড কমতে শুরু করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Anker's Liberty 5 noise canceling earbuds drop to $75.99, with LDAC, Dolby Audio, and multipoint support.
paragraph1: Add Android Authority on Google: Anker’s Soundcore Liberty 5 pack a lot of features for midrange earbuds, and they just hit their lowest price. They’re down to $75.99 on Amazon, which is $54 off the $129.99 list price and a new record low.
paragraph2: Every color is on sale at the same price. Noise canceling is the headline feature. The Soundcore Liberty 5 use Adaptive ANC 3.0, which keeps recalibrating as your surroundings change, so they keep up whether you’re on a bus, in a coffee shop, or walking past traffic.
paragraph3: Sound quality gets plenty of attention too. LDAC support means higher quality wireless audio from compatible Android phones, and Dolby Audio can be switched on in the Soundcore app for a wider, more spacious sound. Multipoint lets you connect to two devices at once, and it keeps working with LDAC turned on, which isn’t always the case.Battery life is rated at up to 12 hours per charge with noise canceling off, or eight hours with it on, and the case extends that to as much as 48 hours.
paragraph4: A 10-minute charge adds about five hours of listening. Six microphones handle calls, and an IP55 rating means sweat and rain aren’t a worry.At $75.99, the Soundcore Liberty 5 are a great pick for Android users who want strong noise canceling and LDAC without paying flagship prices.

bangla_paragraph3: Sound quality gets plenty of attention too. title: Exploring the Indium phosphide supply chain — the material constraint tightening the optical interconnect bottleneck
title_bn: ইন্ডিয়াম ফসফাইড সরবরাহ চেইন অন্বেষণ  অপটিকাল ইন্টারকানেকশন বোতল ঘাটি শক্ত করার উপাদান সীমাবদ্ধতা
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The AI industry's shift to optical interconnects is overwhelming the concentrated InP supply chain behind lasers, transceivers, and co-packaged optics.
paragraph1: Indium phosphide (InP) is a compound material used in specialized chip-making. Unlike silicon, which is the fundamental building block for mainstream logic and memory chips, InP — made from indium and phosphorus — is mainly used to manufacture highly specialized photonic and high-frequency electronic chips, largely due to its outstanding optical properties.
paragraph2: Its immensely expensive and complex manufacturing process also makes it impractical for the large volumes and die sizes needed for logic and memory chips. With the industry predicting a shortfall of this crucial material right as the shift to optical interconnects in data centers begins, we explore the current state of the supply chain.
paragraph3: InP chips have powered high-speed lasers, modulators, photodetectors, and various other optical components used across the telecommunications industry and defense for decades. While the InP supply chain was relatively small and highly specialized, it was generally stable and sufficient to meet global demands.

author: TechPulse
excerpt: Data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia are now required to obtain export licenses if they want to get their Nvidia AI GPUs delivered.
paragraph1: AI data centers in Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, and Indonesia are facing trouble as Nvidia has reportedly ordered its manufacturing partners to stop shipping AI servers to the region. According to the Financial Times, Dell, Supermicro, and other firms that make AI servers using Nvidia AI GPUs have told their customers from the four countries that the AI chip maker has forbidden them to ship their orders. The move comes as the U.
paragraph2: S. closed the loophole that let Chinese AI companies rent compute from data centers outside China equipped with advanced AI chips sourced from American semiconductor manufacturers like Nvidia.The U.
paragraph3: S. has banned the export of advanced AI chips to China since 2022 in an effort to limit its advancement. Even though President Trump eventually allowed Nvidia to export H100 AI GPUs to China in December 2025, companies that wanted to buy them needed to secure an import license from the Commerce Department.
paragraph4: Aside from that, the White House is also collecting a 25% fee for every chip, making it more expensive for a data center in China to buy them. Because of this, many Chinese AI labs are instead renting compute from data centers located abroad. They mostly do this in Southeast Asia, which is just around a four-to-six-hour flight from major cities like Hong Kong, Shenzhen, and Shanghai, although some firms are looking in further areas like Europe.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
title_bn: গ্র্যান্ড চুরি অটো ৬ প্রমাণ করে যে কেন দক্ষতা কোন গুণ নয়
author: TechPulse
excerpt: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.
paragraph1: It should have been impossible for “Grand Theft Auto VI” (GTA VI) to live up to the hype. Fans waited 13 years for the newest installment in the crime-adventure franchise, and Rockstar Games exceeded even those inconceivable expectations when the game finally came out last week. GTA VI launched as the highest-rated game of all time on Metacritic and made $3.79 billion on release day to mark what could be the biggest entertainment event ever – more massive than “Avengers: Endgame” ($2.9 billion) or Taylor Swift’s Eras tour ($2 billion). The 13-year wait certainly fueled the frenzy, and sales, around GTA VI, but some fans craved GTA VI because of what it represents in the emerging era of AI. Even the biggest workaholics among us – startup founders – scheduled time off to play the game, including Spiry co-founder Dima Beseda, who told TechCrunch, “I reshuffled my workload to free up time around the weekends and even booked vitamin IV drips to keep my energy up.” Yet some players felt a sense of anticipatory nostalgia as they wiped away a layer of dust on their Xbox to play the game they’d been looking forward to since they were kids. “We do have a view that GTA is likely to be the last game of its kind to be made this way,” Ben Feder, managing partner at TIRTA Ventures and former CEO of Rockstar parent company Take-Two Interactive, told TechCrunch. That’s because GTA VI was created entirely without generative AI.
paragraph2: “We’re kind of at this technological moment where this way of developing has sort of reached its natural frontier,” Feder said. “I don’t think you can say that games like this will always be around.” As millions of people immersed themselves in Vice City, the tech industry witnessed another long-awaited moment: Anthropic became the first major AI lab to go public. At Nasdaq HQ, Anthropic executives gathered to celebrate the Claude maker’s $81.3 billion IPO. At virtually the same moment that Anthropic broke the record for the largest IPO ever, GTA VI was also breaking records with the highest-rated and best-selling game launch of all time. But when the Anthropic team rang the bell on Thursday, the sound also signaled the end of an era in video game development, and perhaps even in the arts at large. The AI industry operates with efficiency as its north star. The promise of this technology is that we will be able to automate so much work that we can expand the capabilities of humanity, avoiding needless time spent tinkering with ultimately fruitless ideas. Instead, a prompt goes into an LLM, and a response is spat out.
paragraph3: This technological revolution exploded into the world with some soul-crushing side effects: children are inundated with mind-numbing slop on YouTube, lawyers cite nonexistent cases in court, and tech companies like Meta lay off tens of thousands of people as part of a corporate-branded “Year of Efficiency.” But against the backdrop of the AI industry’s first major IPO, Rockstar has unveiled a game that about 5,000 people labored over for more than a decade. The final product is breathtaking, looking so lifelike that it can be hard to distinguish gameplay footage from real life. These sprawling open-world games are usually made possible by procedurally generating new landscapes and objects, but Rockstar has taken the time to painstakingly craft every detail of the world, even developing 30,000 different nonplayable characters with unique appearances and personalities. The video game industry is already grappling with the threat of AI. Google’s Project Genie, which launched earlier this year, allows users to create and wander around 3D worlds generated from prompts to an LLM. The stock prices of several video game companies faltered around the time of Project Genie’s release, perhaps because of investors’ uncertainty about the future relevance of video game developers. “The notion that somehow new tools would allow an individual to push a button and generate a hit, market a hit, and bring it to many millions of consumers around the world, it’s a laughable notion,” Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick said at the time. “It’s just never been the case with entertainment.” Zelnick’s fellow tech CEOs see different future, though.
paragraph4: On a Meta earnings call this year, CEO Mark Zuckerberg promised that, “soon, you’ll have an AI that understands you and [can] even generate great personalized content for you.” Elon Musk even went as far as proposing that a game like GTA VI could be made with AI. “You won’t even have to ask,” Musk wrote on X. “AI will figure what video game you’d like best.” This is the paradox of “Grandthropic” week. GTA VI is so impressively vast and captivating because its developers could make mistakes, experiment, and rework ideas, even if that meant delaying the game (twice). GTA VI was incubated with the exact inefficiencies that investors hope AI companies like Anthropic can help eradicate. “Plenty of fantastic art — video games and elsewhere — almost by definition has to be created slowly, and there’s something to having that kind of inefficiency around it,” Feder said. “Creative output requires deletion, right? Getting to kind of a masterpiece oftentimes requires an enormous amount of deletion.
paragraph5: And when you’re talking about a game of the kind of complexity we’re talking about, that kind of deletion ends up being very expensive, and it is by definition not efficient.” GTA VI reeks of its own humanity – every small detail is loaded with intention, but it’s this impressive precision that keeps the world abuzz, triggering the kind of monocultural moment that has become increasingly rare in a media landscape that revolves around highly personalized social media algorithms. The game forces the player to slow down, which is either frustrating or genius, depending on your sense of humor. People waited more than three presidential terms for the next installment in a high-octane action franchise, only to download a 212 GB behemoth of a game in which your earliest missions involve driving around doing errands and putting up drywall to make your girlfriend happy. Don’t worry — there are still car chases and shootouts — but in a moment when AI feels suffocating, GTA VI is such an artistic achievement that it is reaching audiences that don’t even like violent video games. The ultimate fantasy of GTA VI is no longer to role-play as a criminal — the fantasy is just taking your time to relish the mundane and explore an expansive world that developers were given the time and space to perfect. title: [Update] Jio Takes JioAstro Offline, Says It Was A ‘Demo Survey’
title_bn: [আপডেট] জিও জিওঅস্ট্রোকে অফলাইনে নিয়ে গেছে, বলছে এটি একটি ডেমো জরিপ ছিল
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Update | November 26, 19:47 IST Hours after Jio Platforms’ astrology platform JioAstro became publicly accessible, the company appears to…
paragraph1: SUMMARYHours after Jio Platforms’ astrology platform JioAstro became publicly accessible, the company appears to have taken it offline The launch put Jio in competition with established players such as Astrotalk and AstroSage in India's fast-growing spiritual tech market JioAstro generated birth charts and further gave personalised insights by advanced AI trained in Vedic astrology. Update | November 26, 19:47 IST Hours after Jio Platforms’ astrology platform JioAstro became publicly accessible, the company appears to have taken it offline. “Thank you for participating in the demo survey! It has now closed and is no longer available,” the website reads. Sources told Inc42 that the platform was being tested privately and wasn’t supposed to be realised publicly.
paragraph2: It remains unclear if Jio will make the offering publicly available at a later date. Original | November 25, 18:19 IST Telecom major Jio Platforms has forayed into online astrology market with the launch of a dedicated offering, JioAstro. JioAstro generates birth charts using “Swiss Ephemeris calculations” and further gives personalised insights by advanced AI trained in Vedic astrology. JioAstro is available in English, Hindi, Marathi and Gujarati. The company hasn’t disclosed which large language models (LLMs) power the platform, whether it relies on proprietary models or third-party AI infrastructure.
paragraph3: While JioAstro is accessible through its website and has a listing on Google Play, its terms describe the mobile app as an invite-only prototype available through the internal testing track. With the AI-powered vedic astrology platform, Jio takes on the likes of consumer startups Astrotalk, AstroSage, among others, who have already been in this space for some years. One of the most renowned astrology platforms and India’s 133rd unicorn, Astrotalk, was delisted from Apple’s App Store on November 4. Sources told Inc42 that the spiritual tech startup is in discussions with Apple over the delisting. The app, however, remains unavailable on the platform.
paragraph4: The broader spiritual tech ecosystem has seen growing investor interest, with startups raising capital to expand their offerings. Earlier this year, Astrotalk joined India’s unicorn club following an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) buyback at a $1 Bn valuation. Back then, the startup also said its annual revenue run rate (ARR) had crossed ₹2,500 Cr. Other startups like AppsForBharat, VAMA, MyNaksh, Sanctuary, AstroSure, among others, have also raised investor support in recent times. More recently, Kolkata-based Utsav raised ₹36 Cr ($3.
paragraph5: 8 Mn) in a Series A round led by Atomic Capital, with existing investors India Quotient and Equanimity Investments also participating. The stars of the Indian digital astrology market are on the rise. The segment is estimated to be worth $390 Mn in 2026 and is projected to reach $2.32 Bn by 2032, registering a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 34.61%, as per MarkNtel Advisors.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার জিও প্ল্যাটফর্মের জ্যোতিষ প্ল্যাটଫর্ম জিওঅস্ট্রো জনসাধারণের কাছে অ্যাক্সেসযোগ্য হওয়ার কয়েক ঘন্টা পরে, কোম্পানিটি এটিকে অফলাইনে নিয়ে গেছে বলে মনে হচ্ছে লঞ্চটি জিওকে ভারতের দ্রুত বর্ধনশীল আধ্যাত্মিক প্রযুক্তি বাজারে অ্যাস্ট্রোটালক এবং অ্যাস্ট্রোসেজের মতো প্রতিষ্ঠিত খেলোয়াড়দের সাথে প্রতিযোগিতায় ফেলেছিল।
bangla_paragraph2: জিও কি পরে এই অফারটি সর্বজনীনভাবে উপলব্ধ করবে তা এখনও পরিষ্কার নয়। মূল. নভেম্বর 25, 18:19 আইএসটি টেলিযোগাযোগের প্রধান জিও প্ল্যাটফর্মগুলি একটি উত্সর্গীকৃত অফার, জিওঅস্ট্রো চালু করে অনলাইন জ্যোতিষ বাজারে প্রবেশ করেছে। জিওএস্ট্রো  সুইস এফেমেরিস গণনা ব্যবহার করে জন্ম চার্ট তৈরি করে এবং বৈদিক জ্যോতিষশাস্ত্রের প্রশিক্ষিত উন্নত এআই দ্বারা ব্যক্তিগত অন্তর্দৃষ্টি দেয়। জিঅস্ট্রোর ইংরেজি, হিন্দি, মারাঠি এবং গুজরাতিতে উপলব্ধ। সংস্থাটি কোন বড় ভাষায় প্রকাশ করেনি।
bangla_paragraph3: জিওঅস্ট্রো তার ওয়েবসাইটের মাধ্যমে অ্যাক্সেসযোগ্য এবং গুগল প্লেতে তালিকাভুক্ত রয়েছে, তবে এর শর্তাদি মোবাইল অ্যাপটিকে অভ্যন্তরীণ পরীক্ষার ট্র্যাকের মাধ্যমে আমন্ত্রণ-কেবল প্রোটোটাইপ হিসাবে বর্ণনা করে। এআই-চালিত বৈদিক জ্যোতিষ প্ল্যাটফর্মের সাহায্যে জিও গ্রাহক স্টার্টআপগুলি যেমন অ্যাস্ট্রোটালক, অ্যাস্ট্রোসেজ, অন্যান্যদের সাথে লড়াই করে, যারা ইতিমধ্যে কয়েক বছর ধরে এই জায়গায় রয়েছে। সর্বাধিক বিখ্যাত জ্যୋতিষীয় প্ল্যাটਫর্মগুলির মধ্যে একটি এবং ভারতের ১৩৩ তম ইউনিকর্ন, অ্যাস্টটালক নভেম্বরে অ্যাপল অ্যাপ স্টোর থেকে ডিলিস্ট করা হয়েছিল।
bangla_paragraph4: বৃহত্তর আধ্যাত্মিক প্রযুক্তি বাস্তুতন্ত্রের বিনিয়োগকারীদের আগ্রহ বাড়ছে, স্টার্টআপগুলি তাদের অফারগুলি প্রসারিত করার জন্য মূলধন সংগ্রহ করছে। এই বছরের শুরুর দিকে, অ্যাস্ট্রোটালক কর্মচারী স্টক মালিকানা পরিকল্পনা (ইএসওপি) পুনরায় ক্রয়ের পরে ১ বিলিয়ন ডলারে ভারতের ইউনিকর্ন ক্লাবে যোগদান করেছিল। তখন স্টার্ট আপটিও বলেছিল যে এর বার্ষিক রাজস্ব রান রেট (এআরআর) ₹২৫০০ কোটি ছাড়িয়েছে। অ্যাপসফরভারত, ভিএএমএ, মাইনাকশ, অভয়ারণ্য, অ্যাস্ট্রোসুরের মতো অন্যান্য স্টার্ট-আপগুলিও সাম্প্রতিক সময়ে বিনিয়োগকারীদের সমর্থন বাড়িয়েছে।

title: Memory Costs Become A Headache. How Are Indian Startups Coping?
title_bn: স্মৃতিশক্তির খরচ মাথা ব্যাথা হয়ে উঠছে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Samsung’s entry-level Galaxy A07 5G now costs ₹22,999, up ₹2,000 from ₹20,999, under revised prices that took effect on November…
paragraph1: Samsung’s entry-level Galaxy A07 5G now costs ₹22,999, up ₹2,000 from ₹20,999, under revised prices that took effect on November 16. And that’s not it. Eight days after Diwali, on November 15-16, the prices of around 48 Samsung and Xiaomi smartphone variants rose by ₹1,000-₹4,000. These price hikes are the result of the rising cost of memory chips and other components. But rising memory chip costs are now hurting more than just the consumer electronics industry. The ripple effects have extended well beyond chip giants like NVIDIA, AMD and Qualcomm, and cloud behemoths such as AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud. Consequently, cloud hosting, storage and hardware procurement costs have started to burn holes in the pockets of SaaS companies. For Indian AI startups, too, rising memory costs means that building and running compute infrastructure is getting more expensive, even as limited GPU availability continues to delay deployments. For startups already investing heavily in AI capabilities, the memory crunch raises a pressing question. How are businesses factoring in the changing economics of computing? Let’s dive in… When Compute Becomes A Bottleneck For AI companies, memory is becoming a cost across the entire model lifecycle, from training and data storage to deployment and inference. Training datasets need to be stored, versioned and kept close to computing infrastructure. As companies work with increasingly large volumes of text, images, audio and video, storage requirements grow.
paragraph2: Once a model is deployed, platforms also accumulate user-generated data, including prompts, conversation histories, documents, embeddings and audit logs. Inference, or the process of running a trained model to generate responses, adds another layer of memory requirements. Longer conversations and more users accessing a model simultaneously increase the memory needed to maintain the model’s key-value (KV) cache that stores information from earlier parts of a conversation so that the model can use it while generating subsequent responses. But the pressure is not limited to memory prices alone. AI companies are also combating the rising cost and limited availability of GPUs, which are needed to run AI workloads (training and running the model). Subhashish Banerjee, cofounder of Bharat1 AI, which works with startups and infrastructure providers, said the economics of accessing GPUs have changed sharply over the past few months. Earlier, some AI startups could book GPUs for a few hours each day, depending on availability and price, and run customer workloads during that window. That flexibility has reduced. According to him, GPU prices have risen 30-35% since February 2026, while availability has tightened. Startups that previously booked capacity for 10-11 hours at a time are being asked to commit for three or six months. This has raised a new problem: companies are being asked to pay for capacity before they are sure customer demand will materialise. Simply put: A startup expecting to onboard a customer in June may have to reserve computing resources in March or January. Subhashish said the problem is particularly staring at smaller startups that lack the capital to make long-term commitments.
paragraph3: However, this does not mean enterprises with deep pockets can avoid the shocks. A case in point is Bengaluru-based payments technology company Juspay, which reported a net loss of ₹90 Cr in FY26, compared with a net profit of ₹62 Cr in the previous year, as it stepped up investments in AI capabilities and international expansion. Its revenue, however, grew 30% to ₹664 Cr. The company is also waiting for GPU capacity. Cofounder and COO Sheetal Lalwani said Juspay wants to increase its GPU investments but is constrained by allocation, with delivery commitments stretching three to six months. The company is awaiting a larger 72-GPU rack. RECOMMENDED FOR yOU Then, Indian companies are vulnerable to currency fluctuations. “Almost all of our compute is bought in dollars, which compounds the problem. A price rise that hurts a US company hurts an Indian company more,” said Abhijeet Zilpelwar, the cofounder and CTO of pi-labs, an AI native cybersecurity company. Cloud Over SaaS Profitability Traditional SaaS companies are facing a different set of challenges. The pressure is growing as these businesses continue to add AI features to their products. While they are less exposed to rising memory costs than AI model developers, given their limited reliance on high-end GPUs and specialised memory chips, they are not immune to the broader cost pressures. Their dependence on cloud infrastructure, which runs on servers equipped with DRAM and storage systems using NAND flash, makes them vulnerable to rising memory costs.
paragraph4: As cloud providers face higher infrastructure expenses, some of these costs get passed on to SaaS companies. Applications that once relied largely on conventional computing now need additional capacity to process AI workloads, store larger volumes of data, and support inference. This can increase infrastructure spending even as companies try to keep subscription prices competitive. The challenge is particularly acute for companies with fixed or per-seat subscription models. Their infrastructure costs can increase with usage, while revenue may not rise at the same pace. For smaller SaaS businesses already operating on thin margins, even a modest increase in hosting and storage expenses can make a difference. The scale of the increase is visible in cloud spending. According to industry estimates cited by Financial Express, a growth stage Indian startup that spent ₹8-20 Lakh a month on cloud infrastructure two years ago now typically spends ₹18-45 Lakh. For late stage and enterprise-scale companies, monthly spending has risen from ₹50-80 Lakh to ₹1.5 Cr. These increases reflect the growing complexity of workloads, AI experimentation and GPU computing. But cloud providers are not necessarily passing every increase on to customers. CloudPe cofounder Karan Jaju said the company has kept prices for older-generation cloud instances unchanged, while newer configurations with updated CPUs and RAM have become more expensive.
paragraph5: The pressure comes amid rising memory costs, with TrendForce forecasting computer memory, also called DRAM, contract prices to increase 10-15% quarter-on-quarter in Q4 2026. He added, new hardware (memory chips, CPUs, GPUs, etc.) purchases among some customers have fallen 5-10%. Some are instead exploring virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), which lets employees access cloud-hosted desktops without companies having to buy and maintain physical machines. Subhashish said Series B and Series C companies with substantial computing needs may consider buying hardware through infrastructure providers or loans, while earlier stage startups are likely to continue relying on cloud services and shorter-term rentals. Smaller Models, Lighter Hardware Another response to rising computing and memory requirements is to make AI models smaller and more efficient. This is happening not just among startups trying to reduce inference costs, but also among companies building AI features for consumer devices. The shift towards smaller language models (SLMs) is helping companies run selected AI workloads on smartphones and laptops, instead of sending every request to large models hosted in data centres. Google’s Gemini Nano, for instance, is designed to run directly on Android devices through its AICore system. It can support tasks such as summarisation and smart replies without sending every prompt to the cloud. Apple has made its on-device foundation model available to developers through its Foundation Models framework, while Microsoft’s Phi Silica is designed to run locally on Copilot+ PCs. For AI application companies, another approach is to reduce the amount of computing required for every interaction.
