bangla_paragraph2: এই মাসের ৫ তারিখে, কিন্তু এখনও তা করতে হয়নি, বিষয়টি সম্পর্কে পরিচিত দুইজন ব্যক্তি নাম প্রকাশ না করার শর্তে বলেছেন। প্রায় ৩ ট্রিলিয়ন পরামিতি - এর আকারের পরিমাপ - দিয়ে ডিজাইন করা মডেলটি আংশিকভাবে নিষ্কাশনের বিরুদ্ধে ক্রমবর্ধমান কার্যকর সুরক্ষার কারণে আটকে রয়েছে, এক ব্যক্তি বলেছেন। Z.AI আশা করেছিল যে বছরের শেষের দিকে প্রশিক্ষণ শেষ করে মডেল প্রকাশ করবে, কিন্তু মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের নতুন কম্পিউটিং বিধিনিষেধগুলি 2027 সালের প্রথম প্রান্তিকে বা তার পরেও তার প্রবর্তনকে ঠেলে দিতে পারে, ব্যক্তিটি বলেছে। Z।AI অবিলম্বে তা করেনি
bangla_paragraph3: এআই বলছে যে একটি নতুন নকশা এটিকে ২ ট্রিলিয়ন থেকে ৩ ট্রিলিয়ান পরামিতি সহ মডেলগুলির পারফরম্যান্সের সাথে মেলে। এন্থ্রপিক বলেছে যে সেপ্টেম্বরে এটি সন্দেহজনক নিষ্কাশন প্রচারের সাথে যুক্ত ক্লাউড মডেলের সাথে প্রায় ২০০ মিলিয়ন বিনিময় পর্যবেক্ষণ করেছে, এগুলি আলিবাবা, মুনশট এবং জেডএআই সহ চীনা বিকাশকারীদের কাছে দায়ী করেছে। ওপেনএআই মুনসটের সাথে যুক্ত ব্যক্তিদের বিরুদ্ধে অনুরূপ অভিযোগ করেছে। এথ্রপিক্স অনুমোদিত নিষ্কাষণ সনাক্ত এবং ব্লক করার জন্য এটি যে ব্যবস্থাগুলি ব্যবহার করে তা বর্ণনা করেছে, যখন
bangla_paragraph4: মুনশট ২০২৫ সালের জুলাইয়ে কিমি কে২, জানুয়ারিতে কে২.৫ এবং জুলাইয়ে কে৩ প্রকাশ করেছে। মুনসট ইউরোপে কম্পিউটিং শক্তি ভাড়া নেওয়ার প্রচেষ্টা জোরদার করেছে, বিষয়টি সম্পর্কে পরিচিত একজন পৃথক ব্যক্তি বলেছেন, একটি পূর্ববর্তী সিএনবিসি রিপোর্ট নিশ্চিত করে। এটি প্রশিক্ষণের জন্য তাদের প্রসেসর ব্যবহারের বিষয়ে চীনা চিপ নির্মাতাদের কাছে যাওয়ার পরিকল্পনা করেছে, ব্যক্তি যোগ করেছেন। নিষ্কাশনের বিরুদ্ধে সুরক্ষা মুনশাটের বিকাশকেও ধীর করেছে,
bangla_paragraph5: এনভিডিয়ার প্রযুক্তিতে চীনের প্রবেশের বিষয়ে উদ্বেগ প্রকাশের কারণে তার ব্যবসায়িক লেনদেনের উপর নজর রাখা হয়েছে।এই নিয়মটি মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের বাইরে ডেটা সেন্টারে কম্পিউটিং ব্যবস্থাগুলিকে প্রায় 750 টি এনভিডিয়া এইচ 100 চিপের সমান একটি সীমা অতিক্রম করে।এই নীতিতে 2022 সাল থেকে চীনে চালানের জন্য মার্কিন রপ্তানি লাইসেন্সের প্রয়োজন।এই বিধি কার্যকর হওয়ার আগে ইতিমধ্যে কভার্ড কম্পিউটিং পরিষেবা সরবরাহকারী অপারেটরদের লাইসেন্সিং পাওয়ার জন্য 90 দিন সময় রয়েছে।এটি অগ্রিম চালানের লাইসেন্সিংয়ের প্রয়োজনীয়তাও প্রবর্তন করে।

title: Samsung brings Galaxy Watch 9's health features to Galaxy Watch 8: Check all new One UI 9 additions
title_bn: স্যামসাং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ ৮-এ গ্যাল্যাক্সি ঘড়ি ৯-এর স্বাস্থ্য বৈশিষ্ট্য নিয়ে আসেঃ নতুন ওয়ান ইউআই ৯-এ যোগ করা সমস্ত বৈশিষ্ট্য দেখুন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Samsung is rolling out the One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic, adding Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load and upgraded Sleep Apnea monitoring. The update also brings personalised Sleep Coaching, improved fitnes
paragraph1: Samsung is rolling out the One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic, adding Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load and upgraded Sleep Apnea monitoring. The update also brings personalised Sleep Coaching, improved fitness tracking and new navigation features.Samsung is rolling out the One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Watch 8 Classic.Samsung has started rolling out its One UI 9 Watch update for the Galaxy Watch 8 and Galaxy Watch 8 Classic, bringing several new health and fitness features to the smartwatches. The update has been rolling out since mid-November and adds functionality seen on the Galaxy Watch 9 series and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2. The update includes Heart Health Score, Vitals, Daily Cardio Load and Fitness Index, which are made possible with the introduction of Wear OS 7. Samsung announced the rollout through a blog post on Wednesday, 25 November.
paragraph2: These new features are available via the Samsung Health application and Samsung Health Monitor, but some may require app updates. Availability is subject to country, watch model and carrier. Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 gets new heart health and fitness features Heart Health Score gives users an overall idea of their heart health by combining indicators such as sleep and physical activity. It also enables users to track their scores over time.Samsung is also introducing Vitals, which tracks five health indicators during sleep: heart rate, heart rate variability, respiratory rate, skin temperature and blood oxygen levels. The feature sets a baseline and informs the user if significant changes are detected. However, users must collect at least seven nights of sleep data before accessing these insights.
paragraph3: Daily cardio load is another addition to the update, which is a calculation of the load placed on the heart by physical activity and daily living. Fitness Index, on the other hand, combines multiple fitness metrics to provide users with an overview of physical fitness and activity recommendations tailored to their goals.Sleep coaching and sleep apnoea monitoring get upgradesSamsung has also improved its Sleep Coaching feature by providing more personalized recommendations based on users' sleep patterns and goals. It can start guiding users with three days of sleep data collected over 14 days. Users get a sleep routine checklist and suggestions to improve their sleep.The other big addition is the improved sleep apnoea monitoring system. The feature is available in the Samsung Health Monitor app, which uses an AI-based algorithm to detect breathing disruptions while sleeping.
paragraph4: It classifies the results into three categories: minimal, occasional and frequent. Users require at least two nights of sleep data within 10 days to get results.According to Samsung, the feature received US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) clearance in July and approval from South Korea’s Ministry of Food and Drug Safety in October.Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 update brings new navigation featuresOne UI 9 Watch adds a Portrait Watch Face that automatically arranges the clock around the people in selected photos. Samsung has also improved the Compass app, allowing users to save important locations as waypoints.Users can now replay a track they have recorded and return to the starting point with the new Track Back feature.(With agency inputs)About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing.
paragraph5: She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.
bangla_paragraph1: স্যামসাং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ ৮ এবং ওয়াচ৮ ক্লাসিকের জন্য ওয়ান ইউআই ৯ ওয়াচ আপডেট চালু করছে, এতে হার্ট হেলথ স্কোর, ভিটালস, দৈনিক কার্ডিও লোড এবং আপগ্রেড করা স্লিপ অ্যাপনিয়া মনিটরিং যুক্ত করা হয়েছে। আপডেটে ব্যক্তিগতকৃত স্লিপের কোচিং, উন্নত ফিটনেস ট্র্যাকিং এবং নতুন নেভিগেশন বৈশিষ্ট্যও রয়েছে। স্যামসুং গালাক্সী ওয়াচ ८ এবং ওয়াজ ৮ ক্লাসিকার জন্য ওয়াইউআই ৯ওয়াচ আপডেইট চালু করেছে। সামসুং তার ওয়ান UI ৯ ওয়াচের আপডেটের জন্য গ্যাল্যাক্সিওয়াচ ৮ ও গ্যালাকি ওয়াচ ୮ ক্লাসিক্স চালু করতে শুরু করেছে, যা s নিয়ে এসেছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই নতুন বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি স্যামসাং হেলথ অ্যাপ্লিকেশন এবং স্যামসুং হেল্থ মনিটরের মাধ্যমে উপলব্ধ, তবে কিছু অ্যাপ্লিকেশনের আপডেটের প্রয়োজন হতে পারে। উপলভ্যতা দেশ, ঘড়ি মডেল এবং ক্যারিয়ারের সাপেক্ষে। স্যামসং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ 8 নতুন হার্ট স্বাস্থ্য এবং ফিটনেস বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি পায়। হার্ট হেলথ স্কোর ব্যবহারকারীদের ঘুম এবং শারীরিক ক্রিয়াকলাপের মতো সূচকগুলির সংমিশ্রণে তাদের হৃদয়ের স্বাস্থ্যের সামগ্রিক ধারণা দেয়। এটি ব্যবহারকারীদের সময়ের সাথে সাথে তাদের স্কোরগুলি ট্র্যাক করতে সক্ষম করে। সামসাং ভিটালসও চালু করছে, যা পাঁচটি স্বাস্থ্য ট্র্যাক করে।
bangla_paragraph3: দৈনিক কার্ডিও লোড আপডেটের আরেকটি সংযোজন, যা শারীরিক ক্রিয়াকলাপ এবং দৈনন্দিন জীবনযাত্রার দ্বারা হৃদয়ে চাপের গণনা। ফিটনেস সূচক, অন্যদিকে, ব্যবহারকারীদের তাদের লক্ষ্যগুলির সাথে খাপ খাইয়ে নেওয়া শারীরীক ফিটनेस এবং ক্রিয়াকাণ্ডের সুপারিশগুলির একটি ওভারভিউ সরবরাহ করতে একাধিক ফিটনেট মেট্রিক্সকে একত্রিত করে। ঘুম প্রশিক্ষণ এবং ঘুমের অ্যাপোনিয়া পর্যবেক্ষণ আপগ্রেড পান। স্যামসুং ব্যবহারকারীদের ঘুমের উপর ভিত্তি করে আরও ব্যক্তিগতকৃত সুপারির মাধ্যমে তার ঘুম প্রশিক্ষণের বৈশিষ্ট্যটি উন্নত করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এটি ফলাফলগুলিকে তিনটি বিভাগে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ করেঃ ন্যূনতম, মাঝে মাঝে এবং ঘন ঘন। ব্যবহারকারীদের ফলাফল পেতে 10 দিনের মধ্যে কমপক্ষে দুই রাতের ঘুমের ডেটা প্রয়োজন। স্যামসাংয়ের মতে, বৈশিষ্ট্যটি জুলাইয়ে মার্কিন খাদ্য ও ওষুধ প্রশাসন (এফডিএ) থেকে ছাড়পত্র এবং অক্টোবরে দক্ষিণ কোরিয়ার খাদ্য ও ড্রাগ সুরক্ষা মন্ত্রকের অনুমোদন পেয়েছে। সামসাং গ্যালাক্সি ওয়াচ 8 আপডেট নতুন নেভিগেশন বৈশিষ্ট্য নিয়ে আসে।

title: Data from Chinese AI firm MiniMax accessed by unidentified parties, researcher says
title_bn: চীনা এআই ফার্ম মিনিম্যাক্সের তথ্য অজ্ঞাত ব্যক্তিদের দ্বারা অ্যাক্সেস করা হয়েছে, গবেষক বলেছেন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: AI-CHINA/MINIMAX (EXCLUSIVE, PIX):EXCLUSIVE-Data from Chinese AI firm MiniMax accessed by unidentified parties, researcher says
paragraph1: * Researcher identifies MiniMax in previously anonymous AI data-security investigation* Private links opened days or weeks later; attempts made to retrieve software code* Atlas Cloud warns customers to treat sensitive information sent to MiniMax as exposedBy Wen-Yee Lee and Fanny PotkinTAIPEI/SINGAPORE, Nov 26 (Reuters) - Confidential data submitted to Chinese AI startup MiniMax was accessed by unidentified parties, a cybersecurity researcher told Reuters, even after users requested that their data not be stored or retained.HD Moore, chief research officer at US cybersecurity firm Dragos, identified MiniMax as the Chinese AI developer that was referred to in the firm's earlier investigation into AI data security. The investigation, detailed in a November 19 blog post that did not name MiniMax, found that private web links embedded in requests that were submitted to AI services were subsequently accessed by unauthorized parties.Moore said one secret link sent to MiniMax appeared in a chat channel on Feishu, a workplace messaging platform developed by China's ByteDance, weeks later and was opened by devices in Beijing and Shanghai.Researchers also detected unusual internet activity from the Moscow region involving links submitted to MiniMax, although the evidence did not establish that the links were opened from Russia.Dragos' public identification of MiniMax as the Chinese AI startup that had data submitted to it that was accessed by unidentified parties is being reported here for the first time, as are the findings involving Russia.
paragraph2: MiniMax, which listed its shares in Hong Kong earlier this year, develops multimodal AI models - which can process multiple types of data - and consumer applications.Atlas Cloud, a US-based AI service provider that offers access to MiniMax's models, was among the companies affected by the data exposure. A spokesperson said it chose to use MiniMax’s data centres in Singapore to avoid having customer data processed in China, but information submitted through its platform was potentially exposed after reaching MiniMax.Dragos' findings raise questions about the security of confidential software, financial records and customer information as Chinese AI models attract users from around the world with lower prices and increasingly powerful capabilities.Chinese models were the three most widely used on AI platform OpenRouter in October, measured by the amount of text processed, as Washington considers requiring American companies to disclose their use of Chinese AI.In a statement on Tuesday, MiniMax said its security system had collected and stored web links contained in messages sent to its AI models through other service providers.
paragraph3: The system automatically opened some of those links to check for potential security threats.MiniMax said it did not retain full conversations and had deleted the stored addresses. The firm said the activity had stopped and it had found no evidence, in the requests it examined, that customer conversations or AI responses had been disclosed to third parties.In response, Atlas Cloud said on Tuesday that MiniMax's explanation was consistent with its findings that the links embedded in user prompts were accessed after those prompts were forwarded to MiniMax, rather than on Atlas Cloud's own systems.Atlas Cloud said it stopped forwarding requests to MiniMax and warned customers who used its M3, M2.7 or M3.
paragraph4: 1 Flash models to treat any secrets submitted as potentially exposed.AI platform OpenRouter said it removed three providers, tightened its data privacy requirements and notified all potentially affected customers. It found no evidence that its systems had been breached.PRIVATE LINKS ACCESSEDDragos sent nearly 2 million requests containing secret web links and test login details to AI providers between July and November, then monitored whether anyone subsequently tried to access them.Moore said links sent through different providers were repeatedly opened two to three days later from an internet connection in Singapore, including when customers requested that their information not be stored.The pattern appeared only when requests were forwarded to MiniMax's cloud, not when other companies ran its models independently, Moore said.
paragraph5: Dragos researchers also detected attempts to download private collections of software code that were referenced in MiniMax requests. Moore said researchers observed this new activity after the scraping of secret links appeared to stop on October 22. It was unclear who initiated the attempts or whether any code was obtained.MiniMax did not address the attempted software downloads or the Feishu incident in its public statement.

bangla_paragraph2: মিনিম্যাক্স, যা এই বছরের শুরুর দিকে হংকংয়ে তার শেয়ার তালিকাভুক্ত করেছিল, মাল্টিমোডাল এআই মডেলগুলি বিকাশ করে - যা একাধিক ধরণের ডেটা প্রক্রিয়া করতে পারে - এবং ভোক্তা অ্যাপ্লিকেশন। মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্র ভিত্তিক এআই পরিষেবা সরবরাহকারী অ্যাটলাস ক্লাউড, যা মিনিমাক্সের মডেলগুলিতে অ্যাক্সেস সরবরাহ করে, ডেটা এক্সপোজারে ক্ষতিগ্রস্থ সংস্থাগুলির মধ্যে ছিল। একজন মুখপাত্র বলেছেন যে এটি চীনে গ্রাহকের ডেটা প্রক্রিয়াকরণ এড়াতে সিঙ্গাপুরে মিনিম্যাক্সের ডেটা সেন্টারগুলি ব্যবহার করতে বেছে নিয়েছে, তবে এর প্ল্যাটফর্মের মাধ্যমে জমা দেওয়া তথ্য সম্ভাব্যভাবে প্রকাশিত হয়েছিল।
bangla_paragraph3: সিস্টেমটি সম্ভাব্য সুরক্ষা হুমকিগুলি পরীক্ষা করার জন্য স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে সেই লিঙ্কগুলির কয়েকটি খুলেছিল। মিনিম্যাক্স বলেছিল যে এটি সম্পূর্ণ কথোপকথনগুলি সংরক্ষণ করেনি এবং সংরক্ষিত ঠিকানাগুলি মুছে ফেলেছে। সংস্থাটি বলেছিল, ক্রিয়াকলাপটি বন্ধ হয়ে গেছে এবং এটি যাচাই করা অনুরোধগুলিতে এটি কোনও প্রমাণ খুঁজে পায়নি যে গ্রাহকের কথোপकথন বা এআই প্রতিক্রিয়া তৃতীয় পক্ষের কাছে প্রকাশ করা হয়েছিল। এর জবাবে, আটলাস ক্লাউড মঙ্গলবার বলেছিল कि মিনিমাক্সের ব্যাখ্যা তার ফলাফলের সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ যে ব্যবহারকারীর অনুরোধে এমবেড করা লিঙ্কগুলি w

title: 1Password confirms hackers stole customer data, but not their passwords
title_bn: 1 পাসওয়ার্ড নিশ্চিত করেছে হ্যাকাররা গ্রাহকের তথ্য চুরি করেছে, কিন্তু তাদের পাসওয়র্ড নয়
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Watch out for unexpected recovery emails and invitations.
paragraph1: 1PasswordAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR 1Password has confirmed a security breach that exposed some customers’ personal information, including names and email addresses. The company says no customer passwords were exposed and that users don’t need to change their account or saved passwords. 1Password recommends watching out for unexpected account recovery emails and invitations following the breach. Trust is everything when you’re in the business of keeping people’s passwords safe.
paragraph2: It’s a responsibility that has only grown for 1Password in recent months, with the company enabling Claude and, more recently, other AI agents to sign into websites without exposing users’ credentials. That trust is now being put to the test after 1Password confirmed a security breach that exposed some customer information, although it maintains that users’ passwords are safe.In a blog post published on November 25, 1Password revealed that it began investigating the breach on November 19 after detecting suspicious activity involving an employee’s corporate GitHub account. The attacker gained access to the company’s source code and compromised backend services, obtaining customer names, email addresses, account identifiers, and other account information.
paragraph3: However, 1Password maintains that neither customer vaults nor the encryption keys protecting them were compromised. The company doesn’t store your account password or Secret Key, so you don’t need to change your 1Password password or any passwords saved in your vault. The company says it has secured the affected systems, changed potentially exposed internal credentials, and strengthened its account recovery and invitation verification process. It hasn’t disclosed how many customers were affected.
paragraph4: This isn’t 1Password’s first security scare. In October 2023, the company disclosed an incident linked to a breach at Okta, although no customer data was accessed at the time. Rival LastPass suffered a more serious breach in 2022, with hackers eventually obtaining copies of customer password vaults. As recently as June 2026, LastPass suffered another data breach that exposed customers’ personal information but left their saved passwords untouched.
paragraph5: For now, 1Password users should be particularly wary of unexpected account recovery emails and invitations. Hackers could use the stolen information to make phishing attempts more convincing. So if the incident makes you uncomfortable sticking with 1Password, Android has a safer way to move passwords and passkeys between password managers without exporting your entire vault in plain text.

author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple will open its first Hyderabad retail store, Apple Kukatpally, on December 10 at Lake Shore-Y Junction Mall, taking its India store count to seven. Customers will get access to Apple's latest products, expert support and free Today at Apple crea
paragraph1: Apple will open its first Hyderabad retail store, Apple Kukatpally, on December 10 at Lake Shore-Y Junction Mall, taking its India store count to seven. Customers will get access to Apple's latest products, expert support and free Today at Apple creative sessions.Apple will open its first Hyderabad retail store.Apple is set to open its first official retail store in Hyderabad on December 10, expanding its physical retail presence in India to seven outlets. The new store will be named Apple Kukatpally, set up at Lake Shore-Y Junction mall in Telangana, and will open to customers at 5 PM IST. The launch is part of Apple's recent efforts to strengthen its retail footprint in one of the nation's key technology and business hubs, according to Apple Newsroom and Apple's official India retail website.
paragraph2: The company announced the opening on November 26, revealing the store's barricade design ahead of its launch. The design is inspired by the Apple logo, with its colour palette drawn from the colours of Hyderabad, the 'City of Pearls'. The design honours the city's cultural heritage and its history with pearls, says Apple.Apple Kukatpally store: Products and services customers can expectThe new outlet will also provide an opportunity for customers to discover Apple's lineup of devices, including the latest iPhone models, MacBook Pro, Apple Watch, AirPods, and HomePod. They will also be able to access Apple's in-store support services via Specialists, Creatives, Geniuses and dedicated Business teams.Apple will also be hosting free ‘Today at Apple' events daily at its Hyderabad store.
paragraph3: The topics will include Photography, Video Making, Drawing and Starting with Apple Devices. These workshops are for customers to help them understand how to use their iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.Apple has also shared some exclusive Apple Kukatpally wallpapers and stickers ahead of the launch. The company has also launched a special Apple Music playlist featuring local sounds and culture of Hyderabad. They can be found on Apple's official retail website.Apple stores in India: Full listWith the Apple Kukatpally store, the company's official retail network in India will increase to seven stores.
paragraph4: Its existing outlets include:Mumbai: Apple BKC and Apple BorivaliDelhi NCR: Apple Saket and Apple NoidaBengaluru: Apple HebbalPune: Apple Koregaon ParkHyderabad: Apple Kukatpally (opening December 10)Hyderabad is already a key city for Apple's operations in India, as the city has the Research, Development and Retail Customer Care businesses. The store's opening is expected to further improve its connection with its customers in the city.It's also possible to buy Apple products online via the company's online store or via the Apple Store app or Shop with a Specialist services, which supply personalised help through calls and chats.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. title: Uber Appoints Former Zomato Food Delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan As India President
title_bn: উবার ভারতের প্রেসিডেন্ট হিসেবে জোমাতোর সাবেক ফুড ডেলিভারি প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা রাকেশ রঞ্জনকে নিয়োগ করেছে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Uber has appointed former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as its president for India and South Asia, as the…
paragraph1: SUMMARYUber has appointed former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as president of India and South Asia, effective January 4, 2027. The appointment comes as India remains Uber’s third-largest market globally by trips and a key contributor to its growth ambitions. Ranjan spent eight years at Zomato and joins Uber from Allen Online, where he is the current CEO. Uber has appointed former Zomato food delivery CEO Rakesh Ranjan as its president for India and South Asia, as the ride-hailing platform looks to strengthen its presence in one of its largest global markets. Ranjan will assume the role on January 4, 2027, and report to Dom Taylor, Uber’s regional general manager for Asia Pacific.
paragraph2: He will join Uber from edtech platform Allen Online, where he is currently the CEO. Prior to that, Ranjan spent eight years at Zomato, joining the foodtech company in 2017. During his stint, the ISB alumnus held leadership positions across Zomato Gold and sales before taking charge as CEO of its B2B offering Hyperpure, and eventually the food ordering and delivery business. The appointment follows a search process spanning more than three months, according to Uber. Former president Prabhjet Singh, who held the post for 11 years, left Uber India in July to join OpenAI as its India MD.
paragraph3: Commenting on the appointment, Taylor said Ranjan’s experience in running large consumer businesses in India and his understanding of the market made him a suitable fit to lead the company’s next phase of growth in the region. Uber’s India Growth Ambitions India is Uber’s third-largest market globally by trips, behind the US and Brazil, and its second-largest market by number of earners. The company operates in more than 225 cities in India, with over two million monthly active drivers earning through its platform. India is also home to Uber’s largest technology centres outside the US, located in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, the company said. It is also setting up its first data centre in India in partnership with the Adani Group.
paragraph4: Uber entered India in 2013 and has since expanded its mobility offerings beyond cabs to include bikes, autos and metro services. Ranjan’s appointment comes as Uber looks to build on this scale by improving ride reliability, expanding value-oriented mobility options, and creating better earning opportunities for drivers. In a statement, Ranjan said his priorities would include improving everyday customer experiences through dependable rides, offering value across different journeys and creating better earning opportunities for drivers. India is expected to contribute a significant share of Uber’s global growth, the company said. Earlier this year, Uber infused ₹2,921 Cr into its India arm, as competition intensified in the country’s ride-hailing market, especially from Rapido, which is currently its biggest competitor.
paragraph5: Uber also undertook internal restructuring earlier this year, which saw the company lay off around 200-250 employees in India in September as part of a global layoff exercise that culled 3,300 roles across functions. The layoffs, which impacted both individual contributors and managers, came barely six months after Uber cut around 80 jobs in the country. Despite healthy demand, Uber has been facing issues at multiple fronts in emerging markets like India and Brazil, including a mismatch in driver supply and elevated fuel prices. Since these are price sensitive markets, Uber is rejigging driver and rider incentives to retain supply, the company said during its Q4 2026 earnings call this month.

title: Nothing Ear (note) design revealed ahead of 8 December launch: AI recording, transcription and TALK buttons confirmed

author: TechPulse
excerpt: Nothing has revealed the design of its Ear (note) AI earbuds ahead of the 8 December launch, showing a metallic charging case with dedicated TALK and RECORD buttons. The earbuds are expected to support AI-powered call recording, meeting transcription
paragraph1: Nothing has revealed the design of its Ear (note) AI earbuds ahead of the 8 December launch, showing a metallic charging case with dedicated TALK and RECORD buttons. The earbuds are expected to support AI-powered call recording, meeting transcription, summaries and Hi-Res Audio.Nothing has revealed the design of its Ear (note) AI earbuds.Nothing has revealed the design of its upcoming Ear (note) earbuds ahead of their 8 December launch. On 26 November, the tech start-up released a “teaser” video on X, featuring a pair of transparent headsets and a metallic charging case with separate ‘TALK' and ‘RECORD' buttons. The device is expected to be Nothing's first AI-powered hardware offering, featuring wireless audio, voice recording, transcription and AI assistance.The new earbuds will be able to capture conversations, such as phone calls and face-to-face meetings, and transform them into valuable insights using AI. Nothing has also confirmed Hi-Res Audio support and states the Ear (note) will provide its highest level of in-ear sound yet.
paragraph2: The company hasn't revealed the price or full details of the variant yet.Watch videoNothing Ear (note) design and features revealed The teaser reveals that the new charging case is square and features two transparent panels that let you peek at the earbuds inside– which are metallic. There are dedicated TALK and RECORD buttons, an LED indicator and a USB Type-C charging port. There are also three more white LED lights visible, used to indicate the remaining battery level.The earbuds feature Nothing's signature transparent design and white stems that are marked with 'ear (note)'. The teaser also gives an up-close view of the internal driver assembly. There are two circular holes in the rear of the case, seemingly for microphones.Nothing Ear (note) AI recording and transcription featuresNothing CEO Carl Pei previously discussed the device's capabilities in an interview with Bloomberg.
paragraph3: Pei said users will be able to start recordings with a dedicated button. The earbuds will likely be used for phone calls, and the built-in microphones in the charging case will record face-to-face conversations and conferences.The app could produce transcripts and summaries so that users can go back and review key conversations. The device will also support numerous AI agents via voice control, along with Nothing's voice assistant.Pei said that the product is the first step to introducing a hardware context layer for AI. It's about having AI agents use recorded conversations and take actions like drafting documents, drafting emails and assigning work.Nothing Ear (note) launch date, availability and expected priceRecording conversations raises questions about user privacy. The company reportedly met with law firms and had begun privacy certifications for the device.
paragraph4: The company has also formed a data and security team in London to tackle these issues.The Ear (note) will officially launch on 8 December. The company has yet to confirm its pricing, availability and full specifications.The launch follows a flurry of efforts by technology firms to develop new AI-powered devices. Meta is reportedly developing its Muse Charm AI device, while OpenAI is also developing a smart speaker along with former Apple design chief Jony Ive. title: Green Aero Raises $14 Mn To Build Jet Engines, Combat Drones
title_bn: গ্রিন এয়ারো জেট ইঞ্জিন, যুদ্ধবিমান তৈরির জন্য ১৪ মিলিয়ন ডলার সংগ্রহ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Deeptech startup Green Aero has raised $14 Mn (₹129.2 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by Crane Ventures,…
paragraph1: SUMMARYGreen Aero has raised $14 Mn (₹129.2 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by Crane Ventures Green Aero is now looking to develop engines in the four-kilonewton-plus category over the next three years, Kundu told Inc42. Founded in 2023 by Prithwish Kundu, Green Aero is developing jet propulsion systems, avionics and airframes for high-speed drones Deeptech startup Green Aero has raised $14 Mn (₹129.2 Cr) in a Series A funding round led by Crane Ventures, as it looks to scale indigenous jet engine development and build autonomous combat aircraft for India and global markets. The round also saw participation from 3one4 Capital, Antler Elevate, and existing investors pi Ventures, Antler India, and Rebalance. Founded in 2023 by Prithwish Kundu, Green Aero is developing jet propulsion systems, avionics and airframes for high-speed drones and autonomous combat aircraft.
paragraph2: It will deploy the capital over the next 12-18 months to expand its engine testing infrastructure, hire engineers, develop larger-thrust engines and accelerate flight qualification of its transonic and supersonic drone platforms. The startup is also looking to commercialise its existing engines, having received early interest from domestic and international buyers, Kundu told Inc42. The startup is building a vertically integrated aerospace manufacturing stack, bringing jet engines, avionics and airframe development under one roof. The company operates 87,000 sq ft R&D, assembly and testing facility in Bengaluru. Kundu told Inc42 that the startup has completed more than 100 ground-fire tests and is now moving towards flight testing. The startup expects its flight-testing programme to continue over the next year, following which its larger-thrust engines and transonic drone platforms could move towards commercial deployment.
paragraph3: “The startup currently generates revenue through the supply of small engines, while larger engine categories are undergoing further testing,” Kundu added. Green Aero has also developed its Blue Dragon engine core, which it claims is the first globally to demonstrate air-blast atomisers in the sub-kilonewton engine category. These atomisers are a form of fuel-injection technology generally used in larger jet engines. The startup said its engines can operate on diesel as well as jet fuel, allowing them to cater to different applications across military drones and aerospace platforms. Green Aero is now looking to develop engines in the four-kilonewton-plus category over the next three years, Kundu told Inc42. These larger engines are expected to power aircraft and drones capable of operating in the supersonic regime.
paragraph4: The startup is developing transonic drones powered by its existing sub-kilonewton engines, while its longer-term focus is on Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCAs), autonomous aircraft designed to operate alongside manned fighter jets or independently. Kundu said the company is betting on the evolution of drone warfare towards faster, jet-powered and autonomous systems. The fundraise comes amid growing investor interest in India’s propulsion technology ecosystem, spanning missile engines, aircraft propulsion and satellite systems. D-Propulse, which is developing rotating detonation engines for high-speed drones and missiles, raised ₹25 Cr from IAN Alpha Fund earlier this year and is working towards flight-ready propulsion systems. The startup has also demonstrated a 5 kN air-breathing rotating detonation engine and plans flight tests in 2027. Meanwhile, Bellatrix Aerospace recently secured a multi-year contract from GalaxEye to supply propulsion systems for 30 satellites.
paragraph5: On the other hand, Manastu Space has raised ₹22 Cr in an ongoing funding round to develop satellite propulsion and debris-avoidance technology. While these startups are working across different propulsion applications, the growing funding and commercial contracts point to an emerging domestic ecosystem attempting to build critical aerospace hardware locally, reducing reliance on overseas suppliers.

title: Flipkart CEO Ousted, PhonePe Revives IPO & More
title_bn: ফ্লিপকার্টের প্রধান নির্বাহী কর্মকর্তা বরখাস্ত, ফোনপে পুনরায় আইপিও চালু করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Leadership Crisis At Flipkart Kalyan Krishnamurthy’s decade-long stint as Flipkart group CEO has ended abruptly. Parent Walmart has asked him…
paragraph1: Leadership Crisis At Flipkart Kalyan Krishnamurthy’s decade-long stint as Flipkart group CEO has ended abruptly. Parent Walmart has asked him to step down amid a widening kickback probe and frustration over delayed IPO timelines and steep losses. What Led To The Ouster? An internal investigation has revealed that Flipkart executives allegedly took kickbacks worth ₹150 Cr from sellers to boost visibility and compromise the quality of materials for the company’s private-label business. Notably, this is the third such probe at Flipkart in less than three years. A previous probe had led to the exit of CFO Sriram Venkataraman in March this year under similar scrutiny. With Krishnamurthy gone, chief product and technology officer Balaji Thiagarajan is now stepping in as interim head till the company finds a new CEO. The IPO Question: Governance lapses were only half the story. Walmart executives were also peeved with Flipkart for repeatedly missing IPO deadlines and piling up losses – ₹8,468 Cr in FY26. The US-based retail giant is also unhappy with Flipkart’s capital-heavy expansions into peripheral verticals (like food delivery and microdramas) and sluggish growth during its recent Big Billion Days sale. That said, Walmart has now brought in McKinsey to assess IPO readiness and mandated EBITDA breakeven by March 2027. A Leadership Vacuum: Krishnamurthy’s departure marks Flipkart’s most consequential leadership reset since Walmart’s 2018 acquisition. The rally in Indian equities and rising FPI inflows appear to have given PhonePe greater confidence to revive its IPO. This comes nearly a year after the decacorn filed its updated DRHP for an IPO, which then consisted solely of an OFS of 5.06 Cr shares. It later took a U-turn and deferred the issue, citing geopolitical uncertainty and volatility in global capital markets. 📈 PayU India Breaks Even Prosus-owned fintech company PayU India swung to the black and reported an adjusted EBITDA profit of $12 Mn in H1 FY27 compared to a loss of $1 Mn in the year-ago period. However, adjusted EBIT remained negative at $3 Mn. The bottom line improvements come despite a 3.3% YoY decline in its revenue to $384 Mn in the first half of FY27.
paragraph3: What helped offset the top line decline was growth in its lending business and transaction volumes. Available in four languages, the new service uses AI models, trained in Vedic astrology, to offer personalised insights. With its spiritual tech platform, Jio is taking on the likes of consumer startups such as Astrotalk, AstroSage, AppsForBharat and VAMA. These new-age platforms have raised millions of dollars to offer everything, from online Pujas to virtual Darshans. This comes as the stars of the Indian digital astrology market are on the rise. The space is projected to become a $2.3 Bn opportunity by 2032, driven by AI-powered features, affordable data, convenience and vernacular offerings. 🤖 What’s Sarvam Really Mining? Earlier last week, the AI unicorn came under fire for hosting Chinese LLMs on its new inference platform. But the criticism hasn’t deterred Sarvam. The AI giant is doubling down on homegrown AI models, voice AI, document intelligence and agents.
paragraph4: This is part of Sarvam’s broader full-stack bet, under which it wants to offer Indian enterprises everything needed to build and deploy AI. The point is not that Sarvam has the best model for every task, but that it can provide several layers under one roof. This multi-product bet of the AI unicorn has also begun finding user traction. Tata Capital and Mahindra Finance have already deployed its voice agents across multiple functions, while Sarvam’s sovereignty pitch is bringing more enterprises to its fold. 💼 SoftBank India’s Top Exec Quits Narendra Rathi is stepping down from his role as an investment director at SoftBank Investment Advisers. His stint at the Japanese tech giant will come to an end by the end of this year. Rathi now plans to launch a public markets fund that will focus on India’s AI build-out. The new fund will likely focus on industrial companies, including smaller listed firms, which could benefit from the growing number of data centres in India. The departure comes amid a top-level churn in the Indian VC ecosystem. Earlier this month, Anup Gupta announced that he was quitting Nexus Venture Partners. Fireside Ventures’ cofounder Vinay Singh also resigned from his post weeks ago. But the real challenge lies in getting these actives to the right layer of skin without losing potency. Permea is using pharma-inspired delivery systems to help these ingredients penetrate the skin more effectively.
paragraph5: A Differentiated Bet: Founded in 2025, Permea sells a range of skincare products, including cleansers, creams, serums and moisturisers. Its formulations use specialised encapsulation to protect active ingredients and help them travel deeper into the skin. The startup claims that its liposomal delivery can deliver up to 20X better penetration than non-encapsulated actives. Steady Market Traction: Permea, which currently only sells its products through its own website, claims to have already served 8,000 users so far. It now plans to expand to marketplaces like Nykaa and Purplle, while introducing more products to its range. The Road Ahead: The startup’s growth potential rests on whether its delivery technology can translate into visible, clinically meaningful results for consumers. Building trust will require robust efficacy data, consistent formulation quality and clear communication around what “better absorption” actually delivers. Nevertheless, the opportunity is significant: India’s skincare market is projected to become a $18.4 Bn opportunity by 2034. So, can Permea make actives more stable, targeted and effective? title: Vegapay Bags $10 Mn To Scale Credit Line On UPI Infrastructure
title_bn: ইউপিআই-র পরিকাঠামোর ওপর ঋণ দেওয়ার জন্য ১০ মিলিয়ন ডলার দেবে ভেগাপেই ব্যাগ
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Mumbai-based fintech startup Vegapay has raised $10 Mn (₹92.3 Cr) in a Series A funding round co-led by Vertex Ventures…
paragraph1: SUMMARYMumbai-based fintech startup Vegapay has raised $10 Mn (₹92.3 Cr) in a Series A funding round co-led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia and India and Prosus It will deploy the fresh capital to onboard more banks onto its credit line on UPI platform, introduce secured credit lines backed by fixed deposits, gold and mutual funds The funding round comprises both primary and secondary transactions, with over 40 employees getting an opportunity to sell a portion of their vested ESOPs Mumbai-based fintech startup Vegapay has raised $10 Mn (₹92.3 Cr) in a Series A funding round co-led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia and India and Prosus. The round also saw participation from existing investors Elevation Capital and Eximius Ventures.
paragraph2: The funding round comprises both primary and secondary transactions, with over 40 employees getting an opportunity to sell a portion of their vested employee stock ownership plans (ESOPs). It will deploy the fresh capital to onboard more banks onto its credit line on UPI platform, introduce secured credit lines backed by fixed deposits, gold and mutual funds, and expand its credit card, prepaid card and forex card programmes. It also plans to strengthen its engineering and risk teams. Founded in 2022 by Gaurav Mittal, Himanshu Agrawal and Puneet Sharma, Vegapay provides a technology platform that enables banks to launch and manage Credit Line on UPI (CLOU), credit card and other credit programmes.
paragraph3: Its platform allows banks to run multiple co-branded credit programmes, each with independent limits, pricing and rules. Banks can also deploy the technology on their own cloud infrastructure or on-premises. The startup claims to command a majority of India’s Credit Line on UPI market as of November 2026. Its platform is live with YES BANK, Unity Small Finance Bank, Suryoday Small Finance Bank and BOBCARD.
paragraph4: It also powers credit programmes for fintech and consumer-facing platforms, including Paytm, BharatPe, Kiwi UPI, Scapia and EbixCash World Money. Vegapay’s fundraise comes as Credit Line on UPI emerges as a new distribution channel for formal credit in India. The offering allows banks to provide customers with pre-sanctioned credit lines that can be used to make payments at UPI QR codes through existing payment applications, without requiring a separate credit card or app. While UPI has transformed India’s digital payments ecosystem, the integration of credit into the payment network could create another avenue for banks to distribute lending products.
paragraph5: Vegapay is positioning its platform as the underlying technology layer for banks looking to launch these products without building the entire infrastructure in-house. “UPI was India’s payments revolution. Credit Line on UPI is the UPI moment for credit, and banks should lead it,” said Gaurav Mittal, cofounder and CEO of Vegapay.

title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
title_bn: এফসিসি বলছে স্পেসএক্স মহাকাশে ডেটা সেন্টারের জন্য ১ মিলিয়ন স্যাটেলাইট স্থাপন করতে পারে। বিজ্ঞানীরা সংশয়ী।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
paragraph1: The Trump administration on Wednesday gave SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a long-lofty goal of Elon Musk’s rocket company, in a move that has raised both skepticism and alarm among some scientists.The U.S. Federal Communications Commission lauded its authorization as a historic first amid the artificial intelligence race. It said that SpaceX's one million “orbital compute modules” (forming a data center constellation called “Starmind”) would process massive amounts of data that would be used back on Earth — and bring humans closer to harnessing “the full power of the sun.”“America is leading the world into the era of super intelligence," FCC Chairman Brendan Carr, who was appointed by Republican President Donald Trump, said in a statement.
paragraph2: He added that Wednesday's move “opens a bold new frontier.”A lengthier authorization order published by the FCC noted that the company must deploy at least “one authorized space station” by 2033 — and then gradually add more and more through 2040. Musk welcomed the decision over social media.The world's richest man has long vowed to form vast, solar-powered data centers in space to help run AI tools on Earth. But scientists and industry experts have stressed enormous technical and financial obstacles, as well as a host of environmental concerns.Adam Becker, an astrophysicist and author, called the prospect of launching a million satellites into space to create data centers “a fantasy."
paragraph3: “It’s not going to happen,” he said Wednesday.Proponents of data centers in space argue that capturing the sun’s energy would ease pressure on power grids and cut demand for sprawling computing warehouses on Earth (and resources like water needed to cool them). Space seems to offer a solution because it is cold, but it is also a vacuum, trapping heat inside objects much like a thermos. Becker explained that there are “basic physical limits” to otherwise radiating that heat out — and sending lots of smaller satellites could potentially carry the necessary material combined, but it would be expensive and difficult.He and others also point to additional risks, such as atmospheric pollution through launches and reentries, as well as possible in-orbit collisions that could impact other essential satellites.“You could end up with a cascading set of space junk collisions,” said Becker, noting such crashes could create “a cloud of debris” in the low Earth orbit — where many weather and telecommunication satellites are also found.
paragraph4: In its ruling, the FCC maintained that SpaceX's proposed Starmind constellation operates consistently with its orbital debris rules. It also acknowledged that it had received a “substantial number” of public comments leading up to its authorization Wednesday, including petitions to deny SpaceX's request. But the regulator maintained that deploying the satellites “serves the public interest” — and said that it dismissed topics that it didn't have authority over, such as environmental concerns.The American Astronomical Society, satellite communication company Viasat and Amazon-owned Kuiper Systems were among those who called on the regulator to deny SpaceX's proposed data centers in space.In a statement Wednesday, the AAS said it was “disheartened and dismayed” by the FCC's decision. The organization said that SpaceX's proposed position of data centers in low Earth orbit would undermine decades of federal investment in astronomical facilities and “the ability of astronomers and the public to enjoy and study the night sky.
paragraph5: ”“The proposed constellation involves larger (and therefore brighter) and more numerous objects," AAS said, noting that “these satellites would therefore be visible as extremely bright objects for longer periods in the night sky.”Becker echoed that sentiment. “It also is pollution of the night sky to the naked eye,” he said.Viasat, Amazon, SpaceX and the FCC did not immediately respond to The Associated Press’ requests for further comment Wednesday.
bangla_paragraph1: ট্রাম্প প্রশাসন বুধবার স্পেসএক্সকে ১ মিলিয়ন উপগ্রহ স্থাপন করার জন্য সবুজ আলো দিয়েছে যা বলেছিল যে এটি মহাকাশে ডেটা সেন্টার তৈরি করবে, ইলন মাস্কের রকেট সংস্থার একটি দীর্ঘ উচ্চ লক্ষ্য, এমন একটি পদক্ষেপে যা কিছু বিজ্ঞানীদের মধ্যে সংশয় ও উদ্বেগ উভয়ই উত্থাপন করেছে। মার্কিন ফেডারেল যোগাযোগ কমিশন কৃত্রিম বুদ্ধিমত্তার দৌড়ে এটির অনুমোদনকে একটি historicতিহাসিক প্রথম হিসাবে প্রশংসা করেছে। এটি বলেছে যে স্পেস এক্সের এক মিলিয়ন অর্বিটাল কম্পিউটিং মডিউল (একটি ডেটা কেন্দ্র নক্ষত্রমণ্ডল গঠন করে যা  নামে পরিচিত)
bangla_paragraph2: তিনি যোগ করেছেন যে বুধবারের পদক্ষেপটি একটি সাহসী নতুন সীমানা খুলে দেয়। এফসিসি দ্বারা প্রকাশিত একটি দীর্ঘতর অনুমোদনের আদেশে উল্লেখ করা হয়েছে যে কোম্পানিকে কমপক্ষে একটি অনুমোদিত মহাকাশ স্টেশন  2033 সালের মধ্যে স্থাপন করতে হবে এবং তারপরে ধীরে ধীরে 2040 সালের মধ্যে আরও বেশি যোগ করতে হবে। মাস্ক সামাজিক যোগাযোগ মাধ্যমে সিদ্ধান্তকে স্বাগত জানিয়েছেন। বিশ্বের সবচেয়ে ধনী ব্যক্তি দীর্ঘদিন ধরে মহাকাশে বিশাল, সৌর-চালিত ডেটা সেন্টার তৈরির প্রতিশ্রুতি দিয়েছেন যাতে পৃথিবীতে এআই সরঞ্জাম চালাতে সহায়তা করতে পারে। তবে বিজ্ঞানী এবং শিল্প বিশেষজ্ঞরা বিশাল প্রযুক্তিগত এবং আর্থিক বাধা জোর দিয়েছেন।
bangla_paragraph3: এটা ঘটতে যাচ্ছে না, তিনি বুধবার বলেন। মহাকাশে ডেটা সেন্টারগুলির সমর্থকরা যুক্তি দেন যে সূর্যের শক্তি ক্যাপচার করা বিদ্যুৎ গ্রিডের উপর চাপ হ্রাস করবে এবং পৃথিবীতে বিস্তৃত কম্পিউটিং গুদামগুলির চাহিদা হ্রাস পাবে (এবং তাদের শীতল করার জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় জলের মতো সম্পদ) । মহাকাশ একটি সমাধান প্রস্তাব করে বলে মনে হচ্ছে কারণ এটি ঠান্ডা, তবে এটি একটি শূন্যতাও, থার্মোসের মতো বস্তুগুলির ভিতরে তাপ আটকে রাখে। বেকার ব্যাখ্যা করেছিলেন যে অন্যথায় তাপকে বিকিরণ করতে এবং প্রচুর পরিমাণে প্রেরণ করতে মূল শারীরিক সীমাবদ্ধতা রয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এফসিসি তার রায়ের মধ্যে বলেছিল যে স্পেসএক্সের প্রস্তাবিত স্টারমাইন্ড নক্ষত্রমণ্ডল তার কক্ষপথের ধ্বংসাবশেষের নিয়মের সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণভাবে কাজ করে। এটি স্বীকার করেছে যে বুধবার এর অনুমোদনের আগে এটি একটি  উল্লেখযোগ্য সংখ্যক পাবলিক মন্তব্য পেয়েছে, যার মধ্যে স্পেস এক্সের অনুরোধ প্রত্যাখ্যান করার আবেদন রয়েছে। তবে নিয়ন্ত্রক বলেছিল ଯେ উপগ্রহ স্থাপন  জনস্বার্থে   এবং বলেছিল এটি পরিবেশগত উদ্বেগগুলির মতো কর্তৃত্ব নেই এমন বিষয়গুলিকে প্রত্যাখাত করেছে।
bangla_paragraph5: প্রস্তাবিত নক্ষত্রমণ্ডলে বৃহত্তর (এবং তাই উজ্জ্বল) এবং আরও অনেকগুলি বস্তু জড়িত রয়েছে", এএএস বলেছে, উল্লেখ করে যে এই উপগ্রহগুলি রাতে আকাশে দীর্ঘ সময়ের জন্য অত্যন্ত উজ্জল বস্তু হিসাবে দৃশ্যমান হবে।বেকার এই অনুভূতিটি পুনরাবৃত্তি করেছেন। এটি খালি চোখে রাতের আকাশের দূষণও, তিনি বলেছিলেন।ভিয়াসাট, অ্যামাজন, স্পেসএক্স এবং এফসিসি বুধবার আরও মন্তব্যের জন্য অ্যাসোসিয়েটেড প্রেসের অনুরোধে অবিলম্বে সাড়া দেয়নি।

author: TechPulse
excerpt: A MacBook Air with a new look could launch in late 2027 or 2028, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman said in the latest episode of his Power On podcast. Apple plans to refresh the ‌MacBook Air‌ with M6 chips in early 2027 alongside the MacBook Neo 2, but that up
paragraph1: Wednesday November 25, 2026 3:30 pm PST by Juli CloverA MacBook Air with a new look could launch in late 2027 or 2028, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman said in the latest episode of his Power On podcast. Apple plans to refresh the ‌MacBook Air‌ with M6 chips in early 2027 alongside the MacBook Neo 2, but that update won't include a new design. A more extensive overhaul could follow later in 2027 or in 2028, and the ‌MacBook Air‌ could get an OLED display at that time. MacBook Air is Apple's most popular computer, and they need to keep it very fresh. And so my anticipation is 2027, 2028 is when we're going to get the big MacBook Air overhaul.
paragraph2: And I think OLED will be part of that conversation. Apple last overhauled the ‌MacBook Air‌'s design in 2022, eliminating the prior wedge shape for a more uniform MacBook Pro-style chassis. The machine adopted a brighter Liquid Retina display with a notch for the camera, and a MagSafe charging port. In 2023, Apple added a 15-inch model, but since then, we've only gotten minor updates. Apple just added ‌OLED‌ to the MacBook Pro with the launch of the 2026 PROLED models, so it's not clear whether the high-end display will trickle down to the ‌MacBook Air‌ that quickly.
paragraph3: In prior reports, Gurman has leaned more toward the 2028 timeline than late 2027. Pricing on the PROLED ‌MacBook Pro‌ starts at $2,899, while the ‌MacBook Air‌ is one of Apple's more affordable notebooks and starts at $1,299. Apple would likely need to offer a high-end ‌OLED‌ ‌MacBook Air‌ alongside ‌MacBook Air‌ models with an LCD display to keep the price gap intact. title: IT Secy Defends Sarvam’s Token Factory Over Chinese LLM Debate
title_bn: আইটি সেকশন চীনের এলএলএম বিতর্কের বিষয়ে সারভাম টোকেন কারখানার প্রতিরক্ষা করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Reacting to the ongoing controversy around Sarvam AI hosting Chinese AI models on its new inference service Token Factory, MeitY…
paragraph1: SUMMARYKrishnan said that it was Sarvam’s imperative to monetise its offering, adding that the startup’s work on development of the indigenous AI model is different from its inference platform Critics have been raising questions over Token Factory hosting Chinese models despite Sarvam positioning itself as a champion of sovereign Indian AI Pushing back against the criticism, the AI unicorn said that the service relies on privately procured GPUs, adding that Token Factory will create a new commercial opportunity for the company Reacting to the ongoing controversy around Sarvam AI hosting Chinese AI models on its new inference service Token Factory, MeitY secretary S Krishnan has reportedly said that offering overseas LLMs does not constitute a violation of the principles of the IndiaAI Mission. “I don’t think there is any contradiction between what they (Sarvam) are doing for the IndiaAI mission and working towards the frontier model which will come in years and what they are offering now is a service in the AI space,” said Krishnan as per Business Standard. Defending Sarvam’s Token Factory, the MeitY secretary said that it was the company’s imperative to monetise its offering, adding that Sarvam’s work on development of the indigenous AI model is different from its inference platform. “After all, AI companies also require a revenue model.
paragraph2: They need a model in which they can monetise revenues and many other such experiments have been tried,” he reportedly said. As per news agency PTI, Krishnan also said that the government now also plans to work on a scheme to support AI inference. This comes a week after Sarvam debuted the Token Factory. The new offering lets enterprises access Indian and global AI models through a single API while running workloads on GPUs in India.
paragraph3: Besides Sarvam’s own 105B model, the platform also offers access to overseas open-weight models from Google, DeepSeek, GLM and Kimi. Quickly after the launch, critics raised questions over Token Factory hosting Chinese models despite Sarvam positioning itself as a champion of sovereign Indian AI. Many also raised questions over whether reliance on foreign open-weight models dilutes Sarvam’s push for homegrown AI capability. Pushing back against criticism, the AI unicorn said that the offering relies strictly on privately procured GPUs and not state-sponsored subsidies.
paragraph4: It also said that Token Factory will create a new commercial opportunity for the company, reduce latency and trim India’s dependence on overseas token platforms. To prove that inference hosting has not diluted its core research mission, Sarvam subsequently also rolled out its upgraded Sarvam-105B-1711 model and a dictation API for English and 22 other Indian languages. Addressing reporters on Wednesday, Krishnan also said that the ministry has also gathered feedback from startups and entities regarding Sarvam’s services. “I think based on what Sarvam has told us, based on the experience that people have, we do not see any misuse of the support which the India AI mission has provided to Sarvam in the service that they are now offering,” Krishnan reportedly added.
paragraph5: Going forward, Krishnan added that the government also plans to support the startup’s work towards a trillion-parameter model.
bangla_paragraph1: সারভামকে তার অফার থেকে অর্থ উপার্জন করা জরুরি বলে মন্তব্য করে শ্রী কৃষ্ণন বলেন, স্বদেশী এআই মডেলের উন্নয়নে স্টার্টআপের কাজ তার অনুমান প্ল্যাটফর্মের থেকে আলাদা সমালোচকরা টোকেন ফ্যাক্টরিতে চীনা মডেল হোস্টিং নিয়ে প্রশ্ন তুলেছেন।
bangla_paragraph2: তিনি বলেন, "এটি একটি নতুন মডেল, যা তাদের আয়কে মুনাফা করতে পারে এবং এর মতো আরও অনেক পরীক্ষা-নিরীক্ষা করা হয়েছে। সংবাদ সংস্থা পিটিআই অনুসারে, কৃষ্ণন আরও বলেছিলেন যে সরকার এখন এআই অনুমানকে সমর্থন করার জন্য একটি প্রকল্পে কাজ করার পরিকল্পনা করছে। এটি সরভমের টোকেন কারখানার আত্মপ্রকাশের এক সপ্তাহ পরে এসেছে। নতুন অফারটি ভারতে জিপিইউতে ওয়ার্কলোড চালানোর সময় একক এপিআইয়ের মাধ্যমে ভারতীয় এবং বৈশ্বিক এআই মডেলগুলিতে অ্যাক্সেস করতে দেয়।

bangla_paragraph4: এটি আরও বলেছে যে টোকেন কারখানাটি সংস্থার জন্য একটি নতুন বাণিজ্যিক সুযোগ তৈরি করবে, বিলম্ব হ্রাস করবে এবং বিদেশী টোকেন প্ল্যাটফর্মের উপর ভারতের নির্ভরতা হ্রাস পাবে। প্রমাণ করার জন্য যে অনুমান হোস্টিং তার মূল গবেষণা মিশনকে পাতলা করেনি, সর্বম পরে তার আপগ্রেড করা সর্বম -১০৫ বি -১৭১১ মডেল এবং ইংরেজি এবং ২২ টি অন্যান্য ভারতীয় ভাষার জন্য ডিক্টেশন এপিআই চালু করেছে। বুধবার সাংবাদিকদের উদ্দেশে শ্রী কৃষ্ণন আরও বলেন যে মন্ত্রক স্টার্টআপ এবং সংস্থাগুলির কাছ থেকে প্রতিক্রিয়াও সংগ্রহ করেছে।

title: European spacecraft finds chaotic scene after asteroid deflection experiment
title_bn: ইউরোপীয় মহাকাশযানটি গ্রহাণু প্রতিধ্বনিত পরীক্ষার পর বিশৃঙ্খল দৃশ্য খুঁজে পায়
author: TechPulse
excerpt: "DART made a really, really large mess. However, we didn’t really know what kind of mess."
paragraph1: Hello again “DART made a really, really large mess. However, we didn’t really know what kind of mess.” This image from the Hera spacecraft's asteroid framing camera shows Didymos and its smaller companion Dimorphos, revealing the stadium-sized crater created by the impact of NASA's DART spacecraft in 2022. Credit: European Space Agency This image from the Hera spacecraft's asteroid framing camera shows Didymos and its smaller companion Dimorphos, revealing the stadium-sized crater created by the impact of NASA's DART spacecraft in 2022. Credit: European Space Agency Four years ago, NASA dispatched a small spacecraft on a suicide mission to show how humanity might deflect an asteroid on a collision course with Earth. The first-of-its-kind experiment worked beautifully as the solar-powered space probe slammed into asteroid Dimorphos, permanently altering its trajectory. Using telescopes, astronomers measured changes in the orbit of Dimorphos around a larger asteroid companion named Didymos in the aftermath of NASA’s Double Asteroid Redirection Test (DART) mission. The spacecraft released some 10 billion joules of energy as it impacted Dimorphos in September 2022 at more than 13,700 mph (6.14 kilometers per second), shortening the asteroid’s 12-hour orbit around Didymos by about 33 minutes, 25 times the most conservative expectation. But scientists could only learn so much from DART. The collision destroyed the spacecraft, as expected.
paragraph2: DART recorded images as it took aim on Dimorphos, but only faraway telescopes and a small CubeSat that briefly detected the impact flash could see what happened next. “We knew right away that the impact was successful, that DART made a really, really large mess,” said Sabina Raducan, a planetary scientist at the International Space Science Institute in Bern, Switzerland. “However, we didn’t really know what kind of mess. We were still missing pieces of the puzzle.” Artist’s illustration of the Hera spacecraft with its two deployable CubeSats, Juventas and Milani, in the vicinity of the Didymos binary asteroid system. Credit: ESA-Science Office Artist’s illustration of the Hera spacecraft with its two deployable CubeSats, Juventas and Milani, in the vicinity of the Didymos binary asteroid system. Credit: ESA-Science Office Following up The European Space Agency’s Hera spacecraft recently arrived in the vicinity of Didymos and Dimorphos after a two-year journey from a launch pad in Florida. On Wednesday, ESA released Hera’s first views of the scar left by DART on Dimorphos. The images show the car-sized impactor carved out a crater the size of a stadium, nearly as big as Dimorphos itself, a rugged chunk of extraterrestrial rock measuring about 500 feet (151 meters) across. Mission planners selected Didymos and Dimorphos for the deflection experiment because they are similar to many near-Earth asteroids, but there’s no risk of them striking our home planet. Scientists weren’t sure what Hera would find when it got to the double asteroid, currently orbiting the Sun about 120 million miles (193.
paragraph3: 5 million kilometers) from Earth. “I would say we had two kinds of predictions: either we made a crater, or we reshaped the asteroid,” said Patrick Michel, Hera’s principal investigator from Côte d’Azur Observatory in Nice, France. “In fact, we did both because the crater is so large that the shape has changed. Therefore, we are in a sort of a transition between just cratering and global transformation, and we are still not sure how this can happen.” Hera found Didymos, the larger of the two asteroids, spinning on its axis just as DART observed on final approach in 2022. Dimorphos is no longer so stable. “As Hera returned more images, it became clear that the DART impact has left Dimorphos tumbling wildly in its orbit,” says Michael Kueppers, ESA’s Hera mission scientist. The Hera spacecraft will fly closer to Didymos and Dimorphos over the next six months to obtain more detailed observations. Hera will release two small sub-satellites to attempt landings on Dimorphos and collect data on the asteroid’s composition, internal structure, and mass. Scientists will use this information to reconstruct the dynamics of DART’s impact four years ago and better understand how a future deflection mission might move an asteroid off a trajectory that actually threatens Earth. Near-Earth asteroids come in many shapes and sizes, with different densities and makeups, so knowledge of Dimorphos’s physical properties will anchor predictive computer models teaching scientists how best to deflect all types of asteroids.
paragraph4: “Once we understand, we have a breakthrough, which really solves planetary defense,” Michel said in an interview with Ars. This is a composite image combining 11 long-exposure images from Hera’s Hyperscout-H instrument, centered on the Didymos asteroid. The dot trails correspond to hundreds of boulders of differing sizes in motion around the Didymos-Dimorphos system. The two asteroids have been subtracted from the image for improved visualization of the boulders. These images were acquired on November 6 with an approximate distance of 29.9 kilometers (18.6 miles) from the asteroids. This is a composite image combining 11 long-exposure images from Hera’s Hyperscout-H instrument, centered on the Didymos asteroid. The dot trails correspond to hundreds of boulders of differing sizes in motion around the Didymos-Dimorphos system. The two asteroids have been subtracted from the image for improved visualization of the boulders. These images were acquired on November 6 with an approximate distance of 29.
paragraph5: 9 kilometers (18.6 miles) from the asteroids. What a mess In its initial reconnaissance this month, Hera spotted hundreds of boulders surrounding the double asteroid. This was not entirely unexpected. A picture taken by the Hubble Space Telescope shortly after DART’s impact showed a cloud of material streaming behind Didymos and Dimorphos, but scientists were astonished by the extent of the debris swarm in Hera’s first images. “As we approached Didymos and Dimorphos, we quickly realized the asteroids were not alone,” said Naomi Murdoch, planetary scientist at the Institut Supérieur de l’Aéronautique et de l’Espace in Toulouse, France. “In fact, they had a lot of company.” An image released by ESA on Wednesday combines 11 long exposure frames from Hera’s hyperspectral camera. Image processors on the ground digitally removed the relatively bright Didymos and Dimorphos to reveal a panoply of dimmer streaks and dots, each of which is a rock fragment ranging in size from a football to a washing machine, Murdoch said. “Hera came to visit two asteroids, and we found hundreds of companions,” Murdoch said. One obvious explanation for the boulders is they were thrown off Dimorphos when DART slammed into it.

title: 1Password Security Breach: What Was Accessed and What Wasn't
title_bn: পাসওয়ার্ড সুরক্ষা লঙ্ঘনঃ কী কী অ্যাক্সেস করা হয়েছিল এবং কী কী ছিল না

excerpt: Popular password management app 1Password today said it experienced a security breach earlier this month. 1Password says some customer names and email addresses were accessed, but no customer vault contents were compromised. On November 19, 1Password
paragraph1: Wednesday November 25, 2026 1:09 pm PST by Juli CloverPopular password management app 1Password today said it experienced a security breach earlier this month. 1Password says some customer names and email addresses were accessed, but no customer vault contents were compromised. On November 19, 1Password saw indications that an employee's GitHub account had been breached and began investigating. The company says the breached GitHub account was used to access source code and push malicious code to backend services, with the code downloading some customer data. Here's a list of what the hacker was able to get: Names and email addresses customers use to sign into 1Password Account and user identifiers, and account creation and last sign-in times Public keys Secure Remote Password protocol parameters (1Password says this can't be used for account access) Tokens in emailed links for invitations, provisioning, and account recovery Other non-secret account data related to 1Password's internal architecture, like version numeric identifiers and file numeric identifiers 1Password source code, which 1Password says does not include customer data or user secrets Access to 1Password's CI/CD system, which it says has infrastructure-related secrets for the service to work According to 1Password, there is no impact to its services, availability, or product security. Customer vaults and the items in them were not accessed, nor were the keys that protect vaults. The hacker did not have access to account recovery keys or 1Password apps and browser extensions.
paragraph2: 1Password vaults are encrypted and protected by keys on the user end, so content is not accessible to 1Password or anyone who hacks the 1Password servers. The biggest risk comes from the token breach. Tokens can be used for account recovery, but they only work when paired with an SSO sign-in or a six-digit code sent to a user's email address. Codes have now been changed from six numeric digits to 10 alphanumeric characters to make them more difficult to brute force. The affected GitHub account has been disabled, and the attacker's token was revoked. Internal credentials that may have been exposed have been revoked. Internal GitHub, CI/CD, and endpoint controls have been "tightened," with new detection methods for similar attacks.
paragraph3: The company found no internal evidence of user account takeovers or compromise using the exposed account provisioning tokens, and it has hired independent cybersecurity experts to validate its response. 1Password users who had a token accessed were notified, but it is unclear if 1Password has sent notices about the breach to all users. While the blog post is titled as "update on" a security incident, it does not seem that the breach was disclosed when 1Password first learned of it six days ago. 1Password will not contact users to ask for an account password or Secret Key, and the information should be entered only in the official 1Password app or official website. It recommends all users be cautious about phishing attempts like emails, texts, and calls that mention 1Password or account recovery. Users do not need to update or change anything in their 1Password accounts. title: Google search alternative Kagi launches Gmail rival
title_bn: গুগল সার্চ বিকল্প কেজি জিমেইল প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী চালু করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The pitch is an unusual combination of privacy promises and AI features.
paragraph1: Kagi, a small, Palo Alto, California-based software company that provides a subscription-based search engine as an alternative to Google, has launched a Gmail-like e-mail service. Dubbed Kagi Mail, it makes many of the same claims as the search engine product: privacy, personal data sovereignty, customization, and control. Additionally, Kagi is rolling out a calendar as part of the mail service. Right now, both the email and calendar interfaces are web-only, but native Android and iOS apps are planned for the fourth quarter of next year.
paragraph2: The email interface, currently in public beta, is minimalist. It emphasizes keyboard commands, as well as a private and ad-free experience. (You can see more details in Kagi’s blog post about what they mean by private.) Other feature offerings include unlimited aliases and domains, an anti-lock-in policy for user data, 50GB of storage, rule-based filtering with Sieve, an MCP server, and several optional, off-by-default AI features, like chatting with an agent to search email history, do large-scale re-labeling, or define additional filtering rules.
paragraph3: Some major features are still missing, though. As noted, there are no native apps yet. Critically, there is no contacts address book, but that is also coming in 2027 (Q1 in this case) according to the roadmap. Like the search engine, Kagi Mail is a paid service.
paragraph4: It’s not included in the $5 per month basic Kagi plan, nor is it in the $10 per month unlimited search plan. It is, however, included in the $25 per month Kagi Ultimate subscription, which also offers frontier AI models. If you want to get Kagi Mail without the $25 per month subscription, you can subscribe for $9 per month or $99 per year, and there’s a 60-day trial right now. Opinion: An alternative more of us should maybe consider That’s a lot to pay for email when Gmail has historically been such a strong product.
paragraph5: To most people, it seems ridiculous to imagine paying for a subscription, and that’s understandable.

title: FCC approves SpaceX plan to put AI data centers in space
title_bn: এফসিসি মহাকাশে এআই ডেটা সেন্টার স্থাপনের জন্য স্পেসএক্সের পরিকল্পনা অনুমোদন করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.
paragraph1: SpaceX was given conditional approval by the Federal Communications Commission on Wednesday to deploy and operate a constellation of up to 1 million satellites for its orbital data center business, a regulatory victory for Elon Musk and his bid to move AI data centers into space. The FCC authorization was granted despite objections from Amazon, Viasat, and the American Astronomical Society, which flagged concerns over orbital debris and congestion, radiofrequency interference, and environmental consequences. Amazon, which is building a competitor to SpaceX’s Starlink service, argued in its petition that the application lacked basic details and described it as a “lofty ambition rather than a real plan.” Despite that lack of detail, Amazon also said the proposal “risks real harm.” The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority. FCC Chair Brendan Carr said in a statement that the action “opens a bold new frontier for the computing infrastructure needed to power America’s leadership and growth.
paragraph2: ” Musk thanked Carr in a post on X, writing “Much appreciate. This will be a great asset to America and the world.” This initial regulatory approval doesn’t mean orbital data centers are imminent. SpaceX faces a number of technical and economic challenges, including how to dramatically reduce the cost of manufacturing and launching satellites, cool processors in space, and even how to secure financing for chips that are destined for orbit. The company must also clear other regulatory hurdles. The FCC has not yet approved SpaceX’s plans to handle orbital debris for satellites that would operate above 600 kilometers, for instance.
paragraph3: SpaceX requested a waiver of existing FCC rules, which requires satellites ending missions below 2,000 kilometers reenter Earth’s atmosphere within five years of completing those missions. The company is interested in moving some of these retired satellites into other orbits around Earth or even around the sun, according to the FCC authorization document. SpaceX has said it plans to deploy the satellites, known as Starmind, at altitudes ranging from 500 to 1,002 kilometers. The FCC’s approval gives SpaceX the authority to use radiofrequency communications to maintain contact with and control its orbital data centers from Earth if their primary communications systems fail. The Starmind satellites would primarily communicate using lasers to connect with other satellites, including SpaceX’s Starlink. The FCC has given SpaceX time to sort out these issues.
paragraph4: Under the approval, SpaceX has seven years to get its first operational satellite into orbit and 14 years to deploy the entire constellation. title: WhatsApp Finally Adds Scheduled Messages
title_bn: অবশেষে হোয়াটসঅ্যাপে যোগ করা হয়েছে নির্ধারিত বার্তা
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Popular messaging app WhatsApp was today updated with an option to schedule messages, which the company says was one of its most requested features. WhatsApp users can create a message and schedule it to arrive from 10 minutes to 14 days later in one
paragraph1: Wednesday November 25, 2026 12:38 pm PST by Juli CloverPopular messaging app WhatsApp was today updated with an option to schedule messages, which the company says was one of its most requested features. WhatsApp users can create a message and schedule it to arrive from 10 minutes to 14 days later in one-to-one chats and group chats. Scheduling a message can be done by pressing and holding the send button after composing and then choosing a date and time. Scheduled messages work with text, photos, and videos, and will still send even if a user's device is offline.
paragraph2: There is an option to see all scheduled messages and delete them before they're sent if needed. Scheduled messages are end-to-end encrypted and look like any other WhatsApp message, with no indication on the receiver's end that the message was scheduled. Apple's iMessage service already has a Send Later feature that supports scheduling messages, so WhatsApp is catching up with Apple's built-in messaging option. title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
title_bn: ওপেনএআই বলছে চ্যাটজিপিটি ব্যবহারকারীরা চ্যাট এবং ওয়ার্ককে একত্রিত করার কারণে দ্রুত সীমাবদ্ধতা অর্জন করতে পারে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.
paragraph1: Image Credits:Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch 12:03 PM PST · November 25, 2026 OpenAI has started rolling out a unified Chat and Work experience in ChatGPT to a few of its users, amid criticism from some subscribers that the merger could restrict their usage. The ChatGPT maker began introducing the update to a small group of Pro subscribers, product lead Thibault “Tibo” Sottiaux said in a post on X on Tuesday. The rollout follows OpenAI’s earlier announcement of the merger in an email to users. An OpenAI spokesperson told TechCrunch that while most users are not expected to face more frequent usage resets, a small fraction of its heaviest users may hit their limits sooner.
paragraph2: That’s among the concerns raised by some ChatGPT subscribers on social media and OpenAI’s community forum recently. The users fear that merging the usage limits for Chat and Work could leave them with less access to advanced reasoning models than they currently have, even as they continue paying the same subscription fees. Under the new system, Chat and Work will share a single usage meter across ChatGPT, the OpenAI spokesperson told TechCrunch. Conversations using the Instant model will, however, remain unlimited and will not count toward the shared allowance.
paragraph3: Users can also continue using Instant after exhausting their usage limits. The spokesperson added that OpenAI would continue working to improve efficiency so subscribers could get more out of their plans. While the rollout has started for a small group of users, OpenAI plans to bring shared usage limits more broadly in December, per its support page. Similar to OpenAI, rival Anthropic also moved to bring its conversational chat service Claude and work-focused Cowork under one interface in September.
paragraph4: The changes come as AI companies face mounting infrastructure costs and growing demand for increasingly capable models, putting pressure on their computing resources. Bringing conversational and work-related tools into a single interface could also make AI chatbots simpler to use, allowing users to move between chats and more complex tasks without switching tabs. bangla_paragraph1: Image Credits:Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch 12:03 PM PST · নভেম্বর 25, 2026 কিছু গ্রাহকের সমালোচনার মধ্যে ওপেনএআই তার কয়েকটি ব্যবহারকারীর জন্য চ্যাটজিপিটিতে একটি ইউনিফাইড চ্যাট এবং কাজের অভিজ্ঞতা চালু করতে শুরু করেছে। চ্যাট জিপিটি প্রস্তুতকারক প্রো গ্রাহকদের একটি ছোট গ্রুপের জন্য আপডেটটি চালু করতে সক্ষম হয়েছিল, প্রোডাক্ট লিড থিবল্ট টিবো সটিয়াউক্স মঙ্গলবার এক্স-এ একটি পোস্টে বলেছিলেন। ওপেনএইআই এর আগে ব্যবহারকারীদের একটি ইমেলের মাধ্যমে একীকরণের ঘোষণা দেওয়ার পরে রোলআউটটি শুরু হয়েছিল। একটি অপশন
bangla_paragraph2: এটি সাম্প্রতিক সময়ে সোশ্যাল মিডিয়া এবং ওপেনএআই এর কমিউনিটি ফোরামে কিছু চ্যাটজিপিটি গ্রাহকদের উদ্বেগগুলির মধ্যে একটি। ব্যবহারকারীরা আশঙ্কা করছেন যে চ্যাট এবং ওয়ার্কের ব্যবহারের সীমাবদ্ধতা একত্রিত করা তাদের বর্তমানে উন্নত যুক্তির মডেলগুলির তুলনায় কম অ্যাক্সেস দিতে পারে, এমনকি তারা একই সাবস্ক্রিপশন ফি প্রদান অব্যাহত রাখলেও। নতুন সিস্টেমের অধীনে, চ্যাট ও ওয়ার্ক চ্যাট জিপিটি জুড়ে একটি একক ব্যবহারের মিটার ভাগ করবে, ওপেনএইআই মুখপাত্র টেকক্রাঞ্চকে বলেছেন। তাত্ক্ষণিক মডেল ব্যবহার করে কথোপকথনগুলি হবে, কিভাবে
bangla_paragraph3: ব্যবহারকারীরা তাদের ব্যবহারের সীমা শেষ হওয়ার পরেও তাত্ক্ষণিক ব্যবহার চালিয়ে যেতে পারেন। মুখপাত্র যোগ করেছেন যে ওপেনএআই দক্ষতা উন্নত করার জন্য কাজ চালিয়ে যাবে যাতে গ্রাহকরা তাদের পরিকল্পনা থেকে আরও বেশি পেতে পারেন। যদিও একটি ছোট গ্রুপের ব্যবহারকারীদের জন্য রোলআউট শুরু হয়েছে, ওপেনএই তার সমর্থন পৃষ্ঠার মতে ডিসেম্বরে ভাগ করা ব্যবহারের সীমাবদ্ধতা আরও বিস্তৃত করার পরিকল্পনা করেছে। ওপেন এআইয়ের মতো প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বী অ্যানথ্রপিকও তার কথোপকথন চ্যাট পরিষেবা ক্লাউড এবং কর্ম-কেন্দ্রিক কোওয়ার্ককে এক ইন্টারফেসের অধীনে নিয়ে যাওয়ার পদক্ষেপ নিয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: এআই কোম্পানিগুলি যখন পরিকাঠামোর ব্যয় বৃদ্ধি এবং ক্রমবর্ধমান সক্ষম মডেলগুলির ক্রমবিকাশিত চাহিদার মুখোমুখি হয়, তখন তাদের কম্পিউটিং সংস্থানগুলিতে চাপ সৃষ্টি করে। কথোপকথন এবং কাজের সাথে সম্পর্কিত সরঞ্জামগুলিকে একক ইন্টারফেসে আনা এআই চ্যাটবটগুলিকে ব্যবহার করা সহজ করে তুলতে পারে, ব্যবহারকারীদের ট্যাবগুলি স্যুইচ না করে চ্যাট এবং আরও জটিল কাজগুলির মধ্যে স্যুট করতে দেয়। বিষয়গুলি আপনি যখন আমাদের নিবন্ধগুলির লিঙ্কগুলির মাধ্যমে ক্রয় করেন, আমরা একটি ছোট কমিশন উপার্জন করতে পারি। এটি আমাদের সম্পাদকীয় স্বাধীনতাকে প্রভাবিত করে না
bangla_paragraph5: জগমিত টেকক্রাঞ্চের জন্য স্টার্টআপস, প্রযুক্তি নীতি সম্পর্কিত আপডেট এবং ভারতের অন্যান্য সমস্ত প্রধান প্রযুক্তি কেন্দ্রিক উন্নয়নকে কভার করে। তিনি পূর্বে এনডিটিভিতে প্রধান সংবাদদাতা হিসাবে কাজ করেছিলেন। আপনি জগমিটের সাথে যোগাযোগ বা যাচাই করতে পারেন [ইমেল সুরক্ষিত] ইমেল করে।
