author: TechPulse
excerpt: The TP-Link Archer AX1450 is available for just $39
paragraph1: (Image credit: TP-Link) Suppose you don’t need the extra speed and capacity that Wi-Fi 7 offers, and you just want something cheap to give you decent coverage throughout your house? Well, that’s where something like the TP-Link Archer AX1450 comes into focus. Walmart has the router on sale this week for $39, a $10 discount off its regular asking price.
paragraph2: The Archer AX1450 is by no means a speed demon, delivering up to 250 Mbps over the 2.4 GHz band and up to 1,201 Mbps on the 5 GHz band. That should be more than sufficient if you have a 1 Gbps or lower broadband connection.
paragraph3: You get one GbE WAN port and four GbE LAN ports for connecting your wired devices. The router features four antennas and four wireless streams. Stay On the Cutting Edge: Get the Tom's Hardware Newsletter Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
paragraph4: Brandon Hill is a senior editor at Tom's Hardware. He has written about PC and Mac tech since the late 1990s with bylines at AnandTech, DailyTech, and Hot Hardware. When he is not consuming copious amounts of tech news, he can be found enjoying the NC mountains or the beach with his wife and two sons.
bangla_paragraph1: (ছবি ক্রেডিটঃ টিপি-লিঙ্ক) ধরুন আপনার অতিরিক্ত গতি এবং ক্ষমতা প্রয়োজন নেই যা ওয়াই-ফাই ৭ সরবরাহ করে, এবং আপনি কেবল আপনার বাড়িতে একটি শালীন কভারেজ দেওয়ার জন্য সস্তা কিছু চান? ঠিক আছে, সেখানেই টিপি লিঙ্ক আর্চার এএক্স১৪৫০ এর মতো কিছু ফোকাস আসে। ওয়ালমার্টের এই সপ্তাহে রাউটারটি বিক্রি হচ্ছে ৩৯ ডলারে, এর স্বাভাবিক জিজ্ঞাসা মূল্যের তুলনায় ১০ ডলার ছাড়।
bangla_paragraph2: আর্চার এএক্স১৪৫০ কোনোভাবেই গতির দানব নয়, ২.৪ গিগাহার্টজ ব্যান্ডে ২৫০ এমবিপিএস এবং ৫ গিগহার্টজ ব্যাণ্ডে ১,২০১ এমবিপিক্স পর্যন্ত সরবরাহ করে। আপনার যদি ১ গিগাবাইটস বা তার কম ব্রডব্যান্ড সংযোগ থাকে তবে এটি যথেষ্ট হবে।
bangla_paragraph3: আপনি আপনার তারযুক্ত ডিভাইসগুলি সংযুক্ত করার জন্য একটি গিগাবাইট ওয়ান পোর্ট এবং চারটি গিগবাইট ল্যান পোর্টের সুবিধা পাবেন। রাউটারটিতে চারটি অ্যান্টেনা এবং চার টি ওয়্যারলেস স্ট্রিম রয়েছে। কাটিং এজ এ থাকুনঃ টম হার্ডওয়্যার নিউজলেটার পান আপনার ইনবক্সে সরাসরি টম'স হার্ডওয়ারের সেরা সংবাদ এবং গভীর পর্যালোচনা পান।
bangla_paragraph4: ব্র্যান্ডন হিল টম হার্ডওয়্যারের সিনিয়র সম্পাদক। তিনি ১৯৯০ এর দশকের শেষের দিক থেকে আনন্দটেক, ডেইলিটেক এবং হট হার্ডওয়ারে বাইলাইন দিয়ে পিসি এবং ম্যাক প্রযুক্তি সম্পর্কে লিখেছেন। যখন তিনি প্রচুর পরিমাণে প্রযুক্তিগত সংবাদ গ্রহণ করছেন না, তখন তাকে তার স্ত্রী এবং দুই ছেলের সাথে এনসি পর্বতমালা বা সৈকতের উপভোগ করতে পাওয়া যায়।

title: HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max debuts in Malaysia with dual 200MP cameras and cinematic ARRI video technology
title_bn: HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max মালয়েশিয়ায় ২০০ মেগাপিক্সেলের ডুয়াল ক্যামেরা এবং সিনেমাটিক ARRI ভিডিও প্রযুক্তির সাথে আত্মপ্রকাশ করেছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max is positioned as a flagship device targeting photography enthusiasts and content creators, with the company highlighting its low-light imaging capabilities, advanced stabilisation, professional colour processing and video re
paragraph1: HONOR has launched the Magic 9 Pro Max in Malaysia, expanding the availability of its camera-focused flagship smartphone following its September debut in China. The smartphone combines dual 200MP cameras, professional-grade video technology developed in collaboration with ARRI, a high-brightness display, a large silicon-carbon battery and AI-powered features.The HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max also introduces enhanced connectivity with Apple devices, including iPhone, Apple Watch and Mac, alongside advanced audio capabilities, durability certifications and a range of display technologies focused on eye comfort.Here is a look at the key features and specifications of the HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max.HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max camera: Dual 200MP sensors and 50MP ultra-wide cameraThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max features a dual 200MP camera setup, comprising an Ultra Night Main Camera and an Ultra Night Telephoto Camera, designed to capture detailed images in different lighting conditions.The 200MP main camera features a 1/1.28-inch sensor, an f/1.57 aperture and gimbal-level 3-degree stabilisation. HONOR claims it offers industry-first CIPA 8.05 stabilisation performance.The 200MP Ultra Night Telephoto Camera features a 1/1.4-inch sensor, an f/2.
paragraph2: 6 aperture and CIPA 8.05 stabilisation, while the 50MP ultra-wide camera comes with an f/2.0 aperture.The smartphone also features a 55MP square-format front camera, designed to provide greater flexibility while framing selfies, portraits and group shots.ARRI LogC3 video and 87 professional ARRI LooksHONOR has partnered with ARRI to bring its imaging science to the Magic 9 Pro Max, including an ARRI LogC3 video pipeline. The technology is designed to deliver smoother colour transitions, softer highlights and more nuanced shadows.The smartphone includes 87 official ARRI Looks, allowing users to apply cinematic colour profiles to their footage. The company says the feature is aimed at users looking for professional-style colour grading and creative video output directly from a smartphone.The device also supports cinematic video recording in a 2.39:1 ultrawide aspect ratio and 4K Live Photos, recording three seconds of footage with every shutter press.20-metre cinematic directional microphoneThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max features a Cinematic Directional Microphone that can capture sound from distances of up to 20 metres, according to the company.The microphone is designed to record distant subjects as well as quieter, nearby sounds, offering greater flexibility for video recording, interviews and other content creation scenarios.
paragraph3: HONOR Imaging Chip H1 and RAW-domain noise reductionThe Magic 9 Pro Max is powered by the HONOR Imaging Chip H1, built on a 6nm process and delivering 18.8 TOPS/W energy efficiency, according to the company.The imaging chip uses RAW-domain noise reduction technology, which HONOR claims helps retain original image details while reducing noise, particularly when capturing photographs in challenging lighting conditions.Turret-inspired camera design and anti-reflective coatingThe smartphone features a three-lens turret-inspired camera module influenced by professional cinema cameras. HONOR says the module combines a metal unibody design with precision assembly.The camera lenses are engineered with a 5,600-layer high-precision silicon nitride coating, which reportedly reduces reflections to as low as 1.5%, helping improve optical performance.6.8-inch display with 10,000-nit peak brightnessThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max features a 6.8-inch display with a peak brightness of 10,000 nits. The panel offers 6,000 nits of peak brightness at 20% APL and a minimum brightness of 1 nit.The display supports an adaptive refresh rate ranging from 1Hz to 120Hz, balancing smooth scrolling, gaming and power efficiency.
paragraph4: Nine AI eye-care technologies and TÜV Rheinland certificationHONOR has incorporated nine eye-care technologies, including chip-level AI defocus eye comfort, Circular Polarized Display 2.0, dynamic dimming, AI Circadian Night Display, 4320Hz PWM dimming, Natural Tone Display, Motion Sickness Relief Display, hardware-level low blue light and Personalized Display 2.0.The company claims these technologies help reduce visual fatigue, improve viewing comfort and support healthier display usage. The display has also received TÜV Rheinland Full Care Display 6.0 certification, according to HONOR.Snapdragon 2nm chipset and 8,000mAh batteryThe Magic 9 Pro Max is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 processor, which HONOR says is built on a 2nm process.The smartphone packs an 8,000mAh silicon-carbon battery, designed to offer extended usage. It also features the HONOR RF Enhanced Chip C3 for improved connectivity and signal performance.Dual AI surround subwoofers and spatial audioThe device features dual 1216 HONOR AI Surround Subwoofers supported by an AI spatial soundstage algorithm. The audio system incorporates an 8cc acoustic cavity and 0.88mm amplitude, according to HONOR.
paragraph5: The company claims the smartphone has received SGS 5-Star Directional High-Sensitivity Sound Acquisition Certification and SGS Spatial Audio Certification.Water and dust resistanceThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max carries IP68, IP69 and IP69K ratings for dust and water resistance. These certifications cover protection against immersion and exposure to high-temperature and high-pressure water jets under specified testing conditions.Apple ecosystem integration with iPhone, Apple Watch and MacHONOR has introduced cross-device features designed to improve interoperability with Apple products.The smartphone supports two-way notification mirroring between HONOR phones and iPhones, allowing users to respond to messages received on their HONOR device directly from an iPhone.It also supports Apple Watch integration, enabling the mirroring of incoming calls, messages and health and fitness data to the HONOR phone.Users can transfer footage from the Magic 9 Pro Max to a Mac with a single tap and browse or organise photos and videos on the computer.AI Key and Highlight Clip CaptureThe HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max features a dedicated AI key supporting Highlight Clip Capture. The feature can identify video highlights and offers tools such as subtitle collages, video clipping and video-to-Live Photo conversion, simplifying content editing and sharing.
bangla_paragraph1: HONOR মালয়েশিয়ায় ম্যাজিক 9 প্রো ম্যাক্স চালু করেছে, চীনে সেপ্টেম্বরে আত্মপ্রকাশের পর ক্যামেরা-ফোকাসযুক্ত ফ্ল্যাগশিপ স্মার্টফোনটির প্রাপ্যতা প্রসারিত করেছে। স্মার্টফোনে আইফোন, অ্যাপল ওয়াচ এবং ম্যাক সহ অ্যাপল ডিভাইসের সাথে উন্নত সংযোগের পাশাপাশি ডুয়াল 200 এমপি ক্যামেরা, এআরআরআই-র সাথে সহযোগিতায় উন্নত পেশাদার-গ্রেড ভিডিও প্রযুক্তি, একটি উচ্চ উজ্জ্বলতা প্রদর্শন, একটি বড় সিলিকন-কার্বন ব্যাটারি এবং এআই-চালিত বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলি একত্রিত করা হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই স্মার্টফোনটিতে একটি 55 এমপি স্কয়ার ফর্ম্যাট ফ্রন্ট ক্যামেরা রয়েছে, যা সেলফি, প্রতিকৃতি এবং গ্রুপ শট ফ্রেম করার সময় আরও নমনীয়তা সরবরাহ করার জন্য ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে। এআরআরআই লোগসি 3 ভিডিও এবং 87 পেশাদার এআরআই লুকসহোনর এর সাথে অংশীদার হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: HONOR ইমেজিং চিপ H1 এবং RAW-ডোমেন গোলমাল হ্রাসThe Magic 9 Pro Max হল HONor ইমেজের চিপ এইচ1 দ্বারা চালিত, যা 6nm প্রক্রিয়ায় নির্মিত এবং 18.8 TOPS / W শক্তি দক্ষতা প্রদান করে। ইমেজার চিপটি RAW ডোমেন শব্দ হ্রাস প্রযুক্তি ব্যবহার করে, যা HONOr দাবি করে যে এটি গোলমালা হ্রাস করার সময় মূল চিত্রের বিবরণগুলি ধরে রাখতে সহায়তা করে, বিশেষত চ্যালেঞ্জিং আলোর অবস্থার মধ্যে ফটোগ্রাফ ক্যাপচার করার সময়।
bangla_paragraph4: নয়টি এআই চোখের যত্ন প্রযুক্তি এবং টিইউভি রেইনল্যান্ড শংসাপত্রHONOR নয়টি চোখের স্বাস্থ্য প্রযুক্তি অন্তর্ভুক্ত করেছে, চিপ-স্তরের এআই ডিফোকাস চোখের আরাম, সার্কুলার পোলারিজড ডিসপ্লে ২.০, গতিশীল ডিমিং, এআই সার্কাডিয়ান নাইট ডিসপোলে, ৪৩২০ হার্জ পিডব্লিউএম ডিমਿੰਗ, প্রাকৃতিক টোন ডিসফ্লে, মোশন সিক্নি রিলিফ ডিসসপ্লের, হার্ডওয়্যার-স্তর কম নীল আলো এবং ব্যক্তিগতকৃত ডিসচপ্লে 2.0. কোম্পানি দাবি করে যে এই প্রযুক্তিগুলি দৃষ্টি ক্লান্তি হ্রাস করতে, দেখার আরাম উন্নত করতে এবং স্বাস্থ্যকর ডিসಪ್লে ব্যবহারকে সমর্থন করে।
bangla_paragraph5: কোম্পানি দাবি করে যে স্মার্টফোনটি এসজিএস 5-স্টার ডিরেকশনাল হাই-সেনসিটিভিটি সাউন্ড অ্যাক্সিসিশন সার্টিফিকেশন এবং এসজিএসের স্প্যাটিয়াল অডিও সার্টিফিকেশন পেয়েছে। জল এবং ধুলো প্রতিরোধের জন্য HONOR Magic 9 Pro Max IP68, IP69 এবং IP69K রেটিং ধুলো এবং জলের প্রতিরোধ ক্ষমতা বহন করে। এই সার্টিসিফিকেশনের মধ্যে নিমজ্জন এবং নির্দিষ্ট পরীক্ষার শর্তে উচ্চ তাপমাত্রা এবং উচ্চ চাপের জল জেটের সংস্পর্শে সুরক্ষা অন্তর্ভুক্ত রয়েছে। আইফোন, অ্যাপল ওয়াচ এবং ম্যাকহোনরের সাথে অ্যাপল বাস্তুতন্ত্রের সংহতকরণ ইন্টিটিউটেড।

paragraph2: Thankfully, T-Mobile's new structure still allows for other deal options as well. title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo vs Vivo S2 vs Nothing Phone 4a: Which offers more for  ₹40,000?
title_bn: মটোরোলা এজ ৭০ নিও বনাম ভিভো এস২ বনাম নিথ ফোন ৪এ: ৪০,০০০ টাকায় কোন ফোন বেশি দাম দিচ্ছে?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Motorola Edge 70 Neo takes on Vivo S2 and Nothing Phone 4a in India. Compare their prices, processors, displays, batteries and cameras.
paragraph1: The sub- ₹40,000 smartphone market in India has a new contender, with Motorola introducing the Edge 70 Neo in its premium mid-range Edge series. The new handset enters a segment that already includes the Vivo S2 and Nothing Phone 4a, offering buyers several choices across display quality, camera performance, battery life and processing power.While Motorola is banking on a large battery and a high-refresh-rate display, Vivo is offering a similarly sized battery, while Nothing stands out with a triple rear camera system and its signature Glyph lighting. Here is how the three smartphones compare on price and specifications. Motorola Edge 70 Neo vs Vivo S2 vs Nothing Phone 4a: Price in India The Motorola Edge 70 Neo has been launched in a single 8GB RAM and 128GB storage variant, priced at ₹40,999. However, introductory bank cashback offers bring its effective price down to ₹34,999.The phone is available in four colour options: Mountain View, Gray Lilac, Milky Blue and Sage.The Vivo S2 starts at ₹42,999 for the 8GB RAM and 128GB storage variant. Meanwhile, the Nothing Phone 4a is listed at ₹39,999 for its 6GB RAM and 128GB storage version on Flipkart. Display: Which phone offers the better screen? Motorola Edge 70 Neo features a 6.8-inch 1.5K quad-curved AMOLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate and peak brightness of 5,200 nits.The Vivo S2 also gets a 6.8-inch 1.5K AMOLED screen, but its refresh rate is capped at 120Hz and peak brightness at 3,000 nits.
paragraph2: Nothing Phone 4a comes with a slightly smaller 6.78-inch 1.5K AMOLED display. It supports a 120Hz refresh rate and offers peak brightness of up to 4,500 nits. Processor and software: Motorola vs Vivo vs Nothing The three smartphones use different processors and software interfaces.The Motorola Edge 70 Neo is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset and runs on Android 16 with Motorola's Hello UX interface.The Vivo S2 uses a MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Turbo processor and runs OriginOS 6.Nothing Phone 4a, meanwhile, is powered by Qualcomm's Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chipset and comes with Nothing OS 4.1.All three devices run Android 16 out of the box. Battery and charging: Which smartphone lasts longer? Battery capacity is one of the key differences between the three devices.The Motorola Edge 70 Neo packs a 7,000mAh battery with support for 45W wired charging and 7.5W reverse wired charging. It also carries an IP64 rating for dust and water resistance.The Vivo S2 comes with a slightly larger 7,050mAh battery, although its wired charging support is limited to 44W.
paragraph3: Nothing Phone 4a has a smaller 5,400mAh battery but supports faster 50W wired charging. It also offers 7.5W reverse wired charging. Camera: Nothing Phone 4a gets a triple rear setup The Motorola Edge 70 Neo features a dual rear camera system comprising a 50MP primary sensor with optical image stabilisation (OIS) and a 2MP macro camera. For selfies, it gets a 32MP front camera.The Vivo S2 also offers a 50MP primary rear camera paired with a 2MP secondary sensor. It has a 32MP front-facing camera for selfies and video calls.Nothing Phone 4a takes a different approach with three rear cameras. Its setup includes a 50MP OIS primary sensor, an 8MP ultra-wide camera and a 50MP telephoto lens with 3.5x optical zoom. It also gets a 32MP selfie camera.Another distinguishing feature is Nothing's Glyph lighting system on the rear panel.pecificationsMotorola Edge 70 NeoVivo S2Nothing Phone 4aDisplay6.8-inch AMOLED, 144Hz6.8-inch AMOLED, 120Hz6.78-inch AMOLED, 120HzProcessorSnapdragon 7s Gen 3Dimensity 7360 TurboSnapdragon 7s Gen 4Rear camera50MP + 2MP50MP + 2MP50MP + 8MP + 50MPFront camera32MP32MP32MPBattery7,000mAh7,050mAh5,400mAhCharging45W44W50WStarting price ₹40,999 ₹42,999 ₹39,999With the three phones competing in a similar price segment, buyers can compare their display, battery, processor and camera features before making a choice.

title: Navi Crosses 5% UPI Market Share As PhonePe, Google Pay Slip In October
title_bn: নবির ইউপিআই মার্কেট শেয়ার ৫ শতাংশ ছাড়িয়েছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Sachin Bansal-led Navi continued to strengthen its position in the UPI ecosystem in October 2026. The fintech platform’s share in…
paragraph1: SUMMARYNavi's UPI transaction share rose to 5.04% in October from 4.76% in September PhonePe, Google Pay and Paytm recorded marginal declines in their UPI market shares Navi overtook CRED in UPI transaction value, processing ₹62,492 Cr in October Sachin Bansal-led Navi continued to strengthen its position in the UPI ecosystem in October 2026. The fintech platform’s share in the UPI market crossed the 5% mark over the past month, data released by NPCI revealed. Of the 25.47 Bn processed by UPI, transactions processed by Navi platform rose to 5.04% from 4.76% in September. Overall, Navi hosted 1.
paragraph2: 27 Bn UPI transactions during the month, an 11% increase from 1.14 Bn in September The fintech platform processed around 1.27 Bn UPI transactions during the month, up from 1.14 Bn in September. Navi’s gains came as the UPI leaders — PhonePe, Google Pay and Paytm — continued to see some decline in their market share in October. Taken together, the three platforms still combine over 85% of India’s UPI market. PhonePe remained the largest UPI app, with a 45.34% share of transaction volume, down from 45.57% in September.
paragraph3: Google Pay’s share fell to 32.09% from 32.23%, while Paytm’s share declined to 7.96% from 8.12%. Navi Overtakes CRED In UPI Transaction Value Navi’s growth was also visible in transaction value. The platform processed UPI transactions worth ₹62,492 Cr in October, marginally ahead of CRED’s ₹62,102 Cr, according to NPCI data. This made Navi the fourth-largest UPI app by transaction value, ending CRED’s position in the ranking after more than five years. Among other emerging platforms, WhatsApp’s share increased to 0.
paragraph4: 85% in October from 0.80% in September. FamApp by Trio also recorded a rise to 0.99% from 0.95%, while BHIM’s share edged up to 1.07% from 1.06%. On the other hand, super.money’s share declined to 1.
paragraph5: 65% from 1.69%. CRED maintained its share at 0.59%, while Amazon Pay’s share increased marginally to 0.40% from 0.38%. The data indicates that while PhonePe and Google Pay continue to control a large part of India’s UPI market, smaller players such as Navi are gradually expanding their presence. Navi’s latest gains also come amid growing competition among fintech platforms to capture a larger share of India’s digital payments market.

title: Beyond Its Sovereignty Bet, What’s Sarvam Really Mining?
title_bn: সার্বভৌমত্বের বাইরেও সারভাম আসলে কী খুঁজছে?
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Last week, Sarvam AI found itself in the eye of a storm. The poster child of India’s sovereign AI ambitions…
paragraph1: SUMMARYSarvam AI has expanded its product portfolio with an upgraded 105B large language model and Dictate, a speech-to-text API supporting English and 22 Indian languages Beyond building sovereign AI models, Sarvam is looking to become a one-stop shop for enterprise AI in India, offering everything from foundation models and inference infrastructure to AI-powered applications While its upgraded 105B model narrows the performance gap with global peers on conversational tasks, its voice AI business is already finding commercial traction, clocking over 3 Mn minutes a day and a billion-plus API calls a month, according to the company Last week, Sarvam AI found itself in the eye of a storm. The poster child of India’s sovereign AI ambitions drew flak for offering access to Chinese AI models, including DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM, through its newly launched inference platform, Token Factory. The point of contention among critics has been whether a startup that received government support to build indigenous AI models should be in the business of selling access to Chinese models. Sarvam clarified that its Token Factory runs on privately procured GPUs, and its inference business does not dilute the ambition to build homegrown AI models. Amid this controversy, the AI unicorn has expanded its product portfolio with two new launches — Sarvam-105B-1711, an upgraded version of its existing large language model (LLM), and Sarvam Dictate, a speech-to-text API that supports English and 22 Indian languages. The launches offer a glimpse into Sarvam’s larger game plan. The unicorn wants to offer Indian enterprises everything they need to build and deploy AI. From homegrown AI models and the infrastructure to run them to voice AI, coding agents and workplace applications, Sarvam desires to become a one-stop shop for enterprise AI in India. Not to mention, Sarvam’s full-stack AI ambition has begun to find commercial traction, particularly in the financial services sector, including Tata Capital and Mahindra Finance. The latter has also deployed Sarvam-powered voice agents across sales, collections and frontline employee engagement. It claims to have executed 1 Cr+ customer calls via its voice stack. At Bolna’s Symphony 2026 last week, Vivek Raghavan, the cofounder of Sarvam AI, claimed that the company was clocking more than 3 Mn minutes a day and had crossed a billion API calls a month for its voice AI business. Kivi also understands more than 22 Indian languages, including code-switching, while its Epoch roadmap lists Android among the next platforms. Kivi and Dictate sit at different points in the same stack. Kivi is the end-user application, while Dictate turns the underlying speech and language capabilities into an API that developers can embed into their products. Sarvam also offers a document-intelligence API, Extract. It pulls structured information from documents so developers can route it into their own products. With Extract, Dictate and Kivi, the company has extended its playbook to include voice and documents. paragraph5: Its $234 Mn Series B, led by HCLTech at a $1.5 Bn valuation, gives it the financial firepower to build models, infrastructure and enterprise products at the same time. It is also building for enterprises that care about where their AI runs. Its Token Factory provides access to Sarvam’s models, along with other open-weight models, while the company offers India-based inference and dedicated GPU capacity for its BFSI customers. A bank could use Sarvam’s models, run inference within India, deploy voice agents for customer interactions, use document and workplace agents internally, and build specialised applications around the same infrastructure. The value proposition is not necessarily that Sarvam has the best model for every task, but that it is increasingly able to provide several of those layers under one roof. There is, however, a debate around its India-first positioning. The cofounder and CEO of Smallest.ai, Sudarshan Kamath, argues that Indian-language intelligence alone may not be enough to compete in broader knowledge work, where global models benefit from enormous amounts of English-language data. One practical way to judge that is to look at actual developer usage and whether developers choose Sarvam over alternatives such as Qwen or Gemini.

title: What Jensen Huang’s NVIDIA Return Means For India’s AI Players
title_bn: What Jensen Huang’s NVIDIA Return Means For India’s AI Players
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Jensen Huang’s return as NVIDIA CEO has eased concerns over leadership continuity at a key supplier to India’s AI ecosystem.…
paragraph1: SUMMARYHuang’s return brings greater leadership certainty, but is unlikely to immediately improve GPU availability, lower procurement costs for Indian operators Indian AI companies’ dependence on NVIDIA’s hardware and software leaves them exposed to changes in its supply priorities, global demand, and US export policies NVIDIA accounts for 81.6% of compute units listed on the IndiaAI Compute Portal. Analysts recommend diversifying suppliers, improving infrastructure utilisation Jensen Huang’s return as NVIDIA CEO has eased concerns over leadership continuity at a key supplier to India’s AI ecosystem. However, analysts say it does little to address the Indian AI ecosystem’s dependence on the chipmaker or the constraints keeping advanced computing infrastructure expensive. NVIDIA announced Huang’s reinstatement on November 23, following his resignation on November 12. US President Donald Trump welcomed the decision, describing Huang as a “national treasure”. His departure had raised questions about NVIDIA’s investment plans, supply-chain management, pace of product innovation, and ability to retain talent. For Indian companies building AI infrastructure around its chips and software, continuity at NVIDIA offers greater certainty over the supplier’s direction.
paragraph2: “That said, NVIDIA is not a one-person company, but Jensen’s return does bring more certainty, and AI trade is perceiving this to be a good sign. There will be increased controls and governance at the company, which could impact Jensen’s internal influence in the company. This is something to watch for,” Gaurav Gupta, VP analyst at Gartner, told Inc42. The company’s board has said its independent investigation will continue. NVIDIA has also formed a National Security and Export Control Committee and is seeking a chief compliance officer, adding oversight alongside Huang’s return. For Indian buyers, however, leadership certainty does not necessarily translate into easier access to GPUs or lower procurement costs. “The constraints are largely structural, driven by global demand, manufacturing capacity, advanced packaging, high-bandwidth memory availability and US export policies. These cannot be resolved through a leadership decision alone,” said Achyuta Ghosh, India market lead for HFS Research.
paragraph3: Dependence Beyond The Chips NVIDIA’s presence in India spans AI computing infrastructure, software, data centres, startups, developer tools, and strategic partnerships. Greyhound Research’s analysis of the IndiaAI Compute Portal put NVIDIA’s share at 81.6% of 44,077 listed compute units, ahead of Google, AMD, AWS, and Intel. This measures the composition of the cited portal dataset, rather than NVIDIA’s share of India’s total AI computing capacity. A separate estimate by Counterpoint Research puts NVIDIA’s share of India’s high-end AI training and inference capacity at 85-90%. The dependence extends beyond hardware to NVIDIA’s software ecosystem, particularly CUDA, which developers use to build and run GPU-accelerated applications. Indian startups, data centre operators, and large IT services companies are building AI infrastructure and solutions around this combination. While competing chips are available, adopting them requires technical expertise to adapt software and optimise workloads.
paragraph4: This makes diversification more involved than switching hardware suppliers. “Indian operators would be vulnerable if certain decisions are made that cause NVIDIA to prioritise other projects as India might not be the priority,” Gupta added. Smaller Indian data centre providers face a particular challenge because they compete with global hyperscalers with larger purchasing commitments and stronger supply-chain relationships. To reduce this exposure, analysts recommend securing long-term procurement arrangements, exploring alternative accelerators where commercially viable, and developing the flexibility to run workloads across different hardware and cloud platforms. “India’s goal should be to reduce excessive dependence on any single technology architecture while strengthening domestic capabilities in AI infrastructure management, software and optimisation,” Ghosh said. Making Compute Investments Count Beyond supplier diversification, Indian operators face another test – turning expensive infrastructure into commercially useful AI capacity. Analysts expect GPU availability to improve gradually over the next 12-18 months, particularly for older-generation hardware and enterprise inference workloads. However, they do not expect a significant reduction in procurement costs for the latest high-performance GPUs, given continued strong global demand.
paragraph5: This could leave Indian operators paying a premium for the latest systems even as earlier-generation hardware becomes easier to procure. The response, analysts say, must extend beyond adding GPUs to improving utilisation, optimising workloads, reducing power consumption, and managing the cost of inference — the process of running trained AI models. “The greater challenge is ensuring that infrastructure investments translate into enterprise AI adoption, domestic innovation and globally competitive AI capabilities. India’s AI infrastructure success should ultimately be measured by the AI capability and economic value it creates, not simply by the number of GPUs deployed,” Ghosh added. More efficient models and better infrastructure utilisation could allow enterprises to run more AI workloads on the same computing capacity. Consequently, the cost of delivering AI services could decline even if GPU purchase prices remain elevated. For Indian AI ecosystem players, Huang’s return provides greater leadership certainty at their dominant supplier. However, their longer-term economics will depend on how effectively they convert infrastructure investments into AI services that enterprises use and pay for.

title: [Update] Anthropic Rolls Out Claude Duet In India After US Launch
title_bn: [Update] Anthropic Rolls Out Claude Duet In India After US Launch
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Update | November 25, 2026, 18:50 IST Anthropic has expanded the research preview of Claude Duet, its AI-powered work assistant,…
paragraph1: SUMMARYAnthropic has expanded the research preview of Claude Duet, its AI-powered work assistant, to India, a month after its US launch The move brings Anthropic’s proactive AI agent to Indian professionals and businesses, allowing them to automate tasks across connected apps Powered by Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Duet can schedule meetings, track invoices, prepare financial forecasts and build dashboards Access is being offered through a waitlist for US Claude Pro and Max subscribers, with approval required for sending messages, making payments, and other sensitive actions Update | November 25, 2026, 18:50 IST Anthropic has expanded the research preview of Claude Duet, its AI-powered work assistant, to India, a month after its US launch. Built on Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 model, Claude Duet can monitor users’ connected apps, identify tasks needing attention, and work in the background even when users are away from their devices. Its capabilities include scheduling meetings, tracking invoices, preparing financial forecasts, building dashboards, and developing web applications. In India, Pro, Max, and Ultra subscribers can join a waitlist for the research preview. Team users can access the product through a public beta, while enterprise customers will get access through a private beta. Claude Duet is available as a standalone app on iOS and Android, and through Claude’s website. It supports 35 languages, including Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, and Telugu. Original | October 22, 2026, 11:36 IST Anthropic has unveiled Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent designed to monitor connected apps, prioritise tasks, and carry out work in the background, including when users switch off their devices.
paragraph2: The offering targets professionals and small business owners. Powered by Claude Opus 5.5, it is available as a research preview through a waitlist for Claude Pro and Max subscribers in the US. Users can access Claude Duet through standalone iOS and Android apps or on Claude’s website. It is included in existing Pro and Max subscriptions but shares usage limits with other Claude products. Background checks count towards these limits, while complex assignments consume more usage, Anthropic said. Unlike conventional AI chatbots, Claude Duet is designed to identify work that needs attention without waiting for a prompt. It sends users a daily briefing covering important items across connected apps, including emails and calendars, and provides updates when tasks are completed or require a decision. Users can assign tasks through text or voice messages, ranging from scheduling meetings and drafting email replies to building dashboards, financial forecasts and web applications. The agent can also search past conversations and use existing Claude memories, skills and connected apps.
paragraph3: Claude Duet connects with more than 6,000 tools and plugins available through the Claude Marketplace, including Gmail, Slack, QuickBooks, Stripe, Gusto, LinkedIn, DocuSign, HubSpot and Shopify. For instance, it can identify unpaid invoices through QuickBooks or Stripe and draft payment reminders. It can also prepare payroll information, draft job postings, create follow-up emails using customer and deal histories, and help businesses set up and manage online stores. The agent runs on its own cloud-based virtual machine with a browser, allowing it to continue working even when users close the app or switch off their devices. Anthropic said it checks connected accounts every few hours rather than continuously, partly to limit subscription usage. Claude Duet can also help users make business purchases through Link, Stripe’s digital wallet, and Shop Pay. Payments require user approval, while Link uses a virtual card to avoid sharing the user’s actual card number. Integration with 1Password for accessing saved website logins is also planned. Anthropic said the agent requires approval before sending messages, making payments, signing documents or deleting information. Trading securities and transferring money between accounts remain prohibited, even with user approval.
paragraph4: Users can disconnect apps, and only they can mark tasks as finished. Safeguards And Early Limitations Anthropic said Claude Duet includes safeguards designed to prevent unauthorised actions, prompt injection, and sensitive data leaks. Prompt injection involves malicious instructions hidden in content an agent encounters, such as emails or websites. The protections include an automated system that assesses proposed actions and controls designed to keep passwords and sign-in tokens out of the agent’s direct view. A separate message-checking system is designed to block requests to share highly sensitive information, including credit card numbers and government identification. Other sensitive information, such as health and personal finance details, can be shared only on explicit user instructions, Anthropic said. The company said Claude Duet has undergone adversarial testing and external penetration testing, and is covered by its public bug bounty programme. However, Anthropic acknowledged that the early version may misinterpret conversations, misjudge urgency, or miss information arriving between checks. It is currently better suited to work assignments than personal errands, such as booking tickets, and users cannot yet view its browser. The launch adds to the growing competition in always-on AI agents that work across apps with limited human intervention.
paragraph5: OpenAI’s Dots and Meta’s Muse target similar use cases, while Bengaluru-based Emergent’s Wingman handles tasks across email, calendars, and workplace software through WhatsApp and Telegram. As agents gain access to more business systems, their permissions and accountability are also coming under scrutiny. Recently, CERT-In warned about unauthorised AI agent access to Indian organisations’ systems, highlighting the risks associated with deploying increasingly autonomous tools. Anthropic said feedback from early users will inform further development. The research preview does not currently include Team and Enterprise subscribers. title: Motorola’s Android 17 update fixes Android Auto connections on folded Razr phones
title_bn: মটোরোলার অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ১৭ আপডেট ভাঁজ করা রাজার ফোনগুলিতে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড অটো সংযোগগুলি সংশোধন করে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: No more flipping open your Razr every time you start your car.
paragraph1: Ryan Haines / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Motorola Razr owners report that the Android 17 update fixes a long-standing Android Auto connectivity bug. The issue emerged after the Android 16 update, forcing affected users to unfold their phones to establish a connection. One convenience of owning a flip phone is being able to carry out everyday tasks without unfolding it. But for some Motorola Razr owners, even something as simple as connecting to Android Auto has required opening their phones since the Android 16 update.
paragraph2: Thankfully, the latest Android 17 update appears to be putting an end to this frustration.A Motorola Razr Ultra 2025 owner took to Reddit to share that Android Auto is once again connecting automatically while their phone is folded shut following the Android 17 update. Other owners in the thread have reported similar improvements.The problem dates back several months.
paragraph3: In February, a Razr Plus 2024 owner reported that their phone used to connect to their car wirelessly without even taking it out of their pocket. After installing Android 16, they had to flip open the phone every time they started their car. Neither changing Android Auto’s settings nor clearing app data and reinstalling updates helped. The phone didn’t even need to be unlocked for Android Auto to start working again.
paragraph4: Simply unfolding it was enough.Connectivity isn’t the only issue flip phone owners have experienced with Google’s driving platform. In September, we reported on a separate Android Auto bug that prevented Motorola Razr and Samsung Galaxy Z Flip owners from making outgoing calls through Gemini while their phones were folded shut.It’s unclear whether Motorola’s Android 17 update addresses that problem, too.
paragraph5: Nevertheless, it’s encouraging to see Razr owners regain some of the convenience they lost with Android 16, especially for a feature they potentially use every day.
bangla_paragraph1: রায়ান হেইন্স / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ গুগলে অ্যান্ড্রেড কর্তৃত্ব যুক্ত করুনঃ TL;DR মটোরোলা রাজার মালিকরা রিপোর্ট করেছেন যে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড 17 আপডেটটি একটি দীর্ঘস্থায়ী অ্যান্ড্রিক অটো সংযোগের বাগ সংশোধন করে। সমস্যাটি অ্যান্ড্রিড 16 আপডেটের পরে আবির্ভূত হয়েছিল, প্রভাবিত ব্যবহারকারীদের সংযোগ স্থাপনের জন্য তাদের ফোনগুলি খুলতে বাধ্য করেছিল। একটি ফ্লিপ ফোনের মালিকানাধীন একটি সুবিধা হ'ল এটি খুলতে না গিয়ে প্রতিদিনের কাজগুলি সম্পাদন করতে সক্ষম হওয়া। তবে কিছু মটো্রোলা রজার মালিকদের জন্য অ্যান্ড्रয়েড অটোতে সংযোগ স্থাপের মতো সহজ কিছুও প্রয়োজন।
bangla_paragraph2: সৌভাগ্যবশত, সর্বশেষ অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ১৭ আপডেটটি এই হতাশার অবসান ঘটাচ্ছে বলে মনে হচ্ছে। মটোরোলা রাজার আল্ট্রা ২০২৫ মালিক রেডডিটে শেয়ার করেছেন যে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড অটো আবারও স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে সংযোগ স্থাপন করছে যখন তাদের ফোনটি অ্যান্ড্রেড ১৭-এর আপডেটের পরে বন্ধ হয়ে যায়। থ্রেডের অন্যান্য মালিকরা অনুরূপ উন্নতি সম্পর্কে রিপোর্ট করেছেন। সমস্যাটি কয়েক মাস আগের।
bangla_paragraph3: ফেব্রুয়ারিতে, একটি রাজার প্লাস ২০২৪ মালিক রিপোর্ট করেছিলেন যে তাদের ফোনটি এমনকি তাদের পকেট থেকে বের না করেই তাদের গাড়ির সাথে বেতার সংযোগ স্থাপন করত। অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ১৬ ইনস্টল করার পরে, তাদের গাড়িটি শুরু করার সময় প্রতিবার ফোনটি খুলতে হয়েছিল। অ্যানড্রয়েਡ অটো সেটিং পরিবর্তন করা বা অ্যাপ্লিকেশন ডেটা সাফ করা এবং আপডেটগুলি পুনরায় ইনস্টলেশন করা সাহায্য করেনি। অ্যামাজন অটো আবার কাজ শুরু করার জন্য ফোনটিকে আনলক করার দরকার ছিল না।
bangla_paragraph4: কেবল এটি প্রকাশ করা যথেষ্ট ছিল।ফ্লিপ ফোনের মালিকরা গুগলের ড্রাইভিং প্ল্যাটফর্মের সাথে কেবল সংযোগের সমস্যাটিই অনুভব করেননি। সেপ্টেম্বরে, আমরা একটি পৃথক অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অটো বাগ সম্পর্কে রিপোর্ট করেছি যা মটোরোলা রাজার এবং স্যামসাং গ্যালাক্সি জেড ফ্লিপ মালিকদের তাদের ফোনগুলি বন্ধ হয়ে যাওয়ার সময় জেমিনির মাধ্যমে বহির্গামী কল করতে বাধা দেয়।মোটোরোলার অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড 17 আপডেটটিও এই সমস্যার সমাধান করে কিনা তা অস্পষ্ট।
bangla_paragraph5: তবুও, রজার ব্যবহারকারীরা অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ১৬ এর মাধ্যমে হারিয়ে যাওয়া কিছু সুবিধা ফিরে পেয়েছে, বিশেষ করে এমন একটি বৈশিষ্ট্য যা তারা প্রতিদিন ব্যবহার করতে পারে।

title: Google Messages is testing a revamped voice messaging and media viewer interface
title_bn: গুগল মেসেজ একটি নতুন ভয়েস মেসেঞ্জার এবং মিডিয়া ভিউয়ার ইন্টারফেস পরীক্ষা করছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: The app is also testing an updated media viewer with a larger viewing area and other tweaks.
paragraph1: Joe Maring / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google Messages is testing an updated audio messaging interface with updated visuals and a progress indicator. The messaging app could also make it easier to set Voice Moods while recording, rather than waiting until after you finish. Google Messages is also working on a media viewer update, including new icons and a wider viewing area for photos and videos. Google Messages is already working on voice messaging upgrades, and a future update could bring some more changes to that experience. Currently, the message card shows you an audio message’s overall duration, but it doesn’t tell you how far into the recording you are.
paragraph2: Google Messages is working to remedy that.APK teardownThis reporting is based on work-in-progress code. These features may not ship.We dug into version 20261120_01 beta of Google Messages to enable a revamped audio message card that also shows a progress indicator. This helps you see how far along you are, especially for voice messages that are a couple of minutes long.
paragraph3: But that’s not the only upgrade that’s in development for voice messaging. Last week, we reported on the ability to set Voice Moods in Google Messages while recording, among other changes. We now have visuals on this particular upgrade as well.In its current form, users can set Voice Moods only after they finish recording, as the first two screenshots above illustrate. Letting you choose from the available Voice Moods as you’re recording an audio message certainly seems like a logical upgrade.
paragraph4: Additionally, there’s a dedicated close button (X) at the top right of this updated audio recording interface.We’re also seeing the new “Send” button here in place of “Attach”, something we first learned about in a recent APK teardown. While this will undoubtedly speed up sending voice notes, it could also lead to users accidentally sending one when they didn’t intend to.Beyond the changes coming to the voice recording interface, Google Messages is also testing a revised design for the photo/video viewer.Among the changes we’re seeing is a larger media viewer that spans the width of the screen, replacing the current card-style viewer with rounded corners.
paragraph5: The row of reactions sits in a pill-shaped container at the bottom, with only three visible in this redesign instead of four.Meanwhile, the video playback controls are positioned just below the video rather than directly on it. Lastly, the existing Nano Banana icon for photos makes way for a contact icon bearing a familiar AI sparkle, while the message bubble icon for replies may be replaced by a reply icon (left-facing arrow).As with most early revelations, it’s hard to predict when (or if) these design tweaks will roll out to the Messages app. In any case, we’ll keep a close eye on future app releases for more clues about these feature additions.

bangla_paragraph3: কিন্তু এটিই একমাত্র আপগ্রেড নয় যা ভয়েস মেসেজিংয়ের জন্য বিকাশের মধ্যে রয়েছে। গত সপ্তাহে, আমরা অন্যান্য পরিবর্তনের মধ্যে রেকর্ডিংয়ের সময় গুগল বার্তাগুলিতে ভয়েসের মেজাজ সেট করার ক্ষমতা সম্পর্কে রিপোর্ট করেছি। এখন আমাদের এই বিশেষ আপগ্রেস সম্পর্কে ভিজ্যুয়াল রয়েছে। এর বর্তমান আকারে, ব্যবহারকারীরা রেকর্ড শেষ করার পরেই ভয়েসেস মেজজ সেট করতে পারে, যেমন উপরের প্রথম দুটি স্ক্রিনশট দেখায়। আপনি অডিও বার্তা রেকর্ড করার সময় উপলব্ধ ভয়েজ মেজাস থেকে চয়ন করতে দেওয়া অবশ্যই একটি যৌক্তিক আপগ্রিডের মতো মনে হয়।
bangla_paragraph4: এছাড়াও, এই আপডেট করা অডিও রেকর্ডিং ইন্টারফেসের উপরের ডানদিকে একটি ডেডিকেটেড ক্লোজ বোতাম (এক্স) রয়েছে। আমরা এখানে অ্যাট্যাচ এর পরিবর্তে নতুন সেন্ড বোতামটিও দেখছি, যা আমরা সম্প্রতি একটি APK টিয়ারডাউনে প্রথম শিখেছি। যদিও এটি নিঃসন্দেহে ভয়েস নোট প্রেরণকে ত্বরান্বিত করবে, এটি ব্যবহারকারীদের ঘটনাক্রমে একটি পাঠানোর দিকেও পরিচালিত করতে পারে যখন তারা এটি করার পরিকল্পনা করেনি।ভয়েস রেকর্ডing ইন্টারফেসে আসা পরিবর্তনগুলি ছাড়াও, গুগল বার্তাগুলি ফটো / ভিডিওর জন্য একটি সংশোধিত নকশাও পরীক্ষা করছে।
bangla_paragraph5: প্রতিক্রিয়াগুলির সারিতে নীচে একটি পিল আকারের পাত্রে বসে আছে, এই পুনরায় নকশায় চারটির পরিবর্তে কেবল তিনটি দৃশ্যমান। এদিকে, ভিডিও প্লেব্যাক নিয়ন্ত্রণগুলি সরাসরি ভিডিওর পরিবর্তে ভিডিওর ঠিক নীচে অবস্থিত। অবশেষে, ফটোগুলির জন্য বিদ্যমান ন্যানো কলা আইকনটি একটি পরিচিত এআই স্পার্ক বহনকারী একটি যোগাযোগ আইকনের জন্য জায়গা করে দেয়, যখন প্রতিক্রিয়া জন্য বার্তা বুদবুদ আইকানটি একটি প্রতিক্রিয়া আইকনে (বাম দিকে মুখোমুখি তীর) প্রতিস্থাপিত হতে পারে। বেশিরভাগ প্রাথমিক প্রকাশের মতো, কখন (বা যদি) এটি ঘটে তা পূর্বাভাস করা কঠিন।

paragraph2: The WH-1000XM4C are a refreshed version of Sony’s popular WH-1000XM4, keeping the same compact folding design and noise canceling while adding updated sound tuning. Bluetooth moves up to version 6.0, and Sony’s app now offers a 10-band EQ for fine-tuning the sound.
paragraph3: The battery can also be replaced, which should help them last longer. Sony rates battery life at up to 27 hours with noise canceling on and up to 34 hours with it off. A 3.

title: Lok Capital Announces First Close Of Fund V At $130 Mn
title_bn: লোক ক্যাপিটাল ঘোষণা করেছে যে, ফান্ড ভি-র প্রথম বন্ধ $130 মিলিয়ন ডলারে হবে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Social impact focused investor Lok Capital has raised over $130 Mn in the first close of its latest AIF, Fund…
paragraph1: Social impact focused investor Lok Capital has raised over $130 Mn in the first close of its latest AIF, Fund V. The target corpus of the fund was earlier set to be in the range of $200-250 Mn. The fund will focus on investing in companies focused on financial inclusion, i.
paragraph2: e. expanding access to financial services for underserved segments, and climate and sustainability across agriculture, mobility, logistics, manufacturing, and consumer markets. Via the fund, Lok Capital plans to back 10-12 companies with established business models and sustainable revenue traction with cheques averaging around $8-25 Mn and co-investing in rounds of up to $50 Mn, MD Rajat Bansal told Mint.
paragraph3: The International Finance Corporation, European Investment Bank, and the Dutch government’s Entrepreneurial Development Bank (FMO) have all disclosed proposed investments in Lok Capital’s latest fund. The IFC has proposed an equity investment of up to $20 Mn and an additional co-investment envelope of up to $20 Mn, while the EIB has proposed to invest around $50 Mn. FMO has disclosed a potential investment commitment of around $15 Mn.
paragraph4: Founded in 2004 by Vishal Mehta, Venky Natarajan, and Donald Peck, Lok Capital has launched four funds to date with a cumulative corpus of $347 Mn. It has made over 47 investments till date and claims that 8 of its invested companies have gone public. The investment firm’s portfolio includes companies like Moneyview, RenewBuy, Akshayakalpa, Mintifi, Marut Drones, and Anveshan.
paragraph5: Beyond new-age tech companies, the investor has also backed Jana Small Finance Bank, Utkarsh Small Finance Bank, Suryodya, among others. Most recently, it co-led egg brand Henfruit’s $15 Mn Series A round alongside DSG Consumer Partners and RPSG Capital Ventures. The investor also claims to have delivered a complete exit on the first two funds and expects to liquidate the remaining investments from Fund III over the next year, while it has started delivering the exit proceeds from Fund IV to its LPs.
bangla_paragraph1: সামাজিক প্রভাবের উপর দৃষ্টি নিবদ্ধ বিনিয়োগকারী লোক ক্যাপিটাল তার সর্বশেষ এআইএফ, ফান্ড ভি-র প্রথম বন্ধের সময় ১৩০ মিলিয়ন ডলারেরও বেশি অর্থ সংগ্রহ করেছে। এর আগে এই তহবিলের লক্ষ্যমাত্রা ২০০-২৫০ মিলিয়ন ডলার ছিল।
bangla_paragraph2: ই. কৃষি, গতিশীলতা, সরবরাহ, উত্পাদন এবং ভোক্তা বাজারে আর্থিক পরিষেবাগুলিতে অ্যাক্সেস এবং জলবায়ু এবং টেকসইতা প্রসারিত করা। তহবিলের মাধ্যমে লোক ক্যাপিটাল প্রতিষ্ঠিত ব্যবসায়িক মডেল এবং টেক্সই রাজস্ব আকর্ষণের সাথে 10-12 টি সংস্থাকে গড়ে প্রায় 8-25 মিলিয়ন ডলার চেক দিয়ে এবং 50 মিলিয়ন ডଲାର পর্যন্ত রাউন্ডে সহ-বিনিয়োগের পরিকল্পনা করেছে, এমডি রাজত বানসাল মিন্টকে বলেছেন।
bangla_paragraph3: আন্তর্জাতিক অর্থ কর্পোরেশন, ইউরোপীয় বিনিয়োগ ব্যাংক এবং ডাচ সরকারের উদ্যোক্তা উন্নয়ন ব্যাংক (এফএমও) সকলেই লোক ক্যাপিটালের সর্বশেষ তহবিলে প্রস্তাবিত বিনিয়োগের কথা প্রকাশ করেছে। আইএফসি ২০ মিলিয়ন ডলার পর্যন্ত ইক্যুইটি বিনিয়োগ এবং ২০ মিলিয়ন ডলারের অতিরিক্ত সহ-বিনিয়োগের প্রস্তাব দিয়েছে, যখন ইআইবি প্রায় ৫০ মিলিয়ন ডଲାର বিনিয়োগের প্রস্তাব করেছে। এফএমও প্রায় ১৫ মিলিয়ন ডলারের সম্ভাব্য বিনিয়োগের প্রতিশ্রুতি প্রকাশ করেছে
bangla_paragraph4: ২০০৪ সালে বিশাল মেহতা, ভেঙ্কি নটরাজন এবং ডোনাল্ড পেক প্রতিষ্ঠিত, লোক ক্যাপিটাল এখন পর্যন্ত ৩৪৭ মিলিয়ন ডলারের একটি পুঁজি সহ চারটি তহবিল চালু করেছে। এটি এখন পর্যন্ত ৪৭ টিরও বেশি বিনিয়োগ করেছে এবং দাবি করেছে যে এর বিনিয়োগকৃত ৮ টি সংস্থা পাবলিক হয়েছে। বিনিয়োগ ফার্মের পোর্টফোলিওতে মানিভিউ, রিনিউবয়, অক্ষয়কলপা, মিন্টিফি, মারুত ড্রোনস এবং অন্বেষণের মতো সংস্থা রয়েছে।

title: PhonePe Revives IPO Plans, Eyes March 2027 Listing At Up To $15 Bn Valuation
title_bn: ফোনপে আইপিও পরিকল্পনা পুনরুজ্জীবিত করেছে, ২০২৭ সালের মার্চ মাসে ১৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারের মূল্য নির্ধারণের লক্ষ্যে তালিকাভুক্ত হচ্ছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Walmart-backed fintech major PhonePe has revived its IPO plans and restarted discussions with investment bankers, targeting a March 2027 listing…
paragraph1: Walmart-backed fintech major PhonePe has revived its IPO plans and restarted discussions with investment bankers, targeting a March 2027 listing at a valuation of $12 Bn to $15 Bn, sources told Inc42. The Bengaluru-based company plans to file updated IPO papers by December-end for an offer for sale of up to ₹12,000 Cr ($1.3 Bn). Notably, PhonePe was valued at $14.5 Bn during General Atlantic’s $600 Mn secondary investment in 2025. Sources said PhonePe expects greater clarity by December-end on two regulatory issues affecting the company’s business – the merchant discount rate (MDR) framework for UPI transactions and the 30% market-share cap for third-party UPI apps. A possible extension or relaxation of the cap could ease a regulatory overhang ahead of the proposed listing, the sources said.
paragraph2: PhonePe declined to comment on the IPO development. The Economic Times first reported on the revival of its listing plans. The renewed push comes after PhonePe paused its IPO plans in March, citing geopolitical uncertainty and volatility in global capital markets. At the time, the company said it would restart the process once markets stabilised. The rally in Indian equities and foreign portfolio investors’ return to net buying appear to have given PhonePe greater confidence to revive its listing plans. Growth And Profitability In Focus PhonePe is seeing stronger growth in lending and operating revenue, the sources said. The company’s lending business has grown around 100%, while operating revenue has increased 35%-40% QoQ.
paragraph3: The company is also expected to report a net profit, they added. This would mark a turnaround from FY26, when PhonePe reported a net loss of ₹2,792 Cr. Operating revenue rose 11.5% to ₹7,920.5 Cr from ₹7,105 Cr in FY25. The lending business offers PhonePe a route to diversify revenue beyond its core payments operations. Its growth and contribution to profitability will be relevant to the company’s pitch to public market investors.
paragraph4: UPI Rules Remain Key Beyond financial performance, the regulatory outlook remains central to PhonePe’s IPO preparations. Introducing MDR on select UPI transactions could create an additional revenue stream for payment companies. However, whether such charges will be introduced remains uncertain. The other issue is the National Payments Corporation of India’s (NPCI) 30% cap on UPI transaction volumes handled by individual third-party application providers (TPAPs). NPCI had extended the compliance deadline for existing apps exceeding the cap to December 31, 2026. PhonePe operates above the threshold, making any further extension or relaxation significant for its growth plans ahead of the proposed public market debut. Its renewed listing push also coincides with IPO preparations at payments infrastructure major Razorpay.
paragraph5: Razorpay has received SEBI’s approval for its proposed ₹5,000 Cr–₹6,000 Cr public offering. It is targeting a valuation of around $5 Bn (₹47,000 Cr), with a listing likely between January and March 2027, sources previously told Inc42. The timeline could put its debut ahead of PhonePe’s proposed March listing.

title: Google, Meta risk fines up to 5% of global revenue: Inside Australia’s new law to curb harmful online content
title_bn: গুগল, মেটা বিশ্বব্যাপী আয়ের ৫% পর্যন্ত জরিমানার ঝুঁকিতে রয়েছেঃ ক্ষতিকারক অনলাইন সামগ্রী নিয়ন্ত্রণের জন্য অস্ট্রেলিয়ার নতুন আইনের ভিতরে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Australia has passed the Digital Duty of Care law, requiring Google, Meta and other major platforms to proactively tackle harmful online content or face fines of up to 5% of their global revenue.
paragraph1: Australia has passed the Digital Duty of Care law, requiring Google, Meta and other major platforms to proactively tackle harmful online content or face fines of up to 5% of their global revenue.Google and Meta under pressure as Australia passes landmark law to tackle harmful online content.(AI generated image for representational purposes only)Australia has passed a new online safety law that requires major technology companies, including Google and Meta, to take proactive steps to remove harmful content and features from their platforms. The Digital Duty of Care bill passed the Australian Parliament and will be enacted in a year. Its goal is for technology companies to now be directly liable for safeguarding users against online harm, with any company risking up to 5% of its global annual turnover or A$109m ($72m) as a fine.The new law brings together different Australian codes for Internet safety into one overarching, more comprehensive regime. It holds internet platforms liable for discovering potential risks and dealing with content that is harmful to users before it can reach them.
paragraph2: According to Reuters, the legislation could significantly increase regulatory pressure on global technology companies operating in Australia. Australia warns Big Tech over online safety responsibilities Communications Minister Anika Wells said the bill is a significant step towards creating safer online environments. She compared the reforms to the earlier initiatives in Australia on compulsory seatbelts, plain cigarette packaging and gun control."The Digital Duty of Care is a landmark safety reform," Wells said in a statement following the law's passage. She added that technology companies could no longer avoid responsibility for the safety of Australians using their platforms. The bill is unveiled as Australia and key American tech firms clash over digital rules.New law targets harmful online content and featuresThe Digital Duty of Care applies to platforms' content that encourages hostile attitudes towards women or gender equality.
paragraph3: It also covers material that glorifies criminal activities, encourages dangerous stunts or promotes seriously harmful practices.However, the broad definitions have raised concerns among technology companies and free speech advocates. Industry bodies have said that the law provides a lot of flexibility for the government to determine what is harmful content.According to Reuters, technology companies have also warned that the threat of substantial financial penalties could encourage excessive content removal. Platforms may be more conservative in their content and remove valid content to prevent legal trouble.Australia steps up scrutiny of global technology companiesThe new law sits alongside an emerging suite of laws which have been enacted in Australia to regulate big online platforms. In December 2025, the country became the first in the world to ban children under 16 from using social media.
paragraph4: The government is also to consider initiatives that would require major digital platforms to pay licensing fees for news use.The Digital Duty of Care will come into effect in a year, and technology companies will need to review how they find, manage and remove harmful material from their services in Australia.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting.
paragraph5: She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.
bangla_paragraph1: অস্ট্রেলিয়া ডিজিটাল ডিউটি অফ কেয়ার আইন পাস করেছে, যা গুগল, মেটা এবং অন্যান্য প্রধান প্ল্যাটফর্মগুলিকে ক্ষতিকারক অনলাইন সামগ্রীকে সক্রিয়ভাবে মোকাবেলা করতে বাধ্য করে বা তাদের বিশ্বব্যাপী আয়ের ৫% পর্যন্ত জরিমানার মুখোমুখি হয়। গুগলের এবং মেটাকে চাপ দেওয়া হচ্ছে কারণ অস্ট্রেলািয়া ক্ষতিকর অনলাইন সামগ্রি মোকাবেন এমন একটি ঐতিহাসিক আইন পাস করে।
bangla_paragraph2: রয়টার্স অনুসারে, আইনটি অস্ট্রেলিয়ায় পরিচালিত বৈশ্বিক প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলির উপর নিয়ন্ত্রক চাপ উল্লেখযোগ্যভাবে বাড়িয়ে তুলতে পারে। অস্ট্রেলা অনলাইন সুরক্ষা দায়িত্ব সম্পর্কে বিগ টেককে সতর্ক করেছে যোগাযোগমন্ত্রী আনিকা ওয়েলস বলেছেন যে বিলটি আরও নিরাপদ অনলাইন পরিবেশ তৈরির দিকে একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পদক্ষেপ। তিনি অস্ট্রালিয়ায় বাধ্যতামূলক সিটবেল্ট, সাধারণ সিগারেট প্যাকেজিং এবং বন্দুক নিয়ন্ত্রণের আগের উদ্যোগের সাথে সংস্কারের তুলনা করেছেন। "ডিজিটাল ডিউটি অফ কেয়ার একটি ঐতিহাসিক সুরক্ষা রিপোর্ট।
bangla_paragraph3: এটি অপরাধমূলক কার্যকলাপকে গৌরবান্বিত করে, বিপজ্জনক স্টান্টগুলিকে উত্সাহ দেয় বা গুরুতর ক্ষতিকারক অনুশীলনগুলিকে প্রচার করে এমন সামগ্রীকেও অন্তর্ভুক্ত করে। যাইহোক, বিস্তৃত সংজ্ঞাগুলি প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলি এবং বাক স্বাধীনতার সমর্থকদের মধ্যে উদ্বেগ সৃষ্টি করেছে। শিল্প সংস্থাগুলি বলেছে যে আইনটি ক্ষতিকর সামগ্রী কী তা নির্ধারণের জন্য সরকারের জন্য প্রচুর নমনীয়তা সরবরাহ করে। রয়টার্স অনুসারে, প্রযুক্তি সংস্থারাও সতর্ক করেছে যে উল্লেখযোগ্য আর্থিক জরিমানার হুমকি অত্যধিক সামগ্রীকে উত্থাপন করতে পারে।
bangla_paragraph4: সরকার এমন উদ্যোগগুলিও বিবেচনা করবে যা বড় ডিজিটাল প্ল্যাটফর্মগুলিকে সংবাদ ব্যবহারের জন্য লাইসেন্সিং ফি প্রদানের প্রয়োজন। ডিজিটাল ডিউটি অফ কেয়ার এক বছরের মধ্যে কার্যকর হবে এবং প্রযুক্তি সংস্থাগুলিকে তাদের পরিষেবাগুলি থেকে ক্ষতিকারক সামগ্রী কীভাবে খুঁজে, পরিচালনা এবং অপসারণ করে তা পর্যালোচনা করতে হবে। লেখক সম্পর্কেপ্রজ্ঞ সিংহ রায়প্রজ্ঞার ডিজিটাল মিডিয়া এবং সামগ্রী লেখার চার বছরেরও বেশি অভিজ্ঞতা রয়েছে। তিনি সাংবাদিকতায় স্নাতকোত্তর ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেছেন এবং সিএ।
bangla_paragraph5: প্রয়াগ্য একটি প্রফুল্ল গেমার এবং কাল্পনিক গল্পের অনুরাগী। তিনি গেমস এবং বইয়ের মাধ্যমে নিমজ্জনমূলক জগতগুলি অন্বেষণ করতে পছন্দ করেন, বিশেষত গল্পগুলিতে বিশেষ আগ্রহ রয়েছে যা নতুন দৃষ্টিভঙ্গি, ধারণা এবং অভিজ্ঞতা সরবরাহ করে।

title: PayU India Turns Adjusted EBITDA Profitable In H1 FY27
title_bn: ২৭ অর্থবছরের প্রথমার্ধে পেইউ ইন্ডিয়া সংশোধিত ইবিআইটিডিএ লাভজনক করেছে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Prosus-owned fintech company PayU India swung to an adjusted EBITDA profit of $12 Mn in the first half of FY27…
paragraph1: SUMMARYPayU India swung to an adjusted EBITDA profit of $12 Mn in the first half of FY27 (H1 FY27), compared to a loss of $1 Mn in the year-ago period The development comes as Prosus reported a mixed performance across its India portfolio, with the also disclosing an 8.6% fully diluted stake in Navi However, adjusted EBIT remained negative at $3 Mn, although this was an improvement from a loss of $15 Mn in H1 FY26 Prosus-owned fintech company PayU India swung to an adjusted EBITDA profit of $12 Mn in the first half of FY27 (H1 FY27), compared to a loss of $1 Mn in the year-ago period, driven by growth in its lending business. However, adjusted EBIT remained negative at $3 Mn, although this was an improvement from a loss of $15 Mn in H1 FY26. The bottom line improvements come despite a 3.3% decline in its revenue to $384 Mn from $397 Mn in the last year period. However, disclosing the numbers, Prosus said PayU’s revenue grew 6% in local currency, excluding the impact of mergers and acquisitions (M&A). Excluding strategically cancelled merchant accounts, revenue growth stood at 13% and transaction volumes grew 20% in local currency.
paragraph2: The development comes as Prosus reported a mixed performance across its India portfolio, with the Dutch technology investor also disclosing an 8.6% fully diluted stake in Sachin Bansal-led fintech startup Navi following a $100 Mn investment. Separately, it recognised a $103 Mn impairment on an unnamed listed equity-accounted investment in its Indian ecosystem. The distinction is important as PayU has been exiting merchant accounts that do not meet its profitability requirements, affecting reported payments revenue but improving the quality of its business. PayU’s Credit Business Drives Profitability PayU’s payments business continued to account for the larger share of its revenue, contributing $265 Mn in H1 FY27. However, payments revenue declined 12% YoY in dollar terms, or 4% in local currency, reflecting the timing of the Diwali festive season and strategic merchant exits. Despite the revenue decline, the payments segment’s gross margin improved to 25% from 23% in H1 FY26.
paragraph3: In contrast, PayU’s credit business’ revenue grew by 24% YoY to $119 Mn. This business also turned adjusted EBITDA positive, recording a profit of $10 Mn against a loss of $3 Mn in the year-ago period. Credit revenue grew 36% in local currency. The lending business accounted for around 31% of PayU’s total revenue during the period, compared to 24% a year earlier. Its credit assets under management (AUM) also grew 20% YoY. Prosus Completes $100 Mn Navi Investment At a group level, Prosus disclosed that it completed its $100 Mn investment in Navi in November 2026, acquiring a 9.1% ownership stake in the fintech company.
paragraph4: The investment follows approval from the Competition Commission of India (CCI). Prosus said it would account for Navi as an equity-accounted investment, citing the significant influence it holds through board representation. Based on the $100 Mn investment and the fully diluted ownership percentage, the transaction implies an equity valuation of approximately $1.2 Bn for Navi, as per Inc42’s calculations. Separately, Prosus recognised a $103 Mn impairment on a listed equity-accounted investment in its India ecosystem during H1 FY27, following a significant decline in the investment’s market value relative to its carrying value. The investor attributed the broader market pressure to factors including higher oil prices, elevated global interest rates and a weaker rupee. Prosus reported total impairments of $136 Mn on equity-accounted investments during the period.
paragraph5: Of this, $103 Mn related to the listed investment in its India ecosystem, while the remaining $33 Mn was associated with unlisted investments in its other ecosystem. To note, this impairment reflects a reduction in the carrying value of Prosus’ investment and does not represent a loss incurred by the portfolio company itself. The disclosures come as Prosus continues to reshape its portfolio through investments, operational improvements and capital allocation. The company reported 59% growth in ecosystem revenue to $5.7 Bn in H1 FY27, while ecosystem adjusted EBITDA stood at $492 Mn, compared to $530 Mn in the year-ago period. In India, Prosus said that its ecosystem now reaches more than 500 Mn annual users and processes around 450 Mn orders a month, with PayU’s payment infrastructure embedded across several portfolio businesses.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসারProsus India FY27 (H1 FY27) এর প্রথমার্ধে $12M এর একটি সমন্বিত EBITDA মুনাফা অর্জন করেছে, যা আগের বছরের সময়ের তুলনায় $1M এর ক্ষতির তুলনায় কম। এই উন্নয়ন ঘটেছে যখন প্রোসাস তার ভারত পোর্টফোলিও জুড়ে মিশ্র পারফরম্যান্সের প্রতিবেদন দিয়েছে, যেখানে NAVI-তে 8.6% সম্পূর্ণরূপে হ্রাসকৃত শেয়ারও প্রকাশ করেছে।
bangla_paragraph2: এই উন্নয়নটি ঘটেছে যখন প্রোসাস তার ভারত পোর্টফোলিও জুড়ে মিশ্র পারফরম্যান্সের প্রতিবেদন করেছে, ডাচ প্রযুক্তি বিনিয়োগকারীও ১০০ মিলিয়ন ডলারের বিনিয়োগের পরে শচীন বানসাল নেতৃত্বাধীন ফিনটেক স্টার্টআপ নভির ৮.৬% সম্পূর্ণরূপে হ্রাস পেয়েছে। পৃথকভাবে এটি তার ভারতীয় বাস্তুতন্ত্রের একটি নামহীন তালিকাভুক্ত ইক্যুইটি-অ্যাকাউন্টেড বিনিয়োগের জন্য ১০৩ মিলিয়ন ডলারে ক্ষতি স্বীকার করেছে। পার্থক্যটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ কারণ পেইউ তার মুনাফা প্রয়োজনীয়তা পূরণ না করে এমন মার্চেন্ট অ্যাকাউন্টগুলি থেকে বেরিয়ে আসছে, যা প্রতিবেদনকে প্রভাবিত করে।
bangla_paragraph3: এর বিপরীতে, পেইউউ এর ক্রেডিট ব্যবসায়ের আয়  বছরে 24% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছিল, যা ১১৯ মিলিয়ন ডলার। এই ব্যবসাটিও সমন্বিত ইবিআইটিডিএ ইতিবাচক হয়ে উঠেছিল, গত বছরের সময়কালে $ 3 মিলিয়ন ক্ষতির তুলনায় $ 10 মিলিয়ন মুনাফা রেকর্ড করেছিল। স্থানীয় মুদ্রায় ক্রেদিট আয় ৩% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছিলো। ঋণ ব্যবসায়টি এক বছরের তুলনায় ২৪% এর তুলনায় এই সময়ের মধ্যে পেইইউ এর মোট আয়ের প্রায় ৩১% ছিল। পরিচালিত ক্রেডিট সম্পদ (এইউএম) এছাড়াও ২০% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে। প্রোসাস ১০০ মিলিয়ন ন্যাভি বিনিয়োগ সম্পন্ন করেছে। গ্রুপ স্তরে, প্রোসস প্রকাশ করেছে
bangla_paragraph4: এই বিনিয়োগ ভারতের প্রতিযোগিতা কমিশন (সিসিআই) এর অনুমোদনের পরে ঘটে। প্রোসাস বলেছে যে এটি বোর্ডের প্রতিনিধিত্বের মাধ্যমে এটির উল্লেখযোগ্য প্রভাবের কথা উল্লেখ করে নভিকে ইক্যুইটি-অ্যাকাউন্টেড বিনিয়োগ হিসাবে অ্যাকাউন্ট করবে। ১০০ মিলিয়ন ডলারের বিনিয়োগ এবং সম্পূর্ণরূপে হ্রাসকৃত মালিকানা শতাংশের ভিত্তিতে, লেনদেনটি ইনক 42 এর গণনার মতে নভির জন্য প্রায় ১.২ বিলিয়ন ডলারের ইক্যুটি মূল্যায়ন বোঝায়। পৃথকভাবে, প্রোসস একটি তালিকাভুক্ত ইক্যুটি-অ্যাকাউন্টেড ইনভেস্টমেন্টের উপর ১০৩ মিলিয়ন ডলারে হ্রাস স্বীকার করেছে

title: iPhone 18e tipped for Pro-style camera redesign; iPhone Air 2 may get second camera
title_bn: আইফোন ১৮ ই প্রো-স্টাইল ক্যামেরা পুনরায় ডিজাইন করার জন্য পরামর্শ দেওয়া হয়েছে; আইফোন এয়ার ২ দ্বিতীয় ক্যামেরা পেতে পারে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple's iPhone 18e may get a raised square camera plateau like the M5 iPad Pro, per leaked CAD renders. iPhone Air 2 is tipped to add an ultra-wide camera.
paragraph1: Apple's iPhone 18e may get a raised square camera plateau like the M5 iPad Pro, per leaked CAD renders. iPhone Air 2 is tipped to add an ultra-wide camera.iPhone 18 Pro in hand.(Pragya Singha Roy/Mint)Apple is reportedly planning a major design change for its affordable iPhone 18e, with new leaks pointing to a redesigned rear camera module. According to Engadget, CAD renders of the upcoming phone show a raised, square camera plateau housing the single rear camera, LED flash and microphone. The change could bring the budget iPhone's design closer to that of Apple's premium models.The iPhone 18e is expected to arrive in spring 2027 alongside the iPhone 18 and the iPhone Air 2, in line with Apple's anticipated two-part launch strategy, with premium models first and affordable ones later. The same leak also offers new details on the iPhone Air 2's camera upgrade, which could address one of the first-generation model's biggest complaints.
paragraph2: iPhone 18e could feature a redesigned camera module The iPhone 18e could feature a compact camera plateau measuring approximately 28 mm by 35 mm. There will be one camera at the back of the module, an LED flash and a microphone. It's said to look like the camera module on Apple's M5 iPad Pro.This would be a major change from the iPhone 17e, which had a single rear camera with only a small bump rather than a dedicated camera plateau. Engadget noted that the CAD images came from a supply chain source that has previously shared accurate information on the iPhone 17 and iPhone 18 Pro colours.The iPhone 18e's specifications are expected to stay largely unchanged from its predecessor, including the 48 MP rear camera. The front camera could be upgraded from 12 MP to 24 MP. Other expected specifications include a 6.
paragraph3: 12-inch LTPS OLED display with a 60 Hz refresh rate and Apple's new A20 chipset.iPhone Air 2 tipped to get a second rear cameraThe leaked CAD files also offer further confirmation that Apple is working on a dual-camera setup for the iPhone Air 2. The second-generation model could feature two horizontally aligned rear cameras, potentially adding an ultra-wide sensor alongside the primary camera.Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, tipster Digital Chat Station, and analyst Jeff Pu have also reported that Apple is planning to launch an ultra-wide camera on the iPhone 12.While the camera is upgraded, the device is still likely to have the same 5.6 mm thin design. Its camera module could become slightly thicker, increasing from 3.45mm to 3.
paragraph4: 8mm.iPhone 18 series could retain the Dynamic Island designThe leaked CAD images also reveal that the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2 aren't getting the smaller cut-out display of the iPhone 18 Pro models.However, these details are based on early leaks and design files. Apple hasn't announced any details on the specs or design updates of the next iPhone. Final design and features may also be different by the time they reach the market in 2027.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact.
paragraph5: Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. excerpt: US-based VC firm VU Venture Partners, which has backed tech giants like OpenAI, SpaceX, Uber at early stages, has entered…
paragraph1: SUMMARYVU Venture Partners, which has backed tech giants like OpenAI, SpaceX, Uber at early stages, has entered the Indian market The expansion comes as global venture capital firms continue to explore India's startup ecosystem, particularly in AI, deeptech, fintech and more The firm said that it will deploy capital through its global fund and investor syndicate, which comprises more than 8,000 accredited investors US-based VC firm VU Venture Partners, which has backed tech giants like OpenAI, SpaceX, Uber at early stages, has entered the Indian market. The firm will look to back early-stage startups (seed, Series A levels) and its ticket sizes would range from $100K to $1 Mn. It will look to build an India portfolio concentrated around nine sectors — AI, robotics, space and defence, advanced computing, healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech and industrials, including proptech and climate. The firm said that it will deploy capital through its global fund and investor syndicate, which comprises more than 8,000 accredited investors.
paragraph2: Alongside making equity investments in the world’s third largest startup ecosystem, VU Venture Partners has also introduced its investor accelerator programme, Venture University, in India. For context, Venture University offers an 11-week investor education programme comprising a 40-hour VC workshop and modules, followed by an apprenticeship lasting approximately three to 12 months with VU Venture Partners. The accelerator will accept up to 25 participants per quarter, including aspiring venture capital professionals, angel investors, family offices, emerging and established fund managers, and fund-of-funds. The programme’s first cohort is scheduled to begin on April 5, 2027, with applications now open.
paragraph3: The firm said its previous accelerator cohorts have collectively invested more than $80 Mn across 125+ companies, including over 12 unicorns. Its portfolio includes companies such as Neuralink, Anduril, Figure and Varda, among others. Overall, VU Venture Partners’ senior investment team has deployed more than $2 Bn across 300+ companies, backed over 30 unicorns and recorded more than 20 multi-billion-dollar exits, according to the company. The firm’s India expansion will be supported by Anaina Malik, a partner on its India team, alongside members of its Hong Kong and Australia teams.
paragraph4: VU Venture Partners said it has already made investments in India, including diagnostics startup Redcliffe Labs and hospitality startup goSTOPS. The expansion comes as global venture capital firms continue to explore India’s startup ecosystem, particularly in AI, deeptech, fintech and other emerging sectors. VU Venture Partners’ India expansion comes amid renewed interest from global investors in the country’s startup ecosystem, with several firms committing fresh capital or setting up investment vehicles focused on emerging technology sectors. In February 2026, General Catalyst announced plans to invest $5 Bn in Indian startups over five years, targeting sectors such as AI, defence, healthcare, fintech and industrials.
paragraph5: Qualcomm Ventures also committed up to $150 Mn through a dedicated strategic AI venture fund for Indian startups, with a focus on AI applications across automotive, robotics, IoT and mobile technologies. Accel also closed its ninth India-focused fund with a $550 Mn corpus in August, targeting AI, deeptech and other early-stage businesses. The fund was part of a larger $3.5 Bn global fundraising exercise and came roughly 18 months after its previous India fund.

title: Foxconn India Unit Faces Insolvency Plea Over ₹143 Cr In Alleged Dues
title_bn: ফক্সকন ইন্ডিয়া ইউনিট ১৪৩ কোটি টাকার অভিযোগে দেউলিয়া হওয়ার মুখে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple iPhone assembler Foxconn Technology Group’s India unit is facing an insolvency petition from BCD Emprasa LLP, which is seeking…
paragraph1: SUMMARYBCD Emprasa has filed an insolvency petition against Foxconn’s India unit, seeking nearly ₹143 Cr in alleged dues, interest, service charges, and damages. Payment delays have reportedly stretched beyond a year for some vendors, leaving local contractors waiting to recover money spent supporting Foxconn’s Bengaluru manufacturing operations. BCD leased 700 residential units for Foxconn’s female employees under an April 2024 agreement that required rent payments regardless of occupancy, with a lock-in until July 2026. Apple iPhone assembler Foxconn Technology Group’s India unit is facing an insolvency petition from BCD Emprasa LLP, which is seeking nearly ₹143 Cr (around $15 Mn) in alleged unpaid dues, interest, service charges, and damages. BCD filed the petition before the Chennai bench of the NCLT in August against Foxconn Hon Hai Technology India Mega Development Pvt Ltd, Bloomberg reported, citing the filing. The claim, calculated as of July 8, relates to alleged defaults on rent and utility payments for accommodation leased to house employees working at Foxconn’s Bengaluru facility.
paragraph2: The petition comes amid reported payment delays affecting about half a dozen local vendors working with Foxconn’s India unit. Queries sent by Inc42 to BCD Emprasa remained unanswered till the time of publication. The story will be updated on receiving their responses. Replying to Inc42’s queries, the company claimed that the dispute arose from “the supplier’s failure to meet agreed contractual requirements and quality standards. Despite repeated requests for corrective action, the outstanding issues remain unresolved.” “As the matter is now subject to legal proceedings, Foxconn will take appropriate steps to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests through the legal process and will refrain from commenting further on the specifics of the case,” it added.
paragraph3: Employee Housing Dispute Under an agreement signed in April 2024, BCD leased 700 residential units to accommodate Foxconn’s female employees. The agreement required rent to be paid regardless of occupancy and included a lock-in period extending until July 2026, according to the filing cited by Bloomberg. BCD alleged that Foxconn failed to clear an invoice due in May 2025 and did not agree to appoint an arbitrator to resolve the dispute. In a response to Bloomberg, BCD said the alleged defaults caused significant financial and commercial losses, adding that the matter was sub judice before the NCLT. Other Vendors Await Payments Beyond BCD, at least four other vendors have reportedly been waiting for several months to more than a year for Foxconn to clear their dues, the report said, citing sources. Several of these vendors were engaged in construction-related work at the company’s Bengaluru facility and had been working with the iPhone manufacturer for the first time.
paragraph4: The departure of certain non-Indian employees also reportedly slowed down the processing of payments to local contractors. The disputes come amid Foxconn’s continued investment in its Indian manufacturing operations. In June, its Singapore subsidiary invested $37.2 Mn in Foxconn Hon Hai Technology India Mega Development. The company has also been expanding its component manufacturing ambitions. In May last year, it infused nearly $1.
paragraph5: 5 Bn into its Tamil Nadu-registered entity Yuzhan Technology (India). It subsequently explored setting up another unit in the state to manufacture iPhone enclosures.
