title: Aeravti Ventures Launches ₹300 Cr Fund II, Marks First Close At Over ₹150 Cr
title_bn: এয়ারভটি ভেঞ্চারস ৩০০ কোটি টাকার দ্বিতীয় তহবিল চালু করেছে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Bengaluru-based VC firm Aeravti Ventures has launched its second fund, Aeravti Ventures II, with a target corpus of ₹300 Cr,…
paragraph1: SUMMARYAeravti Ventures has launched its ₹300 Cr Fund II, securing commitments exceeding ₹150 Cr at the first close. It expects to complete fundraising within six months. The fund expands Aeravti’s focus into physical infrastructure-led businesses, alongside food and healthcare, with plans to back 9-10 early-stage startups. Fund II will write initial cheques of ₹6-10 Cr, with follow-on investments of ₹1-–25 Cr. It has already backed three undisclosed startups.
paragraph2: Bengaluru-based VC firm Aeravti Ventures has launched its second fund, Aeravti Ventures II, with a target corpus of ₹300 Cr, securing commitments exceeding ₹150 Cr at its first close. The Category II AIF has attracted capital from LPs of its maiden fund, corporates, family offices, high-net-worth individuals (HNIs), and ultra HNIs. The firm expects to complete the final close within six months and said the capital would be deployed over the next 10 years. Fund II will back 9-10 early-stage startups across three broad themes: food security, health infrastructure, and physical infrastructure. Its focus will span agriculture and allied sectors, biosciences, life sciences, advanced manufacturing, waste management, and energy.
paragraph3: The launch expands Aeravti’s investment strategy into physical infrastructure-led businesses, alongside its existing focus on food and healthcare. The new fund will invest from pre-seed to pre-Series A, with a preference for leading pre-seed and seed rounds. Backing Startups Beyond Seed Stage Aeravti plans to write initial cheques of ₹6 Cr to ₹10 Cr per startup, retaining capacity to invest another 2-3 times the initial amount in subsequent rounds. Follow-on investments would typically be considered 12-18 months after the initial investment, with cheque sizes of ₹10–25 Cr. The fund has already backed three startups but the firm did not disclose their names.
paragraph4: Aeravti Ventures managing partner Rishabh Singh told Inc42 that founder resilience is the firm’s most important consideration when evaluating early-stage businesses. The strategy builds on its maiden fund, which achieved a final close of ₹76 Cr and is fully deployed across seven startups. Aeravti led the seed rounds in all seven companies. The firm had announced the first close of its maiden fund in May 2023, when it was targeting a ₹100 Cr corpus to back emerging technology startups across deeptech, biosciences, agritech, climate, and enterprise tech. Discussing the fundraising environment, Singh said raising capital has become difficult for venture funds in India and globally, reinforcing the need for investment firms to sharpen their focus.
paragraph5: He cautioned against pursuing emerging sectors simply because they are attracting attention elsewhere, arguing that India needs to develop its own VC and startup ecosystem rather than following the US playbook.

title: Massive data leak exposes 3.5 billion records worldwide, putting usernames, passwords and identities at risk
title_bn: বিশাল সংখ্যক তথ্য ফাঁস বিশ্বব্যাপী ৩.৫ বিলিয়ন রেকর্ডকে প্রকাশ করে, ব্যবহারকারীর নাম, পাসওয়ার্ড এবং পরিচয়কে ঝুঁকিতে ফেলে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Two unsecured databases exposed over 3.5 billion records, including passwords, session tokens and 840 million Chinese national ID numbers, WIRED reported. The figure counts records, not unique people, and it is unclear whether anyone downloaded the d
paragraph1: Two unsecured databases exposed over 3.5 billion records, including passwords, session tokens and 840 million Chinese national ID numbers, WIRED reported. The figure counts records, not unique people, and it is unclear whether anyone downloaded the data before access was cut off.Representational image of a cyber attack.(Pexels)Two unsecured databases containing more than 3.5 billion records, including usernames, passwords, national identity numbers and personal documents, have been exposed online, raising fresh concerns about global cybersecurity. Two separate security researchers found the databases and accessed them without authentication. The data covers individuals and groups in dozens of countries, and one database holds over a billion records linked to China, according to a WIRED report published on November 25.Cybercriminals could use such information to hijack online accounts, impersonate users and carry out financial fraud.
paragraph2: The leaked data includes in-depth victim profiles, which could give criminals access to a wide range of personal information, researchers said. However, the 3.5 billion figure counts records, not unique individuals, as it may include duplicate entries and multiple accounts belonging to the same person. Info-stealing malware exposed nearly 2 billion login records Black Hills Information Security's Jeremiah Fowler discovered the first database. According to his findings shared with WIRED, it contained approximately two billion login records, including email addresses, usernames, passwords, cookies, session tokens and device information.The information was organised into 8,471 folders, with some records categorised by country. Fowler also found hundreds of millions of email addresses, over 100 million social media accounts and tens of millions of e-commerce accounts.A fair amount of the information was apparently collected via infostealer malware that steals saved passwords and other highly sensitive data from compromised machines. Fowler also uncovered approximately 400,000 documents that may have been collected by more sophisticated malware capable of creating comprehensive profiles of people.
paragraph3: He said the data could provide attackers with a wealth of information to control the victim's digital identity. Fowler notified the database's hosting company of the exposed database, which limited public access several days later. However, it remains unknown whether anyone downloaded the information before it was secured.1.64 billion records linked to China also exposedThe second database was found by cybersecurity firm UpGuard's research director Greg Pollock. His investigation uncovered some 1.64 billion records, most of which are linked to Chinese people and enterprises.Pollock found that the database included at least 840 million individual national identity numbers, 300 million phone numbers, almost 11 million student enrolment records, and nearly 8 million business registrations. Details of children and the dead were sometimes included in some records.
paragraph4: The database was available for open access and appeared to be part of cybercrime or grey-market infrastructure. Pollock could not identify its owner or establish whether the information had been circulated elsewhere. During his investigation, the database became inaccessible, perhaps as a result of ransomware or another malicious action.Growing concerns over AI-powered cyberattacksThe findings coincide with growing worry over advanced cyberattacks and the misuse of AI. Earlier, Google's Threat Intelligence Group had found AI models that can help agents detect vulnerabilities and strategise cyberattacks with little to no human involvement.Microsoft has also issued a warning about hackers in China leveraging AI tools to attack organisations worldwide.For comparison, one of the largest previously identified data exposures was the 2024 incident known as the 'Mother of All Breaches', which reportedly involved 26 billion records. The new findings confirm the dangers of unsecured databases and the significant accumulation of stolen personal information.About the AuthorPragya Singha RoyPragya is a Technology reporter with over four years of experience in digital media and content writing.
paragraph5: She holds a Master’s degree in Journalism and has covered a wide range of stories spanning space, smartphones, gadgets, artificial intelligence, emerging technologies and the ways technology is transforming everyday life. She focuses on breaking down complex technology and science developments into clear, engaging, and reader-friendly stories, with a keen interest in emerging trends and their real-world impact. Before joining her current newsroom, Pragya worked with News9Live, where she covered the technology beat extensively, reporting on smartphones, consumer technology, AI, space and science, while also contributing to video and visual content. Her experience includes breaking news, explainers, SEO-driven stories, product coverage, interviews, unboxing videos and live event reporting. She has also covered major technology and AI events, giving her experience in both newsroom and on-ground reporting. Beyond journalism, Pragya is an avid gamer and a passionate reader of fiction. She enjoys exploring immersive worlds through games and books, with a particular interest in stories that offer new perspectives, ideas, and experiences.

bangla_paragraph2: The leaked data includes in-depth victim profiles, which could give criminals access to a wide range of personal information, researchers said. However, the 3.5 billion figure counts records, not unique individuals, as it may include duplicate entries and multiple accounts belonging to the same person. Info-stealing malware exposed nearly 2 billion login records Black Hills Information Security's Jeremiah Fowler discovered the first database. According to his findings shared with WIRED, it contained approximately two billion login records, including email addresses, usernames, passwords, cookies, session tokens and device information.The information was organised into 8,471 folders, with some records categorised by country. Fowler also found hundreds of millions of email addresses, over 100 million social media accounts and tens of millions of e-commerce accounts.A fair amount of the information was apparently collected via infostealer malware that steals saved passwords and other highly sensitive data from compromised machines. Fowler also uncovered approximately 400,000 documents that may have been collected by more sophisticated malware capable of creating comprehensive profiles of people.
bangla_paragraph3: He said the data could provide attackers with a wealth of information to control the victim's digital identity. Fowler notified the database's hosting company of the exposed database, which limited public access several days later. However, it remains unknown whether anyone downloaded the information before it was secured.1.64 billion records linked to China also exposedThe second database was found by cybersecurity firm UpGuard's research director Greg Pollock. His investigation uncovered some 1.64 billion records, most of which are linked to Chinese people and enterprises.Pollock found that the database included at least 840 million individual national identity numbers, 300 million phone numbers, almost 11 million student enrolment records, and nearly 8 million business registrations. Details of children and the dead were sometimes included in some records.
bangla_paragraph4: The database was available for open access and appeared to be part of cybercrime or grey-market infrastructure. Pollock could not identify its owner or establish whether the information had been circulated elsewhere. During his investigation, the database became inaccessible, perhaps as a result of ransomware or another malicious action.Growing concerns over AI-powered cyberattacksThe findings coincide with growing worry over advanced cyberattacks and the misuse of AI. Earlier, Google's Threat Intelligence Group had found AI models that can help agents detect vulnerabilities and strategise cyberattacks with little to no human involvement.Microsoft has also issued a warning about hackers in China leveraging AI tools to attack organisations worldwide.For comparison, one of the largest previously identified data exposures was the 2024 incident known as the 'Mother of All Breaches', which reportedly involved 26 billion records. paragraph1: KRAFTON India has rolled out the BGMI Air Open Beta for Android users on 25 November, ahead of its official 10 December launch. paragraph3: However, the game appeared on Apple's App Store for pre-registration ahead of its release.BGMI Air features and download sizeKRAFTON India claims BGMI Air will initially be 1 GB. title: AI agents set to reshape Indian workplaces as 93% of leaders plan adoption: KPMG-CII report
title_bn: এআই এজেন্টরা ভারতীয় কর্মক্ষেত্রে নতুন রূপ দিতে সক্ষম, ৯৩ শতাংশ নেতা এআই ব্যবহারের পরিকল্পনা করছেন: কেপিএমজি-সিআইআই রিপোর্ট
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Indian businesses are preparing to increasingly deploy artificial intelligence agents across their operations, with 93 per cent of leaders intending to use the technology to expand workforce capabilities and 59 per cent already using AI agents to aut
paragraph1: Indian businesses are preparing to increasingly deploy artificial intelligence agents across their operations, with 93 per cent of leaders intending to use the technology to expand workforce capabilities and 59 per cent already using AI agents to automate workstreams or business processes, according to a joint report by KPMG in India and the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII).AI agents set to reshape Indian workplaces as 93% of leaders plan adoption: KPMG-CII reportNew Delhi [India], November 25 (ANI): Indian businesses are preparing to increasingly deploy artificial intelligence agents across their operations, with 93 per cent of leaders intending to use the technology to expand workforce capabilities and 59 per cent already using AI agents to automate workstreams or business processes, according to a joint report by KPMG in India and the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII).The growing adoption of AI is also changing the skills companies require from employees, with businesses increasingly looking for workers who can combine technological expertise with human judgment, the report said.Highlighting the link between AI preparedness and business performance, it noted that 74 per cent of CEOs in India believe workforce readiness for AI will significantly affect growth over the next three years.
paragraph2: The report said AI is changing the nature of work by taking over or accelerating routine activities such as information retrieval, preparing first drafts, summarising information and routine analysis.“Artificial Intelligence is reshaping work at the level of tasks, workflows and decisions before it eliminates entire jobs,” it said.As these activities become increasingly automated, employees will be expected to focus more on defining problems, interpreting information, checking AI-generated results and translating insights into decisions.The report cautioned that simply training employees to use AI tools would not be enough.
paragraph3: They would also need to know how to direct the technology, assess its outputs and retain responsibility for important decisions.“The future skills challenge is therefore not simply to teach employees how to use AI tools, but to build the ability to direct AI, assess its outputs, manage exceptions and retain human ownership of consequential decisions,” it said.This shift is expected to increase pressure on companies to strengthen employee training, as the skills required across industries continue to evolve.Citing the World Economic Forum's Future of Jobs Report 2025, the report said 39 per cent of workers' core skills are expected to change by 2030, while 59 out of every 100 workers will need training by then.
paragraph4: It also identified skills gaps as the biggest barrier to business transformation, with 63 per cent of employers citing them as a challenge.The report added that 85 per cent of employers plan to prioritise workforce upskilling by 2030, while 70 per cent intend to hire people with new skills and 50 per cent expect to move employees from declining roles to areas of growing demand.It also highlighted the potential of skills-based hiring to expand the talent pool by 6.1 times across all roles and 8.
paragraph5: 2 times for AI-related jobs.The report further said businesses would increasingly need to identify, develop and redeploy workforce capabilities as technology and business requirements change.

title: Tidal Bans AI Music, While Apple Music Sticks to Labels
title_bn: Tidal Bans AI Music, While Apple Music Sticks to Labels
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Streaming music service Tidal today said it plans to start blocking AI music on December 9. Any track generated entirely with AI will be removed from the platform, with Tidal rejecting AI songs in the future. Tidal lead Robert Andersen said 43 percen
paragraph1: Tuesday November 24, 2026 3:44 pm PST by Juli CloverStreaming music service Tidal today said it plans to start blocking AI music on December 9. Any track generated entirely with AI will be removed from the platform, with Tidal rejecting AI songs in the future. Tidal lead Robert Andersen said 43 percent of tracks uploaded in the last 90 days have been flagged as AI-generated. Approximately 29 million songs will be deleted and Tidal expects 80,000 to 85,000 songs to be rejected per day. AI music will start disappearing on December 9 and will be "completely gone" at the beginning of 2027.
paragraph2: AI-assisted music will continue to be allowed, since the policy is only for songs made entirely with AI tools. Tidal previously demonetized AI music, but removing it goes a step further. Andersen said Tidal believes the move will "resonate with both artists and listeners alike" because 96 percent of AI songs get zero plays. Apple hasn't banned AI songs from Apple Music, but it introduced AI Transparency Tags earlier this year. Apple is relying on labels and distributors to disclose when AI has been used, and it said in August that tracks "materially generated using AI" must have a "Made With AI" label.
paragraph3: In April, ‌Apple Music‌ VP Oliver Schusser said that more than a third of monthly uploads to ‌Apple Music‌ are 100 percent AI-generated, but AI music accounted for less than 0.5 percent of actual listening. Popular StoriesApple Music's New Selfie Sing Feature Lets You Record Karaoke VideosTuesday November 3, 2026 4:05 pm PST by Juli CloveriOS 27.3 adds a new "Selfie Sing" feature in Apple Music that lets users record themselves while singing a song. There's a dedicated Selfie Sing playlist and a selfie camera view that shows lyrics on the screen while also recording a video.
paragraph4: Apple has a description of the feature: There are some songs everyone knows by heart, the ones that come on and suddenly the whole room's singing along. title: Add Holiday Lights and Snow to Your Mac With Festivitas
title_bn: আপনার ম্যাকের সাথে ছুটির আলো এবং তুষার যোগ করুন
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Festivitas is a fun little holiday-themed Mac app that developer Simon Støvring introduced two years ago and has been updating since. Its main purpose is to add lights to the Mac's Dock and menu bar, but there's also a version for the iPhone and iPad
paragraph1: Tuesday November 24, 2026 3:04 pm PST by Juli CloverFestivitas is a fun little holiday-themed Mac app that developer Simon Støvring introduced two years ago and has been updating since. Its main purpose is to add lights to the Mac's Dock and menu bar, but there's also a version for the iPhone and iPad. The holiday 2026 Festivitas update adds new customizations. For the first time, you can upload custom bulb shapes. There's an option to import an image and convert it to a bulb in a string of lights. Simple PNGs on a transparent background produce the best results, and for more complex images, bulbs can use the original colors. You can customize light shapes, color, size, opacity, drop height, cable thickness, and more in the Settings.
paragraph2: Lights can animate with different patterns, like pulse, twinkle, chase, and wave. There are pointer decorations like sparkles, bubbles, falling leaves, confetti, a Christmas tree, a wreath, and more. Falling snow will now pile up on top of app windows for an added holiday effect. You can adjust snow rate, density, and flake size. Snow and lights can be displayed above app windows or just on the desktop, with lights also visible on the Dock. Shortcuts can be used to play music and turn on lights, activate the snow effect if the weather forecast includes snow, and start a snowstorm. Along with custom bulb shapes and falling snow, Festivitas for the iPhone and ‌iPad‌ now fully transparent animated widgets on the without a screenshot workaround.
paragraph3: Festivitas for Mac requires some accessibility access to work. I asked Støvring about Apple's planned permission changes in macOS 27.3, and how they will affect the Festivitas app. He said Festivitas gets far more access than it needs because Apple's options aren't granular enough, and he'd prefer to ask for less access. Menu bar lights, snow, and pointer effects work without the System & App Protection Override permission, while lights in the Dock and snow landing on windows require access. Festivitas for the Mac offers customer-chosen fair pricing starting at 4.39 euros, and it can be downloaded from the Festivitas website.
paragraph4: The iPhone and ‌iPad‌ app is available for free from the App Store, and it too offers customer-selected fair pricing between $3.99 and $9.99. The updates are free for existing users. title: Android Auto is rolling out a new app navigation layout perfect for wide displays
title_bn: অ্যান্ড্রয়েড অটো একটি নতুন অ্যাপ নেভিগেশন লেআউট চালু করছে যা বড় ডিসপ্লেগুলির জন্য উপযুক্ত
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Android Auto 18.2 shows new side navigation in Spotify, YouTube Music, and more.
paragraph1: Andy Walker / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Android Auto appears to be introducing a new UI for many apps, with navigation options stacked on the side of the screen. Compared to screen-top navigation, the new interface should be easier for drivers to access without being distracted. So far, we’ve seen this look with Spotify, YouTube Music, Amazon Music, and the system dialer.
paragraph2: For as much as we like a good UI on our phones, interface design is arguably even more important when we’re looking at a platform like Android Auto, and today we’re checking out what seems to be an intuitive new upgrade with a big emphasis on easy touch controls.On Android Auto 18.2.
paragraph3: 664604-release, we’re starting to see apps adopt a new layout, trading screen-top navigation options for a list along the side. For an example, here’s how Spotify used to look:Compare that with how the app is starting to appear for Android Auto users now:Instead of having to stretch all the way across the screen to navigate within the app, all our options are conveniently lined up along one side. While that does result in some trade-offs in terms of the density of content on the display, what we do have left tends to be larger and makes better use of available space.
paragraph4: Beyond the new navigation layout, we also spot a few other small tweaks here, like a big new now-playing bar with album art and playback controls.We see a similar transition happening for YouTube Music. Here’s what we’ve had so far:AssembleDebug / Android AuthorityAnd now the new, side-navigation layout:AssembleDebug / Android AuthorityIn addition to Spotify and YouTube Music, we’ve also seen reports of the new look hitting Amazon Music.
paragraph5: But lest you start thinking that this change is only happening for media apps, we also see the new view coming to Android Auto’s dialer:Android Auto is on the edge of a big evolution right now, which Google teased earlier this year back in the leadup to I/O. That’s going to involve new widgets and expanded app support, but also a UI that’s just a whole lot more flexible across varying screen geometries. While we don’t recall seeing this particular tweak show up in any of those previews, it does feel like it’s reasonably in line with those changes.

title: Google Photos is forcing some Galaxy users to save every minor edit as a copy
title_bn: গুগল ফটোস কিছু গ্যালাক্সি ব্যবহারকারীদের ছোটখাটো সম্পাদনা কপি হিসেবে সংরক্ষণ করতে বাধ্য করছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: We've reproduced the issue on a Galaxy S23 FE.
paragraph1: Edgar Cervantes / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Google Photos is forcing some Samsung Galaxy users running One UI 9 to save even minor edits as separate copies. We’ve independently confirmed the absence of the regular Save option on a Galaxy S23 FE. Samsung has reportedly escalated the issue to its engineers, though it’s still unclear whether this is a bug or an intentional change. Google Photos is forcing some Samsung Galaxy users to save images with simple edits, like minor crops, as their own copies. As you might expect, this is already causing frustration among users who are now stuck deleting unnecessary copies from their Google Photos libraries every time they make a minor adjustment to an image.
paragraph2: For reference, the app has traditionally allowed users to simply overwrite original images after minor edits have been made to them. The tech giant recently went as far as letting users overwrite original images even after advanced edits like Magic Eraser, Unblur, or edits with UltraHDR and C2PA formats. That’s precisely why the sudden disappearance of the regular Save option for basic edits is perplexing.Users who have reported facing the bug all have one thing in common. They’re all Samsung users.
paragraph3: We’ve spotted complaints across Reddit and the Google Support forum, with all affected users also suggesting that they’re on One UI 9. Reports about the simple save option’s absence first surfaced all the way back in September, but it wasn’t until earlier this month that we observed a significant uptick in complaints.One user reported encountering the issue on their Samsung A35: Just the other day I noticed while cropped a screenshot that I could only save the photo as a copy rather than the original photo itself… I thought it was a one time fluke, but when editing other photos later in the day I noticed the same behavior: all photos in the Google Photos gallery can ONLY “save as copy.” A Z Fold 8 Ultra user expressed a similar frustration: On my Fold8 Ultra (One UI 9, Android 17), after the “Updating Photo Editor” notification, Google Photos offers only “Save as copy” for every edit, even a simple crop. A Galaxy S26 user took to the Google Support forum to complain: Google Photos used to let me save a simple crop to the original photo.
paragraph4: Now the editor only shows “Save as…” Why is Save no longer available, and how can I restore it without creating duplicate photos? Note that users report the Save button’s absence in photos taken from the phone’s camera, screenshots, and images saved from the internet. I checked my Galaxy S23 FE, and I can confirm that the regular Save button is absent for me as well. Here’s what I’m seeing on my device: After making a minor edit, Google Photos only offers a Save as copy option, with no regular Save button, not even in the three-dot menu, as seen in the screenshots above.At the moment, it is unclear if this is a bug or an intended change.
paragraph5: At least one user has confirmed that they’ve reported the issue to Samsung, and the company has reportedly passed the issue on to its engineers. We’ve also reached out to Samsung to confirm the same. We’ll update this article if and when we hear back.

title_bn: গুগল বলছে অ্যাপলের আইওএস ব্রাউজার নিয়মগুলো 'কাগজে পছন্দ, বাস্তবে নয়'
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Google's Chrome for Developers team today supported Mozilla's complaint about Apple's rules on non-WebKit browser engines in the European Union, calling out restrictions that make launching an alternative engine too difficult. Mozilla recently joined
paragraph1: Tuesday November 24, 2026 1:00 pm PST by Juli CloverGoogle's Chrome for Developers team today supported Mozilla's complaint about Apple's rules on non-WebKit browser engines in the European Union, calling out restrictions that make launching an alternative engine too difficult. Mozilla recently joined a coalition of up to 55,000 businesses and organizations to ask the European Commission to force Apple to change its browser rules. Apple started allowing alternative browser engines in the EU in early 2024, but the coalition says no browser maker has been able to transfer its EU users from Apple's WebKit engine to a new engine because of Apple's conditions. Mozilla explained that using its Gecko browser engine instead of WebKit would require releasing a second Firefox app. Apple says apps with alternative browser engines have to be distributed only in the EU, so Mozilla has been unable to add Gecko to its existing app. Firefox users in the EU would need to transfer to a new app and move all their content, and many users might not be willing to switch.
paragraph2: Mozilla said Apple's conditions are "unworkable" and that Apple has only complied with the EU's Digital Markets Act "on paper." Chrome for Developers echoed the statement in its X post: We agree with @mozilla. Nearly 3 years after alternative browser engines on iOS were EU-mandated, zero launched due to remaining Apple restrictions. Forcing browsers to ship separate apps and re-acquire users is choice on paper, not in practice. Though one Google team expressed support for Mozilla, Google did not sign the open letter to the European Commission. In 2023, Google started work on an experimental version of Chromium for iOS with the Blink engine, but Google said it was only a prototype that would not be released.
paragraph3: In June 2025, Mozilla and Apple participated in a DMA workshop where Mozilla brought up iOS support for third-party browser engines. According to Mozilla, Apple claimed Google and Mozilla have "everything they need" to ship an alternative browser engine in the EU and "have chosen not to do so." In its documentation for alternative browser engines, Apple says its requirements help keep users safe online. Following the open letter, the European Commission said it is in talks with Apple over its browser engine restrictions. It is also consulting Mozilla and other signatories on how rival browsers can compete with Safari on Apple devices. title: Tinkerers are turning old Kindles into DIY weather stations with a little help from AI
title_bn: Tinkerers are turning old Kindles into DIY weather stations with a little help from AI
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Kindles are getting new life after being discontinued.
paragraph1: Kaitlyn Cimino / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR Owners of old Kindles have found new life for them as DIY weather stations. After jailbreaking the devices, they’re vibe coding apps that display the weather and other information. As Amazon continues to end support for more Kindles, new uses for old Kindles are likely to become more popular. There is magic in reading a book, but when the device you read it on is no longer useful, you can always conjure it into something entirely different — which is what’s happening right now on the Kindle Jailbreak sub on Reddit. Posters are showing off old Kindles that now act as weather stations thanks to jailbreaking and a little vibe coding.One poster took their 7th-generation Kindle and used Claude for the transformation.
paragraph2: They went to kindlemodding.org and followed a guide to jailbreak their device and then added the Kindle Unified Application Launcher (KUAL), an app launcher made for modded Kindles.After that, they set the parameters for a weather station app with Claude. The Kindle is mounted on a wall and gets its data through Wi-Fi. The poster said the battery drain is only 10% per week because of power-saving measures they put in place. The app is set to update the data during the day at one-hour intervals, with the screen sleeping between updates.
paragraph3: The Wi-Fi is on only when data is fetched.The replies to the post turned up other people who found that their old Kindles also make for handy ways to check the weather, including a Pokémon-themed one that displays Pokédex entries alongside the time, date, and weather. One person said that they added news headlines to display next to the weather on theirs.Some said they were now inspired to start similar projects. As one poster put it, “Kindles are amazing post-jailbreak. I’m wanting to use it all the time.
paragraph4: Once you jailbreak it makes the thing come to life.”Another post on the same sub showed what looked like a fourth-generation Kindle Touch with a vibe-coded weather station app. “Works much better than any cheap weather gadget I’ve ever owned,” its creator wrote.Modifying Kindles has always been a thing, but the practice has picked up since Amazon announced in April that it would end support for older devices. This meant that not only would Kindles not get software and security updates, but they also could no longer download books from the Kindle Store. It was devastating news to people who had devices that were years old but still worked perfectly fine.
paragraph5: Just yesterday, Amazon added two other Kindles, the 10th-generation Kindle and the Kindle Paperwhite, to its end-of-life list for support, though it’s not clear yet if they will be able to access the Kindle Store.Putting these still functioning E-Ink tablets to other uses is a great way to keep them out of landfills and still adding to daily life.

bangla_paragraph1: আমির সিদ্দিকী / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষগুগলে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েডের কর্তৃত্ব যোগ করুন: আপনার আইফোনটি বাড়িতে দৌড়াতে বা হাঁটার জন্য রেখে যাওয়া অনেক সহজ যখন আপনার ঘড়ি এখনও কল নিতে পারে। 44 মিমি আকারের সেলুলার অ্যাপল ওয়াচ এসই 3 এখন অ্যামাজনে 259 ডলার, যা আপনাকে $ 329 তালিকা মূল্যের 70 ডলার (21%) সাশ্রয় করে। এটি সর্বকালের সর্বনিম্ন।

title: Your old smartphone is likely worth more now as a trade-in than it was last year
title_bn: আপনার পুরনো স্মার্টফোনটি সম্ভবত গত বছরের তুলনায় এখন বেশি মূল্যবান।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Old phones are fetching higher trade-in payouts than last year.
paragraph1: Robert Triggs / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR A new report has found that phone trade-in activity has declined year over year in the US. At the same time, trade-in values have increased significantly. The average trade-in value rose 27% for Android phones and 18% for iPhones. When it’s time to purchase a new phone, do you take advantage of the trade-in deals?
paragraph2: While your old phone could help you save money on your next handset, there are reasons why you may want to keep your old device. It appears more people are choosing to keep their old hardware these days, and in turn, that mindset is driving up the value of trade-ins.According to a report from Assurant, fewer smartphones in the US were traded in during Q3 2026 than in the same time frame last year. This is reportedly the first year since 2017 that money returned through trade-in programs declined year over year, excluding the pandemic.
paragraph3: Specifically, $1.53 billion was returned in Q3 2026, shrinking from $1.59 billion in 2025.Meanwhile, average trade-in value has spiked for both Android phones and iPhones.
paragraph4: The data states that iPhones reached an average of around $171, which is an 18% increase from before. Android phones experienced a noticeably bigger 27% increase in trade-in value, bringing the average to $112.There are several factors that could be contributing to the rise of trade-in value. For example, consumers are holding on to their old phones for longer.
paragraph5: The industry-wide RAM shortage is adding cost pressure to smartphone production. And the demand for pre-owned devices is growing, as a cheaper way to gain access to newer technology.
bangla_paragraph1: রবার্ট ট্রাইগস / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ গুগলে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড অথরিটি যুক্ত করুনঃ টিএল;ডিআর একটি নতুন প্রতিবেদনে দেখা গেছে যে মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে ফোনের বিনিময় কার্যকলাপ বছরের পর বছর হ্রাস পেয়েছে। একই সাথে, বিনিময় মূল্য উল্লেখযোগ্যভাবে বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে । অ্যান্ড্রেড ফোনগুলির জন্য গড় বিনিময় মান ২৭% এবং আইফোনগুলির জন্য ১৮% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছেন। যখন এটি একটি নতুন ফোন কেনার সময় আসে, আপনি কি বিনিময় চুক্তির সুবিধা গ্রহণ করেন?
bangla_paragraph2: আপনার পুরানো ফোনটি আপনার পরবর্তী হ্যান্ডসেটে অর্থ সাশ্রয় করতে সহায়তা করতে পারে, তবে আপনার পুরনো ডিভাইসটি রাখতে চাইতে পারে এমন কারণ রয়েছে। দেখা যাচ্ছে যে এই দিনগুলিতে আরও বেশি লোক তাদের পুরানো হার্ডওয়্যারটি রাখতে বেছে নিচ্ছে এবং ফলস্বরূপ, সেই মানসিকতা বাণিজ্য-এর মূল্যকে বাড়িয়ে তুলছে।অ্যাসুর্যান্টের একটি প্রতিবেদন অনুসারে, মার্কিন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রে কম স্মার্টফোনের বাণিজ্য করা হয়েছিল Q3 2026 গত বছরের একই সময়সীমার তুলনায়। এটি ২০১৭ সালের পর থেকে প্রথম বছর বলে জানা গেছে যে ট্রেড-ইন প্রোগ্রামগুলির মাধ্যমে অর্থ ফেরত কমেছে।
bangla_paragraph3: বিশেষ করে, ২০২৬ সালের তৃতীয় প্রান্তিকে ১.৫৩ বিলিয়ন ডলার ফেরত দেওয়া হয়েছিল, যা ২০২৫ সালে ১. ৫৯ বিলিয়ন ডলারের থেকে হ্রাস পেয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph4: তথ্য অনুযায়ী আইফোনের মূল্য গড়ে ১৭১ ডলারে পৌঁছেছে, যা আগের তুলনায় ১৮% বৃদ্ধি। অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ফোনের ট্রেড-ইন মূল্য ২৭% বৃদ্ধি পেয়েছে, যা গড় ১১২ ডলারে নিয়ে এসেছে। বেশ কয়েকটি কারণ রয়েছে যা ট্রেড ইন মূল্যের বৃদ্ধিতে অবদান রাখতে পারে। উদাহরণস্বরূপ, গ্রাহকরা তাদের পুরানো ফোনগুলি আরও বেশি সময় ধরে ধরে রেখেছেন।
bangla_paragraph5: শিল্প জুড়ে র্যামের ঘাটতি স্মার্টফোন উৎপাদনে খরচ চাপ যোগ করছে। এবং নতুন প্রযুক্তিতে অ্যাক্সেস পাওয়ার সস্তা উপায় হিসেবে প্রাক-মালিকানাধীন ডিভাইসের চাহিদা বাড়ছে।

title: The 12-year-old OnePlus One is now running Android 16 thanks to LineageOS
title_bn: ১২ বছরের ওয়ানপ্লাস ওয়ান এখন লিনিজওএস-এর জন্য অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ১৬ চালাচ্ছে।
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Android 17 is already next on the developer's agenda.
paragraph1: C. Scott Brown / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR The OnePlus One has received an unofficial Android 16 update through LineageOS 23.2, complete with the November 2026 security patch. Android 16 reportedly runs smoother than Android 14 and 15 on the 12-year-old phone, although SIM card compatibility remains limited. The developer is already planning to bring Android 17 to the original flagship killer. Apparently, it’s comeback season for old Android hardware. Hot on the heels of the original Samsung Galaxy Watch getting an unofficial Wear OS 3.
paragraph2: 5 port with Android 11, another piece of tech history is getting a new lease on life. This time, it’s the OnePlus One, which can now run Android 16 thanks to an unofficial LineageOS 23.2 build.The project is the work of developer Mezo123451. After months of development, the custom ROM is now live on XDA Forums, giving the 2014 flagship killer a taste of software released more than a decade after it first hit store shelves.The journey began about eight months ago when the developer shared their plans on Reddit. Understandably, not everyone was convinced.
paragraph3: Getting Android 16 to compile for the phone was one thing, but getting it to boot and actually work was another challenge entirely. Fast-forward to September, and the developer was back on Reddit with Android 16 booting on the OnePlus One. It wasn’t pretty, with graphical glitches and crashes still getting in the way. The latest video demonstration, however, paints a much more promising picture.The developer claims Android 16 sometimes feels even smoother than Android 14 and 15 on the same hardware, although occasional animation stutters remain. The Google Play Store works, as does the camera, including photo, video, and even panorama modes. More impressively, the phone is running the November 1, 2026, Android security patch, which some Pixel owners are still waiting for.
paragraph4: There are still some limitations, though. While the developer’s own SIM card works, compatibility across all carriers isn’t guaranteed. Still, seeing Google’s modern Android interface running this well on a Snapdragon 801 processor with just 3GB of RAM is quite a sight.There’s something particularly fitting about LineageOS bringing the OnePlus One back to life. The phone originally shipped with CyanogenMod, the very project from which LineageOS emerged. While the official LineageOS project has long since dropped support for the phone, the community clearly isn’t ready to call it quits.We ranked the original flagship killer among the best OnePlus phones of all time earlier this year, and its remarkable longevity certainly isn’t hurting its legacy.
paragraph5: Of course, few people are likely to dust off a 12-year-old phone and flash a custom ROM to make it their daily driver. But that’s hardly the point. In an industry obsessed with what’s next, it’s refreshing to see just how much life is left in what came before.And the developer isn’t stopping at Android 16. They’ve already set their sights on bringing Android 17 to the OnePlus One.
bangla_paragraph1: সি স্কট ব্রাউন / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ গুগলে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড অথরিটি যুক্ত করুনঃ TL;DR ওয়ানপ্লাস ওয়ানটি লিনিজওএস ২৩.২ এর মাধ্যমে একটি অনানুষ্ঠানিক অ্যান্ড্রিকোড ১৬ আপডেট পেয়েছে, যা নভেম্বর ২০২৬ এর সুরক্ষা প্যাচ সহ সম্পূর্ণ। অ্যান্ড্রিড ১৬ 12 বছরের পুরানো ফোনে অ্যান্ড্রেড ১৪ এবং ১৫ এর চেয়ে মসৃণভাবে চলেছে বলে জানা গেছে, যদিও সিম কার্ড সামঞ্জস্যতা সীমিত রয়েছে। বিকাশকারী ইতিমধ্যে অ্যান্ডারয়েড ১৭ কে মূল ফ্ল্যাগশিপ কিলারে আনতে পরিকল্পনা করছেন। দৃশ্যত এটি পুরানো অ্যান্ডরয়েড হার্ডওয়্যারের জন্য প্রত্যাবর্তনের মরসুম। হট অন হি।
bangla_paragraph2: অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ১১ এর সাথে 5 পোর্ট, প্রযুক্তি ইতিহাসের আরেকটি টুকরো নতুন জীবন পাচ্ছে। এবার, এটি ওয়ানপ্লাস ওয়ান, যা এখন অনানুষ্ঠানিক লাইনএজওএস ২৩.২ বিল্ডের জন্য অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড 16 চালাতে পারে। প্রকল্পটি বিকাশকারী মেজো 123451 এর কাজ। কয়েক মাসের বিকাশের পরে, কাস্টম রমটি এখন এক্সডিএ ফোরামে লাইভ রয়েছে, এটি প্রথম স্টোর তাক আঘাত করার এক দশকেরও বেশি পরে প্রকাশিত সফ্টওয়্যারটির স্বাদ দেয়। যাত্রাটি প্রায় আট মাস আগে শুরু হয়েছিল যখন বিকাশকারী তাদের পি ভাগ করে নিয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph3: অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ১৬ ফোনের জন্য কম্পাইল করা এক জিনিস, কিন্তু এটি বুট করা এবং আসলে কাজ করা সম্পূর্ণ অন্য চ্যালেঞ্জ ছিল। দ্রুত এগিয়ে সেপ্টেম্বরে, এবং বিকাশকারী ওয়ানপ্লাস ওয়ান এ অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড ১ 16 বুট করার সাথে রেডডিটে ফিরে এসেছিল। এটি সুন্দর ছিল না, গ্রাফিকাল ত্রুটি এবং ক্র্যাশ এখনও পথে পাড়ি দিয়েছিল। সর্বশেষ ভিডিও প্রদর্শন, তবে, একটি অনেক বেশি আশাব্যঞ্জক ছবি আঁকে। বিকাশকারী দাবি করে যে অ্যান্ড্রিক্স 16 কখনও কখনও একই হার্ডওয়্যারটিতে অ্যান্ড্রিড 14 এবং 15 এর চেয়েও মসৃণ মনে হয়।
bangla_paragraph4: যদিও এখনও কিছু সীমাবদ্ধতা রয়েছে। যদিও বিকাশকারীটির নিজস্ব সিম কার্ড কাজ করে, তবে সমস্ত ক্যারিয়ারে সামঞ্জস্যতা নিশ্চিত নয়। তবুও, গুগলের আধুনিক অ্যান্ড্রয়েড ইন্টারফেসটি কেবল 3 গিগাবাইট র্যাম সহ স্ন্যাপড্রাগন 801 প্রসেসরটিতে এত ভালভাবে চলছে তা দেখা বেশ দর্শনীয়। লাইনএজওএস ওয়ানপ্লাস ওয়ানকে আবার জীবিত করার বিষয়ে বিশেষভাবে উপযুক্ত কিছু রয়েছে। ফোনটি মূলত সায়ানোজেনমডের সাথে সরবরাহ করা হয়েছিল, যা লাইনএজেওএস উত্থিত হয়েছিল। যদিও অফিসিয়াল লাইনএজিওএস প্রকল্পটি l
bangla_paragraph5: অবশ্যই, খুব কম মানুষই ১২ বছরের পুরনো ফোনের ধুলো ধুয়ে ফেলবে এবং এটিকে তাদের দৈনন্দিন ড্রাইভার বানানোর জন্য একটি কাস্টম রম ফ্ল্যাশ করবে। কিন্তু এটি খুব কমই গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। পরবর্তী কী হবে তা নিয়ে শঙ্কিত একটি শিল্পে, এটি দেখতে শিথিল করা হয় যে এর আগে যা ছিল তাতে কত জীবন বাকি রয়েছে। এবং বিকাশকারী অ্যান্ড্রয়েড 16 এ থামছে না। তারা ইতিমধ্যে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড 17 কে ওয়ানপ্লাস ওয়ান এ নিয়ে আসার লক্ষ্যমাত্রা নির্ধারণ করেছে।

title: Google Home bug is cluttering device lists with redundant tiles
title_bn: গুগল হোম বাগ ডিভাইস তালিকা অপ্রয়োজনীয় টাইলস দিয়ে বিভ্রান্ত করছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Some devices are showing up as both lights and outlets.
paragraph1: Rita El Khoury / Android AuthorityAdd Android Authority on Google: TL;DR A Google Home bug is causing smart home devices to show up twice, with one tile identifying the device as a light and the other as an outlet or a wall switch. The issue affects devices from multiple manufacturers, including TP-Link Kasa and Leviton, and extends to the Google Home widget. The bug’s underlying cause remains unclear, and unlinking and relinking affected devices doesn’t appear to resolve the issue. Google Home‘s latest bug has some users seeing double — literally. A new glitch is currently causing users’ smart home devices to show up twice within the Google Home app, with one tile identifying the device for what it is and the other identifying it as an outlet or a wall switch.The bug first showed up early in November, though affected users report that it is still prevalent.
paragraph2: It doesn’t discriminate — the issue appears to affect devices from multiple manufacturers, with users indicating that the devices show up correctly within their respective companion apps. This confirms that the bug stems from Google Home and not the hardware.First reported by Reddit user TroVo05 earlier this month, their Kasa TP-Link switches have automatically duplicated. They added that favoriting the affected device doesn’t help either, as the Google Home app automatically favorites the duplicated one as well. This means the Google Home widget displays duplicates too. I have a switch that controls a light.
paragraph3: I call it sink light. But there is also showing an icon that looks like an outlet. Its the same device. Im trying to use favorites but when I favorite one the other automatically saves as well. User PlanktonOwn22 corroborated: This just happened to me with leviton devices. Randomly added a light bulb tile and outlet tile.
paragraph4: More recently, user CINAPTNOD doubled down on the fact that the bug is causing duplicates to show up as outlets: Model is KS225, should just be a light, now since yesterday it’s showing up twice with identical details except one has a light bulb icon and the other has an outlet icon. The duplication can be seen in the embeds above and below.Users have also added that long-pressing the duplicate says that the device is offline, while long-pressing the original shows the device as online. A different user added that the duplicates don’t show up when you go to the app’s Settings > Devices, groups, and rooms. This suggests that the bug only highlights duplicates in the app’s All devices and Favorites menus.Although the bug’s underlying cause remains unclear, some theorize that the October 29 Google Home update introduced it with the introduction of energy monitoring for compatible Matter devices.
paragraph5: This connection is unconfirmed.There doesn’t appear to be a reliable workaround for the bug just yet. Users have tried unlinking and relinking duplicated smart home devices to no avail. We’ve reached out to Google for a comment and will update this article if and when we hear back.Have you noticed duplicates in your Google Home app? Let us know in the comments below.
bangla_paragraph1: রিতা এল খুরি / অ্যান্ড্রয়েড কর্তৃপক্ষ গুগলে অ্যান্ড্ৰয়েড প্রশাসক যোগ করুনঃ TL;DR গুগল হোম বাগ স্মার্ট হোম ডিভাইসগুলিকে দুবার প্রদর্শিত হচ্ছে, একটি টাইল ডিভাইসের পরিচয় দেয় একটি আলো হিসাবে এবং অন্যটি একটি আউটলেট বা প্রাচীর সুইচ হিসাবে। সমস্যাটি টিপি-লিঙ্ক কাসা এবং লেভিটন সহ একাধিক নির্মাতার ডিভাইসে প্রভাবিত করে এবং গুগলের হোম উইজেটে প্রসারিত হয়। বাগগুলির অন্তর্নিহিত কারণটি এখনও অস্পষ্ট, এবং প্রভাবিত ডিভাইസগুলিকে সংযোগ বিচ্ছিন্ন এবং পুনরায় সংযুক্ত করা সমস্যাটি সমাধান করে না বলে মনে হচ্ছে। গুগুল হোম
bangla_paragraph2: এটি বৈষম্য করে না  সমস্যাটি একাধিক নির্মাতার ডিভাইসগুলিকে প্রভাবিত করে বলে মনে হচ্ছে, ব্যবহারকারীরা নির্দেশ করে যে ডিভাইসের সংশ্লিষ্ট সহযোগী অ্যাপ্লিকেশনগুলির মধ্যে ডিভাইসে সঠিকভাবে প্রদর্শিত হয়। এটি নিশ্চিত করে যে বাগটি গুগল হোম থেকে উদ্ভূত এবং হার্ডওয়্যার নয়। প্রথমবারের মতো এই মাসের শুরুর দিকে রেডডিট ব্যবহারকারী ট্রোভো05 দ্বারা রিপোর্ট করা হয়েছিল, তাদের কাসা টিপি-লিঙ্ক সুইচগুলি স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে সদৃশ হয়েছে। তারা যোগ করেছে যে প্রভাবিত ডিভাইসির পক্ষে পছন্দ করাও সাহায্য করে না, কারণ গুগলের হোম অ্যাপ্লিকেশানটি স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে সদ্রব্যাংশকে পছন্দ করে।
bangla_paragraph3: আমি এটিকে সিঙ্ক লাইট বলি। কিন্তু একটি আইকনও দেখানো হচ্ছে যা একটি আউটলেটের মতো দেখাচ্ছে। এটি একই ডিভাইস। আমি পছন্দগুলি ব্যবহার করার চেষ্টা করছি কিন্তু যখন আমি একটি পছন্দ করি তখন অন্যটি স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে সংরক্ষণ করে। ব্যবহারকারী প্লাঙ্কটনওন 22 নিশ্চিত করেছেঃ এটি কেবল লেভিটন ডিভাইসের সাথে আমার সাথে ঘটেছে। এলোমেলোভাবে একটি বাল্ব টাইল এবং আউটলেট টাইল যুক্ত করেছে।
bangla_paragraph4: সম্প্রতি, ব্যবহারকারী সিএনএপ্টনড এই সত্যটি দ্বিগুণ করেছে যে বাগটি ডুপ্লিকেটগুলিকে আউটলেট হিসাবে প্রদর্শিত হচ্ছেঃ মডেলটি কেএস 225 হয়, এটি কেবল একটি আলো হওয়া উচিত, এখন গতকাল থেকে এটি একটি বাল্ব আইকন এবং অন্যটির আউটলেটের আইকনের ব্যতীত একই বিবরণ সহ দুবার প্রদর্শনের জন্য। ডুপ্লিকেশনটি উপরে এবং নীচের এমবেডে দেখা যায়। ব্যবহারকারীরা আরও যোগ করেছেন যে দীর্ঘ চাপের ডুপ্লিক্যাটটি ডিভাইসটি অফলাইনে রয়েছে বলে বলে, মূলটি দীর্ঘ চাপ দিলে ডিভাইসের অনলাইন হিসাবে দেখায়। একটি পার্থক্য
bangla_paragraph5: এই সংযোগটি নিশ্চিত করা হয়নি। এই বাগটির জন্য এখনও নির্ভরযোগ্য সমাধান নেই বলে মনে হচ্ছে। ব্যবহারকারীরা অনুলিপিযুক্ত স্মার্ট হোম ডিভাইসগুলিকে সংযোগ বিচ্ছিন্ন এবং পুনরায় সংযোগ করার চেষ্টা করেছেন, কিন্তু ব্যর্থ হয়েছে। আমরা একটি মন্তব্যের জন্য গুগলের সাথে যোগাযোগ করেছি এবং যখন আমরা ফিরে আসব তখন এই নিবন্ধটি আপডেট করব। আপনি কি আপনার গুগল হোম অ্যাপে অনুলিপিক লক্ষ্য করেছেন? নীচের মন্তব্যে আমাদের জানান।

title: Best Black Friday phone deals on Samsung, Google, Nothing, and more

title: Apple iPhone 18e to MacBook Neo 2: 3 upcoming devices that could be easier on Indian buyers’ pockets
title_bn: অ্যাপল আইফোন ১৮ ই থেকে ম্যাকবুক নিও ২ঃ ৩টি আসন্ন ডিভাইস যা ভারতীয় ক্রেতাদের পকেটে সহজ হতে পারে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Apple is reportedly preparing three more affordable devices for early 2027, including the iPhone 18e, MacBook Neo 2 and a new entry-level iPad. Here is what the devices could offer and when Indian buyers may get to see them.
paragraph1: Apple is reportedly preparing a new range of devices for early 2027, with a focus on products that could be more affordable than its premium offerings. The expected launches include the iPhone 18e, the second-generation MacBook Neo and a new entry-level iPad. Will the rumoured Apple 2027 products be a little less stressful on the pockets of Indian buyers? The devices could give Indian buyers more options if they want to enter Apple's ecosystem without spending as much on its high-end products.According to a report by Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, Apple is planning to launch these products around February or March 2027. The company is also expected to introduce the standard iPhone 18 and an updated MacBook Air during the same period.Apple has not confirmed the launch dates, prices or specifications of these products. However, recent reports have offered some details about what buyers can expect.Apple iPhone 18e could get a new chip and better battery lifeThe iPhone 18e is expected to be one of Apple's more affordable smartphones in 2027. It will reportedly arrive as the successor to the iPhone 17e.According to reports, the phone could be powered by Apple's upcoming A20 chip. It may also come with 9GB of RAM and a bigger battery, which could help improve performance and battery life.
paragraph2: The A20 chip is expected to be used in the standard iPhone 18 as well. This could mean that buyers choosing the more affordable 18e model may still get access to Apple's newer processor.The iPhone 17e was launched in India at a starting price of ₹64,900. Apple has not revealed how much the iPhone 18e will cost. It is also too early to say whether the new model will be priced lower than its predecessor.The phone is expected to arrive around February or March 2027, although Apple has not announced a launch date. MacBook Neo 2 could get more RAM Apple is also reportedly working on the second generation of its MacBook Neo. The first MacBook Neo was launched in India in March 2026 at a starting price of ₹69,900.The laptop was introduced as a more affordable option for people who wanted a Mac without paying MacBook Air or MacBook Pro prices. It runs on the A18 Pro chip and is designed for everyday tasks such as browsing the internet, working on documents, watching videos and using apps.The upcoming MacBook Neo 2 could bring a processor upgrade. Reports suggest that it may use the A19 Pro chip instead of the A18 Pro processor found in the current model.
paragraph3: The laptop could also get 12GB of RAM, compared to the 8GB offered by the first generation. This may help it handle more apps at the same time and improve its overall performance.Apple could also introduce new colour options. However, there is no confirmation about changes to its design or other features.The MacBook Neo 2 is reportedly being prepared for a February or March 2027 launch. Its India price is not known yet. New entry-level iPad could support Apple Intelligence The third device on the list is an updated entry-level iPad. Apple is reportedly working on a new version that could arrive in early 2027.The biggest change could be its processor. Reports suggest that the tablet may use the A19 chip, which could bring a noticeable performance improvement over the current entry-level model.It may also support Apple Intelligence, Apple's set of AI features. The current entry-level iPad does not support these features, making this a possible upgrade for buyers who want to use Apple's newer software tools.
paragraph4: The tablet could also get Apple's N1 wireless chip, which is expected to bring support for newer Wi-Fi technology. Cellular versions may use the company's C1X modem.However, major design changes are not expected at this stage. The new iPad could retain a similar design and display to the existing model, with most of the changes focused on its internal hardware.When could these devices launch in India?Apple is reportedly planning to introduce the iPhone 18e, MacBook Neo 2 and new entry-level iPad around February or March 2027. The standard iPhone 18 and an updated MacBook Air could arrive during the same launch period.Other products, including the iPhone Air 2 and updated iPad Air and iPad Pro models, may follow later in the first half of 2027.For Indian buyers, the biggest question will be pricing. Apple has not announced the India prices of any of these upcoming devices. The final cost will determine how attractive they are to people looking for a more affordable Apple product.For now, buyers should treat the reported specifications and launch plans as early information.
paragraph5:
Apple is yet to officially announce any of these three devices.About the AuthorTrisha BhattacharyaTrisha Bhattacharya is a Senior Content Producer at Livemint, with over two years of experience covering entertainment news from India and beyond. She spends her days tracking what’s trending, breaking down pop culture moments, and turning fast-moving entertainment stories into sharp, engaging reads that actually make people want to click — and stay.
She holds a Master’s degree in English Literature from Lucknow University, a background that shapes her love for layered narratives, strong voices, and stories that linger long after they’re told. Before joining Livemint, Trisha worked with India Today as an entertainment journalist and film critic. There, she reviewed films, covered industry news, and built a strong foundation in storytelling and cultural analysis.
Trisha enjoys working at the intersection of media, culture, and audience interest, always looking for fresh angles and formats. Films, shows, and music are not just her beat but her biggest passion — something that naturally reflects in her writing. Whether it’s cinema, streaming shows, music, or internet trends, she approaches every story with curiosity and intent.
Outside the job description, she’s unapologetically passionate about films, shows, and music — sometimes a little too passionate, if you ask her. That enthusiasm often spills into her work, adding personality, urgency, and a touch of chaos that keeps her writing alive. For Trisha, entertainment isn’t just a beat — it’s a language she speaks fluently.

bangla_paragraph2: A20 চিপটি স্ট্যান্ডার্ড আইফোন 18 তেও ব্যবহার করা হবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। এর অর্থ এই হতে পারে যে আরও সাশ্রয়ী মূল্যের 18e মডেলটি বেছে নেওয়া ক্রেতারা এখনও অ্যাপলের নতুন প্রসেসরটিতে অ্যাক্সেস পেতে পারে। আইফোন 17e ভারতে 64900 এর একটি প্রারম্ভিক মূল্যে চালু হয়েছিল। অ্যাপল আইফোন 18-এর দাম কত তা প্রকাশ করেনি। নতুন মডেলটির দাম তার পূর্বসূরীর চেয়ে কম হবে কিনা তা বলা খুব তাড়াতাড়ি। ফোনটি 2027 সালের ফেব্রুয়ারি বা মার্চ মাসে আসবে বলে আশাবাদী, যদিও অ্যাপল এখনও ঘোষণা করেনি
bangla_paragraph3: ম্যাকবুক নিও ২ এর দাম এখনও জানা যায়নি। নতুন এন্ট্রি-লেভেল আইপ্যাড অ্যাপল ইন্টেলিজেন্সকে সমর্থন করতে পারে। ম্যাকবুক নিও 2 এর নকশা বা অন্যান্য বৈশিষ্ট্যগুলিতে পরিবর্তন সম্পর্কে কোনও নিশ্চিতকরণ নেই। ম্যাপবুক নিয়ো 2 ফেব্রুয়ারি বা মার্চ 2027 সালে চালু হওয়ার জন্য প্রস্তুত করা হচ্ছে বলে জানা গেছে। এর ভারতের দাম এখনও অজানা। নতুন প্রবেশ-স্তরের আইপ্যাক অ্যাপল বুদ্ধিমত্তা সমর্থন করতে পারেন।
bangla_paragraph4: ট্যাবলেটটি অ্যাপলের এন 1 ওয়্যারলেস চিপও পেতে পারে, যা নতুন ওয়াই-ফাই প্রযুক্তির জন্য সমর্থন আনবে বলে আশা করা হচ্ছে। সেলুলার সংস্করণগুলি কোম্পানির সি 1 এক্স মডেম ব্যবহার করতে পারে। তবে এই পর্যায়ে বড় ডিজাইনের পরিবর্তন প্রত্যাশিত নয়। নতুন আইপ্যাডটি বিদ্যমান মডেলের অনুরূপ নকশা এবং প্রদর্শন বজায় রাখতে পারে, বেশিরভাগ পরিবর্তনগুলি এর অভ্যন্তরীণ হার্ডওয়্যারে ফোকাস করে। এই ডিভাইসগুলি কখন ভারতে চালু হতে পারে?অ্যাপল আইফোন 18 ই, ন্যো ম্যাকবুক 2 এবং নতুন এন্ট্রি-লেভেল আইপ্যাক চালু করার পরিকল্পনা করছে বলে জানা গেছে।
bangla_paragraph5:
অ্যাপল এখনও এই তিনটি ডিভাইসের মধ্যে কোনওটি আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে ঘোষণা করতে পারেনি।লেখক সম্পর্কেত্রিশা ভট্টাচার্যত্রিষা ভট্টচার্য লাইভমিন্টের একজন সিনিয়র কনটেন্ট প্রযোজক, যিনি ভারত এবং এর বাইরে থেকে বিনোদনমূলক সংবাদগুলি কভার করার দুই বছরেরও বেশি অভিজ্ঞতা অর্জন করেছেন। তিনি তার দিনগুলি ট্রেন্ডিং কী তা ট্র্যাকিংয়ে, পপ সংস্কৃতির মুহুর্তগুলি ভেঙে এবং দ্রুত চলমান বিনোদনা গল্পগুলিকে ধারালো, আকর্ষক পাঠগুলিতে পরিণত করে যা আসলে মানুষকে ক্লিক করতে এবং থাকতে চায়।
তিনি ইংরেজি সাহিত্যে স্নাতকোত্তর ডিগ্রি অর্জন করেছেন

title: Maharashtra GST Authorities Search Turtlemint’s Insurance Broking Arm
title_bn: মহারাষ্ট্রের জিএসটি কর্তৃপক্ষ টার্টমিন্টের বীমা ব্রোকারদের তালাচায়
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Maharashtra GST authorities have initiated inspection, search and seizure proceedings against Turtlemint Insurance Broking Services (TIB), a wholly owned subsidiary…
paragraph1: SUMMARYMaharashtra GST officials inspected Turtlemint's Mumbai premises on November 23 under Section 67 of the Maharashtra GST Act Turtlemint said its operations remain unaffected and that it is cooperating with the authorities Q2 FY27 revenue rose 35.3% YoY to ₹342.2 Cr, while net losses narrowed 67% to ₹25.83 Cr Maharashtra GST authorities have initiated inspection, search and seizure proceedings against Turtlemint Insurance Broking Services (TIB), a wholly owned subsidiary of listed insurtech company Turtlemint Fintech Solutions. Turtlemint, in an exchange filing, said the proceedings began yesterday at the subsidiary’s registered office in Andheri East, Mumbai under Section 67 of the Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017. The company did not disclose the specific alleged violations or a tax demand. It said the financial, operational, or other impact could not currently be quantified because the proceedings were ongoing. “TIB is extending full cooperation to the concerned authorities and is providing the requisite information, documents and clarifications as may be required in connection with the proceedings,” it said.
paragraph2: Turtlemint added that regular business operations at both the parent company and its subsidiary remain unaffected. It said it would inform the stock exchanges of further developments, including the conclusion of the proceedings. Inside Turtlemint’s Distribution Business Founded in 2015 by Dhirendra Mahyavanshi and Anand Prabhudesai, Turtlemint operates an insurance distribution platform that enables financial advisors to sell motor, health, and life insurance. Its model combines an advisor network with digital tools for comparing and selling policies, training, and back-end support. The company earns revenue through commissions and fees from insurers and other financial services providers. Turtlemint had a digital partner network of over 6.59 Lakh at the end of FY26, following the addition of more than 1.15 Lakh partners during the year.
paragraph3: It worked with 46 insurer partners and issued 7.83 Mn policies in FY26. The GST proceedings come less than five months after the company’s stock market debut in June. Its ₹882.7 Cr IPO comprised a fresh issue of ₹660.7 Cr and an offer for sale of 1.46 Cr shares. Its shares listed at ₹136.
paragraph4: 20 on the BSE, a 10.4% discount to the ₹152 issue price. The GST action adds to regulatory concerns surrounding Turtlemint, whose shares have faced selling pressure following IRDAI’s draft proposals to cap insurance commissions, potentially squeezing its distribution revenue. On the financial front, the company reported a 67% YoY reduction in its net loss to ₹25.8 Cr in Q2 FY27. Operating revenue increased 35.3% YoY to ₹342.2 Cr.
paragraph5: Sequentially, revenue grew 16%, while net loss narrowed 32% from ₹37.8 Cr. Shares of the company ended today’s trading session 0.60% lower at ₹64.63 on the BSE.
bangla_paragraph1: সারসংক্ষেপ মহারাষ্ট্র জিএসটি আইন-এর ৬৭ ধারার আওতায় ২৩ নভেম্বর টার্টলমিন্টের মুম্বাইয়ের কার্যালয় পরিদর্শন করলেন মহারাষ্ট্রে জিএসটির কর্মকর্তারা। টার্টালমিন্টে বলা হয়েছে, তার কার্যক্রম এখনও প্রভাবিত হয়নি এবং এটি কর্তৃপক্ষের সাথে সহযোগিতা করছে। দ্বিতীয় অর্থবছরের দ্বিতীয় প্রান্তিকে রাজস্ব ৩৫.৩ শতাংশ বেড়ে ৩৪২.২ কোটি টাকা হয়েছে।
bangla_paragraph2: টার্টলমিন্ট যোগ করেছে যে মূল সংস্থা এবং এর সহায়ক সংস্থা উভয়ের নিয়মিত ব্যবসায়িক ক্রিয়াকলাপ প্রভাবিত হয়নি। এটি বলেছে যে এটি কার্যক্রম সমাপ্তি সহ আরও উন্নয়নের বিষয়ে স্টক এক্সচেঞ্জকে অবহিত করবে। টার্টালমিনটের বিতরণ ব্যবসায়ের ভিতরে ধীরেন্দ্র মহ্যাবংশী এবং আনন্দ প্রভূদৈশির দ্বারা ২০১৫ সালে প্রতিষ্ঠিত, টার্ট্যালমিনট একটি বীমা বিতরণ প্ল্যাটফর্ম পরিচালনা করে যা আর্থিক উপদেষ্টাদের মোটর, স্বাস্থ্য এবং জীবন বীমা বিক্রি করতে সক্ষম করে। এর মডেলটি একটি উপদেষ্টার নেটওয়ার্ককে একত্রিত করে।
bangla_paragraph3: এটি ৪৬ টি বীমা অংশীদারদের সাথে কাজ করেছে এবং ২ 26 অর্থবছরে ৭.৮৩ মিলিয়ন পলিসি জারি করেছে। জুন মাসে কোম্পানির স্টক মার্কেটে আত্মপ্রকাশের পাঁচ মাসেরও কম সময়ে জিএসটি কার্যক্রম শুরু হয়েছে। এর ৮৮২.৭ কোটি টাকার আইপিওতে ৬৬০.৭ কোটির একটি নতুন ইস্যু এবং ১.৪৬ কোটি টাকায় শেয়ার বিক্রির প্রস্তাব অন্তর্ভুক্ত ছিল। এর শেয়ারগুলি ১৩৬ টাকায় তালিকাভুক্ত।
bangla_paragraph4: বিএসইতে ২০, ১৫২ টাকার ইস্যু মূল্যের উপর ১০.৪% ছাড়। জিএসটি পদক্ষেপটি টার্টলমিন্টের আশেপাশের নিয়ন্ত্রক উদ্বেগকে আরও বাড়িয়ে তোলে, যার শেয়ারগুলি আইআরডিএআইয়ের বিমা কমিশন সীমাবদ্ধ করার খসড়া প্রস্তাবের পরে বিক্রয় চাপের মুখোমুখি হয়েছে, সম্ভাব্যভাবে তার বিতরণ রাজস্বকে সংকুচিত করেছে। আর্থিক ক্ষেত্রে, সংস্থাটি তার নেট ক্ষতিতে ২ য় অর্থবছরের দ্বিতীয় প্রান্তিকে ২৫.৮ কোটি টাকায় ৬৭% হ্রাসের কথা জানিয়েছে। অপারেটিং রাজস্ব ৩৫.৩% বৃদ্ধি পেয়ে ৩৪২.২ কোটি টাকার দিকে চলেছে।
bangla_paragraph5: এই ব্যবসায়িক সেশনের শেষে শেয়ারের মূল্য ₹৬৪.৬৩ শতাংশ কমেছে।

title: GMP Not Indicator Of Expected Returns: SEBI Seeks To Curb IPO GMP Circulation
title_bn: জিএমপি প্রত্যাশিত রিটার্নের সূচক নয়: সেবি আইপিওর জিএমপির প্রচলন রোধে কাজ করছে
author: TechPulse
excerpt: Markets regulator SEBI has moved to curb the publication and circulation of grey market premium (GMP) figures for upcoming IPOs.…
paragraph1: SUMMARYSEBI has advised market participants and registered intermediaries to discontinue publishing, displaying or circulating GMP figures for upcoming IPOs. Investors often track GMP to estimate the potential listing price of an IPO and the profits they could make by selling their allotted shares on listing day. The regulator has warned that GMP transactions are unregulated and offer no investor protection or formal dispute redressal mechanisms. Markets regulator SEBI has moved to curb the publication and circulation of grey market premium (GMP) figures for upcoming IPOs. The regulator has cautioned investors against treating such figures as indicators of potential listing gains.
paragraph2: In an advisory, the market regulator asked all SEBI-registered intermediaries and market participants to refrain from publishing GMP figures across communication channels. For context, GMP refers to the unofficial premium at which shares are reportedly traded in the grey market before their formal listing on stock exchanges. Investors often track these figures to gauge market sentiment around an IPO and estimate potential listing gains before investing. A rising GMP is generally interpreted as a sign of stronger demand and expectations of listing gains, while a falling or negative premium can signal weaker sentiment. Like the name suggests, such figures are speculative.
paragraph3: However, reported premium offers an informal estimate of the price at which a company’s shares could list on stock exchanges. Investors use it to calculate potential gains if they receive an allotment and sell their shares after listing. SEBI added that grey-market transactions take place outside its recognised framework, without any investor protection or a formal price-discovery mechanism. Consequently, investors relying heavily on GMP risk basing their subscription decisions on unofficial market sentiment rather than the company itself. “The publication of such pre-listing premium figures may be detrimental to the interests of investors and contrary to the core principles of transparency and accountability in the securities market,” the regulator said.
paragraph4: SEBI FlagSEBIs Risks Around Unregulated GMP Transactions SEBI’s advisory highlights the lack of regulatory oversight and investor protection in grey-market transactions. Unlike trades conducted through recognised stock exchanges, grey-market transactions take place outside the formal securities market framework. They carry no settlement guarantee or investor protection and are not subject to a regulated price-discovery process The regulator has clarified that investors involved in disputes arising from GMP transactions will not be able to access investor protection benefits under SEBI or stock exchange jurisdiction. They will also be unable to approach stock exchange grievance redressal mechanisms or the online dispute resolution (ODR) portal administered by exchanges and depositories. SEBI has advised investors not to treat GMP as an indicator of an IPO’s likely listing price or expected returns.
paragraph5: It has also urged them to avoid GMP-linked transactions and subscribe to IPOs exclusively through SEBI-registered intermediaries and authorised platforms. The regulator further said that the publication, display, circulation or dissemination of unregulated pre-listing premiums across the securities market may be discontinued.
bangla_paragraph1: সংক্ষিপ্তসার এসইবিআই বাজারের অংশগ্রহণকারীদের এবং নিবন্ধিত মধ্যস্থতাকারীদের আসন্ন আইপিওগুলির জন্য জিএমপি পরিসংখ্যান প্রকাশ, প্রদর্শন বা প্রচলন বন্ধ করার পরামর্শ দিয়েছে। বিনিয়োগকারীরা প্রায়শই একটি আইপিএর সম্ভাব্য তালিকাভুক্তি মূল্য এবং তালিকাভুদ্ধকরণের দিনে তাদের বরাদ্দকৃত শেয়ার বিক্রি করে তারা যে মুনাফা অর্জন করতে পারে তা অনুমান করার জন্য জিএমইপি ট্র্যাক করে। নিয়ন্ত্রক সতর্ক করেছে যে জিএমপির লেনদেন অনিয়ন্ত্রিত এবং বিনিয়োগকারীদের সুরক্ষা বা আনুষ্ঠানিক বিরোধ নিষ্পত্তি প্রক্রিয়া সরবরাহ করে না। বাজার নিয়ন্ত্রকের সেবি জনসাধারণকে সীমাবদ্ধ করতে চলেছে।
bangla_paragraph2: একটি উপদেষ্টা বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে, বাজার নিয়ন্ত্রক সমস্ত সেবি-নিবন্ধিত মধ্যস্থতাকারী এবং বাজার অংশগ্রহণকারীদের যোগাযোগ চ্যানেল জুড়ে জিএমপি পরিসংখ্যান প্রকাশ থেকে বিরত থাকতে বলেছে। প্রসঙ্গের জন্য, জিএমপির অর্থ হল অ-অফিসিয়াল প্রিমিয়াম যা শেয়ারগুলি শেয়ারবাজারে তাদের আনুষ্ঠানিক তালিকাভুক্তকরণের আগে ধূসর বাজারে বাণিজ্য করা হয়। বিনিয়োগকারীরা প্রায়শই একটি আইপিওর আশেপাশে বাজারের আবেগ পরিমাপ করতে এবং বিনিয়োগের আগে সম্ভাব্য তালিকাভর্তি লাভের অনুমান করতে এই পরিসংখ্যাগুলি ট্র্যাক করে। একটি ক্রমবর্ধমান জিএমपी সাধারণত একটি  হিসাবে ব্যাখ্যা করা হয়
bangla_paragraph3: তবে, রিপোর্ট করা প্রিমিয়ামটি এমন একটি মূল্যের একটি অনানুষ্ঠানিক অনুমান দেয় যার উপর কোনও সংস্থার শেয়ারগুলি স্টক এক্সচেঞ্জে তালিকাভুক্ত হতে পারে। বিনিয়োগকারীরা এটি ব্যবহার করে যদি তারা একটি বরাদ্দ গ্রহণ করে এবং তালিকাভর্তির পরে তাদের শেয়ার বিক্রি করে তবে সম্ভাব্য লাভের গণনা করে। সেবি যোগ করেছে যে ধূসর বাজারের লেনদেনগুলি কোনও স্বীকৃত কাঠামোর বাইরে, কোনও বিনিয়োগকারী সুরক্ষা বা আনুষ্ঠানিক মূল্য আবিষ্কারের প্রক্রিয়া ছাড়াই ঘটে। ফলস্বরূপ, জিএমপিতে প্রচুর পরিমাণে নির্ভরশীল বিনিয়োগকারীগুলি তাদের সাবস্ক্রিপশন সিদ্ধান্তগুলিকে অনানুଷ୍ଠାନিক মার্কেজিংয়ের ভিত্তিতে ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ করে তোলে।
bangla_paragraph4: সেবি ফ্ল্যাগসেবির অনিয়ন্ত্রিত জিএমপি লেনদেনের আশেপাশের ঝুঁকিসেবি'র উপদেষ্টা গ্রাই মার্কেট লেনদেনে নিয়ন্ত্রক তদারকি এবং বিনিয়োগকারীদের সুরক্ষার অভাবকে তুলে ধরেছে। স্বীকৃত স্টক এক্সচেঞ্জের মাধ্যমে পরিচালিত লেনদের বিপরীতে, গ্রাই-মার্কেট ণ লেনদা আনুষ্ঠানিক সিকিউরিটিজ মার্কেটের কাঠামোর বাইরে ঘটে। তারা কোনও নিষ্পত্তি গ্যারান্টি বা বিনিয়োগকারীদের রক্ষা বহন করে না এবং একটি নিয়ন্ত্রিত মূল্য আবিষ্কার প্রক্রিয়া সাপেক্ষে নয় নিয়ন্ত্রকের স্পষ্ট করে দিয়েছে যে বিরোধে জড়িত বিনিয়োগকারীরা উত্থাপিত হয়
bangla_paragraph5: এই নির্দেশিকা অনুযায়ী, জিএমপি-সংযুক্ত লেনদেন এড়াতে এবং কেবলমাত্র সেবি-পঞ্জীকৃত মধ্যস্থতাকারী এবং অনুমোদিত প্ল্যাটফর্মের মাধ্যমে আইপিওতে সাবস্ক্রাইব করতে হবে।
